tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/rjai rat+na'i bka' 'bum ga pa'i dkar chag gi rim pa'i dbu phyogs bzhugs so/ /ka)phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len nyung ngur/kha)lnga ldan bsdus pa
༄༅/rjai rat+na'i bka' 'bum ga pa'i dkar chag gi rim pa'i dbu phyogs bzhugs so/ /ka)phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len nyung ngur/kha)lnga ldan bsdus pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rjai rat+na'i bka' 'bum ga pa'i dkar chag gi rim pa'i dbu phyogs bzhugs so// ka)phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len nyung ngur/ kha)lnga ldan bsdus pa/ ga)phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag snying po bsdus pa/ nga)dpal nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi rim pa*/ nga)drod btsan thabs su sbar ba gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ca)mkha' 'gro snying tig gi grol byed khrid kyi zin bris ye shes gsal ba'i mkha' klong*/ cha)rgya gar gyi grub chen dza har pīr gyi snyan rgyud zab mo/ ja)dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza har pīr las brgyud pa'i rlung khrid las 'byung 'khrugs kyi gegs sel/ nya) skyob pa rin po che'i zab chos las bsrung 'khor zhal gdams/ ta)ye ge gsum gyi bsrung ba dang ku su li'i tshogs bsog ta)ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur/ ta)zab lam snyan brgyud/ ta)nam mkha' zhal/ tha)tshe khrid kyi man ngag snying po bsdus pa*/ da)rdzogs pa chen po mngon sum gyis nyams len gnad kyi man ngag na)gsang ba mchog lam gyi lo rgyus/ pa)mchog lam gsang ba'i rgyud bu chung le'u lnga pa/ pha)thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lum gyi cho ga dang dbang gi rim pa/ ba) gsang ba mchog lam gyi gtor ma'i dpe'u ris/ ma)thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi bskyed rim 'jig rten dbang phyug

(2)rig lnga/ tsa) mgon po 'phrin las myur mgyogs/ tsha)gsang ba mchog lam rdzogs rim thugs rje chan po rgyud bshad/ dza)rgyud kyi lung bstan/ wa)gnam mtsho sen mo dor rtogs ldan kun dga' shes rab dang gu re gnyer pa gnyis rdzangs pa'i ri chos dang*/ wa)snyen gnas kyi mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam bzang*/ zha)sems bskyed kyi cho ga yid bzhin nu+or buzhos bya ba/ za)dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro'i dbang gi phreng ba zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde/'a)sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dkyil gyi lha mtshan dang mtshon yig kun sgṛl bas nyis brgya dang so bdun bzhugs/ (3) ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len nyung ngur bstan pa bzhugs so//༄༅/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gdams pa nyams len du bstan pa tshig nyung ngur bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir mdo dang rgyud sde bstan bcos man ngag ma lus pa'i don nyams len du bstan pa zab mo lnga ldan gyi gdams pa nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo bas chos kyis nyams su blang*// zhes pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ stan bde ba la lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas 'dug ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshe rabs du mar bdag gi ma byas pa'i drin can sha stag yin te/ 'di rnams thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes byams pa dang snying rje kun rdzob byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i ngang las oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid do// de'i ngang las rang gi 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/

nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ hūm̐ gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang*/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me dpung chen po rab tu (4)'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i gur khang sra brtan mi shigs pa'i dbus kyi sa bon de nyid rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ham̐'u gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed mnan pa'i dpang du/ rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas 'khril ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur/ de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang*/ go cha'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i sa bon rnams kyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phraus bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par mos shing*/ sgom pas skyo na/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng (5)'thon te rang gi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ pad+ma nas rdo rje'i lam du 'khor bzhin par mos te/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces yab dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces yum gyi snying po bzla bar bya'o// mthar thun bsdu bar 'dod na/

thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud yi dam yab yum gyi bskur gsal ba rnams bsdus ste/ bsrung 'khor yab la/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ḥgi nā da'i bar bsdus te/ mi dmigs par gzhag go /gsum pa ni/ gong ltar rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar/ gyad dang seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ sku mdog sngo bsangs dar dang rin po ches brgyan zhing*/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can du mos te/ yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs bsagasacing maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ (6)sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ dbang rnam pa bzhi bskur bas sku bzhi thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ mthar bla ma rang la thim/ dbyer med spros bral du mnyam par gzhag go/ bzhi pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du bya/ ngag long gtam gyi smra ba bcad/ yid snga phyi dus gsum gyi dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rnam rtog gi dbang du mi btang par lta stangs las yengs su skad cig kyang mi gzhug de la rnam rtog gi 'du 'phro gang byung yang mi brtan gyi/ ngo bo la cer gyis ma yengs par blta ste/ ji skad du/ bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig mi gzhug pa// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag yin// zhes pas/ thog mar rtog pa phra rags kyi 'char sgo ji snyed cig byung yang*/ gong bzhin du nyams len byas pas sems nyon mongs dang rnam par rtog pa gang gis kyang mi g.yo ba ni zhi bar gnas pa/

de'i rang mdangs kyi rtsal 'gag med du 'char yang gsal stong dri ma med pa'i ngo bor rtogs pa ni lhag mthong ngo*// bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum gyis mtshon te/ ting nge 'dzin de nyid las mi 'pho ba ni rtse gcig snang rtsal 'gag med kyi cho 'phrul ji ltar shar yang gsal stong rig pa'i rang 'od du shar ba ni spros bral/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos can thams cad ma lus pa chos nyid du rtogs pa ni ro gcig rang rig ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ 'pho 'gyur dang the tshom bral bas/ sangs rgyas dang (7)sems can gyi re dogs bral ba ni sgom du med pa ste/ rnal 'byor bcu gnyis kyi lam rtags myong*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes lhug par shar te/ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par 'gyur ro// lnga pa ni de ltar nyams su len pa'i thun so so'i mthar yang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba'i cho ga la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i tshul nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di yang*/ stod lung snang rtse gzhis ka nas mi bdag nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis bskul ba las/ 'bri gung bya bral ba rat+na'i ming can 'dzin pas/ gdan sa chen po mthil gyi gnas mchog khang gsar yang dgon kyi 'og min du bris pa'o/// /maṅgal// ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/ ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag sbyin par 'dod pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de yi phyir du phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag nyams su blangs nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig de yang dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/

byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su blang*// zhes don rnam pa lngar gsungs pa las/ gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ bzhi pa dngos gzhi dang*/ lnga pa rjes so// dang po ni/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ byams dang snying rje'i rta pho la// gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na// khrom lha mi'i 'or che mi 'byung bas// sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs pas rang nyid 'khor bar yang nas yang du nying mtshams (11)sbyar ba'i tshe/ sems can re res ma byas pa'i lan grangs la'ang thug pa med par gsungs te/ bshes spring las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam// ril lur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur// zhes pas/ de ltar ma byas pa'i tshe na yang phan pa bsgrubs shing gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i drin dran pa'i sgo nas/ drin lan legs par blan pa'i sems kyi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa rnams la brtse ba bskyed de/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las grol 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ de ltar sdug bsngal dang bral yang byang chub kyi go 'phang ma thob na 'khor ba las mi 'da' bas/ mchog gi go 'phang thob 'dod smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de dag gi phyir du gdams pa nyams su blang ba ni 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems rnams bskyed par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lnga ldan rtogs mgur las/ rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la/ (12) /gzhi 'gyur med kyi brtan sa ma zin na// ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs mi 'du bas// lus yi dam gyi lha la nan tan mdzod// ces dang*/ tha mal rnam rtog gzhom don du// bsgom pa 'di ni rab tu bsgrags// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du bsam/

de'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gis 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi rol me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon du zla ba phyed pas mtshan zhing*/ thod pa rkam rlon gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rnam par mdzes pa'i sku/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs klubs shing*/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs dus kyi gdan la (13)rol pa/ de'i dpang du rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rtsa zhal khro bo'i bzhin can gyi rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing dbu skra lcang lo rgyab tu grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa'i tshul gyi yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang*/ go cha'i lha'am sa bon bkod la/ yab kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs te/ mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag

/chu'i lhag ma las yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par bsam la/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang las bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng thon ste/ yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ gsang gnas las brgyud cing 'khor ba la dmigs te yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gi sngags rnams bzla bar bya'o// thun bsdu bar 'dod na bsrung 'khor yab yum la bsdu/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ de yang zhabs (14)kyu/ khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le'i bar du bsdus la/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag bsngo ba bya'o// gsum pa ni rtogs mgur las/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la la nan tan mdzod// ces dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod par rab tu brtsam// de mnyes pa las kun mkhyen gyi// go 'phang mchog ni thob par gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor gyad dang seng ge snol bas btegs pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba de'i steng du/ pad+ma nyi zla dar zab kyi 'bol gdan rab tu yangs pa'i spo la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi skur snang ba ni/ sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pas bskor nas bzhugs par mos te/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung dang maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha 'phros/

rang gi sgo gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi dri ma ma (15)lus pa dag sku gsung thugs rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas/ mthar rdo rje 'chang 'khor bcas 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim zhing dbyer med du bsam zhing*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// bzhi pa ni/ lnga ldan rtogs mgur las/ sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dengs na// mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas// sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i gdams pa la bzhi ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan gyi nges tshig gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa/ lam phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni dka' 'grel pad+ma can las/ phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed par mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yin la/ rab du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ mi 'pho ba'i bde bas rgyas btab pas na phyag rgya ste/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya las khyad par du gyur pa'am/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral bar gyur pas na chen po'o// zhes sogs gsung pa'i don dran par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ dngos po med la (16)sgom pa med// sgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin// de ltar dngos po dngos min phyir// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar lta ba rtogs par byaid pa la zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis rnal 'byor nyams su blang dgos te/ dang po ni/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/

lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya/ rgal tshigs bsrang*/ kos ko cung zad bkug mchu so rang babs su bzhag lta stangs sna rtser gtad de/ sems 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang mi g.yo bar/ rang babs kyi ngo bo la mnyam par gzhag ces te/ sems g.yeng ba shas che na/ rlung phyi nang du rgyu ba la sems gtad pa kho na rgyun bsrings pas/ gnas cha brtan par 'gyur ro// de'i tshe bying rmugs byung na/ lta stangs kyis bstod cing*/ rlung ro 'bud/ shes pa hur phyung ste gzhag 'phro zhing rgod na lta stangs smad cing*/ shes pa lhod kyis glod la bzhag go /de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ dang po ri gzar gyi ngos nas chu 'bab pa lta bu'i nyams dang*/ gnyis pa chu bo chen po dal gyi 'bab pa lta bu/ gsum pa chu phran rgya mtsho dang 'dres pa lta bu ste/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// de nas lhag mthong ngo sprod pa dang*/ de'i steng du mnyam par 'jog pa gnyis las/ dang po ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin du ngo bos stong*// zhes gsung (17)pas/ de lta bu'i don la 'jog pa ni lta ba/ yengs med rgyun chags su skyong ba ni sgom pa/ de nyid kyi ngang nas sdig pa'i chos spong du med cing*/ dge ba'i chos cha dang bcas pa dor du med par stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi 'dor bar spyod pa ste spyod pa/ de ltar lta spyod gsum rnam par dag pas nyams su blang ba la brten/ gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu ji ltar thob pa yang*/ ji skad du/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni// thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu'o// zhes bshad pa ltar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin steng 'grus med par nyams su blangs pas rnal 'byor bzhi chung 'bring chen po rnams rim gyis thob par 'gyur ro// lnga pa phyag rgya chen po sngon 'gro dang bcas pa nyams su len pa'i thun so so'i mthar/

dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che ste/ rtogs mgur las/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu la// smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rang re'i bstan 'dzin sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan du mas phyug pa/ dpal ri bo che'i dge slong rnam rgyal bzang pos bskul ba las/ 'bri gung gi phyogs su gnas pa'i snyoms las pa rat+na'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// lan gcig zhus so/ mad+galaṃ//

༄༅// lnga ldan bsdus pa zhig bzhugs so// ma gyur nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bral ba'i snying rje dang*// bde ba phun tshogs dang ldan byams par bcas// bla med byang chub thob 'dod smon sems dang*// de phyir lnga ldan lam sgom 'jug par bcas// thams cad mnyam nyid don dam sems bskyed do// de las pad dkar 'dab brgya zla ba'i dbus// rang lus spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi rin chen dar gyis brgyan// dang po thal sbyar shel 'phreng pad dkar 'dzin// rdo rjai skyil krung thugs kar zla steng hrīḥ /snying po yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ spyi bor rang gi bla ma ngo bo'i sku// sku mdog dkar dmar mnyam gzhag skyil krung bzhugs// spyi bor oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ mthing rang mdog 'od zer 'phro// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// oṃ gyi 'od kyis lus sbyangs bum dbang thob// ā yi 'od kyis ngag sbyangs gsang dbang thob// hūm̐ gi 'od (22)kyis yid sbyangs sher dbang thob// bla ma 'od zhu rang thim sgrib gnyis sbyang*// dbang bzhi ma lus yongs rdzogs thob par gyur// rdo rje skyil krung lus bsrang mgrin pa sgu// dpung pa brgyang zhing mnyam gzhag lte 'og bca'// blta stangs la gzhag lce rtse cung zad bsgril// yod med brtag dpyad sgrim lhod rtsol med par// bsgom med yengs med rang gshis rang 'gros gzhag /gshis las ma g.yos bde gsal mi rtog sogs// nyams myong rtogs pa'i ye shes rjen par 'char// nyon mongs rnam rtog bag chags rkyen kun la// spang blang bcos bral rang gshis nyid bskyangs te// spras spros bcos sgyur mtshan ma med par bzhag /de yis bgegs sel bogs thon rang rig la// dbang 'byor dang po'i sangs rgyas rang zhal mthong*// de 'ang lnga ldan rtogs pa'i mgur las// sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dengs na// mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi 'char bas// sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod// (23)ces gsungs/

sems nyid gshis kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' la// 'khor 'das chos tshul dkar nag sprin 'dra ste// bzang ngan du 'ang bcos slad gyur pa na// nyi ltar dngos po gshis kyi gnas tshul dang*// ji snyed shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mi mkhyen pas// rtog dang mi rtog mtshan 'dzin kun 'das pa// rtog bral phyag chen gnas lugs la zhog cig /'dus dang 'dus ma byas dang yod pa yi// dge tshogs ji snyed bdag gzhan sems can rnams// bla med byang chub myur du thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa 'di bon po tshul khrims 'od zer gyis nyams blangs 'khyer bde ba'i phyir bskur ba las// 'bri gung pa rat+nas zho spro lung gi sgar du bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/ ༄༅// dpal nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi rim pa bzhugs so/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru wa ḍā ki ni ye/ dpal nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi rim pa'i bye brag rab tu gsal bar phyai ba rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rgyud srung chos bdag ḍā ki'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin brjod bral ye khyab dbyings kyi klong*// kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi rol pa can// sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la 'dud// nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+ma'i tshal dbye ltar// 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis bskrun pa'i lus ngag yid// rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su gsal mdzad pa'i// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma spyi bos bsten// dus gsum bde chen rgyal ba'i zhing khams su// 'khor 'das ro mnyam dpal gyis 'byor pa'i dbus// snang stong dbyer med dang (26)po'i sangs rgyas dngos// chen gsum 'dzin grol rje btsun kun dgas skyongs// mdo rgyud don gyi bstan bcos bcud bsdus pa'i// zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gdams pa ni// bod yul dbus 'dir gzhung bzang mang grags pa// de kun rang bzhin bzhed pa'i srol bstan mod// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'bri gung rin chen gyi// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs bstan pa'i don nyams len// bstan pa'i 'phrin las phyogs bcur 'gyed brtson rnams// khrid yig rin chen dbang phreng 'di la bsnyen// de la 'dir 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du bka' brgyud mu tig gi phreng ba lta bur rim par phebs pa kun gyi snying po'i bstan pa rin po che la mdzad pa rlabs po che gong 'phel dang*/

bstan pa'i rgyun gyi lam bzang gi srol chen gtod par mdzad cing*/ nā ro'i chos drug la sogs kyi khrid yig gi tshogs kyang*/ de dus kyi gdul bya'i dbang po dang 'tshams par bstan 'dug kyang*/ da lta'i dus na shes rab dman pa dang spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyis (27)bltas tshe/ go rim sgrig cung zad dka' zhing tshig gi tshogs bsdus pa la dgongs/ rgyal dbang a nan+da rat+na dharma dh+wa dza shrī bha dra'i zhabs kyis/ so so'i gzhung la 'thad pa'i lung rigs du mas brgyan pa'i sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba sogs gnang ba kun/ 'dir phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid la byi dor dang*/ rje btsun yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gsob pa dang*/ rang re'i brgyud 'dzin kun la phan pa'i 'dun pa kho na las te/ rnyed bsnyen zang zing mkhas 'dod sgra sgrogs kyi phyir du bdag gzhan kun la ma sems shig de la thog mar re zhig theg pa spyi dang bye brag sngags kyi spyod tshul la brten nas lam bgrod pa'i zab khyad kyi dbye ba cung zad shes dgos te/ de yang dang po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i yid dang 'tshams par gsung gcig nyid du'ang theg pa'i mtha' bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams ni/ gang zag so so'i dbang po'i spobs pa las te/ bgrang ba'i spyod yul las 'das so// de rnams las rags pa gtso bor bton pa/ theg pa gsum zhes grags pa'i theg pa chen po nyid la'ang*/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par spyod pa spyad pas bla med kyi byang chub 'thob la/ phyi ma'i lam la zhugs pas ni skal rab mchog tu mos gus dang brtson 28)'grus chen po'i go bgos shing lam gyi gnad phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la bsten na tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob la/

'bring gi slob pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du byed/ skal dman brtson par mi ldan pas kyang srid pa bar do'am skyai ba rgyud nas sangs rgyas 'grub par gsungs te/ ye shes thig ler/ blo gros che yang theg gzhan gyis// grangs med gsum gyi sangs rgyas yin// zhes dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ rdzu 'phrul kun mkhyen pa dang srid gsum bla ma nyid ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi skye ba 'di la ste// gal te lam du rab zhugs 'chi bar gyur na de tshe de yi 'dzin pas skye ba gzhan la'o// zhes bshad pa ltar/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang chen man ngag gi gnad du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag las/ rgyud sde bzhi so so'i nyams su len tshul dang*/ khyad par bla med kyi lam nyams su len tshul bstan pa ni/ slob dpon sman pa zhabs kyis sbyar ba'i dngos grub 'byung gter zhes bya ba las/ sngags ky-i spyod pa la mos pa de dag kyang bzhir shes par bya'o// kha gcig ni phyi'i gtsang sbra la sogs pa dang bdag gi de kho na nyid la sogs pas/ lhag pa'i lha mnyes par byas nas/ mngon par mtho ba'i dpal nyams su myong bar byas nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod do// yang kha cig ni phyi'i gtsang sbra la sogs pa bya ba dang*/ bya ba ma yin pa spang nas mtshan pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mtshan med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mngon par mtho ba'i dpal nyams su myong nas/ tshogs gnyis bsags nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod do// yang kha cig ni gtsang sbra la sogs pa smad cing*/ nang gi rnal 'byor dam tshig sems dpa'/ phyi rol gyi ye shes sems dpa'/ phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pa mnyes par bya ba la sogs pa'i rim pas/ rang gi lha mnyes par byas pas mngon par mtho ba'i dpal nyams su myong nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod do// de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis de lta bu la mos pa'i gdul bya gzud pa'i phyir thabs gsungs pa ste/

phyag rgya chen po'i lhan cig byed pa yin par shes par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i lhan cig byed pa ni 'di lta ste/ gang dag sems ji lta ba bzhin du brtag pa'i thabs la brtson 'grus 'bar ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pas skad cig re la yang*/ snod dang bcud/ lam dang 'bras bur bcas par sbyor bar byed cing*/ rnal 'byor dang phyag rgya la brten nas tshe 'di nyid la rab dang rab kyis mthar phyin par 'gyur ba la som nyi med pas bla na med pa'o// zhes rim pa bzhin bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa rnams kyi lam nyams su len tshul du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa khyad par rnal 'byor bla na med kyi lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ ma smin smin byed dbang gi rim pa dang*/ smin pa grol byed skyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa dngos bstan pa/ de ltar lam zab mo nyam su blangs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum ste/ gang rjes su gzung ba po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms pa las gdams pa sbyin pa'o// dang po ni dus 'khor bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ dang por yang dag brten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg la lhag par gnas// de nyid bsgoms shing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs// slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid la ni tshangs spyod ldan// bdud rnams la ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o// zhes dang gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/ zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes// thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus shing g.yo ba min pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin du sbed// gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma de nyid bla ma shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdu bar bya// zhes gsungs/

gsum pa ni/ de ltar ji skad gsungs pa'i don dang ldan zhing*/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma de nyid/ thog mar dbang gis smin par bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid de rnams dang ldan pa'i bla mas/ rgyud sde rnams dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lag len cho ga'i 'grig chags khungs gtsang gi rgyun las ji ltar byung ba ltar sbyin par bya zhing*/ de yang*/ dbang gi don rgyud la skyes na thob par bzhed/ ces dgongs gcig las bshad pa bzhin gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan/ rang re'i brgyud pa 'di la yang mnyam med sgam po pas gsang sngags kyi dbang mang du gsan kyang*/ phyis rje btsun gyi drung du phebs pa'i tshe bde mchog lhan skyes kyi dbang rdul tshon dang*/ phag mo'i dbang sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal la brten nas gnang ba'ang don 'di la dgongs par mngon no// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma snod ldan las dang skal bar ldan pa de la ni/ yang dag pa'i don gyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa bstan par bya ste/ 'di ltar mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag thams cad kyi snying po/ rin po che gser zhun dril ba lta bu'i gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi yang snying*/ sngon gyi grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma'i gshegs shul/ da ltar ba thams cad kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lam gyi rim pa 'di la 'khrid par byed pas na khrid ces bya ste/ de yang bsgrub bya gang 'khrid/ 'khrid mkhan gang gis byed/ lam gang la brten nas 'khrid/ yul gang du 'khrid par byed/ (32)ces pa'o// de la dang po ni/ spyir du 'khor ba'i me 'obs chen por gnas pa'i ma rgan/ dkar nag dge sdig gi dmigs bu dang bral ba'i dmus long rnams la/ re zhig skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya'i dbang du gyur pa rnams so// gang gis 'khrid na gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid rang gis bsgoms pas nyams su myong zhing phyin phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'khrid par byed do// lam gang la 'khrid na zab lam nā ro'i chos drug ces bya ba gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma 'khrud cing*/

'khrul pa ye shes su ngo sprod par byed pa gzhom med rnam par mi rtog pa'i lam la 'khrid/ yul gar phyin na kun gzhi rang rig gnyug ma'i pha yul chos dbyings/ ka dag rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen por skyel bar byed do// de lta bu'i zab lam 'di nyid ston par byed pa la/ spyi don gnyis ste/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos so// de yang dang po ni/ grub chen til+li pa la rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ bka' babs nyams kyi brgyud pa gnyis su gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ nga la mi yi bla ma med// nga yi bla ma thams cad mkhyen// gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dngos su mjal/ 'khor lo sdom pas byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la rjes su gnang ba thob gsung ba ltar ro// gnyis pa ltar na/ nga la mi yi bla ma yod// klu sgrub tsar+ya lwa ba pa// skal ba bzang mo nga yi ni// bka' babs bzhi yi bla ma yin// gsungs pa la/ bla ma mar pa dang*// ti phu ba gtso cher zhal mthun par/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ma tang gi pa nas rim pa lnga pa dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ grong 'jug gi bka' babs yang rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ lo hi pa/ ḍing gi pa/ de las phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ su ma ti/ kun tu bzang mo/ thang lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa de las gtum mo la sogs pa'i bka' babs/ ḍom bhi he ru ka bi na pa/ lwa wa pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba de las 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam sgyu lus la sogs pa'i bka' babs par bzhed do// de nyid kyi rjes su bzung ba slob dpon nā ro pa yang*/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs shing*/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur te/ dpal nā len+d+ra na mkhas pa sgo drug pa'i byang sgo par grags so// der thos bsam nyan bshad kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/

rang gi sems ba 'jo ba'i nu ma 'then pa'i tshod tsam du'ang mi gnas par 'dug pas/ sems la dbang thob pa'i gdams ngag cig btsal dgos par 'dug snyam ste/ gnas dben par dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nye snying yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pa las/ (34)sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po byung ste/ shar phyogs ngos su til+li pa'i rigs yin no zhes mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan te/ bka' dpe las/ bla ma chen po nā ro pas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni// 'bum phrag bdun du bzlas pa yis// sa rnams g.yos shing lung bstan thob// ces so// de nas shar phyogs su dpal ldan chen po til+li pa 'tshol du byon pa mjal/ dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad cing bla ma yongs su mnyes par mdzad pa'i mthar/ phyag rgya chen po mngon du mdzad pa des/ rjes su bzung ba ni rje btsun mar pa lo tsā nyid de/ dpal ldan til+li pas nā ro pa la lung bstan pa yang*/ rang grol ye shes nyi ma yis// phu la ha ri'i dgon pa ru/ kha ba can gyi skal ldan pa/ bho ṭa'i ma rig mun sol la// ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis// zhes pa ltar/ rgyud dang man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ mthar phyis 'byung lung bstan pa yang*/ sngon tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can// bod yul gyi mar chung lo tsa khyod// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// 'dod pas rdo la yi ge bris// rigs brgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal// bka' brgyud chu bo'i gzhung las ring*// seng ge khyung gi phru gu bzhin// slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// zhes lung bstan rjes su gnang ba mdzad/ kha ba can du sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad do/ (35)/de'i zhabs la rje btsun mi la ras pas btugs shing*/ sku mkhar la sogs pa'i zhabs tog gis mnyes par mdzad de/ gdams ngag rnams ma lus par gnang*/ thabs lam gyi yon tan rdzogs par mdzad/ rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma bka' bzhi'i mgur las lung bstan te/

de'i drung du mnyam med sgam po pas mjal/ snod ldan gyi slob mar gzigs/ gdams ngag ma lus par gnang*/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs par mdzad/ dbus su 'byon khar thub pa'i bstan pa dang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar dpal gyi sgam po lung bstan/ der theg pa gsum gyi gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sgrub brgyud rin po che dar bar mdzad do// de'i zhabs la 'gro ba'i mgon po rje phag mo gru pas btugs/ gdams pa ma lus par gnang*/ rgyud 'dzin du lung bstan/ mtha' rtsa dpal gyi phag mo grur bzhugs nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol du mdzad do// mnyam med chos kyi rje rin po che yul 'bri klung dam par sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rigs sad pa'i skyes bur gyur pas thos bsam la brtson par mdzad/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i mtshan thos pa tsam nas mos gus kyi gdung shugs dpag tu med pa skyes te/ rtag tu ngu'i rnam thar bzhin du dbus su byon/ bla ma dang mjal/ zang zing dang sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis thugs mnyes par mdzad/ 'gro mgon nyid kyi nga'i sgrub brgyud 'di (36)dge bsnyen sa bcu pa gcig gis 'dzin pa yin zhes lung bstan/ gdams ngag ma lus par gnang*/ dbye chung ri khrod du sgrub pa mdzad/ gsang sngags kyi yon tan ma lus pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ phyis sku rab tu byung bar mdzad/ de nas lung bstan dang rjes su mthun par/ dpal gyi 'bri gung du phyag phebs/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug rgyan du bzhugs shing*/ theg pa gsum gyis sems can gyi don mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan chen po nā ro pa'i chos drug gi gdams pa 'dis gdul bya rnams smin grol mdzad do// de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la sangs rgyas dbon rin po ches btugs/ gdams pa rdzogs par zhus de la rgyal ba gcung*/ de la rgyal sras thog kha ba/ de la bla ma mtshams bcad pa/

/de la spyan snga badz+ra rat+na/ de la o rgyan gyi sprul sku gu ru badz+ra rā dz+was gsan/ de la 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ des bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po la gnang*/ de la la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ des stag lung ngag gi dbang po la gnang*/ des mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la gnang*/ rje de nyid kyi drung du snyigs dus kyi 'dren mchog gcig pu rje btsun mtshungs med kun dga'i mtshan can gyis gsan par mdzad de/ thos pa dang sgrub pa'i yon tan gyis (37)dben pa'i nyam cung bdag lta bu la'ang dgyes bzhin du bstsal ba'o// gang nyams su blang bar byed pa'i gdams pa la'ang sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la'ang spyir chos nyan pa'i kun spyod/ bye brag khyad par du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos nyan pa'i kun spyod gsal 'debs pa dang*/ sngon 'gro'i gdams pa dngos so// de yang dang po ni/ 'chad pa po ji ltar 'os pa'i khri la 'dug ste gtsang ma'i gos bgos la/ bzhin gyi mdangs rab tu gsal ba dang bcas pas/ zang zing dang rnyed pa don du mi gnyer zhing*/ sems bskyed chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i snying po/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ ma 'ongs pa thams cad kyi 'byon lam/ da ltar ba thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam par gyur pa/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi gdams pa gsan nas/ de'i don thams cad phyin phyin ci ma log par thugs nyams su bzhes dgongs pa'i/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams gsal gtab nas gsan par zhu zhes brjod la/

de lta bu'i kun spyod la yang*/ thun mong gi chos nyan pa'i kun spyod dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i kun spyod gnyis las/ dang po ni spyod 'jug las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad// mi na bzhin du mgo dkris dang*// gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang*// mgo bo g.yogs pa dag la min// dman la zab dang rgya che ba// skyes pa med par bud med min// dman dang mchog gi chos rnams la// mtshungs pa'am gus pas kun tu spyad// rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa// dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya// spyod pa yongs su dor mi bya// mdo dang sngags kyis 'drid mi bya// so shing dang ni mchil ma dag /dor ba la ni bgab par bya// zhes pa'i don la mi mthun pa dang bral cing*/ mthun rkyen mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bkyed// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces skyes rabs las byung ba ltar dang*/ gzhan yang snod kyi skyon gsum spangs shing*/ 'du shes bzhi bskyed de gsan dgos pa nor bzang gi rtogs brjod las byung zhing*/ de yang nyan pa'i dus su kha sbub lta bu'i skyon dang*/ bsam pa'i dus su zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon spong*/ sgom pa'i dus su dug can lta bu'i skyon spangs te/ 'du shes bzhi bskyed pa ni/ bla ma la sman pa'i 'du shes/ bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan dgos pa yin te/ (39)/mdo sdud pa las/ nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar// g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ nor bzang gi rtogs brjod las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes dang chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs shing*/

de dag gi thun mong gi chos gsan pa'i kun spyod bstan zin te/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsan pa'i kun spyod ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan dgos par/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams su gsungs te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug sgrub pa po rnams kyi nyams len la dgongs pas so// de la yang gdul bya ngor snang gi phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang*/ don rang gi mtshan nyid kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o// dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yan chad dang*/ chos theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig dus ston 'khor gnas dang chos lnga 'dzoms pa'i dus sam/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig mar gsal 'debs par bya'o// gnas rang bzhin gyis 40)rnam par dag pa chos kyi 'byung gnas sam/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga ston pa rang byung gi ye shes/ 'khor phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ chos bde stong gi nyams myong*/ dus bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skad cig ma ste/ de dag ni gdod ma nas gnas pa'i tshul lo// 'di la phyi nang gsang gsum du'ang shes par bya ste/ de ltar kun spyod de dag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan cing nyams su len pa'i chos/ gsum pa sngon 'gro dngos la'ang*/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ las dang po pa'i gang zag rnams kyis thun mong gi kun spyod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i chos nyams su len pa'i tshul ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ tshe 'di la mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang*/ snyoms las dang le lo'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa dang*/ srid pa la bde bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa dang*/

dal 'byor gyi lus don yod par bya ba'i phyir las rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bsam pa'o// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa'i tshul la'ang gnyis te/ dal 'byor ngos gzung ba dang*/ de nyid rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu ngos gzung ba'o// dal ba brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong pa/(41)/lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// ces mi khom pa brgyad po de las dal bas na dal ba phun sum tshogs pa zhes bya'o// 'byor pa bcu ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// ces pas rang 'byor lnga bstan la// gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o// zhes gsungs pas de ltar na/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che zer ba yin te/ lus 'di la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad 'byung bas so// des na dal ba brgyad/ 'byor bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ /zhes so// de ltar rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul yang*/ dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang*/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang*/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ bshes spring las/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing bu ga dang*// rus sbal 'phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las// mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gi// dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod// ces dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum las kyang*/ grogs dag mir gyur pa ni dkon/

dal ba phun sum tshogs pa ni (42)dkon/ 'khor ba las thar ba ni dkon/ de lta yin gyis dal ba ni chud zos par ma byed cig phyis 'gyod par 'gyur ta re/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam dgos pa yin te/ da lta'i mi lus 'di thob pa la'ang*/ sngon tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa gcig bsrung dgos pas so// gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa'i tshul yang*/ dmyal ba la sa chen po'i rdul tsam yod par gsungs pa dang*/ yi dwags la kha ba sa skya bab pa tsam yod par gsungs pa dang*/ dud 'gro la yang byings na gnas pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba gnyis su yod pa las/ byings na gnas pa ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na/ glum dar ba'i sbang ma tsam yod par gsungs pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba ni mi la brten pa dang*/ ma brten pa gnyis su gsungs pas/ de rnams bsam na nyin mo'i skar ma bas nyung bas so// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che rnyed kyang*/ yun ring du sdod pa ma yin te/ de lta bu'i mi rtag pa bsam pa la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ nam 'chi nges pa med par bsam pa dang*/ gang gis kyang mi stongs par 'chi ba bsam pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ lus 'dus byas yin pas nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ sngar ma shi ba med pas nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ tshe skad cig ma yin pas nges par 'chi ba bsam pa'o// (43)gnyis pa nam 'chi nges pa med par 'chi ba bsam pa la yang gsum ste/ lus la snying po med pas na nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ tshe la snon ma med cing bri chad bar ma chad du yod pas kyang nam 'chi nges pa med par bsam pa dang*/ 'chi rkyen mang gson rkyen nyung bas kyang nam 'chi nges pa med par bsam pa'o// gsum pa gang gis kyang mi stong par 'chi ba bsam pa la yang gsum/ lus kyis kyang mi stongs par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ longs spyod kyis kyang mi stongs par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/

'khor gyis mi stongs par 'chi ba bsam pa yin te/ de skad du rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las kyang*/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur te// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skye bo de ni gang dang gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du 'brang bar 'gyur// ces so// gzhan yang*/ sa 'am 'on te mtho ris na// gal te skyes nas ma shi ba// mthong ngam thos pa su yod mtshar// ces dang*/ mtshan ma bzang po'i mdo las/ sang tsam 'chi ba sus shes kyi// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// 'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni// bdag nyid bshes pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*// tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas// ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar// rang gi 'dod pa dang du len par byos// ces dang*/ rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur nas// yun ring bar du bde spyad kyang*// chom pos phrogs pa ji bzhin du// sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gro// bdag nyid gcig pu mal nang na// gnyen bshes tshogs kyis mtha' bskor yang*// srog chad pa yi tshor ba ni// bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// zhes so// gsum pa srid pa la bde bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa la yang*/ 'khor ba spyi'i nyes dmigs sgom pa dang*/ bye brag so so'i nyes dmigs sgom pa'o/ dang po la yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sgom pa dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sgom pa dang*/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom pa'o// dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sgom pa ni// mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha min 'thab dang rtsod pas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes pa'i don dran par bya'o// gnyis pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la yang*/

mthon po dma' mor 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs te/ rgyal po spyi bo skyes kyi gtam rgyud lta bu'o// gsum pa khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga po 'dis/ gang khyab thams cad sdug bsngal las ma 'das te/ phung po lnga po 'di dag gis rang bzhin ma shes pas sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ngo*// rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa la yang*/ thog mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam par bya ste/ de'i tshul yang*/ tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa dang*/ grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'o// dang po tsha dmyal la yang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sdug bsngal spyir bstan pa/ sgra don dang*/ sdug bsngal bye brag tu bshad pa/ tshe'i tshad bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dang po ni/ bshes springs las/ sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la// yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang*// bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i// dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ de dag gi sdug bsngal ni/ kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan// phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar brlog kha cig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan// s+t+wa re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis bshags// de bzhin gzhan dag khro chu bzhus pa yi/ khu ba 'bar ba 'khrig pa ldud par bgyid/ kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar ba yi// tsher ma can la kun tu brgyud par bgyid/ kha cig lcags kyi mche ba ldan pa'i khyi// gtum pos 'drad cing lag pa gnam du bsgreng*// dbang med gzhan dag lcags mchu rnon po dang*// sen mo mi bzad ldan pa'i khwa rnams 'thog /kha cig srin bu sbur pa sna tshogs dang*// sha sbrang sbrang ma nag po khri phrag dag /de dag mi bzad rma srol cher 'byin pas// za bar bgyid cing 'gre ldog smre sngags 'don// kha cig 'dag ma 'bar ba'i tshogs su ni// rgyun mi 'chad par rab bsreg kha yang bgrad/

kha cig lcags las byas pa'i zangs chen du/ spyi gtsug 'bras kyi cung peng bzhin du 'tshed// sdig chen dbugs dbyung 'gag pa tsam zhig gi// dus kyi bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi// sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam stong du// mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no// dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams dang*// 'jigs pa skye bar gyur na mi bzad pa'i// rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci dgos// zhes dang*/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag gtab sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung du la'ang*// 'ol yang mi bgyi char yang ma phod de// de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzod lo// bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni// ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur par// de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mdo 'jig rten gdams pa las/ gang phyir lo ni stong phrag dag /mang por yang ni de dag tu// phan tshun 'khor zhing zhe gnong ba// mi rnams mi ni gsod pa dag /sdig cing bshags la yang 'tsho bas// de phyir yang sos yin par bshad// gang phyir de ni shing bzhin du// thig nag gtab nas sog le dag /'bar ba yis ni bshog byed pas/ (47)/de phyir thig nag yin par bshad// gang phyir rtag tu tsha ba'i mes// gdung ba drag po skye ba'i phyir// 'jig rten du ni tsha ba'i mes// don dang mthun par grags pa yin// me ni rab tu drag po yis// der 'khod sems can sreg par byed// tsha ba phul du byung bas te// de phyir rab tu tsha bar gsungs// gang dag gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa// de dag lcags kyi tho lum ni// 'bar ba dag kyang za ba dang*// yang dang yang du zas skom 'thung*// de ni drag po'i me dag gis// rgyun mi 'chad par bsreg pas na// gang phyir skad ni 'byin byed pa// de phyir de ni ngu 'bod yin// mes bsreg pa yang drag phyir dang*// ngu 'bod pa yang che phyir dang*// lji zhing che ba nyid kyi phyir// de ni ngu 'bod chen po yin// 'di na gang zag gzugs can la// gnod pa rnam pa mang byas pa// de dag yun ring 'khrul 'khor dang*// ri dang tho ba 'bar bas gzir// gang phyir bsdus nas der 'dor dang*// brdung dang bsreg par byed pas na// de yi phyir na sdus 'joms te// de ltar ming ni don mthun grags// mi rtag des ni lus can gyi// rus pa dag kyang lhags par 'gyur// cung zad bde ba'i skabs med pas// de phyir mnar med yin par bshad// ces so// gsum pa tshe'i tshad bstan pa ni/

dran pa nyer gzhag las/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i tshul yang*/ mi lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub pa ni/ dmyal ba yang sos kyi zhag gcig tu 'gyur la/ yang sos kyi rang lo lnga brgya thub pa yin no// yang rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi zhag gcig tu gyur pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub pa ni/ dmyal ba thig nag gi zhag gcig tu 'gyur la/ thig nag pas rang lo lnga brgya thub pa yin/ thig nag gi tshe'i tshad do// dus ma yin par 'chi ba ni yod do// sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ 'thab bral ba'i zhag gcig 'thab bral ba'i lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ dga' ldan pa'i zhag gcig dga' ldan pa'i lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ 'phrul dga' ba'i zhag gcig 'phrul dga' ba'i lo lnga bcu tham pa la/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i zhag gcig tu gyur pa yin la/ de rnams kyi rang lo lnga brgya thub pa ni/ rim gyis dmyal ba bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ mnar med rnams kyi zhag re rer gyur ba yin la/ dmyal ba de rnams kyi rang lo bye ba sogs mi dge ba'i 'bras bu ma zad kyi bar du 'tsho ba ni tshe tshad do// tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'i tshul bstan zin no// grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal la yang*/ sgra las gyur pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa gnyis/ gzugs las gyur pa'i rnam pa drug dang brgyad yod pa yin la/ dang po sgra las gyur pa ni/ gnas mun pa mun nag shin tu mi bzad pa'i nang du/ lus dpag tshad du ma dang ldan pa/ gzhon sha chags pa/ tshor ba shin tu rags pa zhig tu gyur la/ de la yang rlung shin tu mi bzad pas brdungs pa las/ smre sngags shin tu mi bzad pa a chu zhes brjod pa las/ gzhan gang gis kyang mthu med do// de nas slar yang rlung de nyid kyis brdung pa las/ kye hud pha kye hud ma kye hud mgon/

zhes pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ mthar smre sngags kyang ma thon par so tham tham byed pa'i bar gyi sdug bsngal rnams sgra las gyur pa yin zhing*/ lus thams cad chu bur gyi gang ba ni chu bur can/ chu bur de yang brdol nas lus thams cad snag khrag gis gang bar gyur pa ni chu bur brdol pa can no// de lta bu'i lus de mdog dmar zhing tshal pa brgyad du gas pa ni pad+ma thams cad ltar gas pa'o// de yang mdog sngo zhing tshal pa bcu drug tu gas pa ni pad+ma ltar cher gas pa'o// de yang mdog sngo zhing tshal pa brgyar gas pa ni ut+pal ltar gas pa'o// de yang*/ mdog sngo zhing tshal pa stong du gas pa ni ut+pal ltar cher gas pa'o// de dag gi tshe tshad bstan pa ni/ mdo dran pa nye bar gzhag pa las/ til rjang til rjang nang nas lo brgya zhig /til gcig phyung ste zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yi tshad// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa rgya gar (50)ma ga dha'i bre tshad kyi khal brgyad cu tham pa til rjang zhig tu blug par gyur la/ mi lo brgyad brgya na til re re phyir phyung ste zad par gyur pa ni/ chu bur can gyi tshe'i tshad/ til sbyangs nyi shu zad par gyur pa ni/ chu bur can gyi tshe'i tshad yin pa nas gzung ste rigs 'gres te shes par bya'o// tshe tshad de rnams ni mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs la/ mdo gzhan du gong ma gong ma'i tshe nyis 'gyur du gsungs pa ni/ 'gal ba'i don can du mi bsam te/ sems can so so'i mos pa tha dad pa la dgongs pa'o// 'o na yi dwags su skyes na skyid yod dam snyam na/ der yang bde ba'i go skabs rdul tsam yang med de/ bkres skom gyi tshor ba dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de la yang phyi'i sgrib pa can dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can dang*/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can rnams su yod pa yin te/ bshes springs las/ yi dwags rnams la 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs sogs kyi// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri yi ltos tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang*// 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so// kha cig lpags rus lus shing gcer bu ste// ta la'i ya thog skam pa lta bu lags// kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste// zas su 'bar ba'i khar babs bye ma 'tshal// dmangs rigs 'ga' ni rnag dang phyi sa dang*// khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed de// phan tshun gdong du 'tshog cing mgrin pa nas// lba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo// yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni// zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang*// ljon shing 'bras bu med gyur de dag gis// bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang bskam par 'gyur// bar chad med par sdug bsngal bsten gyur pa// nyes par spyad pa'i las kyi zhags pa ni// sra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig lo// lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/

de nas thar nas dud 'gror skyes na skyid yod dam snyam na/ der yang glen rmugs dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de/ de skad du bshes pa'i springs yig las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang*// bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa// kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus gdab pas gtab ste bkol// zhes so// de ltar dud 'gro las thar nas/ lha ma yin du skyes na skyid yod dam snyam na/ der yang 'thab pa dang rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ bshes springs las/ lha min dag na rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ (52)de dag blo dang ldan yang 'gro ba yi// sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so// zhes dang*// lha min las thar nas lhar skyes na skyid yod dam snyam na/ der yang 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de// bshes pa'i springs yig las// mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi// 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che// de ltar bsams nas ya rabs rnams kyis ni// zhi gyur mtho ris slad du sred mi bgyid/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang*// gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni// sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bya ba// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed snga ltas lnga// lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste// sa steng mi rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag /sbron par byed pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra// 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha dang mi// dmyal ba yid dwags dud 'gro rnams dag tu// skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/

gnod pa du ma'i snod 'gyur lags mkhyen mdzod// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar srid pa'i sdug bsngal de dag las thar bar byed pa'i them skas las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par gzhag pa la yang gnyis te/ dge ba'i las bsam pa/ de'i 'bras bu dang*/ de nyid sgrub par bsam pa/ mi dge ba'i las bsam pa/ de'i 'bras bu dang*/ las de spang bar bsam dgos pa yin te/ de skad du yang*// bzhi brgya pa las// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// de las ngan 'gro thams cad do// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba ste// de las bde 'gro thams cad do// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar dug gsum gyis kun nas blang ba'i las mi dge ba bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spang bar bya zhing*/ de las bzlog pa'i dge ba bcu 'khor dang bcas pa bsgrub par bya ba yin te/ de'i tshul yang*/ mi chos bcu drug la sogs pa nyams su len pa ste/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ lus kyi sgo nas rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi sgo nas rnam pa bzhi// yid kyi sgo nas rnam gsum ste// mi dge bcu po spangs steng du// chang mi 'thung dang 'tsho ba bzang*// rnam mi 'tshe dang gus sbyin dang*// mchod 'os mchod dang byams pas te// mdor na chos ni de yin no// zhes dang*// chos 'dis/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// ngan song gsum las grol 'gyur zhing*// mtho ris lha mi'i nang dag tu// bde bar rgyal srid thob par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi shes rab brgya pa las// mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na// lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*// lha dang mi yi them skas la// 'dzegs na thar pa'ang gam na 'dug /ces dang*// de lta bu'i mi dge ba re res kyang 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi bzhi 'byin par byed de/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu/ dbang gi 'bras bu/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/

bral ba'i 'bras bu dang bzhi/ de yang re re la sbyar na/ zhe sdang gi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu dmyal ba rnams su skye ba yin la/ dbang gi 'bras bu gang dang gang du skyes pa der/ tshe thung nad mang ba dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu srog gcod pa la dga' ba/ srog gcod pa'i phyogs su gzhol ba/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par dka' ba'o// bral ba'i 'bras bu ni/ gang dang gang du skyes pa'i gnas der bkra mi shis shing*/ 'thab rtsod du ma dang ldan pa'o// 'dod chags kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ yi dwags su skye la/ dbang gi 'bras bu ni/ bkra mi shis shing*/ sad ser mang ba/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa sogs kyi phyogs su gzhol ba/ ma byin par len pa las slar ldog par dka' ba'o// bral ba'i 'bras bu ni/ gang du skyes pa'i gnas der 'dod pa chung ba dang*/ chog shes pa dang bral ba'o// gti mug gi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ dud 'gror skye la/ dbang gi 'bras bu ni 'bras bu ye med pa'i sar skye ba dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni gal te mir skyes na yang*/ gti mug shas che bar 'gyur ro// bral ba'i 'bras bu ni/ gang du skyes pa'i gnas der blang dor gyi gnas dang bral ba'o// de skad du yang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ rgyu mthun sogs pas rab phye ba'i// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// ces pas so// de ltar srid pa'i sdug bsngal de dag las thar bar byed pa'i gang zag gis (55)thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro nyams su len pa'i tshul ni bzhi ste/ rgyud snod rung du sgrub par byed pa skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib myur du 'dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ rgyud la byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi las/

dang po skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/ yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la bslab dgos pa yin te/ de skad du yang*/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ srid pa gsum na rgyal ba dkon mchog gtso// de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ste// srid gsum bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no// dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo la 'don// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i tshul yang*/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo/ skyabs 'gro'i nges tshig skyabs su 'gro tshul gyi khyad par/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dang lnga las/ dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ ngan song dang ni gnas min dang*// 'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ skyabs phyir skyabs kyi dam par 'dod// ces pa'i don no// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ theg pa dman pa'i skyabs 'gro/ theg pa 'bring gi skyabs 'gro/ theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro/ de (56)re re la'ang*/ skyabs gnas yul gyi khyad par/ dus kyi khyad par/ bsam pa'i khyad par te gsum gsum yod pa yin no// de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba de la yang*/ rang nyid ngan song gsum las thar 'dod kyi skyabs 'gro ni/ theg pa dman pa'i skyabs 'gro/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi skyabs su 'gro na/ theg pa 'bring gi skyabs 'gro// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi skyabs su 'gro na/ theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro/ dkon mchog gsum dang rang nyid dbyer med du rtogs na rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro'o// bzhi pa bslab bya la'ang*/ thun mong gi bslab bya drug thun mong ma yin pa'i bslab bya lnga rnams yod pa las/ dang po thun mong ni/ sangs rgyas skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song na sems can la 'tshe ba spang*/

dge 'dun la skyabs su song na grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs/ sangs rgyas skyabs su song nas sangs rgyas kyi rten tsha tsha'i dum bu tsam la yang ma gus pa spang zhing gus pa nye bar bsgrub/ chos la skyabs su song nas chos kyi rten yig 'bru tsam la yang ma gus pa spang zhing gus pa nye bar bsgrub/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dge 'dun gyi rten snal ma ser mo tsam la yang ma gus pa spang zhing gus pa nye bar bsgrub/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bslab bya lnga ni/ srog dang bya dga'i phyir du yang dkon mchog gsum mi spang*/ dgos pa gal po che la yang thabasagazhan mi btsal/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab/ phyogs gar 'gro yang phyogs de'i lha la phyag 'tshal/ skyabs su 'gro ba spel cing sbyang ba la bslab pa'o// de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon ni/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon dag /gal te 'di la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha' 'di yang snod du chung*// rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter// phul gyis gzhal bar ga la lang*// zhes dang*/ lha'i dbang pos bstod pa las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus ni spangs nas kyang*// lha yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun la yang sbyar ro// de ltar spyir gyi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab na yang*/ mdor bsdus te/ jo bo rjes rnam pa brgyad du gsungs pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud par 'gyur ba dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad srab cing zad par 'gyur ba dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par mi ltung ba dang*/ lam khyad par can rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'o// skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag (58)bstan zin to// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la yang*/

gang la len pa'i yul/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid kyang spyod 'jug las/ theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*// zhes dang*/ sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rjer ldan// nus dang ldan la blang bar bya// zhes sdom pa nyi shu pa las gsungs/ ji ltar len pa'i cho ga de ltar blangs pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ de'i nges tshig de dag gi dbye ba/ de'i phan yon/ bslab bya dang bcas te rnam pa bdun las/ dang po ni sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas rnams kyis// bu sdug 'dra bar dgongs par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gnyis pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de mnyes pa mtha' dag gis mnyes par byas nas/ dngos dang yid kyi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod nas/ grogs sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ gzhan phan gzhi dang bcas pa sgrub par khas len pa'o// gsum pa ni/ grogs sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'o// bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yis rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan bzung*// zhes so// lnga pa dbye ba ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems so// kun rdzob la yang gnyis te/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems so// smon pa ni 'bras bu la smon pa ste/ 'bras bu la dam 'cha' ba yin zhing*/ grogs sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'o// 'jug pa ni/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ yul mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la blangs te/ spyod pa sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug la tshul bzhin du slob pa'o// don dam byang chub kyi sems ni stong nyid snying rje dbyer med do// drug pa byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon ni/

spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bdun pa bslab bya ni/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ smon pa'i bslab bya ni lnga yin gsungs/ tshogs rgya chen po bsags par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ phan yon rnams yang nas yang du dran par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab par bya ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems spel cing sbyang bar bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab par bya'o// smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis kyi spyi'i bslab bya ni/ byams pa dang snying rje dga' ba dang btang snyoms/ tshad med pa bzhi dang dus thams cad du mi 'bral bar bya'o// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa sdig sgrib myur du 'dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid la yang gnyis te/ sku nyi tshe ba bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i don bsgom pa'o// dang po ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ pad dkar zla ba'i steng gnas pa'i// rgyan rnams kun gyis legasaspras pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pu// rdo rje sems dpa' legs dmigs shing*// yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas// de yis ltung sogs byin brlabs pas// 'phel ba tu ni mi 'gyur ro// grub pa mchog gi legs bshad pas// 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐m̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i mtha' mar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis g.yas skor du bskor ba la dmigs te yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas shing*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gang*/ zhabs kyi mthe bong nas thon/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad lus kyi dbang po'i sgo rnams dang*/ ba spu'i bu gar thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis mer gang*/ thun 'jog khar oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ zhes bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs 'chi// zhes gsol ba gtab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ngas dag par byas so// zhes gnang ba byin nas rang la thim par mos shing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i don stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ldang ba'i tshe bsngo ba bya'o// gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la yang gsum ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi sgra don dang*/ ji ltar 'bul ba'i cho ga dang*/ de ltar phul ba'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du/ maṇ+ḍal la zhes 'byung zhing*/ bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor zhes bsgyur ba'i don bshad la/

snying po len pa zhes bya bar don gyis 'gyur te/ ji ltar snying po len zhe na/ lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa sems can gyi don du bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phul te/ de dag gi gnas thob par byas nas 'gro ba'i don byed pa'o// de dag gang las bshad ce na/ kye rdor las gsungs pa/ dkyil ni snying po zhes brjod te// byang chub sems ni bde chen po// der ni len par byed pa'i phyir// 'dus pa dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ ces so// gnyis pa ji ltar 'bul ba'i cho ga la gnyis te/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'god pa dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa gser la sogs pa yin na/ rang sa mtho zhing 'khor sa yangs pa bsten par bya zhing*/ sor bzhi dang ldan pa la yang 'bul du rung la/ g.yam pa dang sa stegs yin na khru gang pa phyin chad 'bul tu mi rung bas/ tshad dang ldan par bya zhing*/ rang sa sogs gong ltar la dri bzang gi rkyang nul bya/ dbus su rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla dar zab kyi gdan bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ maṇ+ḍal gyi shar du sangs rgyas dkon mchog lhor chos dkon mchog nub tu dge 'dun dkon mchog byang du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa gong ltar bsams shing*/ maṇ+ḍal theb yod na/ de nyid gong bzhag la/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsham/ theb med na de nyid nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ be ga kra ma ho/ zhes pas bteg la bzhag /gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ rgyu sogs gong bzhin la/ de lta bu'i maṇ+ḍal de yang*/ nag tshig sogs ma spangs na sgrub pa po la khams 'dus 'byung bas spang*/ maṇ+ḍal de nyid la dri yi chag chag ma gtab na sgrub pa po skam sar skye bas/ dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ tshom bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ rab rin chen yin na 'dab tu rung la/ 'bru dang sman la sogs pa 'dab tu mi rung bas spang*/

de nas tshom bu dgod tshul ni/ dbus mtho bar bya zhing*/ dgod pa'i tshe mdun nas g.yas bskor dang*/ sdud pa'i tshe mdun nas g.yon bskor du bsdud par bya zhing*/ tshom bu rnams ha cang mthar song na/ sgrub pa po mtha' khob tu skye ba'i skyon dang*/ ha cang dbus su rub na sgrub pa po khams 'dus 'byung ba'i skyon yod pas spang zhing*/ tshom bu rnams rim par dgod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal byi dor bya ba dang lhan cig tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri rin po che 'khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa/ ma tshang ba med pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ dgos pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs nas/ mthar zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro//

༈ //bzhi pa rgyud la byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla dar zab sna tshogs pa'i gdan mtho la yangs pa'i steng du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus 'gro ba sems can thams cad la chos ston pa/ thugs ting 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug pa/ lha'i dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ rje na mo sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// zhes sogs bdun rnam dag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs so// bla ma 'od gsal chos kyi sku la=/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ngag la nus pa thob par= sems la rtogs pa 'char bar= phyag rgya chen po dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/

bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi spyi bor thim/ lus kyis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag lus 'od dkar pos gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas/ de bzhin du bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag lus 'od zer dmar pos gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag lus 'od zer sngon pos gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba ldan par byas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga byung*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// mthar bla ma dam pa 'od zer gyi gong bur zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la thun mtshams ngal bso'i rim pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ ye shes rgya mtsho las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// sa lam rim pa ma lus bgrod/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /ces gsungs pa dang*/ sam bhu ṭa las/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med par ni// gru yis pha rol phyin mi nus// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/

chos kyi rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal mnga' nas/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces ji skad bshad pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya zhing*// de ltar sngon 'gros rgyud legs par sbyang dgos pa'ang chos drug gi ka dpe gong ma las/ dal 'byor rgyu 'bras las rnams las// rnal 'byor don gyi snying po btsal// zhes dang*/ ka dpe phyi ma las/ gang zag blo yi khyad par las// rim gyis pa dang cig car ba// rim gyis pa yi sman chen de// cig char ba yi dug tu 'gyur// cig car ba yi sman chen de// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// des na sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la// cig car ba ni bsten par bya// sems can dang po'i rigs can la// rim gyis pa ni bsten par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don du phyi ma ltar nyams su len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos// cig car ba dang rim gyis pa zhes pa// sems can khams kyi byang chub sgrub pa la// rim gyis yin gyis cig car ma yin zhes// yang yang bka' stsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag sngon du sbyangs pa che chung gis/ da lta nyams len gyi brtson 'grus phal che chung dgos tshul la dgongs pa'o// de ltar sngon 'gros rgyud legs par sbyangs pa'i slob ma la rang rgyud dang 'tshams pa'i chos bstan par gsungs te/ de yang*/ gdul bya tshogs bshad dang slob bshad gnyis su shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gang zag gi dbye ba yang*/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ ji skad du/ ut+pal dang ni pad dkar dang*/ pad+ma tsan+dan rin po che// rang bzhin tha dad ming gis ni// thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin// de ni mang du thos gyur la// 'dzin pa la ni rnam par mkhas// skad cig gis ni brjed gyur pa// ut+pal zhes bya'i gang zag go// gzung bya mang du thos gyur kyang*// ston pa yi ni nus med cing*// bum pa'i nang gi ras bal bzhin// pad dkar zhes bya'i gang zag go

/dad par ldan zhing snying rje shes// thos nas blo yis kha 'byed la// tshegs med 'o ma bzhin du 'dzag /pad+ma zhes bya'i man ngag go /thos pa nyung zhing nga rgyal ldan// rtsa ba med par mang du smra// rjes su 'dzin par mi nus pa'i// tsan dan zhes bya'i gang zag go /ut+pal dang pad dkar dang*// pad+ma tsan dan nyid dag ste// gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni// tshogs pa la bshad snod yin no// rdzogs pa'i rim pa skal ldan zhing*// rtag tu spyod pa rnam pa brgyad// 'di ni rin chen gang zag ste// slob ma la bshad snod yin no// bde gshegs rnams kyi gdul bya la// snod dang snod min yongs brtag pas// rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis// bshad pa rnam pa gnyis bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ spyir tshogs pa la bshad par bya ba n-i/ bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas shing*/ zab pa ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim rnams so// slob ma la bshad par bya ba ni/ 'dod chags chos sbas la sogs pa'i sbas don rnams dang*/ 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi don rnams te shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim rnams so// de ltar slob ma'i dbye ba rnams shes par byas la/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa nyams su blang ba ni/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi lus sems kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs bcos slad med pa bla mas ji ltar bstan pa de nyid/ lam du nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu thob tshul bstan pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs la brten te/ bsgom par bya ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad shes par bya ba'i phyir lus dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs kyis bsgom bya don gyi ngo bo shes par bya ba'i phyir/ lta ba'i don gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ grub chen til+li pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni/

mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gi// lus kyi chos su gnas pa yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad par byed pa la/ dang po ni/ bar do dang po'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ni/ chos dbyings stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ pha ma'i kun+da dkar dmar 'dres par gyur pa ni/ gdan nyi zla las mngon par byang chub pa/ de yang phor skye na hūm̐ dang mor skye na a'i tshul gyis mngal du 'jug pa ni gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ pho mo skye ba'i dbang gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ dril bu'i tshul du gnas pa ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ zla dgu ngo bcu nas skye ba na sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o// de ltar yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/ skyes nas 'dod chags bral nyid dang*// mngal gyi khru ma chos gos dang*// de bzhin ma ni mkhan po nyid// mgo bor thal mo sbyar ba phyag /'gro ba'i bya ba khrims kyi gnas// sngags kyi bzlas pa a dang haṃ// skye gnas 'khor lo'i rnam pa a// bde chen dbyings kyi rnam pa haṃ// gcer bu skra dang kha spu bregs// sngags 'don skyes pa dge slong nyid// 'di dag rkyen gyis sems can rnams// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// zla ba bcu yang sa rnams nyid// sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /zhes gsungs so// gnas pa rtsa bshad pa/ 'gyu ba rlung bshad pa/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems bshad pa/ sdom pa 'khor lo bshad pa/ de nyid nyams su len pa'i thabs gtum mo bshad pa/ zhes gsung rgyun la yod/ gnyis pa rtsa'i chags tshul ni/ de ltar ma'i mngal du zhugs pa nas zla ba bcu gnyis kyi bar du zhag re re la lus kyi rtsa nyis brgya nyis brgya chags pas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro// de rnams kyi rtsa'i gtso mo rnams bsdus pa ni brten pa lus kyi rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis su ma rgyud rnams las gsungs shing*/
