khams dkar dmar he ru ka yab yum dang*/ gong gi rtsa rnams su 'bab pa'i khams kyi bye brag so dang sen mo sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rgyu ba rnams/ bde mchog gi lus dkyil du dpa' bo rnams su gsal bar gsungs shing*/ rnam par rtog pa lus dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi skabs su ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rtog pa gang skyes pa'i dus su skad cig ma bsam pa'i rang gzugs su grub la/ de'i byed las rnam par smin pa'i lus grub pa'o// zhes skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi gsung las/ rtsa ba rlung lnga'i khrid du 'byung ngo*// gzhan yang mdor na/ lus sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sku'i rang bzhin dang*/ ngag grags stong rdo rje gsung gi rang bzhin/ yid snang stong rdo rje thugs kyi rang bzhin du ye gdod ma nas gnas te/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ bskyed rim ni yongs su grub/ ces pa lta bu'o// de ltar lus dngos po'i gnas lugs rags pa bstan nas/ gnyis pa sems dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad par byed pa la/ ji skad du/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ sems ni ye shes rnam lnga dang*// bde ba stong pa nyid dag dang*// mi rtog pa dang ting 'dzin gyi// sems kyi chos 'di gnas pa'o// zhes gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo spros pa'i yul gyi mtha' thams cad dang bral cing*/ ngo bo dang nges bzung rtag brtan ther zug gi dngos po dang bral ba/ chal chad med bkag had po'i bdud kyis gzhom par mi nus shing snang ba dang*/ srid pas bsdus pa'i 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi klong chen po 'di yi bdag nyid dam/ phyi mo lta bur kun la khyab pa 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ ye khyab ma hā mu dra'i dbyings gzhi 'di nyid la/ bzang ngan legs nyes bde sdug gi ngo bo ci yang ma sgrib shing*/ bkra bar 'char ba 'di ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/

de ltar dngos por shar ba kun kyang ma 'dres shing*/ tha dad du snang yang go ma 'gag pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams kyang sems las logs su gyur pa med cing*/ de ltar snang ba kun kyang chos dbyings 'di nyid kyi ngo bo gcig pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de ltar kun la khyab pa 'di nyid kyi ngo bo rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa gang gi tshe yang*/ bya ba mi bslu shing stong nyid rgyu 'bras su snang ba ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so// de ltar yang rje bram ze chen pos/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu sbyin par byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rje btsun nā ro pas/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang*/ bde ba dang stong pa dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gdod ma nas gnas par gsungs te/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ 'di ni 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di ni mya ngan 'das pa'o// 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can de// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa nyid// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam par rtog pa'i snang cha'i rtsal ma 'gags par kun tu 'char ba chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid du nges pas so// 'di la 'khrul gzhi med de/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgongs don gyi snying po 'bras bu gzhi thog nas rang chas su gnas pa kho nar bzhed de/ rnam rtog kyang sems las gzhan du min pa'i phyir ro// de yang ji skad du/ do ha las/ gang zhig sems las rnam spros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam// zhes gsungs shing*/ mdor bsdu na sems 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum gyi mtha' dang bral bar rtogs pa 'di nyid la chos kyi sku zhes kyang zer/

rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes kyang zer/ lhag mthong don dam pa'i bden pa zhes kyang zer/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes kyang zer te/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ a'o nga ni tha mal gyi shes pa skyong*/ zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos kyang*/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// ces dang*/ slob dpon tog rtse pa'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med do gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /ces gsungs so// de ltar rang sems rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ ci yang ma yin la cir yang snang ba 'dis thams cad la khyab par gnas pa yang*/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ spros dang bral ba rang gi sems// 'khor 'das kun gyi rang bzhin te// dus gsum kun la khyab pa ste// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'o// zhes gsungs/ de ltar da ltar gyi lus sems 'di la 'bras bu rang chas su gnas pa bstan pa ste/ sems dngos po'i gnas tshul cung zad bshad zin to// de ltar lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs su gnas pa de nyid/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis ngo sprad cing*/ lam nyams su blangs pa las/ 'bras bu thob par gsungs te/ dwags po'i chos bzhi las/ gzhi la gnas pa/ lam la goms pas/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pas chos nyid/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yod pas bsgrub na 'grub la/ rgyu med na bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ gshis la mi gnas na bltas pas mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de ltar gong du bstan pa ltar lus sems ye nas sangs rgyas su gnas/

de nyid yod kyang ngo ma shes pa ni/ ye shes de nyid las logs su ma gyur pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya ba/ nye bar len pa'i rgyu dang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas te/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba na 'khor te/ nga bdag chags sdang gi dug lnga'i bdag nyid du gnas so// de ltar yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi lus skye ba rim par chags pa ltar sprul sku'i ngo bo de nyid lam du/ mngon par byang chub lngas yi dam gyi lhar gsal gtab/ lus yongs su rdzogs te bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la zhugs pa'i longs sku'i rang bzhin de nyid bskyed rim gyi ngo bor nges te/ tha mal gyi 'dzin pa thams cad dbyings su bsres te lha'i sku de yang rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'o// lus 'byung bzhi'i sgyu ma 'dus pa'i phung po 'jig pa de 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i ngo bo nyid lam dus rdzogs rim chen po gsum sogs kyi ming gzhi kun/ 'dzin gzhi 'dzin grol rang babs kyi rol pa gnas pa'o// de yang dang po ni/ mnyam med sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ phyi lus lta bu'i bskyed rim 'khor lo sdom pa/ nang snying lta bu'i bskyed rim dgyes pa rdo rje/ gsang ba snying khrag lta bu'i bskyed rim rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don dran pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom/ de'i ngang las/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la/ rang gi sems nyid bam̐ yig smug nag 'od 'bar ba grub pa'i tshe/

gri gug thong gshol/ dbyug pa zla tshes thig le'i gzugs rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ mkha' la glog 'khyug pa'am nam mkha' la dar dmar po 'phyar ba ltar bur/ rang nyid yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gnyis ma rtsa zhal khro chags 'dres ma'i nyams can rngam zhing 'jigs pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po nam mkha'i dbyings su ngur sgra sgrog cing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas spras shing bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon bhan dha khrag gis gang ba thugs kar rol ba/ me tog dmar po dang sin dhu ra'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ sku'i rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi gar chen khams gsum gyi dbyings su bsgyur ba/ gru mor he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba dang*/ rang lus las 'bar ba'i me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo/ snying kar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃḥmoṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hum̐ hūṃ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍ+ri ka du kha rnams kyis mtshan par bsams la/ gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i bskyed rim la blo nges par bya zhing*/ 'di ltar lha'i skur bsgom pa ni chos thams cad du ma ro gcig pa'i sku la rtsa ba'i zhal khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams kyi nyon mongs kyi chags sdang dbyings su zhi ba/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrog pa'i chos sku 'gyur ba med pa mtshon pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings kyi lhag ma rgyab tu grol ba ni/

ye shes dbyings su rgyas pas sems can bde la 'god pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar bas/ bdud bzhi rtsad nas bcod pa/ g.yon pa ban dha khrag gis bskang ba bsnams pa las/ rtog med kyi zas la rol ba/ thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan pa bde gshegs rigs lnga mtshon pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig dag par mtshon pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis spras pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug mtshon pa/ chos nyid kyi rol pa mtshon pa'i bam chen gyi gdan la nyon mongs pa bsreg pa'i phyir du ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa sogs kyi rnam dag dran par byas la/ bsgoms pas skyo na lte bar chos 'byung gi dbus su pad nyi'i lte bar bam̐ las sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa ṇa ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci nus su bzla bar bya zhing*/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe lte ba'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam par 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi sems can rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba rnams la thim/ de rnams rang nyid la/ de yang bam̐ la thim ste bam̐ yig khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le na da la bsdus pa'i ngang nas ma yengs pa'i dran par 'jog de ltar bskyed rdzogs zung du 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa la brten zhen pa dang 'dzin pa'i chags gzhi kun phra rags kyi tshul du spong ste/ de yang skyed rim gyis lus ngag yid tha mal gyi 'dzin pa las grol ba'i phyir du/ lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i snang la dngos med kyi tshul du sgom ste/ dpal phag mo gru pas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku bsgom// dgos pa tha mal gyi zhen pa ldog /ces gsungs so// rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog pas ni/

der 'dzin gyi 'ching ba las kyang 'da' ste/ gong du bstan pa'i sems dngos po'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag go /lam gyi dngos gzhi dpal nā ro'i chos drug 'di nyid la'ang gnyis te/ rtsa ba dang yan lag go /dang po la'ang bzhi ste/ 'pho ba'i bag chags kyi dri ma sbyong ba la gtum mo/ sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa la 'od gsal/ bag chags nying 'khrul gyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa la rmi lam/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa sgyu lus so// yan lag la gnyis te// 'khor ba dang bar do'o// de yang*/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas gtum mo dang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas 'od gsal/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas rmi lam/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la brten nas sgyu lus dang*/ las rgya 'pho bar gyi gdams pa rnams nyams su blang bar bya'o// dang po gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing la'ang*/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la yang gnas dang spyod lam gyi mtshan nyid/ lus sbyang ba dang*/ rtsa sbyang ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba'o// de la gtum mo sgom pa'i tshe gnas khang gi sgo lhor bstan pa ma yin pa'i nang du/ rang gi lus la yi dam gyi lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i byug pas brgyan/ rigs dang mthun pa'i phyogs su kha bltas la/ rnam snang gi chos bdun gyis 'khod do// thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bskyed rdzogs kyi ngang la ci gnas su bzhag de'i ngang las slar yang rang lus lha sku sgyu ma lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor/ gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pas bskor bar bsams la/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs la 'gyod tshangs drag pos stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags shing*/

lus longs spyod ltos med du dbul/ rlung bde rtsa 'jam thig le'i gegs skyon mi 'byung zhing*/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gsol ba gdab tshogs rten rang la bstim/ de'i ngang las rang phyi dbyibs yi dam du gsal gtab pa la/ nang khru ma phus gtab pa'i shel gyi bum pa skyon dang bral ba lta bu'i stong gsal du sgom zhing shes pa ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog go /de'i dgos byed ni nang rtsa yi gnas lugs mthong ba dang*/ rtsa mdud rnams grol te/ rlung gnad du chud pa la brten gegs skyon mi 'byung zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do// skabs 'dir yan lag lnga sbyong dang*/ nā ro drug bskor gyi 'khrul 'khor bya bar 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i khrid yig las byung ba yin kyang*/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa ltar rtsa rlung sbyar ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ rlung gnad ldan pa'i ngang nas 'khrul 'khor ston pa'i phyag len 'di nyid gtso bor byas te/ don du 'brel bar mngon no// de yang*/ rang lus lha sku stong ra'i khong dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ba/ kha dog rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan de lta bu/ yar sna tshangs bug dang*/ mar sna gsang gnas su sleb pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po yas sna sna bug gnyis dang*/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhir dbu ma la yi ge cha'i dbyibs su zug pa ste rtsa'i gtso mo gsum dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad gur gyi chon thag brgyangs pa lta bu/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gdugs kyi 'degs byed lta bu/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis gdugs phub pa lta bu ste/

de rnams kyang sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi ldan sog sbubs lta bu stong gsal du bsgom mo// chos drug gi yig cha rnying pa la lar/ ma dag lus kyi stong ra dang*// dag pa lha'i stong ra/ rtsa'i stong ra zhes stong ra gsum du bstan na'ang*/ rgyud pa 'di nyid kyi bzhed par de rnams kyi tha snyad du dbye ba mi mdzad de/ skyed rim yongs grub kyi gnad kyis/ phyi dbyibs yi dam kyi sku zhal phyag rgyan yongs su rdzogs pa la/ nang rtsa'i 'khor lo stong ra'i tshul du gsal 'debs pa'o// de ltar gong du bstan pa'i dmigs pa rnams gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rlung sbyang bar bya ste/ thog mar lus gnad ni rkang pa skyil krung las/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur g.yas pa gru 'og tu bcug g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo brkyang bas/ thog mar rlung sna bug g.yas nas dal bus brngubs te/ yid mig rlung gsum dril la g.yon nas sgra med du 'bud pa'i tshe/ g.yas kyi mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa bkag yang phyag rgya rlung gnad bsgyur bas g.yas su 'bud pa ste re mos kyi tshul du g.yas g.yon gnyis su gsum gsum 'bud/ de rjes rdo rje khu tshur pus steng so sor bzhag la dbus su gsum ste 'bud pa dgu phrugs zhes bya'o// de nas bum pa can dgang stong gi rlung sbyor ni/ lus gnad de'i ngang las mgrin pa cung zad bkug ste/ dal bus rngubs la mchil ma mid pa dang lhan cig lte 'og tu mnan la drod cung zad phebs pa dang*/ 'og rlung thon te kha sbyor du thub thang du bzung zhing*/ ma thub pa'i tshe cung zad btang la/ yang dal bus mnan no// rngubs chung cig byas la phyir yang sgra med du btang ngo*// de yang rngubs dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phangs dang rnam pa bzhi// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur nyen yod// ces dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ rlung sgra med du rngub pa rngubs pa'i gnad// rlung lte 'og tu skyur ba dgang ba'i gnad// rlung rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad// rlung phyi nang bsal ba gtong ba'i gnad// rlung gi gnad bzhi ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen// zhes gsungs pas/

rlung rngubs pa'i tshe dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu rlung gi rnam par dal busaspyan drangs ro rkyang gi lam las brgyud/ lte 'og tu 'dril cing*/ rtsa 'khor lo rnams gang bar mos/ phyir dbyung ba'i tshe sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rlung dang 'dris te phyir dbyung zhing*/ rlung rting cung zad sgra bcas su 'bud pa'i tshe/ spyi gtsug dbu ma'i rtse las thon/ sngo phyur phyur song bar mos pa ni mda' ltar 'phang ba zhes bya ste/ dran pa tsam min pa nan tan che bar mi bya'o// lung 'og ma'i phyi nang bsre ba zhes bya ba ni/ phyir dbyung ba'i tshe nang gi nam mkha' dang phyi'i nam mkha' bsre ba'i don la dgongs pa'o// de ltar rlung sbyang ba'i dgos pa ci zhes na/ rlung ro bus pas/ rtsa ngan pa'i nang du rlung 'khyims pa gang mchis pa rnams kyang 'thon pa dang*/ rlung log mi 'byung la/ snod ma dag pa'i dri ma can bkrus pa ltar 'gyur ro// de las 'jam rlung bum pa can nyams su blangs na/ rlung gi gegs mi 'byung zhing*/ lus kyi rtsa mdud kun grol ba dang*/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog kyang yin no// de ltar lus gnad dmigs pa rlung dang bcas pa de nyid kyi ngang nas/ lus sbyang bar bya ba ni/ lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur can mdun du brkyang zhing g.yas kyi phur ba gsum/ phyag rgya de bsgyur ba gsum/ mgo lus med par phur zhing*/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon la'ang phur ba gsum dang*/ mthar rdo rje skyil krung 'bebs/ rlung sprugs dang bcas pa gsum bya ba ni/ lus 'dul rlung khrus zhes bya'o// lus 'khrul 'khor bya ba ni/ sked pa g.yas g.yon bskor ba yis// lte ba'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed/ gru dpung phyi nang bcus pa yis// snying ga'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed/ ske ni bcud bskor bsdams pa yis// mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// mgo bo bskor zhing bcag pa yis// spyi bo'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// yan lag bzhi yi brkyang bskum gyis// tshig gi rtsa rnams dul bar byed// mgo lus med par phur ba yis// lus kyi rtsa rnams grol bar byed// zhes dang*/

rngul dgram pa'i phyir du/ so bdun ma'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ dbus dang g.yas g.yon sked bskor ni// drug gsum bco brgyad mda' 'gengs drug /zhags bskyur dpung brdeg drug drug ste// so drug 'debs dang so bdun no// zhes pa rnams lag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar gnad ma 'chugs par bya'o// de ltar sbyang ba gsum gyi legs par sbyangs nas/ dngos gzhi gtum mo nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ ma zin zin byed/ zin pa brtan byed/ brtan pa bogs dbyung ba'o// dang po la yang*/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ bzhag pa sems kyi gnad/ nyams len dus kyi gnad dang gsum las/ dang po ni rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/ lag pa lte 'og tu mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bya ba'am/ pus mkhyud du bskor/ mgrin pa dgug rked pa bsrang*/ dpung pa brgyang*/ mig sna rtser gtad/ sgom thag rab gnas dang ldan pa bcang*/ lus sems li khri ltar sgrim par bya ste/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/ rkang pa re mig bzhin du bsnol// dgos pa drod ni skye ba yin// lte 'og sor bzhi bcal ba ru// mnyam gzhag phyag rgya bcing bar bya// dgos pa bde ba skye ba yin// sgal tshigs dong rtse bzhin du brtsegs// dgos pa rlung gnad chud pa yin// mgrin pa rgya mdud bzhin du bsdam// dgos pa mi rtog skye ba yin// dpung pa rgod gshog bzhin du brgyang*// dgos pa rlung gnad chud pa yin// lus sems li khri bzhin du sgrim// dgos pa drod skye myur ba yin// mig gnyis sna rtse gtad par bya// dgos pa shes pa gsal ba yin// sgom thag gis ni legs par bsdam// dgos pa lus gnad dam pa yin// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa dmigs pa sems kyi gnad ni/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng*// lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad// phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// steng na haṃ yig rnam pa can// 'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍa li// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo'i dbyibs// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams pa zer// sems gnad du chud dam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas/

gong du bstan pa'i rlung gnad de'i ngang nas/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sgom par sems bskyed/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs shing*/ snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i spyi bor/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par gsal gtab/ lus longs spyod dbul/ dbang bzhi blang*/ mthar bla ma rang la bstim/ de nas rang lus phyi lha'i sku/ nang stong ra'i dbus su/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal gtab pa'i lte 'og rtsa mtshams su/ dmar cha'i dwangs ma a shad kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rtse mo rno zhing 'khyog pa'i rnam pa can gyi/ me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dbu ma'i nang du/ cung zad gnas par bsgom/ gsum pa nyams len dus kyi gnad ni/ spyi dang bye brag las/ dang po ni/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ nyams len dus ni bar mtshams med// dus kyi rgyal po dran pa'i tshe na ste// 'di la gza' skar tshes grangs brtsi mi dgos// zhes dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ srog rtsol sgom pa'i dus gnad ni/ rlung mnyam rgyu'i dus mchog tu bshad par snga gong rnams dang*/ man ngag gi yi ge ci rigs su byung bas/ rlung yon po srang ba'i 'khrul 'khor yang gzhan gyis kha bskang ste/ dus gnad ma 'chugs par nyams su blangs na/ bogs che zhing lhag pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ram snyam pa yang shes ldan rnams kyi dpyod par mdzod cig spyi don gnyis pa/ gtum mo zin pa brtan par byed pa gsum ste/ sngar gyi me shin tu phra ba de la g.yas g.yon gyi rlung gis bsnun pas/ me de nyid che 'bar lug ril tsam pa dang*/ mthe bong tsam pa dang*/ bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam pa ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan la mnyam par bzhag go// spyi don gsum pa/ brtan pa bogs dbyung ba la yang gsum de/ drod dang bde ba/ mi rtog pas bogs dbyung ba'o// de yang ji skad du/ rlung gi skyod pas 'og gi 'khor lo nas bzhed glog gi zer ltar 'od gsal cing*/

tshigs can gsum po bsregs nas 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod gyur bdud rtsi'i rgyun rab 'bab/ sangs rgyas ye shes spyan dang 'dres shing skyon bral kun dga'i tshogs ster ba/ dngos dang dngos med rnam par spyod dang bral ba'i phag mo yis ni khyed la bsrungs// zhes rkang pa dang pos drod kyi bogs 'don pa dang*/ rkang pa gnyis pas bde ba'i bogs 'don pa dang*/ rkang pa gsum pa dang bzhi pa dag gis mi rtog pa'i bogs dbyung ba bstan pa ste/ dang po la'ang gnyis te/ nang lus la sbar ba dang*/ phyi yul la sbar ba'o// dang po ni/ dus gnad sngar bzhin la/ rlung gis drag tu bsnun pas/ me'i sa bon las me cher 'bar/ rim pa bzhin/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams kyi rtsa gsum 'khor lo dang bcas pa mes gang bar dmigs shing*/ rlung drag tu gzung nas/ gangs seng ma dang*/ rtsub shing me'i 'khor lo'i 'khrul 'khor bya ba ni/ me thab drug bcings lus gnad las/ sked pa g.yas g.yon bskor ba dang*// gru dpung bcu zhing rgyab mdun du// 'phul 'then 'bebs rnam gsum gsum bya// 'di ni rgya gar gangs seng zhes// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor dang po ste// mnyam med mi la'i dgongs pa mchog /tsog bu rkang snol srin lag gis// rkang mtheb gzung zhing rked bskor dang*// dpung pa gzings dbab brdeg tshogs kun// gsum gsum bya ba'i lus gnad ni// rtsub shing me yi 'khor lo zhes// 'jig rten mgon po'i khyad par chos// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa'o// rgyal dbang kun dga'i phyag bzhes las// gangs seng rtsa ba yan lag gi /'khrul 'khor gcig tu dril ba ni// lus gnad me thab drug bcings las// sked bskor pus bzur dpung 'bebs dang*// 'phul 'then 'bebs dang gsum gsum ste// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gsum pa'o// de ltar 'khrul 'khor rnams lag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar/ rlung gi gnad ma 'chugs par nyams su blang ba'i tshe/

rtsa 'khor de dang de rnams su/ gtum mo ye shes kyi me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyis/ chil chil gang bar bsam zhing*/ de'i tshe lus rngul na/ dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor so bdun dang*/ sran phyes 'phur ba rnams lag len ltar bya'o// yang sngar ltar rlung gis bsnan pas/ 'khor lo bzhi dang rtsa ba'i me'i sa bon las cher 'bar/ bu ga dgu dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas phyir byung*/ me ri dwags kyi spu lta bus mgo lus thams cad 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ drod kyi 'khrul 'khor rtsa ba yan lag la 'bad/ gegs byung na sngar gyis sel lo// yang rtsa ba'i me'i sa bon las kyi rlung gis bskyed pas/ lus thams cad la me 'bar/ rang gi gnas khang*/ yul gru/ 'dzam bu'i gling*/ gling bzhi gling phran/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bar rim pa bzhin du bskal pa'i me dpung chen po ltar 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ rlung rtsol dang drod kyi 'khrul 'khor la 'bad/ gegs byung na sngar gyis sel lo// 'di'i skabs su gtum mo bde drod kyi lang tsho ngom pa'i phyir/ brgyud pa gong ma'i phyag len las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ ras 'bud bgyi ba la gsum te/ rab lta ba'i sgo nas ras 'bud la/ 'bring dmigs pa/ tha ma rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor ro// dang po ni/ snang srid thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa 'ba' zhig tu shar ba dag gis/ dmigs pa rlung 'khrul 'khor la sogs mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi thun sgom byed spyod kyi yul las 'das pa dag ste/ don dam mchog gi gtum mo mngon du gyur pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gang zag sbyangs pa mngon du gyur cing shes yul rang mdangs dri ma dang bral cing*/ gang dmigs pa'i yul las skad cig kyang mi yengs pa dag go /gsum pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i thabs lam rnams nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams te/ 'bring dang tha ma'i slob ma rnams tshan khrus bya zhing*/

bla mas bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor gang yang rung ba gsal gtab la/ shis brjod kyis brtan par bya zhing*/ dmigs pa dngos ni/ mal stan me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba'i steng du/ seng ge'i nyal thabs kyis gnas pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba gnyis kyi dbus su/ lus dngos kyang lcags bsregs pa lta bur bsam zhing*/ phyi snod nang bcud kyi me rnams bsdus nas lte 'og sor bzhir me bya sgong tsam pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ snam sbyar ram/ dar la'am/ ras rkyang gi bgo ba dang ldan pas bde bar nyal lo// gnyis pa bde bas bogs byung ba ni/ kye rdo rje'i brtan pa dang po'i rdo rje rigs kyi le'u las/ lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te// bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /zhes dang*/ ka dpe las/ srog rtsol gyis ni sbyor ba yis// lte ba'i a las me 'bar te// 'khor lo bzhi bsregs rtsa kha dbye// me lce haṃ la reg pa yis// byang chub sems kyis rtsa gnas gang*// a la babs shing thigs pa chad// bde stong dbyer med don la gzung*// zhes gsungs pas/ lus gnad me thab drug bcings dang*/ rlung gnad sbyor ba bzhi ldan las dmigs pa ni/ lte ba nas gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar bas/ g.yon zla ba'i rgyu ba bkag ste/ ro ma'i nang du yar 'bar/ snying gar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bon/ buṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa'i yi ge lnga rtsa mdud kyi tshul du gnas pa/ rlung gis bkrol zhing*/ de nas g.yas nyi ma'i rgyu ba bkag nas/ me de nyid g.yon brkyang ma'i nang nas thon/ mgrin par yum lnga'i sa bon/ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ aṃ/ zhes pa'i yi ge lnga/ rtsa mdud kyi tshul tu gnas pa bkrol te/ me de nyid g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag dbu ma'i nang du mar babs/ me sor bzhi tsam 'bar bas lte ba'i bar du sleb par bsgom/

slar yang de las me 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang nas rgyud/ 'khor lo gsum rim gyis bgrod de/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'bar bas/ dbu ma'i yar sna byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yi ge haṃ dkar po mgo mthur du bstan pa/ ba'i nu ma lta bur gnas pa la/ me lces reg pas ji ltar zhun mar gyi zar bu la/ tsha ba'i zer gyis gdungs pa las/ zhun 'thigs pa ltar haṃ las byang chub kyi sems dkar po snum la 'dril ba/ bde ba'i rang bzhin du babs/ me'i rtse mo la reg la khad 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor lo 'og ma rnams su babs par bsam zhing*/ de ltar bsgoms pas kun da 'pho ba'i skyon du 'gyur srid na/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su blangs te/ de yang rlung gi sbyor bas/ me cung zad 'bar ba dang*/ thig le'i rgyun je thung la song ba las 'khor lo rnams su/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag cing*/ spyi bo'i bar bsgom/ 'di'i skabs su skyob pa yab sras kyi khyad chos 'khrul 'khor gyi gdams pa/ gzhan dang thun mong du ma gyur pa'i phyag bzhes zab mo/ lus sbyong bcu gnyis ma zhes bya ba/ byang chub kyi sems 'dren 'grems brtan par byed pa ni 'di'o// de yang rtsa tshig dang 'khrul 'khor dngos bstan pa las// dang po ni/ 'dzin pa sbyor ba drug ldan ri rab 'degs pa rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya/ kā hig yi dwags kyi 'dug stangs/ hring hring dri za'i 'dug stangs/ gyad kyi 'dug stangs/ bgrod pa'i thang gzhi/ glang chen gyi hing rings/ stag mo'i skyug stangs/ wa mo'i snom tshul/ g.yang mo'i sgang sprugs/ nya mo'i 'phar rdebs/ bab bzhi 'phra ba/ sgo dgu dgag pa seng ge rnams rol lo// de rnams las gnyis pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung dang*// sgal tshigs rab tu bsrang bya zhing*// lag pa khu tshur bsnol bya ste// rlung gnad pho rlung sgang dril la// nyi zla'i sgo gnyis gyen ldog bsgril// dmigs pa gser gyi mchod rten nam// ri rab bteg la mkha' ru yal// de ltar sbyor ba drug ldan ni// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor dang po'o// rkang pa skyil krung lag pa g.yas// rdo rje khu tshur mchan 'og brten// lag g.yon sdig mdzub nam mkha' bsgring*// rlung ni phyir dbyung kā hig sgra// yid mig rlung gsum mdzub rtser gtad// phyag rgya de bsgyur lan gsum ste// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa'o// drang por langs pa'i rkang lag ni// gcu zhing brkyang la hring gi sgras// rlung phyir dbyung zhing gsum du bskyar// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor gsum pa'o// khri 'degs gyad kyi 'dug stangs la// ga'u kha sbyor rlung gi gnad// nya bzhi'i sha dang shed bsgrim pa// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor bzhi pa'o// langs pa'i rkang lag thad bzhir brgyang*// bum can kha sbyor rlung gi gnad// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor lnga pa'o// pus btsugs lag gnyis khu tshur ni// mdun du kha sbub hūṃ gi sgras// rlung gnad phyi ru dbyung ba ni// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor drug pa'o// rkang pa'i lus gnad sngar bzhin la// gru mo lag ngar sar dbab cing*/

khu tshur dgye la hag gi sgras// rlung gnad phyi ru dbyung ba ni// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor bdun pa'o// skyel krung lus steng khu tshur bcang*// rngub chung g.yon nas g.yas su 'bud// g.yas nas g.yon du'ang de bzhin te// dbus nas rngub chung dbus su 'bud// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor brgyad pa'o// pus btsugs lus sgur lag ngar ni// sa steng bzhag cing g.yas g.yon gcu// lus gnad de las sprug pa ni// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor dgu pa'o// gan rkyal nyal ba'i rkang lag ni// mkha' la brkyang zhing brdeg pa dang*// lus kyang lan gsum brdeb par bya// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor bcu pa'o// 'greng ba'i rkang lag g.yas pa ni// nang du bskor zhing 'phrol ba dang*// phyi ru bskor zhing 'phra bya ste// de bzhin g.yon du'ang phyi nang gnyis// bskor zhing 'phra bar bya ba ste// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor bcu gcig pa// skyil krung lus bsrang lag gnyis kyi// mthe'u srin kha dang gung mos sna// mdzub mos mig dang mthe bong gis// rna ba dag ni bkag byas la// pho rlung sgang dril g.yas g.yon dgyer// 'dir bshad 'khrul 'khor bcu gnyis pa// dgu dang bcu pa bcu gcig pa'i// rlung gnad bum can kha sbyor ro// de ltar 'khrul 'khor rnams lag len gyi gnad ma 'chug par mthong ba brgyud pa las 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// gzhan yang 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal pos/ mdzad pa'i yig cha las/ kun+da bsrung dka' na sum chos ltar gnad du bsnun/ zhes pa dang*/ 'dren rkyang pa la 'bad pas rkang pa 'khums pa sogs kyi gegs byung na/ gtum mo sku bsring ba'i gnad zab mo'i man ngag ltar shes par bya/ zhes pa'i zhal shes gnyis kyang*/ 'dir gang zag phyi rabs pa rnams kyi don du bshad par bya ste/ dang po la'ang gsum/ nyon mongs pa lam tu gtong ba'i man ngag /bde chen byang chub sems kyi mnangag theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag go// dang po ni/

bde ba'i nyams ches skyes pa'i dus skad cig gnyis pa de nyid la/ nyon mongs pa de rang ga shes pa tsir gyis bzung la khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa'am/ gzhu bdung ba'i tshad tsam du ma yengs par byas la lam du gtong*/ yun sher snying tshar gcig bklag pa'i yun tsam du gnad la dbab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas/ gong du spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad du/ thig le g.yos pa rnams dug la sngags kyis gtab pas sman du 'gyur ba bzhin du/ byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med pa'i bde bar ro gcig pas/ gnas skabs su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i zhal mthong ba'i dgos pa yod/ gsum pa ni/ de nas lus yi dam gyi sku/ zhal phyag gdan phyag mtshan rgyan dang bcas pa gsal gtab pas ba spu'i bu ga tshun la khrems par gyur pas/ yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa la tshegs med do// gnyis pa gtum mo sku sring ba'i man ngag ni/ sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du btang nas/ rang lus yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba las/ sku'i cha mar bsrings te mda' rgyang gsum tsam du gnas pa'i khong pa'i nang*/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo gsal gtab pa'i 'dus mdor/ me'i sa bon a shad la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par bsgoms pas bde ba mi bzod pa byung na/ me 'bar la khad pa dang*/ des kyang ma thub na/ me de nyid 'bar bas rtse mo lte bar sleb pa tsam du bsgom/ des kyang ma thub na snying ga dang mgrin pa rnams su me lce reg tsam gsal gtab ste/ yun ring ba ni ma yin no// des gong gi skyon rnams sel lo// de nas slar yang bde ba'i shugs chung na/ bde chen 'khor lo'i bar du me 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ haṃ las byang sems kyi rgyun babs nas/ dga' bzhi lugs 'byung dkar dmar 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du nyams su blang ba ni sngar dang 'dra'o// yang dwangs ma'i gegs su 'gyur srid na/

dga' bzhi lugs bzlog gi dmigs pa sngar ltar las/ ras chung drug bskor du grags pa'i 'dren 'grems kyi 'khrul 'khor bgyi bar 'dod na/ 'di lta ste/ dang po mgur chu bum pa nyed// gnyis pa ri bo'i rtse nas bsgul// gsum pa rgya mtsho gting nas dkrug /bzhi pa gling bzhi dbang du bsdud// lnga pa bya rkang rdo rje 'gros// drug pa seng ge rnam rol lo// de'i lag len 'di lta ste/ dang po skyil krung lag gnyis ni// brkyang phur mgrin pa mnye ba'o// gnyis pa skyil krung pus steng du/ khu tshur brgyang zhing mgo bo bskor// gsum pa lus gnad de nyid las// rgya mtsho col zhing g.yas g.yon bskor// bzhi pa gan rkyal yan lag bzhi// brkyang zhing lus la brdeg pa gsum// lnga pa skyil krung sgyid khug tu// lag ngar g.yas g.yon bcug byas la/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong la// ljid bkal pa la 'beb gsum bya// drug pa seng ge rnam rol ni// gong du bshad las khyad ma mchis// de ltar 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi tshe// sbyor bzhi rlung gnad lhag par gces// zhes rnams kyang lag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bya'o// 'di dag gi skabs su// nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ drod shas chung na me'i dmigs pa dang*/ bde ba shas chung na thig le'i dmigs pa rnams la/ gtso gang che nyams su len tshul/ rigs pa'i mda' yis bsnun par bya zhing*/ bde drod 'dzin stong gi don la myong ba ci skyes su bzhag go /gzhan yang*/ rje rin po che'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag 'di la/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ snum zhing 'dril ba bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ bya sgong tsam pa zhig bsgom par bya'o// de la goms pa dang*/ brgyad bcu drug tu gyes par bsgom/ de la gnad du song ba dang*/ thig le dkar dmar gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsgom/ de nas mthar rim gyis rtsa ba'i thig le'i bar du bsdus/

bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin las/ skad cig kyang ma yengs par rtse gcig tu sgom ste/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang*/ mar me'i rtsa mo rab bcings ltar// rtag tu 'di dag rnal 'byor las// nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces so// gsum pa mi rtog pas bogs dbyung ba ni/ bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten pa la phog gzhal yas khang du byas/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu/ nang bcud kyi sems can rang 'dra'i yi dam gyi skur gsal ba la thim/ de rnams kyang bdag nyid la bsdu/ bdag gi phyi dbyibs yi dam lhar gsal ba yang*/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang rtsa ba'i me 'am thig le la bsdu/ de nyid kyang nā da shin tu phra ba'i bar rim gyis bsdus nas/ nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin/ spros bcas rtog dpyod phra 'dzin/ had sgom nga rlom thams cad dang bral bas/ gang phrad kyi ngo bo la gcer yan du bzhag go /de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum la gnad du bsnun pas/ rtsa bskams pa rnams bangs/ 'byar ba rnams bye/ 'chus pa rnams srong*/ mdud pa rnams grol nas yon tan gyi rtsa kha rnams bye/ de'i nang du rlung sems 'dus pas byang chub kyi sems 'phel zhing*/ rten 'brel de rnams 'dzom pa las/ bde drod mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur te/ de yang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis nye bar zhi ba/ spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba kho na nyid yin kyang*/ de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du/ 'gag med rtsal gyi 'char sgo las/ bde drod kyi rnam pa ltar shar yang*/ shar dus nyid nas rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ ci yi ngo bor yang ma grub cing cir yang snang ba/ shes bya thams cad la khyab cing*/ skad cig ma gcig tu 'du ba/ bde sdug dang btang snyoms/ spangs rtogs thams cad du gdags pa'i gzhi la/ de nyid gang gis kyang rnam pa thams cad du ma gos pa/

sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhes bzang du ma song zhing*/ sems can gyi rtog pa zhes ngan par mi gnas pa tha snyad ming tshig yi ges dpyod cing dpag pa'i gting mtha' ma mchis shing*/ ji ltar brtags kyang*/ de'i ngo bor gnas pa la/ gang ltar brjod pa kun gyis gos pa med pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ de ltar bsgoms par gyur pa la// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// rtsa bye bas rtsa mdud grol// thig le 'phel zhing bde ba rgyas// bde ba'i ngo bo mi rtog pa// de gsum dbyer med lhan cig skyes// 'du 'bral med pa chos skur 'bar// zhes gsungs te/ don dam mchog gi gtum mo'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ ye shes kyi gtum mo zhes pa'am/ mi rtog pas bogs dbyung ba zhes pa'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pa'i rjes thams cad du/ rkang rjen mi bya/ dung mi 'bud/ chu mi brgal/ 'khyags pa yid la mi bya/ lan tshwa dang sgog btsong spang*/ rul sungs can gyi zas dang*/ tsha skyur can gyi btung ba sogs/ drod dang bde ba'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad la 'dzem par bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing gi gdams pa zhes bya ba/ gang zag brtson 'grus can gyis bsgoms pas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas pa'i chos so// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i sgrib pa sel bar byed pa 'od gsal la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad/ khrus dang sku mnye bya/ grib la 'dzem/ kha zas bcud can bsten/ lus mchong rgyug dang 'gro 'dug ngag long gtam gyi smra brjod/ sems rnam par g.yeng ba rnams kyis dben par byas la/ mi shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong la dbul cing*/ 'od gsal zin pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ zhag gsum du gnyid spang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/

paṇa chen nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ gnyid dang rmi lam so mtshams na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// rmi lam 'od gsal 'thug po nyid// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas/ 'od gsal nyams su blang ba la/ 'dir gtum mo dang 'od gsal 'brel pa can yin pas/ nyin par dang srod la gtum mo bsgom/ gung gi thun la bab par/ 'od gsal gzung bar bya ste/ (102)dang po ni lus yid dam du bsgom pa'i/ nang stong ra'i dbus su/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo dang bcas pa gsal gtab/ spyi bo tshangs bug gi thad/ gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'chang gi cha byad can mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsgoms la/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod do// dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ bdag do nub bag chags 'khrul pa'i rmi lam mi rmi bar/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan bdun nam bcu gcig gi bar du gsol ba gtab/ mthar bla ma spyi bor thim/ de'i ngang las snying gar dbu ma'i nang du/ pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku chung la yan lag rdzogs pa/ dag cing gsal la dri ma med pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang ste shel gyi bum pa mar mes bltams pas kun tu gsal ba ltar lus phyi nang med par 'od kyi rnam pa'i ngang las/ bla ma'i sku las sems ma yengs par/ sngas byang du bstan/ gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug cing rkang pa shad kyis brkyang ba'i long bus longs bu non par bya/ lag sor g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas bkag

srin lag gis mig mnan/ mdzub mos rna ba bkag mtheb mos rtse'u chung mnan/ gru mos nu ma g.yas pa non par byas/ lag pa g.yon pa brla g.yon gyi steng brkyang ste 'jam rlung bum pa can gyi ngang nas/ rtog pa gzhan gyi bar ma chod par nyal na zin par 'gyur ro// des kyang ma zin na/ sngon 'gro rnams sngar dang 'dra'o// tho rangs nam langs nyi shar gsum gyi dus gnad dang bstun la 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba bya'o// gal te de ltar byas kyang ma zin na/ mtshams dam du bcad/ zhag gsum tsam du/ kha zas dang gnyid spang*/ bzhi pa'i nub mo bur chang bag tsam btung zhing*/ bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gtab pa dang*/ snying gar bla ma 'od zer dang ldan par dmigs pa sogs sngar ltar la/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba la sems gtad de/ gnyid du btang bas zin par 'gyur ro// des kyang ma zin na/ sbyor ba'i chos rnams gong bzhin byas la/ bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar/ thig le sngon po yungs dkar gyi 'bru tshad tsam/ dag cing gsal la snum zhing 'dril ba/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar bsam zhing*/ snying ga'i thig le la sems gtad de/ de'i ngang la rnam rtog gi 'du 'phro byung na/ 'od zer gyi rnam pas de nyid la thim par dmigs nas/ ma yengs pa'i ngang du gnyid log par bya'o//gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ 'od gsal ngos gzung ba dang*/ de nyid bogs dbyung ba'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ gzhi'i 'od gsal dang*/ lam gyi 'od gsal dang*/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal lo// dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ sems ni sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi sems nyid gdod ma nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gnas pa ni/ gzhi'i 'od gsal lo// gnyis pa lam gyi 'od gsal la gnyis te/ nyams kyi 'od gsal dang*/

rtogs pa'i 'od gsal lo// dang po ni/ nang lus kyi gnas lugs mthong ba dang*/ gnas khang gi nang mthong ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan ci rigs par mthong bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ snang mched thob gsum la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyun chad nas/ gnyid kyi dngos po de yang*/ gsal stong nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil ltar smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das par rtogs pa la/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal zhes byung ste/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i snang ba rnams/ thams cad gnyis med ye shes dang*// gcig tu byed pa'i bsam gtan la// 'od gsal zhes bya nā ro pa// zhes dang*/ ka dpe las/ 'od gsal lam du bya ba ni// chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pa// snang ba gsum ni rgyu can te// ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni// 'od gsal bar ni zhugs par gyur// stong pa ma yin mi stong min// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so// ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las// nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar// de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las// sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung zhing 'gag /'od gsal 'di ni rnam lnga ste// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal dang*// shes pa 'od gsal 'char ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od gsal dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal dang*// rtogs pa'i 'od gsal bstan pa'o// de la dus ni lnga yin te// 'chi ba'i dus dang dbu mar gnas// mnyam gzhag dang ni log pa'i tshe// mnyam rjes ro gcig gyur pa ni// lhag mthong rtogs pa'i dus yin no// 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa las// de las zung du 'jug pa 'char// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal zin pa'i go ba de// gnyid kyi dngos por gyur pa yang*// gsal stong nam mkha' mtha' med dbus// ting 'dzin du ni gyur pa'o// 'on kyang sad rgyu da rung yod// ces gsungs so// gsum pa 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ni/

de ltar gong du bstan pa'i lam gyi 'od gsal mthar phyin pa las 'bras bu ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro// spyi don gsum pa nyams myong gi bogs dbyung ba ni/ nyin gyi tshe gtum mo sgom zhing*/ de'i nyams myong bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin spros bral tu rtogs pa'i dge sbyor de dang*/ mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bsgom/ yang mtshan mo'i 'od gsal de/ nyin par rgyas gtab la bsgom par bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis/ gnyid mthug po la brten nas sangs rgya ba/ 'od gsal ba lam gyi sgron me'i gdams pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa bag chags nying 'khrul gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba rmi lam la drug ste/ rmi lam 'dzin pa/ sbyang zhing spel ba/ ya nga spang zhing sgyu mar bslab pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ 'dun pas 'dzin pa dang*/ dmigs pas 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad/ grib la 'dzem/ de nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam zhing skyo shas drag po bskyed/ gang gis kyang dgos pa med ces ngag tu'ang brjod cing*/ blo sna'i rgyun rbud kyis btang nas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ de nas mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo bsgom zhing*/ de nyid kyang rmi lam yin snyam du rgyas gtab/ rjes 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam thams cad du/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos bde sdug btang snyoms la sogs gang shar yang*/ rmi lam du gsal btab cing ngag tu'ang brjod/ de nas thun gyi mthar skyabs yul gsal gtab la/ skyabs 'gro bya zhing sems can thams cad kyi don du rmi lam gzung bar sems bskyed/ skyabs yul rang la bstim zhing*/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa bla ma la dbul/ rmi lam zin par gsol ba gtab/

mthar bla ma rang la bstim/ de'i ngang las 'jam rlung bum pa can lan gsum gzung la rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa gsum byas la/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis ma yengs par gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o// des kyang ma zin na sbyor ba rnams sngar ltar byas la/ tho rangs nam langs nyi shar gsum gyi dus gnad dang bstun te nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos rnams gong bzhin la/ dmigs pa dngos ni rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mgrin par gdan bzhi rtsigs kyi steng du/ bla ma dam pa'i sku rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa mtshon gang pa/ 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba gsal gtab la/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ rmi lam zin pa'i gsol ba gtab pa dang*/ 'dun pa bdun tsam bya/ bla ma des kyang chos thams cad rmi lam yin zhes gsung bar bsam zhing*/ bla ma de nyid kyi mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po mdun kyi 'dab mar a sngon po/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar nu ser po/ rgyab kyi 'dab mar ta dmar po/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar ra ljang khu rnams gsal gtab la/ 'jam rlung bum pa can bdun gzung*/ phyogs kyi yi ge bzhi la rim pa bzhin shes pa gtad/ mthar gnyid du 'gro khar dbus kyi oṃ la sems gzung zhing*/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par/ lus gnad snga ma bzhin nyal bar bya'o// des kyang ma zin na/ sngon 'gro rnams gong bzhin la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thig le dkar po sran ma tsam 'od dang bcas pa dmigs/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ 'jam rlung bum pa can bcu gcig tsam gzung*/ lus gnad gong bzhin nyal lo// des kyang ma zin na/ dus gnad sgug pa sngar dang 'dra/ ci nas kyang ma zin na/ sbyor ba rnams snga ma lta bu la/ rang gi 'og tu thig le dmar po dang*/ steng du thig le dkar po gnyis chu nang du rde'u bskyur ba'i ri mo bzhin rgya je cher song ba/

ga'u lta bu'i dbus su rang lus gnas par bsam zhing*/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang*/ rlung mang du gzung la lus gnad sngar ltar nyal lo// des ni ci nas kyang zin par 'gyur ro// de yang rmi lam rmis pa de nyid rmi lam du 'dug snyam du shes pa ni/ rmi lam zin pa'i tshad do// de ltar zin par gyur kyang*/ brtan par ma gyur nas sad par gyur na/ nyal ba'i tshe nyin par dang thun gyi tha mar sad par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ rdo rje nor bu'i sbu gur thig le nag po sran ma tsam la shes pa gtad cing*/ rlung bum pa can nyer gcig tsam bsgom/ 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pas/ thig le la sems gtad cing gnyid log par bya'o// yang gal te 'phral tu rmi lam zin pa ltar snang yang*/ de'i mod la 'khrul par song na/ ci nas kyang ma 'khrul bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ rmi lam zin dus 'jam rlung bsgom par bya'o// gnyis pa sbyong ba ni/ gong gi sbyong ba rnams kyis ni 'dod du zin cing brtan par gyur ba'i tshe/ 'di rmi lam yin pas ji ltar byas kyang btub snyam pas/ nyi zla'i zur la 'jus nas sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs lha gnas rnams dang*/ mngon dga' dang*/ dga' ldan la sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing mchog rnam par dag pa rnams su 'gro ba dang*/ zhing gi gtso bo rnams kyi zhal lta zhing chos nyan pa sogs su sbyong bar bya'o// gsum pa spel ba ni/ rmi lam zin pa'i snang lam du mi'am rta sogs dngos po gang rmis pa de nyid yi dam du bsgom/ de yang gnyis bzhi brgyad/ bcu drug nas mthar 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar spel bar bya'o// bzhi pa ya nga spang zhing sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ rmi lam du gang rmis pa de dag la thog brdzis su bya ste/ chu me g.yang sogs rnams la rmi lam du shes pas slar mchong ba dang*/ gzhan yang sha za dang srin po/ gnod byed kyi cho 'phrul ya nga zhing skyi g.ya' ba la sogs gang byung yang*/

sngar gyi 'dun pas thog rdzis su bya'o// de yang dang po/ bdag 'dzin gyi zhen 'khris la brten/ cung zad dka' zhing mi phod pa 'byung yang*/ de nas cung goms kyin ro snyoms te rmi lam gyi 'jigs skrag dang*/ ya nga ba'i rtog pa thams cad bde stong du phril phril 'char ro// lnga pa sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ rmi lam zhes bya ba gud nas sbyang rgyu ci 'dug nyin par gyi snang ba 'di ka sgyu ma yin mod/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma la khyad ci 'dug mi rtag pa'i ngos nas khyad par med pa myong bas grub pa 'di yin mod/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang ba/ snang bzhin du stong pa snang stong zung 'jug gi ngo bor lta bas thag bcad/ de'i don bsgoms pas nyams su blang sa spyod pas steng 'grus med par sbyangs pas/ nyin par dang rmi lam la khyad med pa 'byung ste/ de tsam na/ dus gsum shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhal mthong zhing lung ston pa 'byung ste/ de la yang zhen pa med par/ rmi lam dang sgyu mar shes par bya'o// drug pa rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid ni/ gong gi don gsal bar phye ste/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i ri mo/ rnam rtog bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan/ rang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig yin par ngo shes par byas la/ de thams cad kyang*/ dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar yang*/ rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ rmi lam dus kyi snang tshul 'di/ skyes pa rmis na pho 'drer 'dzin/ bud med rmis na mo 'drer 'dzin// byol song rmis na klu ru 'dzin// bzang po rmis na sems 'phang bskyed/ ngan pa rmis na sems mi dga'// rang sems rtsa bar ma shes na// phyi nang bgegs la zad mtha' med// dang po chos la thos pa dgos// go bas mtha' gnyis spong ba yin// yin min sgro 'dogs chod pa na// gol sas mi 'jigs gdeng thob yin/

zhes pa dang rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'pho nus na/ bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes dang*/ ka dpe las/ rmi lam lam khyer gdams pa ni// chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste// ngo bo nyid kyi ma skyes shing*// rang bzhin dag pa'i de nyid la// 'khrul pa log par rab tu gsungs// rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i// rmi lam dri ma med mthong na// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las// skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur// 'di la don lnga rgyas par bshad// don bzhis nyams su blang ba'o// dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang*// sbyang dang goms pa 'khrid pa dang*// sngar ni gong du rgyas par bstan// don bzhis nyams su blang ba ni// dang po rmi lam gzung ba dang*// de nas sbyang zhing sgyu mar bslab*// de nas ya nga spang ba dang*// kho na nyid don sgom pa'o// chos rnams rmi lam ltar shes na// sems can don du rab tu 'jug /sgyu ma lta bu lam khyer bas// sgyu ma lta bur sangs yang rgyas// zhes gsungs te/ bag chags can rmi lam la brten te sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa'o// bzhi pa sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong ba sgyu lus la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i don rgyas par bsgom/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ sems can gyi don du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du bya ba'i sems bskyed/ bla ma dam pa la lus longs spyod dbul/ sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i gsol ba gtab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ ma dag pa'i sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu khru gang pa zhig la me long g.ya' dag pa zhig gdags la btsugs/ de'i nang du rang gi gzugs brnyan 'char bar bya/ de la rang gis yid kyis mtshang nas 'bru ba'i smad ra dang*/

yon tan gyi bstod ra sna tshogs byas la/ gzugs de la brtag nas chags sdang gi bzhin ji ltar du snang brtag de la dga' mi dga' skyes pa'i rtags shar na de nyid la brtag ste/ gzugs brnyan de me long las byung ngam bzhin las byung*/ gal te me long las byung na ni bzhin med par yang 'char bar rigs la/ bzhin las byung na ni me long med par yang 'char bar rigs so// 'on te gnyis char la ma brten na ni gzugs brnyan nam du'ang 'char bar mi rigs kyang*/ kun tshogs pa'i tshe gzugs su snang ba ni mi 'gag cing 'char ro// 'di ni snang dus nyid nas stong pa/ stong dus nyid nas snang ba/ 'di thams cad kyang me long gi gzugs brnyan kho na nyid kyi don du shes par bya zhing*/ slar yang bstod smad du mas chags sdang gi rnam 'gyur 'char ram mi 'char lta zhing*/ dngos su'ang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'i grogs kyis bstod smad byung ba'i dus su/ gong bzhin brtag de dag la'ang dga' mi dga'i rtog pa dang rnam 'gyur ma shar na/ rang lus me long nang gi gzugs brnyan du gsal ba la/ bstod smad byed du bcug cing brtag khyad mi 'dug na 'byongs pa yin/ khyad 'dug na bdag gzhan gyi lus ngag yid chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan/ chu'i zla ba/ nam mkha'i 'ja'/ mig yor*/ smig sgyu/ rmi lam/ sgra brnyan/ dri za'i grong khyer/ mig 'khrul/ glog chu bur sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul pa ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis sam dpe'i gtso bo gsum ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi rgyab tu yi dam gyi sku 'gying log tu bris pa bkram ste/ de nyid du me long gi nang du 'char bar byas la yun ring du bsgom/ de la sems nges pa dang*/ rang nyid me long nang du gsal ba'i yi dam gyi sku de nyid du gsal gtab/ 08388863(chad)00000000 gzugs brtan de la bltas la gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur nges pa dang*/

de ltar bsgom mo// de nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms te/ de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa/ kha dog nam mkha'i 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu'i zla ba lta bu/ rnam pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu dang*/ sgra thams cad kyang grag stong brag cha lta bu'i tshul gyis sngags kyi rang sgrar mos shing*/ yid kyi 'gyu ba thams cad kyang rig stong 'dzin med mtha' bral rtag chad la sogs phyogs lhung gi 'ching ba la ma zhen par byed dgos te/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i zhal nas/ yod ces rtog pa ji snyed pa// de snyed rtag pa'i lta ba ste// rtag par mngon par zhen pa na// de yang sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid min// med ces rtog pa ji snyed pa// de snyed chad pa'i lta ba ste// khyad par mngon par zhen pa na// de yang sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid min// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bur snang ba de nyid rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo/ rten 'brel de nyid skad cig mar yang 'du ba/ skad cig ma de yang rkyen las skyes pa/ rkyen las skyes pa de nyid kyi ngo bo rang bzhin skye ba med nyid de/ dbu ma rtsa ba las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa/ chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa nyid// gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin// zhes gsungs so/ gsum pa rjes ni/ thun mtshams spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du'ang gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyang*/ yi dam gyi lha snang stong sgyu ma lta bu/ sgrar grags pa thams cad sgra brnyan ni brag cha lta bu/ yid kyi dran rtog thams cad kyang wal po rjes med 'dzin med rang grol nyid du nges pa'i shes pa dang ldan pas/

yi dam gyi snying po yang bzla bar bya'o// de ltar yang*/ chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur las/ rmi lam yul gyi 'khrul pa la/ mgrin pa gnad kyi sa bon can// phyi na snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smra ma btub// nyin mtshan snang ba sna tshogs pa// sprul pa sku yi ngo bo nyid// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// spyir zhen pa log gam lo tsā ba// zhes dang*/ ka dpe las/ sgyu lus lam du bya ba ni// snang ba 'di dag 'gro ba kun// sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad te// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas// thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong*// phyi dang nang du rnam phye ba// thams cad sgyu ma las gzhan min// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis// sgyu ma'i lus 'di shes par bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu yi zla bas so// me long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris la// gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs// rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs// de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtag /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang*// rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang*// mig 'phrul mtshungs pa gang gis mthong*// smig sgyu rmi lam lta bu dang*// dri za'i grong khyer dag dang mtshungs// sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// 'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin te// dmigs med kun rdzob dag tu ni// sgyu ma lta bur rab tu bshad// dag pa lha yi sgyu lus dang*// rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus te// gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri// ro dang reg bya nyid dag la// mig la sogs pa 'jug gyur pa// sgyu ma lta bur nye bar brtag /rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid du// mang du bshad pas ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bag chags dag pas sangs rgya ba sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'o// spyi don gnyis pa yan lag gi gdams pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'pho ba la gsum/ rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba/ 'bring sgyu lus su 'pho ba/

tha ma bskyed rim du 'pho ba'o// dang po ni/ dus la bab pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nyid tshe 'dir lam goms pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa ste/ 'chi ba'i rtags rnams rdzogs nas rlung tshangs bug las bton te/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la bzhag pas/ 'chi ka'i 'od gsal dang gnyis lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu 'dres te/ bar do med par 'od gsal de nyid kyi ngang la chos kyi skur sangs rgya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dus la bab pa'i rtags mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa de/ snod kyi 'jig rten ye shes kyi gzhal med khang du bsams shing*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lha me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu snang la rang bzhin med par bsgoms nas/ srog 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i snang ba 'char te/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pas longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgya'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni dben pa'i gnas su gtan bde bar 'dug la/ lus gnad legs par bca'/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lha sku stong gsal tu gnas pa'i spyi bor/ bla ma rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang du mos la lus longs spyod dbul/ 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i gsol ba gtab/ mthar bla ma rang la bstim la rlung bum pa can chung 'bring chen po la rtsal sbyang*/ de'i ngang las khong dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar mda' snyug tsam du gsal gtab/ de'i nang gi lte ba'i thad du āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ la mthing nag spyi bor k+ṣa dkar po rnams bsam la/ steng rlung mnan cing*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pas/ lte ba'i āḥgayos/ dbu ma'i nang las brgyud/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang yar 'thon spyi bo'i k+ṣa phul/ rlung ma thub nas phyir gtong dus/ hūṃ snying gar bzhag

āḥlte bar phab/ de ltar thun bzhir rlung bum pa can bdun bdun du bsgom par bya'o// rtags ni spyi bo za ba dang*/ 'tshog pa dang chu ser dang*/ 'brum bu la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ rna ba'i bug pa bkag pa'i sgra chad pa dang*/ mig btsir bas 'od med pa/ grib ma'i mgo bo'i rlangs pa med pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang ltas kun rdzogs par gyur na dus la bab pa yin te tshogs bsag rang lus yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bo 'dom gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dam pa yi dam gyi skur mos pa la lus longs spyod ltos med du dbul/ 'chi ba lam du slongs par gsol ba gtab/ lus gnad tsog bu'i seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis ngang nas rang lus yi dam gyi sku stong gsal gyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma yi ge dang bcas pa gong bzhin gsal gtab la/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then bzhin pas āḥhika bcu gcig brjod pas ā hūṃ la thim/ slar yang āḥhig bcu gcig brjod cing 'og rlung then pas hūṃ de mgrin par sleb par bsam/ de nas 'og rlung 'then cing*/ aḥhig lnga brjod pas hūṃ gis k+ṣa phul nas/ hūṃ de nyid spyi gtsug tu thon par bsam/ de nas 'og rlung drag tu 'then bzhin pa nas/ ā hig mang bar brjod pas hūṃ de rgyangs kyis bla ma'i thugs kar thim par bsam la/ lus la sems kyis phyi mig mi lta bar sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad do// bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du bzhag par bya'o// de yang spyir theg pa chen po 'di thabs kyi khyad par du byas pa yin/ de'i nang nas ma bsgom par sangs rgya ba la 'pho ba 'di mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ bsgoms na sangs rgyas kun la yod// ma bsgoms sangs rgyas nga la yod// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid la dgongs pa'o// gzhan yang chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ sgo dgu 'khor ba'i skar khung can// sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i sgo// sgo dgu bcad nas sgo gcig 'byed// sems kyi mda' la rlung gi gzhu// hig gis rgyud kyis rab bskul nas// rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das// ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer// rlung dus su khegs sam lo tsā ba// zhes dang*/

ka dpe las/ 'pho ba'i bye brag shin tu mang*// sbyangs te 'pho dang ting 'dzin dang*// srog dang rtsol bas 'pho ba dang*// lus kyi rtsol bas 'pho ba dang*// rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba dang*// btsan thabs dag tu 'pho ba dang*// spros med chos sku'i 'pho ba dang*// spros bcas gzugs sku'i 'pho ba dang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'pho ba dang*// sprul pa sku yi 'pho ba dang*// yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i 'pho ba dang*// de dag thams cad ro gcig par// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las// pus mo bskor zhing se gol gdab// brgya rtsa brgyad pa zin pa'i tshad// snying gar zin nas lkog mar bzung*// dbugs ni ngal bar gyur pa na// sna sgor ma mnyam ngal bso bya// rang 'dod dbu mar zin gyur na// bde ba'i 'khor lo drang bya ste// shes pa bde ba can du gtad// tshangs pa'i sgo nas 'pho bar bya// rims la sogs pas ma phog par// 'pho ba'i bsgyur bas mchog yin no// dus la babs na 'pho bya ste// dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur// ji ltar 'das pa'i lus ngag la// ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung*// zhes gsungs te/ ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba'i gdams pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa bar do la bzhi/ rab 'od gsal ngos gzung ba/ ma zin na sgyu lus su sbyang ba/ mngal sgo dgag pa/ mngal sgo gdams pa'o// de rnams la thog mar thim rim shes par bya ste/ snang ba thim pa dang*/ rtog pa thim pa dang*/ rags phra thim pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis/ yul lnga thim pa dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi thim tshul lo// dang po ni/ mig gi dbang po sgra la thim pas mig gis gzugs mi mthong*/ rna ba'i dbang po dri la thim pas rna bas sgra mi tshor/ sna'i dbang po ro la thim pas snas dri mi tshor/ lce'i dbang po reg bya la thim pas lces ro mi tshor/ lus kyi dbang po yid la thim pas lus kyi reg bya mi tshor ro// gnyis pa ni/ sa chu la thim pas lus kyis zungs mi thub/

chu me la thim pas dbang po'i sgo rnams bskams shing skom dad che/ me chu la thim pas lus kyi drod chung*/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyir dbyung gi rlung ring zhing*/ nang du 'jug pa'i rlung thung la rtsub par rgyu ba dang*/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pas phyi dbugs 'gro'o// rtog pa thim pa ni/ skad cig skad cig gis dbye bas rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ dang po shes pa snang ba bya ba 'ong*/ rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu skya hod pa 'byung*/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa so gsum 'gag de nas snang ba mched pa la thim pas/ rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu dmar lam pa 'byung*/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag de nas mched pa thob pa la thim pas/ rtags mun nag lta bu nag 'thib pa 'byung*/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'gag go /phra rags thim pa'i rim pa ni/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas skad cig ma bzhi pa la/ 'od gsal chen po bya ba 'char/ rtags sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu shes pa gsal stong ngos gzung med pa 'byung*/ sngon rgyu'i shes pa rags pa dang phra ba bag la nyal ba 'gag go /de nas 'di yi snang ba ni nub/ bar do'i snang ba ma shar ba'i bar der 'od gsal 'char ba ste/ de la ji tsam bsdod par bya ba rang dbang du byar yod cing dag pa'i bar do mngon du 'gyur ro// de ltar yang*/ paṇa chen nā ro pas/ 'od gsal ba la rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// ces gsungs so// de'i ngang las snying rjes zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs te/ 'gro don bya ba ni khyad par gyi gdams pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar 'od gsal ngos ma zin na/ de nas dug gsum gyi snang ba rags pa zhig ngos gzung la/ nga shi ba yin par 'dug gnas 'di yang bar do'i gnas/ grogs 'di yang bar do'i grogs su 'dug snyam pa dang*/ gzhan yang phra rags kyi rtog pa gang ji snyed skyes pa thams cad kyang*/

'di bar do'i snang bar 'dug snyam du bsam te/ bar dor shes pa'i ngang de nyid nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ rang lus yi dam du gnas pa'i spyi bor bla ma dam pa gsal gtab/ de nas snang rig gi 'gyu ba gang shar kyang*/ bar do shes pas bden par ma grub par blos bcad cing bsgom mo// gsum pa la gnyis/ mngal du 'jug bya dgag pa dang*/ skye gnas 'gog pa'o// dang po ni/ rang yi dam lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu bsgom/ de nas sgyu ma tsam du 'dzin pa yang dor te/ 'od gsal stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba la bzhag go /de ltar ma nus na/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zag mngal du 'jug pa po de'i snang ba la/ rang nyid phor skye na ma la chags shing pha la sdang ba dang*/ mor skye na pha la chags shing ma la sdang ba'i rtog pa 'byung ste/ de'i tshe sngon yang chags sdang 'di nyid kyis rgyu byas 'khor bar 'khyams par 'dug da ci nas kyang chags sdang mi bya'o snyam du dran pas yang yang gzung ngo*// des kyang ma khegs na pha ma gnyis bla ma yab yum du bsgom mchod pas mchod cing*/ chags grol gyi gdams pa zhu snyam du bsam mo// des kyang khegs pa dka' na/ bla ma yab yum kyang yi dam gyi sku snang la rang bzhin med par mos la/ gsang ba'i dbang zhu ba'i mos pa bya'o// des kyang khegs par ma gyur na bla ma dang yi dam yab yum sogs snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig las med bzhin du snang ba/ snang bzhin du stong pa/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pas de sngas phan chad 'khor bar 'khyams te/ da ni yang dag pa'i bden pa/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rig grol rang shar gyi de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag go snyam du shes par bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas bdun phrag dang po khegs shing*/ de nas yang snga ma ltar 'bad pas bdun phrag phyi ma rnams kyang khegs pa la tshegs mi 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/

bde ba can gyi zhing mchog rnam par dag pa dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang la mos pa de dang der skye bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya zhing*/ yang ma'i mngal du 'jug pa na'ang sems can gyi don byed nus pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal rigs sam/ rigs mtho zhing gtsang ba bsod nams dang ldan pa dag gi lus blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa la nan tan du bya'o// de ltar gong du bstan pa'i gdams pa rnams kyang*/ ji ltar bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs pas/ bar do'i chos bzhi po dag gi don phyin ci ma log par mngon du 'gyur te/ grub chen nā ro pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ rmi lam da lta'i shes pa dang*// bar srid shes pa bsre dgos te// rmi lam bar do bsre 'pho'i gnad// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bo can// ming yang bar do'i gdams ngag zer// don rmi lam 'byongs sam lo tsā ba// zhes dang*/ ka dpe las/ bar do lam du blang ba ni/ dang po snang ba gsum gyis ni// thim pas 'od gsal ngos gzung ba// gnyis pa dag dang ma dag pas// sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas ni// bar ma dor ni sangs rgyas thabs// gsum pa mngal sgo dgag pa dang*// bzhi pa mngal sgo bdams pa'o// de la skye ba'i bar do ru// bsgoms pas sangs rgyas gtum mo dang*// sgyu ma'i sku la bslab par bya// de la sgom par gyur pa dang*// rmi lam sgyu lus gnyis bsres la// rmi lam bar do sbyong bar bya// rmi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa dang*// 'chi kha dus kyi bar do ru// 'od gsal ba dang 'dres pa las// sgyu lus ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gis// bag chags thams cad bsregs pas ni// 'od gsal me yis sbyangs nas ni// zung du 'jug pa'i skur sangs rgya// rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag gi// shes pa skye lugs 'di lta ste// snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim// rags pa thim dang phra ba thim// thim pa'i rjes su goms pa dang*// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal 'byung*// de yi rjes la zung 'jug 'char// sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// mi slob pa ru gyur tsam na// 'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin// gong du bstan pa de dag ni// rgyas par bshad na 'di lta ste// dang po lung rigs man ngag gis// rgyud la rtog pa shar tsam na// snang ba 'gag lugs bstan pa ni// gzugs ni sgra la thim gyur pas// sgra yang dri dang dri yang ro// reg bya'i bar du rim gyis thim// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// de rnams rim gyis rnam shes la// rnam shes snang ba la thim tshe// phyi rtags zla shar lta bur lta// nang rtags du ba lta bu 'byung*// snang ba de nyid mched pa la// thim tshe phyi rtags nyi shar 'dra// shes pa mar me lta bu 'byung*// mched pa thob pa la thim pas// phyi rtags mun pa lta bu 'byung*// shes pa mar me lta bu 'char// thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas// phyi rtags tho rangs dus tshod kyi// skya rengs shar ba lta bu 'byung*// nang gi shes pa nam mkha' ni// sprin dag lta bu 'char ba'o// 'od gsal de las ldang ba yi// zung 'jug ngos nas gzung bya ste// mngon par byang chub 'od gsal mes// bag chags thams cad sbyong dus su// slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya'o// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed med tsam na// goms pa mthar phyin gyur pa ste// mi slob zung 'jug ces bya'o// 'bras bu thob par gyur pa yin// de la srid pa'i bar ma dor// sgyu lus zung 'jug skur gyur te// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob bo// de la goms pas mngal sgo khegs// gal te zung 'jug ma shes na// srid pa'i skye ba mi khegs pas// chags sdang snang ba kun spangs la// dran pa'i spyan mas mtshams sbyar te// mngal bdam pa yi sbyor ba byed// mngon dga'i 'pho ba byas pa yis// gang 'dod gnas su skye bar 'gyur// 'chi ba stong pa chos sku la// bar ma dor ni longs spyod rdzogs// srid pa'i skye ba sprul pa'i sku// skye ba'i cha ni thabs yin la// 'gag pa shes rab srid mthar byed// ces gsungs so// gzhan yang grub pa'i dbang phyug gong ma dag gis bar do la drug tu dbye ste/

de las 'khor 'das bar do/ skye shi bar do/ lam gyi bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ 'chi kha bar do/ srid pa bar do zhes gsungs pa'i 'grel byed/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas mdzad pa dang*/ de re re la'ang gsum gsum du phye ste/ skye ba lam du 'khyer ba la skyed rim rnam gsum/ 'chi ba lam du 'khyer ba la rdzogs rim rnam gsum/ bar do lam du 'khyer ba la ngo sprod rnam gsum/ gsum ga lam du 'khyer ba la zhing sbyong rnam gsum rnams kyi sbyar bshad rgyas par dbye ba'i/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rgyun bar ma chad par mchis pa dang*/ bar do'i nyams len dmigs rim gyi skor/ zab chos sogs su bshad pa dag gis kha bskang na 'ong bar sems kyang*/ gong ma ni yi ge mang bas 'jigs pa dang*/ phyi ma 'di dharmā rā dzas mdzad pa'i khrid yig gzhung du 'di las ma mchis pas 'dir spros kyang*/ ma rtogs log rtog gi sgro skur gyi gzhir gyur gyis dogs pas ma bkod do// gzhan yang 'dir bshad pa'i bar do'i gdams pa 'di nyid kyi rgyab chos su 'gyur ba'i lung go bde bar bkrol ba ni/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal nas/ lam 'chi ba'i srid pa dang 'gyu ba gnad gcod kyi 'phrang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i skye mched rim gyis thim pa'i rjes su/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag dang bral ba/ nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i chos nyid/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba*/ ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs ma bcos ji lta ba gcig dus der 'char bas/ de ka 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos te/ de ngo shes par byed pa la/ da lta bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i don go ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi 'od gsal sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa bar do la/ sngon byung yid kyi gzugs can snang mun 'od kyi bar dor dbang po kun tshang thogs med cing*/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan pa'i lus shig yod pa de ka longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/

zung 'jug lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs nas/ bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus sbyongs pa yin pas/ de yin pa la yin par shes par bya ste/ da lta bskyed rim lha sku la dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi sgyu ma rmi lam sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa tha ma pa la rig pa las kyi rlung gis rang dbang med par bskyod pa'i 'phrang*/ dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus der pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chags sdang skye bas/ sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyis/ rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar/ gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyung ba las kyi snang ba mi 'char dgu 'char/ dus phyis bsam nas skye ba len pa de ka skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos te/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo'i drod kyi ye shes bskyed pa dang*/ chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa'i don nyams su myong bas mig ser dang chags sdang sbyang 'tshal/ mdor hril gyis dril na 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur lugs kyi dus dang sa mtshams de ltar bgyid 'tshal/ zhes gsungs te/ srid pa bar dor 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa'o// de ltar sngon du theg pa spyi dang bye brag gi lam bgrod tshul myur bul gyi dbye ba bshad pa la brten nas sngags kyi theg par blo bkug lam de nyid la 'jug par byed pa la'ang*/ ma smin smin byed dbang bskur ba la slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid bshad de/ nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar gtan la phab/ de ltar dpon slob kyi rten 'brel tshogs pa las/ zab mo dbang gi rim pas smin par byas shing*/ smin pa grol byed bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa bshad pa la/ khrid kyi mtshan don gtan la phab nas/ yid ches khungs btsun brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyis/ slob ma'i rgyud la nges shes bskyed cing de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni/

thun mong dang thun min gyi sngon 'gro brgyad kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs pa la'ang*/ slob bshad dang tshogs bshad gang gi snod du rung slar brtag par byas te tshogs bshad du rung ba la/ rgyud dang 'tsham par chos ston tshul dang*/ mos gus rab skal ldan slob bshad kyi snod du rung ba ni/ zab pa'i gdams pa sbyin par bstan ste/ dngos po'i gnas lugs khyad gzhi dang lam gyi gdams pa dang*/ khyad par gyi chos su bstan pa ni bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin bshad pa/ dngos gzhi dngos la gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i gdams pa bzhi dang*/ yan lag gnyis su bstan pa rnams nyams su blangs pas/ spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas gtum mo la gnad du bsnun pas/ 'pho ba'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa 'dag 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas/ 'od gsal la gnad du bsnun pas/ sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i sgrib pa 'dag 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas rmi lam la gnad du bsnun pas/ bag chags nying 'phrul gyi sgrib pa 'dag /'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo brten nas sgyu lus la gnad du bsnun pas sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa 'dag 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub bo// de ltar rtsa ba'i gdams pa bzhi la gnad du bsnun pas sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur/ yan lag gi gdams pa 'pho ba la gnad du bsnun pas lam gzhan ma bsgoms kyang*/ skye gnas ngan pas bar mi chod/ bar do la gnad du snun pas/ lam blo chod du 'gyur ba'am/ skye ba la rang dbang 'thob pa'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing zhes pas/ mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo sgom zhing*/ rjes thob tu chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin med par shes par bya'o// mtshan mo gnyid mthug po la brten nas/

'od gsal dang de las bag chags kyi 'khrul par ldang na rmi lam sbyang zhing*/ skabs su 'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams pa yang gong du bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs pas/ skyon thams cad dang ma bral ba med cing*/ yon tan thams cad ma rdzogs pa med pa'i drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang*/ bla na med pa thob pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba rdzogs pa zhig 'byung ba lags so// gang zhig thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong du mkhyen brtse'i nyi 'od rab gsal bas// brtan g.yo srid gsum 'dzin ma'i zhing gi tshogs la kun nas snyoms pa'i drod 'dzin cing*// dge ba'i pad tshal sku gsum don gnyis 'byor ldan 'bras bu phyogs bcur rab yangs pa// de ltar ye shes tsha zer 'od kyis 'phrin las srid mtha'i bar du nyams len stsol// kun gzhi chu gter yangs pa'i rgya mtsho las// dgos 'dod kun stsol rin chen dbang gi rgyal// thabs mkhas ded dpon chen po las 'ongs pa'i// bcud 'phreng gdams pa 'di la kun spyod shog /dam chos rin chen 'di yang srid mtha'i bar// chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad pa yongs med cing*// nyon mongs tsha gdung bsreg pa zhi ba'i gnyen// bdud rtsi lta bus 'gro kun rgyal gyur cig /ces dpal nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi rim pa'i bye brag rab tu gsal bar phye ba rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyang*/ gsung rab kyi don la rgya chen thogs pa med pa'i dpyod pa can/ rigs rus kyi mngon par mthau ba'i/ rgya ston gdan sa ba nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan bzang po dang*/ dpal ri bo che pa'i dge slong rnam rgyal bzang po sogs/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis yang yang du bskul ba la brten 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis/ chu pho 'brug gi lo hor gyi zla ba drug pa'i dus tshes dge ba la/ gdan sa chen po nyid du grub par bgyis pa'o// lan gcig zhus so/༄༅// drod btsan thabs su sbar ba gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā kī ni/

gser 'phyang lo bdag hor zla gnyis pa la// yangs pa can du gnas pa'i gnam gang nub// tho rangs 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'di ltar shar// mdun gyi nam mkhar me dpung chen po ni// gru gsum rtse mo dbal bcas 'dom gang tsam// rab tu tsha ba'i ngar ldan 'bar ba las// gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa btsan thabs sbar ba ni// gnad tshig skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i lam zhugs brtul zhugs bzang*// skal ldan skyes bu'i tshogs rnams 'di ltar go /lte ba'i rang me gnad bcud ma sbar na// lus kun khyab pa'i bde drod mi 'byung bas// gsol gdab bcud bzhi phul cig gdams pa bshad// legs par gdams so the tshom med par dgongs// bla ma yi dam dbyer med ye shes me// ye shes ḍā ki me la gsol ba thob// gru gsum me'i nang du rang lus kyang*// byin za'i phung po de dang dbyer med bsam// bcud pa dang po sus 'khyud stod smad 'then// bcud pa gnyis pa bcud bcu dbang du sdud// bcud pa gsum pa brla zur sor mos gzir// bcud pa bzhi pa pus mgo lag gis reg /'phul ba gcig po sta zur khu tshur bcang*// zhal gdams gab pa snying phur bde drod 'bar// zhes pa'i rang sgra 'di rnams yid la bcags// mtshan ldan rje dang mched grogs rnams la 'bul// dge des don gyi tsaṇ+ḍa mngon gyur shog /ces pa 'di nyid/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mtshungs med dharmā kīrtis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ dpal bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa chen por/ mchog gi sprul skus dbus mdzad dge 'dun 'dus par bcas pa la/ zab lam chos drug gi nyams khrid/ rje btsun gong ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung dang bcas pa phul ba'i tshe/ 'khrul snang la shar ba yin/ dpon slob kun la phul bas/ bde drod kyi nyams shugs 'byung du 'bar ba la nges shes skyes pa las/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba las 'bri gung pa bya bral rat+na'i ming can gyis bkod pa'o/// /maṅga lam/
lan gcig zhus so// 137)༈ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi grol byed khrid kyi zin bris ye shes gsal ba'i mkha' klong bzhugs so/// /
