na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ma lus pa'i mdzod kyi mnga' dbang phyug cing*/ yon tan rab tu rgyas pa'i mthu rtsal gyi phrin las chen pos/ nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la snyoms par khyab pa'i thugs brtse ba can/ rtsa ba gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ a+yon gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ bdag sogs lus can thams cad lus gus pas phyag 'tshal shing*/ ngag dang bas bstod la/ yid dad pas lan gcig ma yin par skyabs su 'chi'o// de nyid kyi rjes su 'jug par smon pa'i yid can/ dad brtson dang shes rab che ba/ bla ma la phu dud che zhing*/ 'dzin chags dang g.yeng sems chung ba/ rgyud dul cing sdig la 'dzem pa/ gsang thub cing nyams len la brtul zhugs che ba/ skyo shas che zhing dam tshig mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba/ de lta bu'i snod ldan gyi gang zag gang rnams/ sngon bsags smon lam gyi 'bras bu sad de/ rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyi dgongs pa/ ḍā k+ki kun gyi thugs bcud kyi thig le/ zab gter las byung ba'i lam zab 'di nyid ston par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang mjal cing*/ rgyud smin byed kyi dbang gi rim pa yang*/ phyi spros bcas bum dbang dang*/ nang spros med gsang ba'i dbang*/ shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes/ yang gsang shin tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che/ khyad par kun tu spros med thod rgal rigs pa'i rtsal dbang rnams te khyad par gyi dbang lnga po rnams dang*/ gdams pa rnams dkar chag ltar lung stabs su nyan te/ grol byed khrid kyi rim pa rnams nyams khrid du bgyi ba'i long ma mchis pa la/ phyis slad kyi khrid don la 'jug par 'dod pa rnams kyi don du/ rang gi dran pa gso ba'i phyir/ nyams len khrigs chags su 'god par bgyi bas/ chos bdag ḍā ki'i tshogs la bzod par gsol cing rjes su gnang bar mdzod la byin gyis rlobs sh-ing*/

gzhan yang*/ slob dpon chen po'i bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dam can srung ma gter bdag 'khor dang bcas pas kyang*/ bka' gsang ba chen po 'di yi bstan pa'i rgyun nyi zla ltar gsal cing rgyas la/ bye brag rtsom pa 'di yi bar chad ma lus pa srungs shig /de yang*/ 'dir rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ lung thams cad kyi phyi mo/ 'dus pa man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying*/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don mngon sum du ston par byed pa/ zab lam mkha' 'gro snying tig nyams su len par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos bzhi rjes mtha' rten dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rgyud pa chos la nges shes bskyed/ mtshan ldan gnas grogs gtor tshogs bsham// zhe bcad snying rus sngon 'gro bas// mi rtag snying rje byang sems bsgom// 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba la// lus ni rigs drug zhi khro dang*// rdo rje skyil krung lus kyi steng*// ngag ni drug sgra rgyas gdab hūṃ// rtsal sbyong bsnyen rtsal lam zhugs so// yid ni sdug bsngal bde ba dang*// byung gnas 'gro la brtag pa ste// ru bshan phyi ltar dbye ba'o// gnas drug gam rigs drug sa bon ni// 'bru gsum sems sbyang nang ltar dbye// rnal du dbab dang sor bzhug ste// bcu drug don ni sngon 'gro'i chos// zhes pa rnams las dang po ni/ rgyud klong gsal las/ skal ldan nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir// brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad par bya// zhes pas/ de yang ji ltar bshad cing nyams su len pa'i thabs ni/ de nyid las/ brgyud pa nye zab khungs btsun phyir// kun tu bzang nas rim par bshad// ces pa ltar/ gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du/ chos sku cir yang ma grub pa ka dag gi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ lhun grub 'gag pa med pa'i rang gdangs las dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pa/

nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur snang ba longs sku rdo rje 'chang la gsungs te/ des 'og min du sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' la rang gi ngo bos gsungs/ des dur khrod me ri 'bar bar/ yang sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la tshig tsam du gsungs/ des slob dpon shrī singha la gsungs/ de nyid kyis rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsungs te/ g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu thugs nyams su bzhes pa las/ zag bcas kyi sku nyid zag med sgyu ma'i sku/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ skye 'chi dang bral ba'i 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin la mnga' brnyes/ gnas de nyid du gdams pa yi ger gtab ste/ bod yul du spyan drangs kyang*/ de'i tshe snying tig bstan pa'i dus la ma bab pa dang*/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra 'byon par dgongs te/ gzho stod gter sgrom gyi gnas su/ yum mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la/ glen sgom yid dpyod rmugs 'thums dang phral nas/ lnga ldan ye shes kyi snying po gtan la phab ste bstan/ de nyid kyis bka' bsdu bar mdzad de/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi gdams pa ma bu tshang ba dkar chag yi ger bkod pa yang*/ slar gsang ba'i rgyas gtab bo// de'i tshe rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug khang yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i rab gnas dga' ston kyang rdzogs pa las/ mchim phu dge'u gong gi dur khrod chen por slob dpon gyi drung du tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad du phyin pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i btsun mo 'brom bza' byang chub sgron la 'khrungs pa'i/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal ces bya ba/ dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa zhig sku gshegs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar mtshal gyi ྣྲི bris pa la rnam shes bkug pas smra shes par gyur/ gsang mtshan pad+ma las 'brel rtsal du btags/ rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la lha lcam gyi sngon gyi las 'bras myong 'gyur rnams bka' stsal ba'i mthar/

ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus/ khong rang gi skye ba'i chos skal du/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gdams pa'i zla la/ lo rgyus 'di rnams kyang*/ yi ger bkod nas yid ches pa'i phyir sbas gsung ste/ gter sgrom sras mo'i spyi bor bzhag nas smon lam gnang ba ni/ 'di skad ces/ phyi rabs skal ldan don du ni// ldang lung phu yi brag la sbed// ldang lhas rgyal ba'i bka' 'di bsrungs// gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs na// lcags sgrom 'bar ba lta bu'i yul// 'brong bu nyal ba lta bu'i ri// de lta bu yi spyi stengs su// rdo rje mkha' 'gros byin brlabs pa'i// 'brug gam spre'u yos lo pa// spro ring theg chen chos la mos// mkha' 'gro snying tig thabs kyi cha// de yi dngos su mthong ba'i rtags// g.yas pa thabs kyi brla nang du// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dra ba'i/ sha rme ḍā ki'i spyan 'dra yod// de ltar mtshan rtags rdzogs pa yi// las ldan skyes bu de la gtod// de min len na lus sraug phrol/ zab rgyaḥ gter rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ bka' rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ ḍāk+ki'i rgya'oḥ zhes gtad cing gdams te/ slar sras mo de nyid kyang gshegs/ spur de nyid slob dpon gyis bsregs pa'i tshul bstan yang*/ skad cig gi a+yon gyi yul du tshogs 'khor mdzad de/ de ltar lung bstan pa'i dus la bab par 'bri ldang chos 'byung gi gnas su sku 'khrungs pa'i skyes bu/ rin chen tshul rdor zhes bya ba la gter bdag rnams kyi lung bstan dang*/ kha byang lde mig phyag tu byon te/ chu mo glang lo ston zla tha chung gi nyer bdun la khra mo brag nas spyan drangs te/ sprul sku de nyid la las ldan slaub ma nyer gcig 'byung bar/ a+yon rin po che nyid kyis lung bstan pa ltar/ skyes bu grub thob rnams rim par brgyud pa ni/ dam sel dang 'dres khyer gyi brgyud pas bar ma chod pas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'o// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni/

'di nyid las/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// gnad 'di ma rtogs dge ba bcu// spyad kyang 'khor ba las mi grol// sngar du mtshams med lnga spyad kyang*// 'di phrad ngan song ltung mi srid// 'di dang rtags grol gnyis sprad na// lo drug phung po lhag med grol// 'di med gang zag gzhan spyod pa// bskal par nyan bsam sgom bsgrubs kyang*// bskal par sangs rgyas re ba med// ci phyir mngon sum gnad ma rtogs// sde gsum rim dgu'i chos rnams kyis// 'di nyid don la reg pa med// 'di ni kun las khyad par 'phags// gzhi la shes rab lhun gyis grub// thabs kyi mngon sum skad cig la// mthong ste grol 'gyur the tshom med// ci phyir mkha' 'gro dngos kyis ston// 'di la spyod pa'i skyes bu ni// kun bzang yab yum dbye rgyu med// ḍā ki lus dang grib mar 'grogs// 'di dang tshig gi 'brel ba yang*// skye ba gsum du mi thogs grol// sgra tsam rna bar thos pas kyang*/ tha mal skye ba 'dis chod 'gyur// zhes sogs gdams pa 'di yi phan yon dpag tu med par/ rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyis gsungs so// de lta bu'i lam zab 'di nyid dus bzhir rnyed par dka' ba ste/ gdams pa dngos dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir/ the tshom dang yid gnyis spangs te/ bsgrub par bya dgos so// gsum pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ klong gsal las/ gangs khrod lung stong ri rtse dur khrod dam// shin tu dben la dwangs shing mtho ba'i sar// skal ldan skyes bu nyams len bya ba'i gnas// zhes gsungs te/ dgos ched ni/ gangs khrod dang lung stong du gnas pas dge sbyor 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod do// ri rtse na shes pa gsal ba'o// dur khrod skyo shas skye ba'o// dben pa'i gnas ni nyams len la bar chad med pa'o// dwangs shing mtho ba ni dbyings rig gsal ba'i dgos pa rnams so// bzhi pa grogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/

gong du bstan pa'i gnas de rnams su byang chub sgrub pa la/ rab tu gcig pur bsgom/ 'bring mtshams dang 'dag sbyar bya/ tha ma grogs mtshan nyid 'di rnams dang ldan pa byung na 'grogs te/ ji skad du/ dam tshig mtshan ldan dag pa'i snang ba che// dug lnga'i shugs chung blo che khong yang che// ngang rgyud ring zhing brtse ba'i grogs dang 'grogs// zhes pas/ de yang dam tshig gtsang bas nyes ltung mi 'byung ngo*// dag snang che bas kun dang mthun no// dug lnga shas chung bas nyon mongs mi skye'o// blo brtan cing khog yangs pas rkyen dbang du mi 'gro'o// ngang rgyud ring zhing brtse bas dus rtag tu mi 'bral cing phan thogs pa'o/ lnga pa gtor tshogs dang mkho ba'i yo byad kyi mtshan nyid tshang dgos pa yang*/ rgyud las/ yo byad kun ldan chos kyi dngos grub 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas gtor ma bzang bas ni/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'du'o// tshogs mchod la brtson pas nyams chags bskong zhing dngos grub myur ba'i dgos pa yod do// drug pa dang bdun pa zhe bcad dang snying rus kyi sgo nas gdams pa sgrub tshul ni/ de ltar gnas grogs yo byad dang ldan pa'i tshe/ lus ngag yid tha mal du gnas na/ nyon mongs 'phel ba'i dben pas phung po lhag med kyi sangs rgyas lta a cang che ste/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo las 'da' bar mi nus so// de lta bas na/ srog la bab kyang bka' gsang ba zab mo 'di nyid kyi gdeng tshad mngon du ma gyur gyi bar/ bdag 'jig rten g.yen bcos kyi bya ba mi sgrub/ gal te 'du 'dzi zang zing gis non te/ gdams pa 'di bor na chos bdag bka' bsrung gis chad pa chod cig ces mna' bor zhing rkyen bzang ngan gyi sgo nas bar chad ji ltar byung yang gong gi zhe bcad de nyid kyi don 'dun pa snying rus kyis mthar dbyung bar bya'o// de nas thun mong gi sngon 'gro nyams su len tshul ni/ 'das rjes las/ mi rtag snying rje byang sems sbyang*// zhes gsungs pas/

brgyad pa mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ bdag gzhan snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i gnas tshul la brtags pas/ kun kyang mi rtag pa sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor nyid las rtag pa snying po can grub pa med pa'i nyams su myong ba nges shes bskyed de/ mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang*/ dgu pa mi rtag pa de yang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la spyod pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje'i sems dang*/ bcu pa sdug bsngal de dag rgyu dang bcas pa las grol bar byed pa la/ kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i dbyings su ma phyin na/ byas bsags kyi chos la 'bras bu med par yid ches te/ grol ba thob 'dod kyi 'dun pas bdag gzhan kun la snyoms pa'i sems kyis lam nyams su len pa ni/ smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems so// de yang*/ rgyud las/ mi rtag snying rjes byang sems kyi// chos 'jug theg chen lam du 'gro// zhes gsungs pa'i dgos pa yod do// bcu gcig pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed dgos pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ 'khor 'das ru shan ma phye na/ khams gsum lus ngag yid kyi yang*// 'brel pa chod par mi 'gyur ro// zhes pas/ dbye ba dngos ni dben pa'i sar phyin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lus 'khor 'das ru shan phye nas phyis 'khor bar mi ldog par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de lus bcer bur phyung ste/ dmyal ba la tsha grang gi spyod pa/ yi dwags la dkres skom gyi spyod pa/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod kyi spyod pa/ lha min la 'thab rtsod kyi spyod pa/ mi la brel 'phongs kyi spyod pa/ lha la 'dod yon gyi spyod pa/ bde gshegs zhi khro'i bzhugs stangs sogs/ dran tshad du byas pa'i rjes shes rgyud la bkal te blta'o// de ltar zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ lus la chags zhen med cing*/ lus med pa snyam byed pa dang*/ bkres skom tsha grang dang na tsha med pa'i nyams skye na 'byongs ba'i rtags so// de ltar ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// de nas sbyang ba ni/

thal 'gyur las/ rdo rje dkyil krung dang bcas te// lus sbyangs sems la phan pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ lus drang por bsrangs ba'i rkang pa gnyis kyis mthil sprod/ lag pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ nyin mtshan zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ lus kyi sha rnams na zhing shag shig tu song ba snyam byed na 'byongs pa'i rtags te/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// de ltar lus sbyangs pa'i dgos pa ni/ sde brgyad dang 'byung po phal gyis rang lus rdo rje me 'bar bar mthong ste bar chod kyis mi tshugs so// lus kyi spyod pa spyad pa la gsum te/ thun mong dang khyad par mthar thug go /dang po ni lus kyi sdig pa 'dag cing*/ gnyis pa lus la zhen pa bzlog pas/ da phyin chad lus 'khor bar mi ldog la/ lus de nyid sprul skur grol lo// gsum pa de yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis su med par mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod do// bcu gnyis pa ngag ru shan dbye ba ni/ 'das rjes las/ ngag gi sngon 'gro bya ba'i phyir// rigs drug sgra skad sna tshogs brjod// zhi khro'i sgra dang 'byung ba'i sgra// rnam pa sna tshogs nyid la spyad// ces pa ltar/ dben pa'i sar phyin te/ sems can gyi don du ngag ru shan dbye bar sems bskyed/ de nas dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro/ lha min lha mi rnams kyi skad rigs dran tshad brjod cing*/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i gsung dang*/ khro bo'i gad mo 'byung ba'i rang sgra'i rnam pa sogs brjod/ de'i rjes shes rgyud la bkal te blta'o// de ltar zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ bla ma'i gdams pa la go ba rnyed pa dang*/ don ched du ma gzung bar yang rang rdol du 'byung bas/ de ltar ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// de nas sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ thal 'gyur las/ ngag ni hūṃ zhes gnas pa la// rgyas gdab pa dang rtsal sbyang dang*// bsnyen rtsal lam du zhugs pa'o// de ltar ngag sbyangs sems la phan// zhes gsungs pas/

dang po rgyas gdab pa la gnyis te/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa dang*/ nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa'o// de yang ngag tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes ring bar brjod pas/ snang ba thams cad hūm̐ du rong nge ba la shes pa gtad la so dang mchu ma reg tsam byas te/ rlung dang snang cha rtog pa gsum gcig tu sbyang ba la 'bad pas/ snang ba thams cad ban bun du song na 'byongs pa'i tshad de/ de ltar ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// gnyis pa yang*/ lus skyil krung drang por bsrangs la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ khong pa'i nang du hūm̐ gcig byung gnyis byung hūm̐ rong nge ba la shes pa gtad/ de ltar zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ nang du hūm̐ ro nge ba yod pa snyam byed pa dang*/ lus phyi nang mi bde ba byung na 'byongs pa ste/ de ltar ma byung gi bar du bskyar zhing*/ rlung bsdams pa gnad du che'o// gnyis pa rtsal sbyang ba la'ang phyi nang gnyis te/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ hūm̐ drag la thung bar brjod cing*/ cir snang thams cad la thal byung du 'gro ba la zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ phyi yi snang ba thams cad sang sing dang khral khrol du song ba snyam byed na 'byongs pa ste/ de ltar ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// gnyis pa yang*/ hūm̐ drag la thung bar brjod pas/ hūm̐ gi tshogs lus la phyi thal nang thal du 'don/ sbyang ba la zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ lus kyi sha khal khol du 'phar zhing khral khrol du song ba snyam byed na 'byongs pa ste/ de ltar ma byung gi bar bskyar ro// gsum pa bsnyen btsal ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu'i thur ma ring thung ji ltar 'tshams pa zhig btsugs la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ hūm̐ gi thag pa gru gu ltar dkris par bsam zhing nam mkha'i mthongs su rang gi 'dun pas ci bgrod kyi bar dbyug pa la dkris par mos la/ slar yang grol bar bsams la zhag gcig gi bar du 'bad pas/ lus sgyid lug pa dang*/ nyal ma nyol du 'byung ngo*// de ltar ma byung gi bar bskyar ro// bzhi pa lam du 'jug pa ni/

hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ hūm̐ khru gang pa 'khyogs 'gros su 'gro ba la shes pa gtad de/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du dmigs pas ji ltar gzhal thub kyi bar du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang*/ mthar de nyid mi dmigs par blta'o// de ltar zhag gcig tu 'bad pas/ 'bol le shig pa byung na 'byongs pa'i tshad de/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// ngag sbyang ba'i dgos pa ni/ phyi yul la rgyas gtab pas/ phyi snang ba rang bzhin med par mthong*/ nang phung po la rgyas btab pas lus ngag rang bzhin med par grol/ phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyangs pas/ snang ba bde gsal du 'gro/ nang lus la rtsal sbyangs pas/ phung po 'od gsal du 'gro/ snyems rtsal bas dmigs pa gar yang bsgyur du rung*/ lam du zhugs pas lam srol du tshud pa'i dgos pa yod do// de ltar ngag gi spyod pa byas pa'i dgos ched gsum las/ thun mong dang*/ khyad par/ mthar thug go /dang po ni/ ngag gi sdig pa 'dag cing gong du bstan pa'i yon tan thob/ gnyis pa yang*/ ngag gi zhen pa log pas da phyin ngag 'khor bar mi ldog cing*/ ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur grol lo// gsum pa yang*/ ngag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung dang gnyis su med par mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do// bcu gsum pa yid 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba ni/ 'das rjes las/ yid kyi sngon 'gro bya ba'i phyir// rigs drug sdug bsngal blo la blang*// ces pas dben pa'i gnas su phyin te/ sems can gyi don du yid ru shan dbye bar sems bskyed/ de nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal du gyur pa dran tshad yid la bsams te/ zhag gcig gi bar du 'bad cing*/ bar bar du rjes shes rgyud la bkal nas blta'o// sbyang ba ni/ thal 'gyur las/ sems ni thog mar byung ba dang*// bar du gnas dang tha mar 'gro// de ltar sems la brtag dpyad na// sems sbyangs sems la phan pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ dang po sems kyi byung ba la brtag pa ni/

sems 'di phyi snod dang nang bcud gang nas byung*/ de yang stong pa ltar snang ba/ yod pa dang med pa rtag pa dang chad pa/ thams cad la brtag pa zhag gcig tu btsal bas/ sems nyid byung sa dang rgyu mtshan med par btsal du ma rnyed pa ni/ sems chos nyid ngos gzung dang bral bar gtan la phebs pa yin te/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// gnyis pa sems 'di phyi snod nang bcud/ lus kyi mgo mjug stod smad gang du gnas zhib tu brtags pas/ lta byed kyi shes pa gsal yang*/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub pas/ gzhi med rtsa bral/ gang du yang gnas pa med par shes na 'byongs pa ste/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// gsum pa ni/ 'gyu byed kyi sems 'di 'khor 'das snod bcud/ yod med snang stong*/ gang du 'gro ba zhag gcig tu brtags pas/ 'gro bya dang 'gro byed kyi mkhan po ma rnyed de/ skye ba med par gtan la phebs pas/ 'gro sa dang bral ba zhig shes na 'byongs pa ste/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// sems sbyangs pa'i dgos pa ni/ thog mar sems kyi ngo bo gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs pa de ni chos sku/ dran snang gi 'char sgo gsal yang*/ de nyid ngo bo nges gzung dang bral ba de ni longs spyod rdzogs sku/ mthar sems nyid byung gnas 'gro ba rnams kyang*/ skye med du mthong ba ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ de rnams su ngo sprad do// de ltar sems kyi spyod pa byas pa la dgos pa gsum ste/ thun mong dang khyad par mthar thug go dang po ni/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa 'dag cing*/ zug rngu'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ gnyis pa sems kyi zhen pa log pa dang*/ da phyin chad 'khor bar mi bzlog cing*/ sems chos skur grol lo// gsum pa ni/ yid sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang gnyis su med par mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod do// de ltar phyi 'khor 'das ru shan/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas ma phye na/ gong du bstan pa'i yon tan rnams las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/

'bad brtson chen pos nyams su len pa ni/ phyi 'khrul pa'i rkyen snang ba zhig par byed pa yin no// bcu bzhi pa nang lus ngag yid gsum 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed dgos pa ni/ rgyud klong gsal las/ nang gi 'khrul rgyu zad bya'i phyir// 'khor 'das ru shan nang ltar dbye// zhes pas/ gong gi spyod pa gsum gyi phyi 'khrul pa'i rkyen snang zad kyang*/ nang lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khrul pa'i rgyu dang sa bon ma zad pas/ de'i gnyen por 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba ni/ 'das rjes las/ lus ni ma rig rgyus bskyed phyir// rigs drug sa bon nyid du gnas// rig pa sku gsum dngos yin phyir// sku gsum yi ge gsum du shar// yi ges rtsal sbyangs ru shan dbye// zhes gsungs pas/ de yang rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ rkang mthil rnams su/ a su ྣྲི tri pre du drug gsal gtab/ slar yang spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ mthing ga rnams las ye shes kyi me 'bar te/ rigs drug gi sa bon/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags thams cad thul gyis bsregs par bsams la/ zhag bdun gyi bar du yi ge gsum la 'bum tsho bdun bsnyen pa bya'o// de ltar 'bad pas/ rtags ni lus ngag yid gsum/ tha mal gyi zhen pa 'gag par 'gyur te/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// nang lus ngag yid gsum 'khor 'das ru shan phye ba'i dgos pa ni gsum te/ thal 'gyur las/ 'di la dgos pa rnam gnyis te/ thun mong mchog gi dbye ba brtag /ces dang*/ klong gsal las/ ru shan nang ltar sus phye ba// 'khrul gzhi 'khor ba'i sa bon stongs// gsum po 'khor bar ldog pa med// ces gsungs pas dang po thun mong gi yon tan ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa'i sa bon 'dag pa dang*/ bar chod kyi sa bon kun zhi zhing*/ gnyis pa ni/ sgo gsum gyi zhen pa log pa ste/

da phyin chad lus ngag yid gsum 'khor bar log pa'i sa bon med pas mi ldog nges pa dang*/ sku gsum du grol lo// gsum pa mthar thug rang gi lus ngag yid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod do// de ltar nang gi ru shan ma phye na/ lus la 'khor ba'i sa bon gnas te/ gong gi yon tan de rnams las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ 'bad pa chen pos lam nyams su blang ba ni/ nang 'khrul pa'i sa bon gzhom par byed pa yin no// bco lnga pa phyi rnal tu dbab pa bstan pa ni/ klong gsal las/ lus ngag yid kyi 'byung 'khrugs las/ de dag grol phyir rnal du dbab// ces dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'khor 'das ru shan phye nas ni// lus ngag yid ni rnal du dbab// ces so// dang po ni/ 'das rjes las/ de nas lus ngag yid gsum po// rnal du 'bebs la mkhas par bya// ces pas/ lus rnal du dbab pa ni/ stan bde ba la lus kyi cha glod de gnas par bya/ ngag rnal du dbab pa ni/ ci yang mi smra ba dang*/ yid rnal du dbab pa/ dran 'dzin 'phro 'du'i rtog bcas thams cad bkag ste glod nas gnas par bya'o// de ltar rnal du dbab pa la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su lus ngag yid gsum rnal du phebs na'ang 'byung ba mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ nad rkyen mi 'byung zhing bsam gtan la gnas pa'i dgos pa yod/ mthar thug lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'dzin par rang dag tu grol lo// rnal du ma phebs na/ gong gi yon tan las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ 'di nyid du bstan pa ltar lus ngag yid rnal tu dbab pa la zhag gsum nyams su blangs pas/ lus mi 'gyur bar gnas pa dang*/ ngag smra mi 'dod pa dang*/ yid 'jig rten gyi bya ba la mi 'jug pa 'byung ste/ ma byung gi bar tu bskyar ro// bcu drug pa nang sor bzhugs pa gal che ste/ 'das rjes las/ nyan thos byang sems khro bo yi// lta stangs nyid kyis sor yang bzhug ces pa ltar// dang po ni/

lus nyan thos kyi lta stangs kyi ngang nas/ smra ba bcad/ yid mig rten la shes pa gtad/ gnyis pa lus rnam snang gi chos bdun/ mig byang sems kyi lta stangs ngag smra ba'i rgyun bcad/ yid mig rtse sna rtse sems rtse gsum gcig tu dril la mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ lus khro bo'i lta stangs mig bar snang la bgrad/ ngag khro bo'i gad rgyangs ha ha hi hi la sogs pa brjod/ yid lta stangs mi g.yo bar gang shar gyi rnam rtog zil gyis gnon/ de ltar lta stangs rnams la zhag gsum du 'bad pas/ thog mar nyan thos kyi lta stangs kyi sems mi gnas pa gnas par byas/ bar du byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gnas pa brtan par byas/ tha mar khro bo'i lta stangs kyis brtan pa grol bar byed pas/ de ltar lta stangs gsum las mi g.yo bar rtog pa rtsad gcod sems kyi 'tshang btsal/ byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag de rjes rnam rtog sems su ngo sprad/ sems nyid stong pa/ stong bzhin du snang ba/ snang stong gnyis med/ gnyis med rang grol/ dug lnga rang grol/ tshogs drug rang grol rnams su ngo sprad do// btags grol gyi rgyud las/ phyi nang kun btags ye stong grol// zhes dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ rang rig rtog pa kun bral ba// grol lugs chen po bzhi dang bcas// ye nas grol bas bskyar gzhi med// rang gis grol bas gnyen po med// gcer gyis grol bas mthong sar yal// yongs su grol bas 'bad rtsol med// ces gsungs so// lus ngag yid gsum sor chud pa'i rtags ni/ sgo gsum dge sbyor las 'bral mi phod pa 'byung ste/ ma byung gi bar bskyar ro// de ltar 'bad pas/ yon tan ni/ gnas skabs su bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye zhing*/ mthar thug lhag mthong ka dag gi dgongs pa rtogs par 'gyur ro// sor ma chud na gong gi yon tan rnams las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang bar bya'o// de ltar sngon 'gro chos bcu drug gi sgo nas blangs pa'i khregs chod kyis rgyud legs par bltams pa dag gis/

dngos gzhi thod rgal nyams su blang tshul ni/ ji skad du/ lus ngag yid gsum bya ba ni// phyi nang gsang gsum dgu phrugs dor// sgo gsum gzir zhing gnad bzhi gcun// de ltar don bcu dngos gzhi bstan// zhes pa rnams las dang po ni/ klong gsal las/ mngon sum gnad la dbab pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang ba'i bya ba ni// lus ngag yid kyis dgu phrugs btang*// zhes pa dang*/ 'das rjes las/ phyi nang bya ba kun btang ste// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ zag med kyi ye shes yon tan rgyun la brten pa la/ bya ba dgu phrugs su btang ba gal shin tu che'o// ji ltar btang ba ni rgyud las/ lus kyi bya ba btang ba ni// chos dang 'jig rten bya ba btang*// grogs med gcig pur gnas par bya// ngag gi 'khrul gtam chos spyod btang*// lkug pa lta bu nyid la bslab// yid ni 'jig rten bya ba yi// 'gyu ba bcad la gnas par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dang po phyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba btang ba ni/ lus 'jig rten gyi bya ba/ ngag lo ka'i gtam/ yid nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rtog pa thams cad spang*/ gnyis pa nang gi bya ba btang ba ni/ lus phyag bskor dang 'khrul 'khor/ ngag chos spyod dang bzlas brjod/ yid skyed rim dang rnam rtog gi rtog pa thams cad spang*/ gsum pa gsang ba'i bya ba btang ba ni/ lus grogs med gcig pur gnas par bya/ ngag lkug pa ltar smra ba bcad/ yid snga phyi'i bsam blo thams cad spong*/ de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su dor ba la zhag gsum du 'bad pas/ lus ngag yid gsum bya ba gang la'ang 'jug snying mi 'dod pa zhig 'ong ste/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// de 'i dgos ched ni gnyis te/ gnas skabs su sgo gsum 'khrul pa'i rjes su mi 'brang ste/ mthar thug zag med kyi ye shes kyi rgyud la myur du 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do// de ltar yang rgyud las/ lus ngag 'khrul pa rgyun chad nas// ye shes rgyun la gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bya ba ma btang ba'i skyon ni gong du bstan pa'i yon tan las log par 'gyur te/

de nyid las/ byar med rgyun la ma gnas par// rig pa'i don la reg pa med// ces so// de nas lus ngag yid gsum gzir ba gsum gyi ngang nas nyams su blang ba ni/ klong gsal las/ rig pa lus la gnas gyur kyang*// 'khrul 'khor dag gis ma gcun na// ye shes dbang por snang mi nus// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ de ltar ngag gnad ma gzir na// brjod med don ni mi rtogs shing*// 'khrul pa'i gtam gyis don la sgrib// ngag gnad gzir ba mchog tu gces// zhes pa dang*/ sems kyi gnad nyid ma gzir na// dbyings dang rig pa mi mthong bas// gnad gzir btad pa'i 'ben nyid bca'// zhes gsungs pas/ mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum gzir ba gal che ste/ thal 'gyur las/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge yis// 'khrul pa'i 'jigs pa kun bral nas// rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bzhugs stangs ni// glang chen nyal ba la brten nas// chos nyid rnams la longs spyad de// pad+ma'i spyan gyis mthong bar 'gyur// sprul pa sku yi bzhugs stangs ni// drang srong tsog pu la brten nas// chos nyid snang ba rang sprul te// chos kyi mig gis mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ bzhi pa lus gzir ba ni/ bzhugs stangs gsum las/ dang po stan gyi thog tu/ rkang mthil sprad pa'i pus mo gnyis phyir bgrad/ mthe bong bcangs pa'i lag pa gnyis kyi mthil sa la btsugs/ ro stod dgye ba'i mjing pa yid tsam gyen la bstod pa'i mig smin phrag gi nam mkha' la mi 'gul bar lta ba ni/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs te/ seng chen 'gying ba zhes bya'o// yang stan gyi thog tu/ kha sbub tu 'dug ste/ pus mo brang la sbyar/ gru mo sa la btsugs/ lag mthil gnyis kyis lkog ma bteg sor mo 'gram pa la sbyar zhing*/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ mig nam mkha' la zur gyis hrig por blta'o// de ni longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen nyal ba zhes bya'o// yang stan gyi thog tu/

rkang pa'i long bu dag bshibs te/ lus tsog pur 'dug pa'i lag pa gnyis mkhal khung ngam pus mo la bskor/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ mig zim bur bar snang la blta bar bya'o// de ni sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong tsog pu zhes bya'o// lnga pa ngag gzir ba ni/ thal 'gyur las/ ngag ni bslab dang gnas pa dang*// la zla ba nyid bstan par bya// zhes pas/ thog mar smra ba bcad pa yun thung la bslab/ de ni yun ring ba la bslab/ skabs su rang gi chos spyod rnams kyang gsal ba re brjod/ gzhan la long gtam mi smra ste/ lus kyi brda tsam bya/ la bzla ba ni/ brjod pa thams cad spangs te/ lkugs pa lta bur gnas par bya'o// drug pa yid gzir ba ni/ klong gsal las/ phyi yi mkha' la gtad pa yis// nang gi sgron ma dngos su snang*// zhes pa dang*/ 'das rjes las/ sems ni smin phrag mkha' la gtad// sku gsum rig pa stong par 'char// zhes pas/ sems gtad pa'i 'ben ni phyi'i nam mkha' stong pa la ma yengs par gnas pas/ yul stong pa de la dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma/ rig pa stong gsal du 'char ro// de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gzir ba la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs la gnas pas nang gi 'byung ba rnams zad pa'i dgos pa yod do// longs sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis g.yo byed kyi rlung zin pa'i dgos pa yod do// sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis lus drod bskyed cing 'byung ba snyoms pa'i dgos pa yod do// ngag gzir bas gnas skabs su/ 'khrul pa dang nyon mongs pa mi 'phel lo// yid gzir bas gnas skabs su rig pa mngon sum du gsal bar nus so// mthar thug lus gzir bas/ ka dag gi don rtogs shing*/ lhun grub kyi don 'char ba dang*/ 'khrul snang zhing khams su 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do// ngag gzir bas mthar thug rig pa'i don la myur du reg cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi klong du yongs su 'da'o// yid gzir bas/

mthar thug phung po lhag med du 'tshang rgya'o// de ltar gzir ba gsum gyis nyams su ma blangs na gong du bstan pa'i yon tan rnams las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ 'bad pa chen pos gzir ba gsum las mi 'da' bar 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gnad bzhi ltar nyams su blangs pas/ rtags ni lus bzhugs stangs su gnas pa la mi bde ba med pa dang*/ ngag lkugs pa ltar 'gro zhing*/ sems gtad pa'i 'ben la rtag par gnas pa byung na 'byongs pa ste/ ma byung gi bar du bskyar ro// bdun pa gnad rnam pa bzhi la brten nas/ mngon sum rang thog tu dbab dgos te/ thal 'gyur las/ sems gnad gzir dang lta stangs gcun// yul gnad nam mkha' spyan bral la// sgo gnad ldog pa zur gyis blta// rlung gnad shin tu dal la bslab// de la gnad bzhis gzir ba yis// sku gsum rig pa stong par 'char// zhes pas/ bdun pa sgo yi gnad gal che ste/ dper na lha khang la sgo med na/ nang gi rten mi mthong ste/ yid dpyod du lus pa ltar lus kyi tsit+ta rin po che'i nang du/ dwangs ma dgu 'dus pa'i snying po rig pa ye shes gnas kyang*/ sgo'i gnad ma shes pas/ kun gyi dbang pos mngon sum du mi mthong ste/ chos spyi ni yid dpyod du lus pa'o// de las ye shes 'char ba'i sgo ni mig gnyis yin te/ thal 'gyur las/ ye shes 'char ba'i sgo nyid

ni// lus bcud dwangs ma kun 'dus pa// tsak+ṣu zhes pa'i sgo las thon/ zhes pa dang*/ klong gsal las/ ye shes 'char ba'i sgo ni mig /'char gnad phab bzlog zur la mnan// ces so// de yang mig rtsa ba men gyi rwa lta bu snying dang 'brel bas/ rtsa'i nang du ye shes kyi mdangs gsal te/ dper na bum pa'i nang gi mar me kha la gsal ba dang mtshungs te/ sku gsum gyi gzigs stangs gsum gyis mthong ngo*// brgyad pa yul dus kyi gnad ni/ rgyud las/ dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dpyid kyi dus// zer gnyis dus su mchog tu bshad pa yin// ces pas/ phyi rol gyi yul na bun ser bu med/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa'i dus su 'char ba yin te/ rig pa ye shes de yang gnas snying du bzhugs kyang*/ sgo mig la gsal bas/ yul dwangs shing nyi ma rkyen dang bral ba la sgo yi gnad bcun pas/ me long du byad 'char ba ltar/ yul rkyen dang bral ba de la/ nang dbyings kyi sgron ma rig pa mngon sum du gsal bar 'gyur ro// de ltar yul la sgo'i gnad bcun pa'i dus su/ dgu pa rlung gi gnad che ste/ thal 'gyur las/ rlung rig dal bas ye shes 'grub// ces pa dang*/ 'das rjes las/ rlung gnad shin du dal la bslab// ces gsungs te/ rlung dal ba la ma brten na/ rlung gis rig pa spur nas sems mi zin pas/ rlung dal ba la bslab/ de yang mchu dang so gnyis bag tsam ma reg par bya/ rlung sna la mi btang kha la btang ste/ rlung phyi nang gi 'gyu ba ring thung mnyam pa las/ phyir cung zad 'dor/ de ltar byas pas ci tsam na rlung gi 'gro 'ong chad de/ rtog pa'i 'gro 'ong zad nas/ dbyings rig g.yo 'gul med par gnas so// de ltar gnad gsum la bcun te nyams su blangs pas/ dbyings rig gsal stong dwangs pa'i yul du mngon sum du lhag ge mthong bas/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba zhes bya'o// bcu pa rig pa'i gnad ni/ phyi'i dbyings nam mkha' stong pa yul dang 'dra ba la/

nang dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma/ khyim lta bu de'i nang du/ rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud 'char ba de nyid gang du'ang mi btang bar gzung dgos te/ klong gsal las/ rig gnad lug rgyud btson du gzung*// zhes dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dbyings kyi rig pa'i rang yul 'char// rdo rje nyid ni lug gu rgyud// de nyid nang du gzhug par bya// ces gsungs so// de ltar dngos gzhi la zhag drug nyams su blangs pas/ sgo'i gnad 'byor pa'i rtags su mig yul la ji tsam gtad kyang tshugs pa dang*/ yul gyi gnad 'byongs pa la/ yul la gtad pa tsam gyis ye shes 'char zhing*/ rlung gnad 'byongs nas/ dbyings rig g.yo 'gul med par gnas pa dang*/ rig pa'i gnad 'byongs pa'i rtags su lu gu rgyud 'gul 'phrig med par sdod pa ste/ de rnams ma byung gi bar bskyar ro// gnad bzhi la bcun te 'bad pas nyams su blangs pa'i dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba dang*/ mthar thug snang ba bzhi zad de/ lhag med du 'tshang rgya'o// gnad rnams rang thog tu ma phebs na/ gong du bstan pa'i yon tan rnams las log pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes kyi yon tan 'char tshul ni/ ji skad du/ chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba dang*// nyams snang gong du 'phel ba'i rtags// rig pa tshad du phebs pa dang*// chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba bzhi// 'char tshul lung dang 'bras bur bcas// log na skyon du bstan pa'o// ces gsungs/ de yang snang ba bzhi yi 'char tshul gtan la ma phebs na/ dge sbyor gyi so mtshams mi shes par ngal bar 'gyur te/ gtan la dbab pa gal che'o// de ltar yang*/ thal 'gyur las/ de las snang ba bzhir 'gyur te/ chos nyid mngon sum snang ba yis// yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i tshig las 'das// gong du 'phel ba'i nyams snang gis// 'khrul pa'i snang ba nub par byed// rig pa tshad phebs snang ba yis// sku gsum rtog pa'i lam snang 'das// chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba yis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyun thag bcad// ces gsungs pas/

dang po ni/ thal 'gyur las/ chos nyid mngon sum snang ba ni// dbang po'i sgo las nges thon te// sprin med pa yi mkha' la gsal// zhes pas/ gong du bstan pa'i gzir ba gsum dang*/ gnad bzhis bcun te/ brtson pa chen pos 'bad pas/ rang gi smin mtshams su dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba bar snang gi 'ja' lta bu'am/ rma bya'i mdongs lta bu zhig 'char ro// de dag gi nang du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'khyil chu'i nang du rdo bor ba lta bu'am/ phub kyi sba sgor ba lta bu'am/ yungs 'bru'am sran 'bru tsam 'char bar 'gyur ro// de'i nang du rig pa rang gi ngo bo rdo rje lu gu rgyud phra ba rta rnga la mdud pa bor ba lta bu'am/ me tog gi drwa ba drwa phyed rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu gcig la gnyis 'brel la sogs 'char ba yin no// de ni rang rig thig le nyag gcig zhes bya ba yin no// de yang dang po rig pa 'du 'bral med pa/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du gnas so// de yang dbyings kyi rtags su 'od khyim/ ye shes kyi rtags su thig le/ sku'i rtags su lu gu rgyud do// de dag gi gnas lugs tsit+ta rin po che nas ngo bo ka nas dag pa/ rang bzhin sku dang 'od gsal ba/ thugs rje kun la khyab par bzhugs so// de dag gi lam snang dbang po'i mngon sum du mthong bar yod pas/ yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba tshig dang blo/ shes rab dang rtog dpyod kyi lta ba nub pa'o// de ltar rig pa mngon sum gyi snang ba mthong ba la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su mngon sum mthong bas yid dpyod bral la/ mthar thug ni rig pa mngon sum du mthong bas/ dge sdig gis mi gos shing*/ phyir mi ldog pa'o// chos nyid mngon sum ma mthong na/ gong gi yon tan gyi 'bras bu mi 'byur ngo*// gnyis pa ni thal 'gyur las/ nyams kyi snang ba gong 'phel ni// ye shes kha dog phyir phyung nas// gyen 'greng dang ni rtsibs shar dang*// thig le sna tshogs sku nyid dang*// rags par snang ba'i yul la gsal// ces sogs gsungs pas de nas nyams snang gong 'phel gyi snang ba ni/

shes nyams dang snang nyams gnyis las/ 'dir snang nyams ston te/ de nas nyams su blangs pas/ dbyings dang rig pa res gsal/ res mi gsal ba 'byung ngo*// de nyid nyams su blangs pas/ dbyings rig smin mtshams las bral te/ dbang po mngon sum dang 'du 'bral med pa 'byung ngo*// thig le'i rnam pa de dag kyang*/ sran ma tsam du 'gro'o// de nas nyams su blangs pas/ 'od lnga'i snang ba dum bur snang ba dang*/ gyen 'greng dang rtsibs shar dang*/ mdung rtse lta bu dang*/ re lde'i rnam pa lta bur 'gyur zhing*/ 'od snang de dag rang gi mdun tsam khyab par 'char/ thig le tsam du 'gro'o// rig pa ni 'dab chags 'phur skyen tsam du 'gro'o// yang nyams su blangs pas/ dbyings kyi snang ba de las rin po che'i dra ba dang*/ 'od kyi dra ba dra phyed 'dra ba dang*/ mig mangs ris dang*/ mig tshags lta bu dang*/ za 'og gur khyim 'dra ba dang*/ mchod rten lta bu dang*/ lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ 'khor lo lta bu dang*/ mda' lta bu dang*/ pad sdong lta bu dang*/ nyi zla lta bu dang*/ ye shes mkhar thabs lta bu dang*/ ral gri lta bu dang*/ rdo rje lta bu dang*/ gri gug lta bu dang*/ me lce lta bu dang*/ nya mig gi rnam pa lta bu 'char bar 'gyur ro// 'od des rang gnas pa'i lung pa thams cad khengs par 'gyur zhing thig le de yang mkhar phor tsam du 'gro'o// rig pa ni ri dwags spang rtsi la rgyug pa tsam du 'gyur ro// yang nyams su blangs pas/ 'od ni yul khams tsam du 'char/ thig le ni bse phug tsam du 'gro/ rig pa ni bung ba bcud la lding ba tsam du 'gyur ro// yang nyams su blangs pas/ 'od ni stong gsum gang du bltas tshad khyab/ dbyings rig nyin mtshan med par gsal/ thig le'i nang du sku rkyang pa re snang la/ rig pa'i bar du yang sku phra mo 'byung*/ rig pa ni 'gul 'phrig med par sdod pa'o// de ltar shar ba'i dus na/ bar do'i snang ba 'byung*/ da lta gtan la phebs pas phyis bar do med do// de ltar nyams snang gong du 'phel ba la dgos pa gnyis te/

gnas skabs su nyams snang gi rig pa'i yon tan thob la/ mthar thug bar do'i snang ba rang sar grol ba'o// nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba ma shar na gong gi yon tan la log pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa ni thal 'gyur las/ rig pa tshad phebs snang ba yis// longs sku'i mtshan dper gsal ba ni// ma nges kha dog 'ja' tshon 'dra// rigs lnga yab dang yum du snang*// de nas lnga lnga zung dang bcas// rab tu gsal ba'i thig les 'brel// yab yum sku yi rnam pa can// 'khrul snang zad nas zhing khams so// zhes gsungs pas/ de nas rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba ni/ gong gi thig le de dag re re'i nang du/ sku yab yum lnga lnga shar te/ de rnams kyang grangs las 'das pa las/ bre srang gis tshad la phebs pa ltar/ tshad la phebs pas de nas ma bsgoms kyang chog pa'o// de ltar tshad la phebs pa'i dus na/ lus 'od gsal du grol/ 'byung ba rang dag tu song bas gdos bcas kyi phung po rang sar grol te/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur rang grol ba'o// de ltar tshad la phebs pa la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su rig pa tshad la phebs na/ ma bsgoms kyang chog par go la/ mthar thug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ngos zin la/ skur 'dzin pa yang rang sar grol ba'o// tshad la ma phebs na/ gong gi yon tan rnams kyis dben pa'i skyon yod do// bzhi pa ni thal 'gyur las/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ni// nyams kyi snang ba stongs nas ni// lus zad dbang po'i yul yang zad// rtog tshogs 'khrul pa las grol nas// brjod gzhi tshig dang bral ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ de nas chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ni/ de yang nyams kyi 'phel zad de/ snang ba'i nyams dag la/ snang dang mi snang du 'dzin pa'i ngo bo med pa ni/ chos nyid zad pa zhes tha snyad btags pa'o// nyams dang lus dang*/ dbang po dang*/ rtogs tshogs dang*/ tshig dang khrul pa thams cad zad nas/

zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po mi snang bar sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// de ltar chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ba la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs su snang ba bzhi yi tshad zin pas mtshams phyed la/ mthar thug tu chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ste/ lhag med du sangs rgyas par thag chod pa'o// de ltar chos nyid zad sar ma bskyol na/ gong gi yon tan mi thob pa'i skyon yod do// spyi don bzhi pa mtha' rten gyi gdams pa ni bzhi ste/ ji skad du/ mi 'gul gsum la bzhi bca' zhing*// sdod pa gsum gyis tshad gzung zhing*// thub pa gsum gyi gzer gtab ste// gdeng bzhi mngon du gyur pa las// 'bras bu 'byung tshul bstan pa'o// zhes pas de yang klong gsal las/ mtha' rten man ngag rnam bzhi yis// gong ma'i rgyab tu med thabs med// ces pa rnams kyi dang po ni/ de la mtha' rten yid ches bya// mi 'gul gsum la gzhi byas pas// rlung sems gnad la phebs pa'o// zhes pas/ dus rgyun du lus 'dug stangs gsum las mi 'gul bar byas te/ de yang lus ma 'gul bas rtsa mi 'gul/ rtsa ma 'gul bas mig mi 'gul/ mig ma 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/ rlung ma 'gul bas sems mi 'gul/ des ni 'gyur byed rgyun chad nas/ rig pa gnas pa'i dgos pa yod do// mig gzir stangs gsum las mi 'gul bar byas te/ de yang rig pa'i gnad rtsa rtsa'i gnad sgo/ sgo'i gnad sgrol ma'o// de yang rtsa ma 'gul bas mig mi 'gul bas/ mig ma 'gul bas sgron ma mi 'gul/ des sems ma 'gul bas rtog pa mi 'byung ngo*// des dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i dgos pa yod do// gnyis pa sdod pa gsum gyi tshad gzung ba ni/ thal 'gyur las/ sdod pa gsum gyi tshad gzung bas// rmi lam bzlog dang lus ngag yid// rtags dang tshad nges gzung ba'o// zhes pas/ dbyings rig la yun ring bar gnas pas brtan pa'i tshad sdod pa gsum 'byung ste/

phyi snang ba bskyod pa'i rlung zad pas/ dbyings rig 'gro 'ong med par sdod/ nang phung po bskyod byed kyi rlung zad pas/ lus 'gul ba med par sdod/ gsang ba 'gyu byed kyi rlung zad pas/ sems la rtog pa 'gyu mi srid pa'o// skabs 'dir tshad rmi lam gyis gzung ba dang*/ rtags lus ngag yid gsum 'char ba 'byung ngo*// brtson 'grus rab la rmi lam dbyings su thim 'gro/ 'bring rmi lam 'od gsal du 'char/ tha ma rmi lam du ngo shes pa 'byung ngo*// rtags lus ngag yid gsum la 'byung ba ni/ snang ba bzhi la rtags gsum gsum 'byung ste/ dang po chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba mthong ba'i rtags gsum ni/ lus rus sbal mkhar gzhong du bcug pa ltar 'gyur te/ de yang rus sbal 'khob pa dang*/ mkhar gzhong 'jam pas 'gul mi shes pa ltar/ lus 'gul ba med par bya byed dang bral ba 'byung ngo*// ngag lkugs pa ltar 'gyur te/ smra mi 'dod pa 'byung ngo*// sems 'dab chags rnyi la zin pa ltar 'gyur te/ sems 'phro ba ltar snang yang gang gtad du sdod pa'o// nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba mthong ba'i rtags gsum ni/ lus skyes bu nad kyis gdungs pa ltar 'gyur te/ lus rgyan dang byi dor bral ste ngo tsha med par 'gyur ro// ngag smyon pa'i tshig ltar 'byung ngo*// sems skyes bu rtsi dug gis thebs pa ltar 'byung ste/ dug bdun byung na cis kyang 'chi bar shes pa ltar/ da khams gsum du mi ldog par thag chod pa'o// rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba mthong ba'i rtags gsum ni/ lus glang po che 'dam du chud pa ltar 'gyur te/ glang po che 'dam du chud kyang stobs che bas skad cig la thon pa ltar/ 'byung ba lnga la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// ngag grul bum gyi phru gu ltar 'gyur te/ grul bum gyi phru gu skad snyan pas/ gzhan gyi yid 'phrog pa ltar/ ci smras pa thams cad gzhan nyan cing phan thogs pa'o// sems skyes bu 'brum nad byang ba ltar 'gyur te/

'brum nad byung ma thog slar bskyar nas mi 'byung ba ltar/ khams gsum du mi ldog par yid ches pa'o// chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ba'i rtags gsum ni/ lus dur khrod kyi mi ro ltar 'gyur te/ gshed ma brgyas mtha' bskor yang*/ nyam nga med pa 'byung ngo*// ngag brag cha ltar 'gyur te/ gtam gyi zungs med pas gzhan gyi lad mo zlo'o// sems bar snang gi na bun ltar 'gyur te/ na bun skad cig la yal 'gro ba ltar/ skad cig ma la bag chags kyi dri ma med par sangs rgya'o// gsum pa thob pa gsum gyi gzer gdab pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ thob pa gsum gyi gzer gtab pas// zag bcas phung po mi snang ba'o// zhes pas skye ba rang dbang thob pa ni/ 'di'i dus su phung po'i snang ba 'gags nas/ gdos bcas su mi snang ba'i dus su/ sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod na/ rang gi lag sor la gtad cing bltas pas/ snang ba kun rang log ste/ skabs su bem po kun snang zhing sgra thos pa 'byung ste/ snang ba rnams rang log nas sems can gyi don byed pas/ mi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba la rig pa bcug pas de las yang rig pa rang byung gi ye shes gnas pa'i gnad kyis/ las la bzang ngan med de/ mtshams med lnga byas pa yin yang*/ 'di nyid la 'byung ba rang dag nas/ sangs rgya ba la the tshom med do// 'di'i dus su bem po la rig pa bcug kyang*/ de nyid 'gul ba dang skad 'byin nus so// gnyis pa 'jug pa la rang dbang thob pa ni/ sor mo la rig pa gtad nas rang la lugs su bzhag pas/ de nyid la mi snang bar sangs rgya'o// gsum pa rlung sems rang dbang thob pa ni/ rlung sems las su rung bas/ rlung gi yon tan thams cad 'byung*/ sems can gzhan tshe 'pho ba'i dus su/ de la rang gi rig pa bcug pa ste/ de mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yin yang*/ de rang dang mnyam par sangs rgya'o// las la bzang ngan med pa'i gnad kyis so// bem po rnams la thogs pa med/

mngon par shes pa thogs med du 'char ro// bzhi pa gdeng bzhi ni/ mu tig phreng ba las/ tshad ni gdeng bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyid// ces pas yar gyi gdeng gnyis dang mar gyi gdeng gnyis so// de ltar gong gi bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas/ rtags tshad bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ gdeng rnam bzhi 'dir 'dus te// dang po ni dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thos kyang brod pa mi skye'o// de dag rig pa las gzhan med par rtogs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa sangs rgyas la re ba med de/ rang las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas rgyu med par rtogs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang tshe tshad thos kyang 'jigs pa med de/ rang gi rig pa ye nas 'khrul pa med par shes pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ 'khor ba 'khyams mkhan med par thag chod de/ 'khor bar ltung ba'i dogs pa med pa'o// ltung mkhan ma grub par shes pa'i phyir ro// gdengs tshad bzhi po 'di las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro// de ltar mtha' rten gyi man ngag 'di rnams kyi rgyab rten byas te nyams su blangs pas/ dbang po rab ni lo gsum dang*/ zla ba gcig gis grol lo// tha ma dag gis kyang lo bdun dang zla ba bcu gcig na grol bar 'gyur ro// mtha' rten gyi man ngag gi dgos ched ni gnyis te/ gnas skabs su thag chod pa'i dgos ched yod/ mthar thug tu gong ma'i tshad dang rgyab rten du 'gyur ba'i dgos ched yod de/ rgyud las mtha' rten dbang gi man ngag ni// gong ma'i yon tan mtha' ru 'byin// zhes gsungs so// rgyab rten man ngag bzhi med na de dag gi yon tan las ldog par 'gyur ro// de ltar gong du bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu thob tshul ni gnyis te/ thun mong gi grol tshul dang*/ khyad par gyi grol tshul lo// dang po la gsum te/ sa'i non tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas lugs dang*/ de'i rtags kyi 'byung tshul bstan pa'o// dang po nyams su blangs pas/

sa'i non tshul ni rang shar las/ sa zhes bya ba logs su spyod pa ma yin te/ bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag gcig la sa rnams rdzogs nas yod do// de yang ngo sprod bstan pa'i gang zag de/ dang po bden pa mthong ba'i dus na/ de la dga' ba skyes pa ni sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'o// de yang rang gi rig pa yin par shes pa de ni/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa thob pa'o// de nas de la goms pa ni/ sa gsum pa 'od byed pa thob pa'o// de nas de la goms nas/ 'od kyi snang ba mthong ba de ni/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba'i sa thob pa'o// de yi ye shes kyi snang ba mthong ba de la goms nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis sbyangs nas/ ye shes mthong ba de la ni/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba'i sa non pa'o// de nas 'od las thal ba'i sku mthong ba'i tshe/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i sa non pa'o// de nas rig pa goms pa mthar phyin nas nyon mongs pa ring du spangs pa'i tshe/ bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa non pa'o// de nas de'i ngang la yon tan rdzogs pa ni/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i sa non pa'o// de nas de'i yon tan mi g.yo bar gnas pa ni/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi sa non pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi snang ba la nges shes zin te/ snang ba lhun gyis grub par shar nas/ chos kyi sprin lta bur mthong nas/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi sa non pa'o// des ni gang zag bden pa mthong ba/ dbugs 'di nyid ma bor bar sa non tshul lo// gang zag dbugs bor ba rnams la/ 'di ltar sa non pa yin te/ 'khrul snang 'gags nas tshom bu'i snang ba shar ba nas/ bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od kyi sa non pa'o// de nas snang ba de la ma chags par phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa ni/ bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa non pa yin no// rang gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi zer thag shar nas/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'od kyi tshom bu lnga 'khor ba'i tshul du gnas pa ni/

bcu gsum pa yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa non pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi snang ba la gnas pa ni/ bcu bzhi pa bde ba chen po'i sa non pa yin no// de nas lhun grub kyi snang ba la nges pa rnyed pa ni/ bco lnga pa rig 'dzin kyi sa non pa yin no// de nas ka dag gi sa la ye shes lhug par shar nas de'i gong na gzhan med pa ni/ bcu drug pa ye shes bla ma'i sa non pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// klong gsal las/ bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag gis// dang po'i sa nas bcu drug bar// rim pas nyams su blangs pas 'byung*// gzhan dang go bstun gnas skabs kyi/ yon tan 'bras bu mthong tshul lo// ces so// gnyis pa sangs rgyas lugs ni/ thun mong du sangs rgyas pa zhes pa ni phung po lhag ma dang bcas nas sangs rgyas pa'o// gsum pa gdams pa 'di nyams su blangs pa'i gang zag lam pa po'i tshe'i dus byas pa ji ltar grol tshul dang*/ nyams len mthar phyin pa'i rtags kyi byung tshul lo// dang po ni lus ngag yid gsum 'khor 'das ru shan phyed pa'i gang zag rtags 'byongs pa tshe'i dus byas na ni/ phyi ma 'di dang phrad nas sangs rgya'o// sgo gsum gnad du chun pa'i rtags rdzogs pa de dus las 'das na rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams su dbugs phyung nas lo lnga brgya na sangs rgya'o// chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i rtags rdzogs pa de dus las 'das na/ khams gsum du mi ldog par sangs rgya'o// nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba'i rtags rdzogs pa de dus las 'das na/ bar do dang po la sangs rgya'o// rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba mthong ba'i rtags rdzogs pa de dus las 'das na/ bar do med par sangs rgya'o// chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ba'i rtags rdzogs pa de dus las 'das na/ phung po lhag med du sangs rgya'o// gnyis pa ni 'od tshad la phebs na 'das dus su 'od dbyung*/ thig le tshad la phebs na 'das dus sku gdung ring bsrel 'byung*/

rlung tshad la phebs na 'das dus sgra 'byung*/ dbyings tshad la phebs na 'das dus sa g.yo/ zhing khams tshad la phebs na 'das dus 'od 'byung*/ sa tshad la phebs na 'das dus sku 'byung ba rnams te/ rgyas par ni sku gdung ba 'bar ba rtags kyi rgyud dang*/ btags grol gyi rgyud nas bshad do// de lta bu'i phy-i'i grol lugs ni mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o// snying gi me long las/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni 'od dang sgra dang sku dang gdung dang sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// zhes gsungs so/ khyad par gyi 'bras bu'i grol tshul ni/ gong ma las yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya ba ni/ phung po lhag ma med par sangs rgyas pa'o// zhes pa ni nyon mongs pa phra rags kyi tshogs dang*/ 'byung ba lus kyi gdos pa thams cad rang sar sangs nas/ ngo bo'i skur rgyas pas/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med par rang bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes su sangs rgyas pas ye shes gsum 'du 'bral med/ thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las su sangs rgyas pas thugs rje la rgyun chad med pa'o// de yang klong gsal las/ ngo bo stong gsal ye shes sku// rang bzhin thugs rje phyogs ris med// dbyer med chen por ye sangs rgyas// zhes dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ chos kyi sku yi sku gsung thugs// yon tan dang ni 'phrin las so// sku ni stong dang gsal ba yi// mtshan ma med par rang bzhin no// gsung ni sgra tshig ming dang bral// brjod cing gleng gzhi nyid bral lo// thugs ni bsam dang 'gyu med las// 'phro zhing dpyod pa rnams las 'das// yon tan phyir 'ong ldog pa med// dbyings dang ye shes khyab pa med// rang bzhin bcos pa med pa'o// 'phrin las ma byung byas pa med// shugs 'byung ba dang 'gag pa med// ma byas byas pa med pa'o// longs spyod sku la sku gsung thugs// yon tan dang ni 'phrin las so// sku ni snang la rang bzhin med// gsal dang gsal byed rig pas khyab// gsung ni rang byung rang snang dang*// spro bsdu snang ba'i 'khor lo'o// thugs ni rgyun chad med gzigs dang*// mkhyen pa'i rtsal dang dgongs pa'o// yon tan mtshan dpe rdzogs pa las// dgongs gsal mngon shes rdzogs pa'o// 'phrin las chos kyi 'khor lo las// phyi nang gsang ba rnams spros te// so so'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas dang// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*// rang byung ljags las rnam spros te// 'khor la rang gi ngo bos ston// sprul pa'i sku la'ang sku gsung thugs// yon tan 'phrin las rnam pa lnga// sku ni mtshan dang dpe byad la// gdul bya gang 'dul lus sprul te// gsung gi sdeb sbyor legs pa la// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis yan lag drug

/thugs ni shes bya'i ye shes gnyis// rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs par gnas// yon tan mkhyen pa rdzogs pa dang*// phrin las phyi nang gsang ba yi// mdzad pa ma lus rdzogs pa yi// phun sum tshogs pa lngar gnas so// zhes gsungs so// de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'dzin chags gdos pa dang bcas pa sangs/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las su rgyas pa ste/ sku lnga'i 'dzin pa stongs nas/ thog ma'i gzhi ka dag chen por rang shar rang grol rang sangs pa'o// de yang rang shar las mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'khor ba sangs// ye shes sku nyid don la rgyas// sangs rgyas zhes kyang de la bya// ces pa dang mu tig phreng ba las/ grol pa nyid ni thog ma'o// zhes pas ye thog dang po'i gzhir grol ba'o// de ni chos zad ka dag gi 'bras bu zhes bya'o// des mthar thug 'bras bu'i grol tshul bstan pa'o// de ltar gong du bstan pa'i gdams pa/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang mthar rten gyi tshul lam/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi tshul du nyams su blangs pas/ bdag nyid grol ba'i skyes bu des ni/ gzhan la bstan nas gzhan rgyud grol bar byed pa la/ slob dpon rin po che nyid kyi bka' rgya dang smon lam 'di ltar gnang ste/ ma 'ongs las can zhig dang 'phrad par shog ces/ skyes bu las dang skal bar ldan pa sngar bstan pa'i mtshan ldan gyi slob ma snod can la sbyin par bya ste/ gzhan du kha bsags g.yo sgyu dad med dam nyams phal gyi spyod yul ma yin pas gsang bar gdams te/ klong gsal las/ yid bzhin nor bu gsang rgyud 'di// ma 'ongs las can rnams dang 'phrad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ de'i dus lnga tshogs kyi rten 'brel 'grig par gyur na/ blo chung dang skyo ngal gyi dri ma ring du bor te sems can gyi don bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang bdag gzhan theg pa mchog gi lam la mos shing gdams pa nyams su blang ba rnams kyi phyir du/ snying tig dngos kyi gzhung las/

btags grol don khrid/ thod rgal khrid yig nyams len spra khrid/ rtags yig tshad yig khrid yig dngos gzhi rtsa 'grel/ lung phreng rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i go rim so so'i skabs su bab par bsgrigs te/ chu pho 'brug gi lo hor zla gnyis pa'i yar gyi tshes brgyad la/ 'bri gung gi bla brang 'tshe'u khar snyoms las pa gnam lcags me 'bar gyis bkod pa 'di la/ ma rtogs log rtogs kyi dri ma mchis na/ rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i spyan ldan rnams dang*/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro bka' srung la bzod par gsol bas/ yang zab snying po'i gdams pa'i lam 'di nyid nyi zla ltar rgyas par gyur cig// / maḍ+galaṃ// lan gcig zhus so/

༄༅// rgya gar gyi grub chen dza har pīr gyi snyan brgyud zab mo bzhugs so/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza har pīr las brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di la gnyis te/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dang gdams pa dngos so// dang po ni/ a+yon gu ru/ mgon po chen po/ dza har pīr te bla ma de dag ni 'ja' lus su grub pa brnyes pa ste/ da ltar yang skal ba dang ldan pa mtha' dag gis/ zhal dngos su mjal zhing gsung gi gdams pa nod par nus pa sha stag go /grub chen dza har pīr gyi slob ma ni bdag gi bla ma badz+ra nā tha ste/ rang lo nyer bzhi pa la mjal zhing*/ gdams pa 'di rnams nod par bgyis pa'o// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po ni tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas bsgrub par byed pa la/ bar gcod kyis mi tshugs pa sngags srung gi man ngag chu la brten nas tshe bsgrub pa'i man ngag zas dug bsrung ba bhi sha stobs 'joms kyi man ngag pha rol rigs sngags kyi nus pa gzhom pa byad bzlog gi man ngag ste/ bzhi po 'di sngon 'gro phran bu'i bskor ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la brten pa'i bskor la/ kha zas kyi 'khri ba gcod cing 'ja' lus sgrub par byed pa la 'byung lnga'i rlung zas su bza' ba'i dmigs pa rgyun khyer gyi man ngag /rlung 'phyug med du 'jug pa dbu ma gsal byed dang*/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dbu ma bskor ba'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag bde ba'i gnad bskul zhing rtsal sbyang bogs 'don pa thig le dkar dmar dmigs pa'i man ngag de'i tshe kun da'i gegs bsrung zhing bzung ba rtsa rlung them bu'i man ngag byang sems gyen du 'dren cing lus kun la 'grems pa'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag phung po lhag med kyi 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi man ngag rnams so// gsum pa rjes phran bu'i skor la gnyis te/

rlung sbyor dang sngags la brten pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas skabs kyi gegs bsal/ stod gzer dang sbo 'khrog gzhom zhing*/ stod smad kyi gegs bsal ba'i rlung dang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag mig dang rna bar rlung 'dzin cing*/ de'i 'khrul 'khor dang phyir gzhil ba/ rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa rlung sor mo la dgram pa'i man ngag rnying rlung dang chu gzhi sha lhad 'don pa'i dmigs pa rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag gsang ba sbubs su sbas te gtsug tor bsgrub pa dang*/ de dag gi gegs sel ba'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag tsha grang gi nad skyugs su 'dren pa dang sbyang ba'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag rnams so// sngags la brten pa'i skor las/ gzhan snang dbang du sdud cing bsod nams kyi stobs bskyed pa'i sngags kyi man ngag lus stod smad kyi bskrangs 'bur dang dman 'bru khros pa zhi bar byed pa'i sngags kyi man ngag mda' mdung mtshon cha'i ngar dbal gdugs par byed pa/ sa la brten pa dang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i man+t+ra/ mdze dang pho nad sogs sgos su bcos par byed pa chu la brten pa'i man+t+ra/ gzhan phan ser ba bsrung ba'i gtor ma bca' gzhi sngags la brten pa'i man ngag rnams mchis pa las/ sngags la brten pa rnams ni zur du gsal/ 'dir dngos gzhi dang*/ rlung sbyor phran bu rnams ston te/ dang po kha zas kyi 'khri ba gcod cing 'ja' lus bsgrub pa la/ 'byung lnga'i rlung zas su za ba dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa rgyun khyer gyi man ngag 'di la lnga ste/ sngon 'gro lus kyi gnad bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rlung lnga'i kha dog gsal btab la bsdu ba dang*/ rlung zhi bar bza' ba dang*/ drag por bza' ba dang*/ btsan thabs su bza' ba'o// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad grib la 'dzem/ stan gyi rgyab mtho ba la 'khod de/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i rting pas gsang ba'i rtsa chen mnan/

g.yas kyi rting pa spu mtshams su gtad pa'i rkang sor gyi rtse sar btsug la brten/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo pus steng bkab cing*/ lus shin tu drang ba'i mgrin pa sgu bas stong mgo non par bya/ mig mdun gyi gnya' shing gang tsam gyi sar rang babs su lta stangs su bya'o// gnyis pa ni ngag tu oṃ na mo na mo na mo/ dza har pīr/ dza har pīr/ dza har pīr/ zhes brjod la srin lag g.yas la mchil ma btab ste smin mtshams su byug go/ dmigs pa ni smin mtshams su grub chen dza har pīr de nyid rab byung gi cha byad can/ phyag gnyis dbu'i gtsug tu thal mo sbyar ba/ zhabs mthil gnyis sprad de/ bzhengs pa'i sku mtshon gang pa'am nas 'bras tsam pa lam mer bzhugs pa la sems gtad/ de'i ngang las phyi rol gyi snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo/ sa'i rlung ser po/ chu'i rlung dkar po/ me'i rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung ljang khu/ nam mkha'i rlung sngon po rnams su gsal btab la/ rngub pa'i tshe rlung kha dog lnga ldan nar gyis drangs nas/ lus kyi nang khengs par bsgom mo// gsum pa rlung zhi bar bza' ba ni/ lus gnad snga ma de nyid las/ rlung ro phyir 'bud/ der gzhur te rngubs la/ rtsol bcas kyi mchil ma mid pa yang yang bya ste/ rlung gi gang bar gyur gyur gyi bar bya'o// des ni rlung gegs mi 'byung zhing 'byongs pa'i dgos pa yod do// bzhi pa drag por bza' ba ni/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa sngar ltar la/ rlung ro sgra bcas su 'bud/ de nas sgra bcas su rngubs la kha btsum pa sgang la mchil ma sgra can du mid tshad sngar ltar ro// lnga pa btsan thabs su za ba ni/ rlung ro sgra bcas su 'bud cing*/ lte ba bcar pho ba mchin btsal/ lkaug ma dang mid pa mdun du brgyangs pas/ mgrin pa nas rlung sgra bcas su skad cig gis 'jug ste nang khengs pa dang*/ cung zad mnan/ gsum kar rgyab rlung rang sor 'jog la 'dor ba spangs/

dmigs pa ni gsum ka 'dra'o// 'di dag ni nyams len rgyun khyer te/ rgyun tu nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa rlung 'chug med du 'jug pa dbu ma gsal byed dang*/ rtsa lam sbyangs ba dbu ma bskor ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad kyi man ngag ni/ lus bsgur te langs pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyi bar la bskum khru gang yod pa bya/ pus stengs lag gnyis bzhag la sked pa bsrang*/ steng rlung phul nas bcad/ long gnyis mnon/ mdun rlung mchun rtsal la drangs/ 'byongs tshe rkang tshugs par 'gyur ro// de nyid las dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon phyun re mos bya zhing bskor ba'o// rlung gnad ni gong bzhin no// gsum pa bde ba'i gnad bskul zhing bogs 'don pa thig le dkar dmar dmigs pa'i man ngag la gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang dngos so// dang po ni/ lus gnad de nyid las/ rang lus rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po/ rtsa ba phra ba kha gdengs rgyas pa lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i yar sna dwangs ma dkar po mar sna dwangs ma dmar po byi'u'i sgo nga tsam bsam/ rlung gong ltar la/ thig le dkar dmar dbu ma'i sked par 'phrad pa'i tshe dbu ma g.yas su skor tshe dkar pos dmar po 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba dang*/ g.yon du bskor dus dmar pos dkar po gong bzhin 'ded par bsgom pa ni sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa ni 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad gong ltar la/ thig le dkar po mar babs te/ dmar po'i 'og tu sleb pa na/ dbu ma g.yas su skor dus dkar pos dmar po ded nas tshangs bug bar 'gro ba dang*/ g.yon du bskor dus dmar po ded de gsang gnas bar 'gro bar bsgom zhing 'bad pas rlung dbu mar tshud rtags mgo bo na zhing gzer ba 'byung zhing*/ bde ba'i nyams rtsol med du 'char ro// thun mtshams rnams su thig le dkar dmar gnas so sor bzhag go /'di'i skabs su bde ba'i shugs chen po 'bar te/ byang sems 'pho ba'i rkyen du 'gyur nyen na/

bzhi pa kun+da'i gegs bsrung zhing bzung ba rtsa rlung them bu'i man ngag la gnyis te/ rtsa them dang rlung them mo/ dang po ni/ rgyun khyer gyi lus gnad kho na'o// gnyis pa ni/ rtsol med kyi pho rlung mdun du phul/ lte ba sgal tshigs la bcar te 'then/ rtsa them dang sbyar bar bya'o// de ni gegs srung zhing bzung ba'o// lnga pa byang sems gyen la 'dren cing lus kun la 'grems pa'i rlung gnad dang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag la gnyis te/ 'dren pa dang 'grems pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ lus stod la 'dren pa dang*/ mgo la 'dren pa'o// dang po ni rkang pa'i lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lag gnyis mdun du bshibs la brkyang*/ rtsol med kyi rlung rngubs chung byas la/ lus stod du bcud cing lus stod sor mo la phyun btsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ rkang gnad sngar ltar la/ lag gnyis pus steng bkab la/ bsrang zhing rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung mgrin pa dang mgo bor bcug cing*/ 'phyun mig btsal lo// gnyis pa 'grems pa ni/ rkang pa dkyil krung*/ lag gnyis pus steng bzhag la/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung brgyangs la/ lus dang mgo bo g.yas su bcu zhing*/ pus mo g.yon gyi mgo lag pa g.yon gyis mnan/ spus mo g.yas lag pa g.yas kyis nang du then pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor de nyid bsgyur bar bya zhing lus kun la chun rtsal lo// drug pa phung po lhag med kyi 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi man ngag ni/ 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad dbu ma ka 'dzug dang 'dra ba la/ rlung phyir dbyung ba'i tshe rang gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs skyon rnams du ba'i rnam pa sngo bun bun thon/ sdig sgrib nad gdon gegs skyon rnams dud pa dang sa rlangs kyi rnam par sangs kyis thon par dmigs la ka ba btsug pa'i nang du/ btsan thabs kyi rlung gzhugs pa'i tshe/ slar yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi byin brlabs brtan g.yo'i bcud rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par byon/

dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang*/ dbu ma rang yang 'od kyi rnam par bsam zhing*/ dmigs pa dang sbyar ste/ g.yas g.yon du bskor ba ni sngar bzhin no// de ltar skabs skabs su bogs 'don la rtsal sbyang zhing*/ dus kun tu rgyun khyer gyis nyams len sems kyi bzhag thabs zhal las shes so/ la 'bad par bya'o// gsum pa rjes gegs sel dang phran bu'i 'khrul 'khor rlung gnad kyi man ngag gi bskor la brgyad las/ dang po stod gzer dang sbo 'khrog gzhom pa dang*/ stod smad kyi gegs sel ba'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag la bzhi ste/ de yang rtsol med rgyun khyer gyi man ngag nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ ro stod gzer ba dang*/ sbo zhing rtsibs logs phan tshun bsdams pa ltar na ba sogs byung na/ sel ba'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus bsrang zhing*/ rkang pa rtsa them ltar la/ rtsol med kyi rlung dgang zhing steng rlung cung zad mnan/ lag pa gnyis mdun du 'phang zhing*/ stod kyi rlung gseng la brdeg go /gnyis pa smad sbo zhing khrog pa dang na zug byung na 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad sngar ltar la rdo rje khu tshur pho stod pho smad du brdeg cing 'beb bya ba dang*/ gru 'beb dang 'beb spel mar bya'o// gsum pa stod gegs rlung gegs rlung 'chor ba sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad ni/ rgyun khyer ltar la sor mo pus stengs su chun rtsal la rkyang zhing smad par bya'o// bzhi pa smad kyi bgegs sel ni 'og rlung 'chor tsa na tshad na ?lus gnad sngar las cung sgur zhing lag pa pus stengs bsrang zhing dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyi sel lo// gnyis pa mig dang rna bar rlung 'dzin zhing gzhil ba dang*/ rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa rlung sor mo la dgram pa'i rlung gnad dang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag la gsum ste/ dang po mig la rlung 'dzin cing gzhil ba ni/ lus gnad rgyun khyer ltar las/ rna ba'i bug pa mtheb bus bkag ste/

rlung phyir bus rjes lag g.yas mtheb mdzub kyis rna gshog bsdams nas mig bsgril zhing*/ rlung nang du then pas/ sgra bcas su 'byung phyir gzhil ba yang lus gnad de la rlung phyir 'don pa'o// gnyis pa/ rna bar rlung 'dzin pa dang gzhil ba ni/ rna ba'i bug pa gsal ste sngar bzhin no// phan yon ni rna ba dang mig la skyon mi 'byung zhing*/ lha yi rna mig gi mngon shes dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gsum pa sor mo la rlung dgram pa ni/ lus gnad rgyun khyer ltar ram/ 'dren gyi 'khrul 'khor ltar la/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung stod du brgyangs te/ lag nya dang sor mo bsgyur zhing 'chun btsal bas/ dang por rtsa gsal zhing*/ 'byongs tshe thal ba spur nus so// bzhi pa snying rlung gi gegs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang rlung sbyor gyi dmigs pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis mthil sprad pa'i sor mo lag gnyis kyis sbar 'dzings su bsdams/ rlung sbyor ka 'dzug ltar la/ dbu ma sngar bzhin gsal btab pa'i yar snar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kyang gong bzhin gsal ba la/ yar 'then dus bla ma dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ sa'i gding du mar 'byon pa la sems gtad*/ yang rkang mgo la/ bla ma'i bzhugs tshul zhal las shes/ 'tshun btsal/ phyir 'then cing 'bebs pa'i dus/ bla ma yar 'byon/ smin phrag gi thad du bzhugs pa la sems gtad cing*/ sa 'og gi dmigs pa rgyun bsring bar bya'o// lnga pa chu ser gyis lus dang yan lag bskrangs pa sogs la/ dbu ma btsugs pa'i nang du yan lag gi chu ser bsdus par dmigs shing chu ser bsdu ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung gi lus dgang zhing*/ srol rlung gi 'khrul 'khor ltar 'beb bya ba dang*/ lag len zhal las shes/ yang rkang pa skyil krung tsog pu/ lag sor g.yon g.yas kyis bzung ba'-i nang sar bstan la 'beb bya'o// des ni chu ser bshang sgo las thon yong ngo*// drug pa sha lhad 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor rlung gnad ni/

rkang pa dang lag pa bsnol la bsgreng zhing*/ brtsol bcas dang brtsol med kyi rlung dgang la lus kun la 'chun btsal lo// bdun pa sba ba sbubs 'dren gyi 'khrul 'khor la gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang gegs sel ba'o// dang po ni/ rkang pa gnyis pus mo btsugs pa'i bar du khyud gang yod pa bya zhing lag pa rdo rje khu tshur pus stengs bzhag la/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi mdun rlung brgyang zhing phyir phul/ rgyab rlung drag tu 'then la 'chun btsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ gong gi 'khrul 'khor dang rlung gnad la 'bad pas/ dri chu bsdams pa'i gegs byung na lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lag pa mdun du brkyang zhing stod kyi rlung gseng du brdeg pa gsum gyi rjes su/ rkang pa mdun du brkyang zhing lus byin pa la 'bebs/ rlung gnad gong bzhin no// brgyad pa tsha grang gi nad skyungs su 'dren pa dang sbyang ba'i/ rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag ni/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung dang ldan pas/ chu bskol dang grang mo gang rung 'thung zhing*/ lus gnad rgyun khyer ltar las/ dkrug pa'i lag len zhal las shes/ 'khrul 'khor la 'bad cing sgregs bton pas bskyugs 'byung zhing*/ bshang sgo la'ang nad thon no// gnad kyi man ngag lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ sna mig gnyis kyi gegs sel khyad par rlung skom du 'thung ba rnams zhal las shes so// de ltar tshe gcig gis mtshungs med 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i rlung dang 'khrul 'khor gyi gdams pa zab mo lam gyi cha lag tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa 'di nyid dus bskal gyi dbang gis mtshungs gzhan la sbyin pa'i chos su ma mthong yang*/ dad pa dang dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma mang zhig gis bskul ba la brten/ 'bri gung gi phyogs su gnas pa'i ldom bu ba/ rat+na'i ming can gyis shing pho rta'i lo hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes bzang po la/ gter sgrom brag dkar du sbyar ba yin pas/ phyis 'byung lam 'dir mos pa kun kyang bsgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas nas nyams su len pa dang*/
snying nas chos byed ma gtogs pa la/ dpe dang gdams pa byin na/ 'di nyid kyi bka' srung drang srong gza' brgyad kyis snying khrag thang la phos shig /ཿlan gcig zhus/

༈ zab lam snyan brgyud bzhugs so/ (198) na mo gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki na ye/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// 'khrul snang shar ba'i gdams pa'i brjed tho zhig /phyi rabs rnams la phan blos bri bar bya// bzod par gsol zhing bka' yi rgya 'khrol zhu// steng 'og rlung ni dbu ma'i khyim du gzhug /gling bzhi rab bgrad ri rab lto bar 'gengs// de ni dbu ma'i rlung gi lam sbyong ste// rtsa gnas ma khrems bar du 'di la 'bad// dngos gzhi rlung gnad gong dang 'dra ba la// gling bzhi ri rab 'phar zhing brdeg pa ni// 'chun ldan rab tu bsgrims pa'i ngang nyid nas// grangs med ci gnas bar du 'bad cing bsnun// rjes bar nyi zla mun par mngon sum blta// phyi nang dbyer med don dang mi ldan bar// tha mal ya bral bar du mi gcod cing*// rang babs gtad med ngang la 'bad pa gces// zhes pa 'di yang snyom las ldom bu ba/ rat+na'i ming can bdag gis bris pa 'dis// mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// kun bzang he ru ka dang dbyer med shog// / nam mkha' zhal mjal bzhugs so/ na mo rat+na gu ru dza har pīr na mo/ thabs shes zung ni brtsaigs pa'i gdan stengs su// ri rgyal lhun po 'gying zhing rab tu brtan// dpag pasam ljon pa'i zung can mkhrang zhing ldem// rnam rgyal khang bzang dkar gsal steng du phye// rlung lha pho mo zom chen nang du bsnyal// ri rab them skas nang nas sbar zhing sbud// de tshe rang rig nyi zla'i lha zhal mthong*// zhes pa 'di ni nam mkha' zhal mjal te/ gnas chen gter sgrom brag dkar dben gnas su/ bzang po'i tshes la rat+na lak+ṣa mis// zhar la smras te dug lnga'i dgra las rgyal// gdod ma'i mgon mchog gang de mthong gyur cig // lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/ dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza har pīr las brgyud pa'i rlung khrid las 'byung 'khrugs kyi gegs sel nad 'joms bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni ye/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir zab lam mkha' spyod myur lam rlung la brten pa'i nyams len/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza har pīr zhes yongs su grags pa/ de las brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la/ gang zag 'byung ba'i sgyu lus byer zug ma snyoms pa'i khyad par las/ gegs sel lugs kyi man ngag la ma rmongs pa gal che ste/ gtso bor lam 'di nyams su blangs pas man ngag gi gsang la nges pa rnyed pa na/ bdag gzhan gyis 'du ba ma snyoms par bya ba'i phyir/ gegs gang gis sel zhing bogs gang gis 'don par bya ba ni/ rlung rig gis 'dun pas bsgyur zhing dpyad pa na/ 'char bar 'gyur bas las la sbyar bas don 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar mi ldan na gnas skabs kyi gegs sel nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bri bar bya ste/ de yang thog mar rlung zhi drag gang bza' yang*/ gre ba bskam pa lta bur gyur nas rlung sgra bcas dang sgra med/ phyir 'gro dang nang 'gro ma go bar rlung mid ma shes na/ snod kyi nang du chu cung zad khyer te mchu la sbyar zhing drangs shing*/ chu dang mnyam du mid pas shes par 'gyur zhing*/ yang rlung bzas pas mid pa la zug dang rke mchus pa lta bus rlung chud dka' ba na/ lus gnad tsog pur bya/ lag gnyis mgo bor sor mo bsnol te bsdams/ rked pa bsrangs rlung bzung la gzhan gyis rgyab nas tshigs pa drug bdun gyi thog tu pus mo gtad de/ lag pas stod nas bsdams te/ phyir ltag 'then drag tu byas la/ rlung dbyung dus kha sna nas sgra bcas su bus pas sel lo// yang mdun stod brgyangs pa lta bu dang*/ sgrog rus bral snyam byed pa/ mid pa mchus pa lta bu byung ba na/ rgyab dang ro stod sgrogs nas gzer ba lta bus rlung chud mi bde na/ langs pa'i lag pa sbar 'dzings gyis mgo nas bsdams/

rlung bsdams pa'i rgyab sog phrag tu ras sam snam bu'am gang rung gi pho stod khu tshur nyis bsgril tsam bzhag la/ grogs kyis rgyab nas bsdams te/ 'degs 'jog ci mang dang*/ yang sgrog rus la khu tshur brdeg cing*/ rke dang gnya' ba lag pas bshud/ mar dkar gyis byug pa bya zhing*/ rlung bcud pa'i rke la mchun btsal lo// g.yas g.yon du bskor ba rnams byas pas rlung chud bde bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rlung bcud pas mgo bo na zhing gzer na/ rlung bzung ba'i lag pas mgo la brdeg pa mang du bya'o// yang rlung lus kyi gzhog gcig la chud cing*/ gcig la ma chud na gang ma chud pa phyogs kyi stod smad kun la rlung bcud la 'chun btsal/ rkang lag mgo sogs lag pas bshud pa mang du byas la/ nyal tshe rlung ma chud pa phyogs kyi gzhogs sa la phab ste nyal bas rlung yo ba bsrong par 'gyur ro// yang lag pa sbid pa dang*/ tshigs chen dang por tshigs na ba sogs byung na/ rlung bcud pa'i na sa 'phur zhing srog rtsol gyi rlung lag pa la 'chun btsal/ 'khrigs ma na na lag pa pad kor ltar byas la/ tshigs su mar gsar gyis byug pa 'them par bya/ yang dpung tshigs dang ro stod gzir na/ lus bsrang lag gnyis rang babs su pus steng bzhag ste/ rlung bcug la dpung pa phyi nang bskor ba re mos dang*/ mnyam du bskor ba'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas sel lo// yang bar rlung stod du brgyang zhing mgo bo na zhing*/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas/ rlung bseng rnams na zhing 'phyang ba dang*/ sha khol tsher 'khrig pa sogs byung nas rlung rnal du ma phebs na/ sa khod snyoms pa'i steng du shing sdum lag ngar tsam hril nar gyi steng du/ rkang pa'i rgyud mor khug khel bar byed pa'am/ shing phur khru gang pa gnyis kyi rtse mo sar btsug pa'i bar du 'khyud gang tsam yod pa'i shing phur gnyis kyi mgo rkang pa'i rgyud khug bkal te/ lag pa mdun du 'khar ba la brten ljid rkang pa la bkal ba'am/

yang na dbyug pa khru gsum tsam yod pa'i sne mo brang gi lhen snar btsugs te/ lus kyi ljid bkal zhing rlung bsdams lan lnga'am gsum la sogs pa bskyar bas rkang pa la drod phebs shing*/ bar rlung stod du 'tshangs pa'i gegs sel bar 'gyur ro// yang thur sel gyen du log pa zhes kyang zer/ las rlung drag tu gyen la log nas dbugs mi thon zhing*/ mgo bo dang rna 'gram ro stod rlung gseng rnams na zhing mig gyen du ldog dbugs phyi nang du bskyel 'dren khag lus kyi smad drod 'chor zhing/ stod drod che bar 'bar/ mchan 'og dang skra mtshams nas rngul 'bab dri chen dang dri chu bsdams/ lce gro phugs su bros pa byung na/ myur du 'chos dgos te/ de las 'gyangs na tshe'i dus byed do// de'i gegs bsal ba ni/ ska rags sam/ gru gu 'am/ ras kyi pho ldo ji ltar 'tsham pa zhig de'i brang khugs su bcug la bsdams/ rlung bzung nas grogs kyi khur ba'i rgal tshigs dang po nas/ mjug gu thung gi bar khu tshur gyis/ dang po dal bu dang*/ de nas drag tu brdung zhing phur ba grangs lnga'am/ bdun gyi bar byas pas rnal du phebs shing*/ de dag gi bar khur mi des kyang lus sprug cing bsig go tshabs chung na gong ltag 'then chung ba dang*/ dpung phrag prag ??g.yas g.yon dang*/ yan lag bzhi'i 'gul mtshams kyi rlung bseng rnams la gnad du bsnun zhing*/ rtsa'i gnad mnyes pas gegs sel bar 'gyur ro// yang yan lag gi rlung log na/ mig na zhing tsha ba dang*/ gangs kyis phyed pa lta bu dang*/ mchi ma 'dzag cing*/ gang dang gang la'ang blta bar mi nus shing*/ mig 'bras na ?na lus gnad bsgur ba dang*/ lta ltangs gzir ba las byung ba yin te/ lus gnad ni rgyab tu dgye ba las/ lag pa'i khur sha phan tshun mnye zhing bshud pas/ drod phebs pa dang mig la sbyar zhing phur la/ mig phugs nas phyi ngos su cung zad 'phur zhir/ ltag pa'i bar sna gong nas bshad cing 'phur ro// yang sna subs shing tsha ba dang sbrid pa klubs na/

rlung bzung ba'i sna khrung krum nyed cing*/ mgrin pa dgye rlung 'bud pa mang du bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas lce bskrangs zhing bsgyur mi shes pa lta bu dang*/ lce'u chung babs na/ ha'i sgras kha nas rlung phyir dbyung zhing lce gyen thur du bsgril/ yang rna ba 'ur zhing na ba dang*/ gting nas gzer na rlung bcud cing*/ rna ba 'phur zhing mar byug bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas so na zhing khrol te mgul zhing 'phar na/ mar dkar bzhu ba'i nang du srin bal shing bu'i rtser bcings pa bcug pa'i drod dang bcas pa de nyid so mtshams su nam nam bya ba'am/ mar khu kha nang du bzung ngo*// yang khyab byed log na gdong pa sbos shing kha sna 'tshub/ lus byin la tsha bram dang*/ grang lhang*/ za phrugs dang sha ro bal ldags/ zug med du bskrangs pa sogs 'byung ste/ 'di yi gegs kyang rlung log chen po'i bcos kha dang*/ nyi ma dro ba la byug pa 'them par bya zhing dbyi/ mi bskyod pa'i khrus byug gis kyang sel lo/ khyad par ngo gdong sbos pa la/ gan rkyal lus gnad dang*/ ha 'don phur nyid kyis sel lo// yang des kyang ma sol na bya rog g.yam pa me la tshos par bsregs te/ zhib tu gtags la mar nag rnying pa la btab byugs pas sel lo// yang rlung gis ya ma spar te/ rtsa rgyud dang mgo gzhogs khyad yod par na ba dang*/ so dang 'gram pa na ba na/ rlung bsdams pas 'jing ltag la bshud cing 'phur/ mar dkar byug pas sel lo// yang lus stod smad gang du'ang gzer zug lhang lhang na na ?gang byung du lus bsrang zhing rlung bzung ba'i gang na sar rlung bcud cing*/ drag tu phul la/ lag gis phur zhing bshud do// yang rlung bzung bas/ bad 'khris kyi nad slongs nas/ pho ba'i stod smad du na zug che ba la/ rlung gi ma 'chun zhing*/ bshal bskyug dka' na/ 'phrul sbyongs sman ni/ chu rtsa drag snum med pa dang*/ byang bul thar nu rnams cha mnyam la/ thur mgo gang tsam chu bskol gyi lcags kyis 'phul la btang*/

de rjes rlung zhi drag gang rung grangs mang bar bcug gos kyis 'byibs pas sbyongs 'byung ste/ chu bskol 'thung ci thub yang yang btang la/ rlung mnan pas/ nad gang yang bshang sgo las 'thon zhing*/ mthar chu mdog ma thon bar bshal 'byung ngo*// me drod gso ba la/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ shing tsha pi pi ling bzhi cha mnyam pa la/ rgya tsha zhad tsam btang ba zhib tu btags la/ rna brus gang gi tshad chu grang gis phul la btang*/ thun grangs tshad dang sbyar ro// yang chu bsdams shing bsri na/ lcam 'bru/ sdig srin/ drod sman/ pi pi ling*/ g.yer ma gze ma rnams cha mnyam/ rgya tsha zhad tsam gtang ba'i thang*/ dang po sla zhing bar du gar ba/ tha mar sla ba ci mang btang*/ bal 'dab gtsang ma la sngags 'di brgya stong bzlas la chu sor sbyar/ oṃ chu shad mar nar nar sa chal chal chu thon thon/ des nad las grol bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang rlung gi nad phal che ba la/ rus bsar gyi thang sbyin/ 'khris pa la a ru ra gser mdog gi thang btang*/ bad kan skya smug gang la'ang*/ mtshal bul tog gcong zhi/ sga skya rnams cha mnyam la/ zhib tu btags la chu bskol gyi phul zhing btang bas/ nad bshal du 'byung ngo*// sha dug dang sbyar dug sogs kyi nad slongs pa la/ gtso bor rlung la 'bad cing*/ dri chu bskor bzlog steng 'og gis drangs pas/ nad byang gso ba'i sman du 'gyur ro// sa bdag dang klu'i nad 'don na/ thog mar rlung la byang bar byas la/ gnyen po'i sman ni/ bse zho zho gang*/ thar nu zho phyed/ sman chen zho gang*/ a ru ra gser mdog zho bzhi/ gla rtsi zho lnga/ ra khrag nag po zho lnga rnams dang*/ pad+mo mar khra bar gshog phral ba bcu gcig rgya tsha zho phyed/ pi pi ling ma nyams pa rdog po gsum/ shing dngar sran ma tsam/ sdig srin thun bzang ba gsum gyi bongs/ lcam bu thun lnga/ gze ma thun lnga/ rma bya'i gdongs gsum/ rus sbal dang*/ pir gyi rus pa zho re/ de rnams zhal shes ltar zhib tu btags la/
