tsan dan mar khus mgo bsdus pa'i ril bu sran chung tsam re re nangs re bzhin brten/ rlung la 'bad pas/ nad rnams rang sbyongs su 'byung zhing*/ sos par 'gyur nges so// 'dir ni rags pa'i nye bar mkho ba ci rigs su bris pa ste/ de las gzhan yang rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun par bya'o// 'di dag gong du dge slong gtsang mas zin bris su byas 'dug pa la gzhi byas shing*/ ma 'thus pa kha shas mtshams su bab par bsgrigs te/ lha btsun chos kyi rje'i bkas bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal pos/ ru tshal pho brang du bris pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba'i don du gyur cig// /lan gcig zhus so/ maḍ+galam/ ༈ tshe khrid kyi man ngag snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/ (bla ma bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag tshal lo// 'dir 'ba' ra ba nas brgyud pa'i tshe khrid zab mo nyams su len pa la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par rten mchod mthun rkyen mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par ldan pas nyams su len pa la/ thog mar nyams len dus kyi gnad ni zla ba yar ngo'i cha/ dus tshes gza' skar dge ba la/ tho rangs bya rog gi skad mi sgrag cing*/ rlung g.yon nas rgyu ba'i dus kha nub tu phyogs la stan bde bar/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ bzhag pa sems kyi gnad la gsum las/ sngon 'gro/ dngos bzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni rgyas par na/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ rgyu 'bras kyi don la bsam pa'i thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi dang*/ skyabs sems yig brgya maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs khrid chen sbyor chos ltar nyams su blang zhing*/ cung zad bsdus par na/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhis rgyud bskul te/ mdun du skyabs yul kun 'dus mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba la skyabs su 'gro zhing skyabs yul rang la bstim/

byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gnad la/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan gyis spras shing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim pas skyabs gsum kun 'dus su mos la/ yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs bsag maṇ+ḍal spyi ltar dbul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med// mchog gsum kun 'dus yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sku gsum thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ slar yang bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs byung*/ rang gi lus thams cad la khyab pas/ sgo gsum du 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas par mos/ mthar bla ma rang la bstim/ gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzhag dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul dang*/

g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpang du/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing*/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khril ba/ yab yub gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer spro bsdus rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ gnyis med du bstim zhing*/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa la mchod bstod/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ la yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi thugs rje nus mthu yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim zhing*/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams nas 'thon rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus ngag gi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dag cing bde stong gi nyams myong rgyud la skyes par mos la/ yi ge brgya pa bzla'o// mthar bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// zhes sogs kyi gsol ba gdab pas/ gsung gi gnang ba byin te rang la thim par dmigs la/ gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzhag dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim dang*/ bcud len la brten te tshe bsring ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ chos dbyings rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla bre yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bar mtshams med par khyab pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'od zer kun du 'phro bas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa gong bzhin gsal ba dang/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang*/ pad zla'i gdan la sngar bzhin tshe dpag med bskyed pa'i bdag mdun gyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla ba la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du mos/ slar thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma ra ga'i mdog 'dra dri med 'od 'phro ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod cing*/ tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe/ sa ra ha ka ra re/ sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam lnga sogs gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i bon las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi tshe gdon bgegs log 'dren gyi rkus shing phrogs pa dang*/ 'thor zhing yar ba thams cad bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can 'od zer gyi tshul tshe bum gyi nang du bsdus pa las/ bdud rtsi khol zhing lud rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba sogs lus kyi nang gang bas/

tshe nyams thams cad sor chud par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wan tī ye swa hāḥ zhes stong ngam brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ de lta bu zhag gsum las mi nyung bar byed pa ni dmigs pa dang po'o// yang gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba chen po sa la brten nas/ tshe bskyed rgyas smin cing bsdu ba'i nus pa ji snyed pa dang*/ rang gi sha rus kyi khams nas tshe nyams pa thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rnam par tshe bum du bsdus shing rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pa sogs sngar ltar la/ lus bsra ba brtan pa/ gzhom gzhig dang bral bar bsgom zhing*/ sngags bzla ba ni sngar ltar ro// yang gsol ba btab pa gong bzhin gyi 'od zer 'byung ba chen po chu la brten nas tshe bskyed rgyas smin pa dang bsdu ba'i nus pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ rang gi khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams pa thams cad drangs shing*/ tshe bum las brgyud rang gi gnas rnams gang bas lus snum bag dang ldan par mos la bzlas pa bya/ yang sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis/ 'byung ba chen po me la brten nas tshe bskyed rgyas smin cing bsdu ba'i nus pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams pa thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par drangs shing tshe bum las brgyud/ lus kyi gnas rnams rim bzhin gang bas lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan par dmigs bzhin pas bzlas pa bya/ yang sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i 'od zer gyis 'byung ba chen po rlung la brten nas tshe bskyed rgyas smin cing bsdu ba'i nus pa ji snyed yod pa rnams/ 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ bum pa las brgyud lus kyi gnas kun rim gyis gang bar dmigs shing bzlas pa bya/ yang gsol ba btab pa'i 'od zer gyis 'byung ba nam mkha' la brten nas tshe bskyed rgyas smin pa'i nus pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/

rnam par shes pa'i khams nas tshe nyams pa 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ bum pa las brgyud lus kyi gnas kun gang bas/ rig stong gsal ba'i rang gshis rnyog pa bral bar bzhag cing*/ de'i ngang las bsnyen pa bya/ yang gsol ba btab pa'i 'od zer gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ mdor na rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus/ tshe bum las brgyud/ rang gi gnas kun rim bzhin gang bas/ de dag thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams ma lus pa bdag nyid la rdzogs par mos shing*/ bsnyen pa bya/ yang gsol ba btab pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad la phog mdun du spyan drangs pa rnams kyang 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu/ tshe bum las brgyud/ rang gi gnas kun rim bzhin gang bas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs kun 'dus te/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes par mos la bsnyen pa bya zhing*/ rjes so sor gzungs ring kyang ci nus bzla'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim la bsten nas tshe bsring ba la gnyis las/ rtsa dang rlung la brten nas tshe bsring ba'o// dang po ni lus gnad sngar ltar la/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i nang khru ma phus btab pa bzhin stong rar bsgom pa'i nang gi dbus su/ rtsa a ba dhū ti dmar po mda' smyug 'bring po'i phra sbom tsam/ yar rtse spyi gtsug dang mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir sleb pa gdugs kyi yu ba lta bu la/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug/ snying gar brgyad/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams kha dog dmar po gdugs rtsibs lta bu kha thur du phyogs par bsam/ dbu ma'i mar sna tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po mtshon gang pa rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum dang thugs khar sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la/

mchod cing bstod la gsol ba btab pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sngar ltar shes rab kyi cha'i sa'i ro bcud tshe bum du bsdus/ de nyid tshe'i bdud rtsi nyi ma'i chu rgyun mtshal dang chu'i khu ba lta bur gyur pa khol zhing lud pas/ dbu ma'i nang khengs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor las brgyud/ lus kyi cha smad khengs pas gong bzhin tshe'i dngos grub thob par dmigs shing sngags bzla/ de bzhin du snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab las brgyud lus kyi nang khengs par bsams shing*/ sngags bzla'o// de nas bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma dbu ma'i mar snar 'dus pa las/ tshe dpag med dmar po mtshon gang pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang*/ sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab pa las/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/thabs kyi cha'i sa'i ro bcud bdud rtsi zla ba'i chu rgyun 'o ma lta bur bsdus shing khol ba las/ bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun gyi yas mar 'khor lo bzhi las brgyud/ lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas/ sngar bzhin tshe'i dngos grub thob par dmigs la/ bzlas pa gnas so sor dmigs te bya ba ni/ 'byung ba chu dang*/ me rlung nam mkha'/ lha mi'i rgyal po dang bsod nams can/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la'ang 'gre'o// de nas bdud rtsi nyi ma dmar po yar 'bar ba dang*/ zla ba dkar po mar babs par bsams shing bzlas pa bya/ mthar nyi zla'i bdud rtsis lus kyi mgo zhabs thams cad khengs pa la mnyam par bzhag gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ bum pa can dang dbab bzlog la brten nas tshe bsring ba'o// dang po ni lus gnad sngar ltar la/ rtsa dbu ma 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas g.yas g.yon gnyis su ro ma dang*/ brkyang ma zhes pa'i rtsa gnyis kyang*/ phra sbom dbu ma dang mnyam pa/ yar sna sna bug gnyis dang*/ mar sna lte 'og rtsa mtshams su dbu mar zug par dmigs la/ rlung g.yon nas rgyu ba nas mgo brtsams te/
nang du 'dug pa oṃ gyi rang bzhin/ nang

du gnas pa ā'iḥrang bzhin/ phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du dmigs te/ ldang 'jug gnas gsum re rer brtsis pa'i brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bgrang bar bya'o// de'i skabs su rlung yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rlung sbyor ni zhal las shes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'bud pa dgu phrugs sngon du 'gro bas/ steng rlung dbyung ba na thur sel dal bus 'dzin/ steng rlung nang du 'dzin pa na thur sel 'jog de la goms nas steng rlung dang thur sel gnyis ka dal bus 'dzin/ de ltar rlung srog thur gnyis ka 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gong ltar gsal btab pa'i rlung phyir dbyung ba na 'og gi tshe dpag med kyi bum pa nas nyi ma'i bdud rtsi byung ba lte ba'i rtsa 'dab khengs pa dang*/ nang du 'dzin pa'i dus su zla ba'i bdud rtsis spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab khengs/ yang dbyung ba'i dus su bdud rtsi dmar pos snying ga khengs pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i dus dkar pos mgrin pa gang*/ yang dbyung ba'i tshe nyi ma mgrin par byon pas nyi zla 'dres/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs/ yang bzung bas zla ba snying gar byon pas nyi zla'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar 'dres pas khengs/ gtong ba'i dus nyi ma spyi bor byon pas bdud rtsi dkar dmar 'dres pas khengs/ yang bzung bas zla ba lte bar byin pas bdud rtsi dkar dmar 'dres pas khengs par bsgoms shing*/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// gsum pa ni rang tshe dpag med rgyan cha lugs spyi lta bu yum chos dkar mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyi snyoms par zhugs pa/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med dkar po sngar bzhin gsal ba la/ rjes chags kyis mes mchod pas/ phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi lud/ spyi bo dang mgrin pa snying ga lte ba'i rtsa 'khor rnams rim pa bzhin gang bas/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam/ de'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i rjes chags mes mchod pas/

lte 'og tu gong bzhin tshe dpag med gsal ba'i phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi dmar po yar lud/ lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor rnams khengs pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong zhing*/ lus la me dpung mched pa lta bu'i bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin 'bar/ bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun spyi bor 'dus pas/ yus gos dkar mor gyur te/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med dkar po dang snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs pas/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa 'khor bzhi'i gnas rnams gang ste/ dkar dmar 'dres pa'i bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ yang bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun lte 'og tu 'dus pas/ yum du gyur te snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang sems dmar po a shad kyi rnam par 'bar/ byang sems dkar po mar babs pa dang gnyis 'bar 'dzag tu byas pas/ lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis gang*/ bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin 'bar bas/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang rdo rje lta bu'i srog thob par bsam mo// spyi don gsum pa bcud len gyi tshe bsring ba ni/ rlung gi gnyen por ra mo shag bad kan gyi gnyen por bcong zhi// 'khris pa'i gnyen por rtag tu ngu*// lus zungs kyi gnyen por dbang lag 'du ba spyi'i gnyen por a ru ra gser mdog rnams cha mnyam pa/ ra mo shag gi khu bas legs par bsdus la/ khu ba tshags la btsags pa'i nang du lcags bcug nas ma khol gyi bar du me cher bcug khol nas me chung du byas la/ skya ba'i sna la chags tsal pa na phog ste grangs su bcug bcong zhi me la bsregs te 'dril ba bshig pa'i phye zhib du btags pa dang*/ sbrang 'dzin zhib du btags pa'i phye chang gar ma phul gang tsam du btab/ dbang lag sa dug phyung ba'i phye ma 'o ma la nyin zhag gcig thug pa gar ma rtsam pa sbyar ba/ nangs par 'khris pa de la gser mdog zhib du btags pa'i phye ma dang/

gong gi bcong zhi dang sbyang 'dzin dang sbyar te/ gtun du dal bar mnye/ de la ra mnye'i kha 'da' dang bu ram dang*/ sbrang spra bton pa gsum ran par bsres pa dang sbyar la ril bu ri bong gi ril ma tsam byas pa/ ka pā la mtshan ldan gyi nang du blug la rang tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i bcud kyi dngos po/ badz+ra a mṛ ta dang*/ swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs byas la nang gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ yi ge sum brgya tsam bzlas/ slar yang 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems gyi thugs rje byin rlabs/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro du ma'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs shing*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim par bsams/ yi ge sum brgya tsam re bzlas la ril bu la btab/ 'bru gsum yang bdud rtsir zhu nas thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub rtsol nus pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams shing*/ slar yang gong bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas pa bskyar zhing*/ zhag bdun nam/ lnga'i gsum gcig sogs su bsgrub pa'i mtshams dam du bcad/ mis ma mthong bar bya/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu de tho rengs kyi dus gsum nas bdun gyi bar khams dang gang 'phrod bsten pa'i dus su'ang*/ gong bzhin bcud bsdus par bsgoms la bza'o// de ltar dmigs pa/ bzlas pa/ rlung bsgom pa/ bcud len gyi rdzas bstan pa bzhi po 'di la gcig dril du byas te/ lo drug bsgom na 'chi med 'grub par the tshom med ces gsung ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi gdams pa la bzhi ste/ tshe'i sgo bsdam pa dang*/ snying gi dbus su tshe phur gdab pa/ dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo zhing phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de nas thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ dbu ma'i sna yar mar gyi tshe dpag med dkar dmar gnyis gsal btab ste/ sgo gnyis bkag par bsgom/

gnyis pa ni/ 'og tshe dpag med kyi bum pa las bdud rtsi yar lud pas/ snying gar sleb pas nyi mar gyur pa dang/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi bum pa las bdud rtsi bab snying gar sleb pa na/ zla bar gyur pa'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su rang gi sems hūm̐ sngon po'am hrīḥdamar po gcig tu bsam/ srin mdzub gnyis kyi rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar yang*/ hūm̐ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can mgo phyir bstan pa breng chags su gnas par bsam/ 'dis sgo gsum bsdams shing tshe phur thebs pas gdon bgegs kyis bar du mi chod gsung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dus rgyun tu tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med pa 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i chos la 'bad par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar dmigs pa dang*/ bzlas pa/ rlung dang*/ bcud len bzhi po 'di la chig dril du byas te lo drug tu bsgoms na 'chi med 'grub par the tshom med ces gsung zhing*/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi gdams pa 'di rnams kyang zhag bcu gnyis bsgoms na/ lo bcu gnyis tshe bsring ba yin zhes gsung yang*/ zla ba gcig bsgoms na nges par lo bcu gnyis tshe bsring bar nus zhes gsungs/ mthar thug 'di nas 'phos nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i drung du skye bar the tshom med ces gsung ngo*// de ltar mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i khrid kyi dmigs rim khrigs chags su bsgrigs pa dgongs bde ba zhig gyis/ mi dbang chen po grags pa mtshan can gyis bka' nan du phebs pa la brten/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa dharma kīrti'i gsung gi gdams pa bzhin/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis/ lcags pho khyi lo hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin/

dus tshes dge bar/ gzho spro lung bla brang gi lcang lo can du rdzogs par bris pa 'dis kyang*/ snying po'i lam bzang 'di nyid gang gis nyams su blangs pa la/ mchog dang thun mong gi 'bras bu ma lus pa bde blag tu thob par gyur cig// /lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/ ༈ rdzogs pa chen po mngon sum gyi nyams len gnad kyi man ngag bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len pa la tshul lugs dpag tu med pa zhig yod par gsungs 'dug kyang*/ 'dir yang gsang ba rmad du byung ba/ mngon sum snying tig gi lugs su nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la/ snod dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ gsol ba lan gsum btab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi rim pa/ bde gshegs zhi khro'i bskongs bshags dang*/ phyi spros bcas bum pa'i dbang*/ nang spros med gsang ba'i dbang*/ gsang ba rab tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ yang gsang shin tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che/ khyad par kun tu spros med thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams bskur zhing*/ so so'i mthar/ bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyi rim pa la rim pa ltar sbyang ste/ de yang khrid gzhung bka' gter so so las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pas khrid lugs su gdab par bya'o// de yang rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len pa la/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du 'du ste/ gzhi ka dag lhun grub/ lam khregs chod dang thod rgal/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes/ zhes gsungs te/ gzhi ka dag ni/ khams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa/ dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul/ ji bzhin nyid ma bcos pa'i shes pa/ rang ga so ma/ rgya gar yang ma chad/ phyogs gang du'ang ma lhung ba/ bzang ba dang ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa kun gyis ma gos pa'i dwangs sangs rig stong 'di la zer/

lhun grub ni de ltar stong bzhin du snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad go mi 'gag par kun tu snang ba'i rtsal 'gag med du 'char rung ba 'di'o// lam nyams su len pas ni/ gzhi ji bzhin nyid de lta bu las dgag sgrub med par nyams su len pa ste/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ ji bzhin nyid de ma bcos na// chen po bzhi la gnas bcas kyang*// nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du// 'di ni rnal 'byor legs pa'i lam// zhes gsungs te/ de dag gi nyams len ni/ rang sems byung gnas 'gro gsum mkhan po gzhi med rtsa bral du rtsad bcad/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i nyams gsum gyis mtshon te yid byed blo 'dzin gyi lta ba thams cad kyi phugs gtib la/ rang gshis 'di bzo med gnyer med/ gshis ci yang ma yin pa gdangs gang du'ang ma grub cing 'gag pa med/ gtad med du sang nge/ rjed med du khrol le bar rtogs pa ni/ ka dag tu khregs chod pa zhes bya ste phyag chen pa dang khyad med do// mngon gsum snying tig man ngag bsgom par 'dod pas kyang*/ ka dag gi gdeng dang mi ldan na/ lam gol bar gsungs pas/ thog mar ka dag gi don la yid ches par bya ba gal che ste/ rdzogs chen gzhung las kyang*/ ka dag 'di la gzhi bcas nas// lhun grub nyams su blang ba ni// zhes dang*/ khregs chod 'di la gzhi bcas nas// thod rgal nyams su len pa ni// zhes gsungs pas/ de nas mngon sum thod rgal nyams su len pa ni/ lus bzhugs stangs gsum la slob dgos te/ de yang gnas ni shin tu dben la dngas shing mtho ba'i sar// skal ldan skyes bu nyams len bya ba'i gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i gnas sam ci bde bar/ dang po chos sku seng ge'i 'dug stangs ni/ lus kyi tshug la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur sar phab/ 08388863(chad)00000000 mig steng gi nam mkhar gtad/ 'di ni lus tsha shas che ba dang*/ gnas rong khung lta bur nyams su len na shis so// gnyis pa longs sku glang chen lta bu'i bzhugs stangs ni/

lus kha sbub nas pus brang sbyar/ lag sor gyis 'gram nas btegs/ 'jing pa cung zad bteg /mig nam mkhar zur gyis blta'o// 'di ni lus tsha grang snyoms pa dang*/ gnas mtho dman snyoms pa las shis so// gsum pa drang srong tsog pu'i 'dug stangs ni/ rkang pa gshibs pa tsog pur byas la bsgom thag gzhug lag pa bsnol te lus bsrangs la/ mig zim bus bar snang la ba'i zer khrid do// 'di ni lus grang shas che ba dang*/ gnas mtho ba shis so// de nas ngag long gtam gyi smra ba bcad/ sems mig gi lta stangs la bcun te nyams su blangs pas/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces bya ba/ dkar phro phro ba me tog gi dra ba dra phyed lta bu/ phra ba rta rnga la mdud pa bor ba lta bu dang*/ mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed lta bu rnams mthong ba ni/ rang rig thig le nyag gcig mngon sum du mthong bas/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi lam mo// de la zhen med du bskyangs pas/ mngon sum gyi snang ba de rnams kyang phra ba dang rags pa dang*/ gsal 'tsher/ lhun sdug 'od lnga'i snang ba du mar 'char zhing*/ rdzing bur rdo bor ba'i ri mo lta bu dang*/ thig le thig phran lnga lnga sogs gya gyur snang ba kun tu 'char ba dang*/ khro bo'i sku brkyang pa dang phyed sku sogs cung zad mthong ba ni/ nyams gong 'phel lo// de yi dus lus 'khrul pa'i bya ba dang bral/ rlung sems gnas pas rnam par rtog pa'i g.yeng ba rang sar zhi ste/ tshe la bar du chod kyang*/ chos nyid bar do la nges par grol bar gsungs so// da dung nyams su blangs na/ thig le lnga ldan mu khyud rim pa du ma'i nang du/ zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa rdzogs par mthong ste/ 'di dus phyi yul gyi snang ba thams cad 'ja' 'od dag pa'i zhing khams su grol/ nang rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi zhen bral du grol/ gsang ba gzugs phung sha khrag gi gdos bcas 'di phung po 'di lus su grol bas/ logs nas rtsal 'phel ba dang*/

yangs pa dang*/ 'char du med par thag chod pa ni/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba zhes bya'o// de nas slar de nyid las mi g.yo mi 'pho ba bzhin du/ lus kyi 'byung ba rang sar dengs pas dbang yul kun kyang 'dzin med du zad/ bde sdug yod med kyi chos thams cad zad pas/ blo zad chos zad bya rgyu zad pa la/ chos nyid zad pa zhes bya ste/ lam snang ba bzhi'i gnas skabs bstan pa'o// de ltar snang gzhi 'char gzhi 'char shes thams cad rig pa ye shes kho rang nyid de/ de ni kun tu bzang po ye sangs rgyas pa dang*/ 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams sdig spyod shan pa lag dmar la khyad med du zhugs te bzang ngan med par bstan no// de ltar bzhugs pa'i rig pa de la ni pho mo med/ rgan gzhon med/ thog mtha' med/ phyogs cha med/ spangs thob med/ re dogs thams cad dang bral ba ste/ rnam pa cir shar yang*/ rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba lags so// dper na gser gyi rgyu las/ phye ma gong bu bzhu btul ji ltar byas kyang*/ rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa bzhin te/ rig pa'i ngo bo 'khrul par shar yang*/ ma 'khrul bar gnas kyang*/ rig par snang yang*/ ma rig par shar yang*/ sku dang ye shes kyi ngo bo ye thob yin te/ gang snang brtags na ngo bo stong pa ni chos sku/ de nyid 'gag med du gsal ba ni longs sku/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phris lnga lnga lnga ldan du lam me/ 'gag med thugs rje'i rtog 'gyu thal thol du shar yang rjes med rang yal du hrig ge ba ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ ye shes rnam pa lnga rang sangs rgyas kyi tshul dubazhugs so// de ltar bzhugs pa bzhin nyams su longs te 'bras bu mngon du mthar phyin pa ni/ dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i 'bras bur gsungs pa lags/ de ltar gzhi lam 'bras gsum du bsdus te/ mngon sum ye shes nyams su len tshul gyi rim pa 'di nyid kyang*/ mi dbang nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi gsung gis yang yang bskul ba la brten/

rang la lam rtags kyi yon tan cha tsam ma mchis kyang*/ bzhed pa dang sbyar te snying tig gi khrid lugs su mtshon pa lags pas thugs kyi ge sar dbus su dgyes par bstim mo// sā mā yāḥ lan gcig zhus so/ maḍ+galam/

(237)༈ gsang mchog lam gyi lo rgyus bzhugs so// lhag pa'i lhag la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes kyi 'grub sbyor bzang por/ bde chen yangs pa can gyi gzims chung 'khrul dkar mtshams mal zhig bgyis pa'i nub gcig bdag gi snying ga nas 'od zer dkar po zhig nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phros pas mod la/ nam mkha'i dbyings su'ang 'od dkar po lta bar mi bzod pa lta bu'i rab tu gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig 'dug pa'i dkyil du/ 'od mthing ga shin tu dwangs pa'i dbus ky-i cha de nyid du/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dang zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa bkra lam gyis gsal ba byung*/ de las 'phros te thugs rje chen po rigs lnga 'khor gyis bskor zhing*/ de rnams las gzhung dang sgrubs thabs ltar zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs shing gsal ba'i ngang nas/ slar yang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka nas 'od dkar po zhig bdag gi snying gar zer thag 'then pa lta bur byung ba'i sne la/ yang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i drang srong dri med dge ba/ drang srong rgan po'i cha byad can ras dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs/ rngul len/ chos gos rngul len gsol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sm-in ma dang sma ra dkar sham sham pa/ phyag g.yas chu shing 'khar ba gsum 'khyogs can brten pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pas bgrang 'phreng 'dzin cing*/ zhabs la sag lham gsol ba zhig bdag gi mdun du skad cig la byon byung zhing*/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor yang gsal bzhin pa'i ngang du 'dug cing*/ bdag gi bsam pa la 'di bzang ngan gyi rtags mtshan ci 'dra zhig yin snyam pa'i the tshom du gyur pas/ drang srong dri med dge ba na re/ ya ki'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ni/ chos sku'i sangs rgyas yin/ thugs rje chen po rigs lnga ni longs sku'i sangs rgyas yin/

bdag drang srong dri med dge ba ni sprul sku'i sangs rgyas yin pa nas/ gdul bya dus la babs pa'i chos ston du 'ongs pa yin gsung ba las/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi dkyil 'khor mchod gtor/ dbang tsag yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par/ mdun du yongs rdzogs bkra lam gyi gsal bar byung ba las/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi tshul dang*/ drang srong dri med dge bas dbang las rgyal theb dang mtshungs par byas nas/ rgyud cho ga skyed rim sgrub thabs rgyud bshad/ mgon po 'phrin las myur mgyogs lung bstan/ gzhan yang rdzogs rim mngon sum dang 'brel ba/ dbang lung rnams lha tshogs thams cad gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ khrigs chags su rim pa ltar lhag chad nor 'khrul spangs par gnang byung zhing*/ bdag gis kyang chos longs sprul sku'i lha tshogs rnams mchod pa dang tshogs kyis mnyes par byas shing*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams bdag po'i dbang dang mtshungs par rang nyid la thim pa'i snang ba byung*/ lan gc-ig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// / ༄༅/ mchog lam gsang ba'i rgyud bu chung le'u lnga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ khams gsum dus gsum phyogs gang 'gyur ba med// ma bcos gsal dag bde chen lhun gyis grub// gzhi med rtsa bral 'gag med kun snang ba// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid yangs pa'i 'khor lo'o// de nyid ngang las mi g.yo'i rang mdangs las// dag pa'i rang snang ma 'dres rig pa'i dngos// kun gsal rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i mtsho dbus su// ma chags pad+ma'i sdong bu'i khri 'phang la// bcom ldan mgon po snang ba mtha' yas sku// mnyam gzhag phyag gi pad sdong lhung bzed 'dzin// chos gos gsum ldan skyil krung mdzes par bzhugs// rigs mthun byang sems du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'bral med ting 'dzin ngang du bzhugs pa la// 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis gsol ba ni// kye ma 'gro ba'i mgon po rig pa'i rgyal// rang bzhin ma bcos khyab gdal zhing khams las// lhun grub rang snang dran shes mi g.yo zhing*// ngang nyid rtsol bral yan pa'i babs gnas na// srid dang zhi bar mi dmigs mnyam nyid ngang*// de las kun rtog rang 'od rnam lnga la// 'khrul 'dzin nga khyod bag chags las su gyur// chags sdang dbang gi 'khor 'das yul rkyen du// shar ba'i sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid// 'ching 'dzin 'khrul pa gzhig pa'i bka' rtsol cig

/gshis las mdangs shar gling gzhi'i le'u 'o// ༈ //de nas rang rig ston pas bka' stsal pa// nyon cig bde chen dag pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs// gdod nas dag pa'i 'khor 'das zhing khams su// kun snang 'char byed rang sems bde bar gshegs// byed chos spang blang bral ba'i chos 'chad cing*// rnyog bral 'dus pa'i rang snang 'khor gyis bskor// 'di ni rang byung yang dag sangs rgyas te// ma bcos byed pa med par grub mod kyang*// 'khrul 'dzin ma rig rtog pas dbyen spyos te// nga khyod dge sdig bde sdug kun bzung bas// khams gsum rigs drug srid pa'i 'khor lor shar// dbyings la 'dzin zhugs 'khrul pa'i le'u'o// ༈ //slar yang rang rig snang ba'i 'khor tshogs nyon// de ltar 'khor ba'i 'gro drug sems can rnams// dbyings kyi kun gzhi nam mkha' lta bu la// nga dang khyod kyis phyogs dang ris su phye// rang snang rang rtsal gzha' tshon lta bu la// 'di dang 'di zhes kha dog so sor gzung*// phan dang gnod pa rang grib lta bu la// gzhan du 'dzin pas chags ldang du mar snang*// de tshe bdag ni kun nas snying rjer ldan/ 'di kun 'khrul pa gzhi ru grol ba'i thabs// rang rig snang ba rang ngo sprod byed pa'i// 'dzin pa'i 'ching zhen dbyings su bral lo snyam// nyin mtshan dus drug mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin las// 'dren pa'i 'phrul pa lo ke shā ra ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi rin chen gyis brgyan pa// rab dkar rdor skyil pad zla'i gdan bcas te// bar snang nyi shar lta bur mkha' la gsal// de yi thugs sprul 'gro ba'i ded dpon ni// drang srong dri med dge ba zhes bya ba// rab dkar sma ra ring zhing thod bcings can// bzang po'i gos gyon chu shing bgrang 'phreng 'dzin// thugs rje'i bdag nyid gang de'i mdun du 'khod// chos las longs sprul sprul pa'i le'u 'o// ༈ //de nas drang srong dri med dge ba yis// 'phags pa de la 'di skad gsol ba ni// ston zla'i mdangs 'phrog rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag

/nyon mongs dri bral pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// yon tan rab rdzogs rgyan rnams kun ldan pa'i// 'phrin las phyag gis 'gro ba 'dren par bstod// rang cag sngon gyi smon lam bden pa yis// 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig ltar brtse yang*// sems can 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin nyon mongs dbang*// 'di dag thabs kyis drang ba ma yin pa// dngos kyis 'dul ba'i bsags pa ma mchis pas// 'di rnams blo bzlog lam du smin dang grol// rtsol med snying po'i ngang las 'byor ba'i thabs// 'phags pa nyid kyis bdag la bka' stsol zhig /rab gus dang bas pus btsug thal sbyar 'dud// de la 'phags pas lan du bka' bstsal pa// bdag gi sprul pa drang srong dri med dge /legs so legs so legs pa'i blo mnga' ba// drang srong chen po dri med dge ba che// sems can smin grol gdams pa bskul ba legs// de ni ngas bshad ma yengs gus par nyon// nga dang khyod la 'khrul pa yong med kyang*// 'khrul pa'i blo can 'di la dri mas sbags// mchog lam gsang ba'i bka' stsal le'u 'o// ༈ //drang srong chen po dri med dge ba nyon/ thog mar dbang thob dam sdom sgo gsum 'byor// 'dir bshad spyod sgom lta ba'i gdeng ldan zhing*// thugs rjer mnga' ba'i rdo rje slob dpon ni// rten 'brel brda thabs lam gyi phyug gyur pa// de la 'khor bas skyo zhing 'das la mos// rang bas gzhan gces 'dzin pa'i sems dpa' che// de ni bde gshegs rigs mchog sad pa ste// de ltas slob ma gcig nas stong gi bar// grangs su ma chad snying rje'i bu rnams gzung*// ngan sems bsgrub g.yel thos sgrog rnams la gsang*// don ldan 'tshogs tshe mkho ba'i yo byad ni// dkyil 'khor tshogs gtor dbang gi rdzas bshams la// mos bus gsol gdab thog mar dbang bskur ni// mi lus thob dka' mi rtag nyes dmigs dang*// las 'bras mi bslu brda dbang rnam bzhi po// gsum bskyar sngon 'gro'i dbang ste dang po'o// dngos gzhi spyod dbang ma nges brda yi tshul// lus lha ngag sngags yid kyi gnas sbyang ste// bsgom pa'i dbang gsum brda don 'phrod par bskyar// spros med kun snyoms bde chen lta ba'i dbang*// yon tan 'phrin las 'bras bu yongs rdzogs rnams// brda yi mtshon pa'i tshig rnams gsal gdab bskur// de nas khrid gdab spyod pa'i sgor zhugs te// sgo gsum mnyam pa'i dam tshig khri la 'dug

/chos sku'i ston par tshe yi dngos grub zhu// longs sku'i lha la bskyed rdzogs gdams pa zhu// sprul sku'i drang srong spyod lam kun tu bskyang*// mtha' brten rang babs lta ba'i gdeng la spyod// bdag gzhan dbyer med don dang ma ldan bar// rab 'bad gnyen pos dran pa bsrangs su gzhug /mi dang mi min gegs kyi gnod 'tshe bral// 'dir bde phyi mar byang chub thob par nges// drang srong chen po de ltar yid la zung*// smin grol bskyed rdzogs gdams pa'i le'u 'o// ༈ //de nas drang srong byang chub sems dpar bcas// rab dad dga' mgu yi rang mngon par bstod// gsang ba'i rgyud bu chung le'u lnga pa 'di// bde gshegs thugs rje'i zer las snang ba ste// lha mi 'byung po kun gyi phyag bya'i 'os// drang srong chen po nyid la legs par gtad// zhes gsung rgyud 'dir bstan pa'i smin grol rnams sna tshogs rang grol la gdams so rgya/ rgyud las bshad pa'i lung bstan logs su phyung*/// / lan gcig zhus so/ maḍ+galam/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi cho ga dang dbang gi rim pa rnams bzhugs so/ lo ki shā ra la na mo/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi sm-in byed dbang gi bya ba ni 'di ltar ro// de yang rgyud las/ thog mar dbang thob dam sdom sgo gsum 'byor// 'dir bshad spyod sgaum lta ba'i gdeng ldan zhing*// thugs rjer ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni// rten 'brel brda thabs lam gyis phyug gyur pa// zhes gsungs pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gang yang rung bas mi 'grub ste/ de yang dbang thob ces pa ni sngon gyi bsags pa rab tu gyur pas gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing*/ khyad par lam 'dir bzhugs pas dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i don so sor ngo 'phrod pa'o// dam sdom zhes pa ni gsang sngags spyi dang bye brag 'di nyid las bshad pa'i dam tshig dang*/

byang sems so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'o// sgo gsum 'byor zhes pa ni lus ngag yid thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su nges pa'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'am/ don dang ldan pa'o// spyod sgom lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa ni/ lam mchog 'dir zhugs nas/ 'di yi spyod sgom lta ba las logs su ma gol ba'o// thugs rjer ldan pa ni/ rang nyid spangs rtogs dang ldan par yang ma zad/ gzhan la sbyin pa'i mthu dang ldan pas byin gyis brlab nus pa'o// rten 'brel brda thabs lam gyis phyug pa ni/ slob ma'i rgyud smin pa dang grol ba dang rab kyi mthar phyin par byed pa la thabs kyi gdams pa du mas phyug pa ste/ yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ 'phags pa nyid kyis rjes su gzung bar rig par bya'o// gal te gong gi mtshan nyid las ring na/ chos 'di ston pa'i slob dpon du rung bar ma bshad do// de ltar gong du bstan pa'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan kyang*/ slob ma snod dang mi ldan na gdams pa sbyin par ma bshad/ rgyud las/ ngan sems bsgrub g.yel thos sgrog rnams la gsang*// zhes pas/ ngan sems ni lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa'i phyogs su gzhol ba'o// bsgrub g.yel zhes pa ni/ gang zag lta ba khengs dbang du gyur pa ste/ sgrub pa la ni mi brtson pa'o// thos sgrog ces pa ni/ gsang mi thub pa ste/ de rnams ni snod du mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid do// snod ldan gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rgyud las/ de la 'khor bas skyo zhing 'das la mos// rang bas gzhan gces 'dzin pa'i sems dpa' che// de ni bde gshegs rigs mchog sad pa ste// zhes pas/ 'khor bas skyo ba ni/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal 'du shes shing skyo ba'i rang bzhin no// 'das la mos pa ni/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i chos theg pa chen po'i don la mos pa'o// rang bas gzhan gces pa ni/ chos 'di'i khyad par gyi chos/

tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po ldan pa'o// de nas bde gshegs rigs mchog sad pa ste// zhes pa ni de lta bu'i slob ma de ni chos 'dir 'jug na/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad de rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i skyes bur shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dag ni yongs su gzung ba la bcad pa med do// rgyud las/ de lta'i slob ma gcig nas stong gi bar// grangs su ma chad snying rje'i bu rnams gzung*// zhes pas gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par/ mchod gtor dang mkho ba'i yo byad kun tshogs par bsags la/ rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa de nyid/ bde ba'i stan la kha nub tu phyogs par 'dug la/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ nang mchod mchod pa sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bsangs/ byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dus gsum gyi bde bar bshegs pa rnams dang*/ 'gro drug gi sems can rnams kyang 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnam par mdun du spyan drangs par dmigs la/ pad ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta ces sbyar la mchod/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi yang dbul/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ dus gsum bla ma bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ khams gsum 'gro drug 'phags pa'i lha tshogs la// mchod gtor rgyan gyi pū dza 'di phul bas// dgyes par bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol// zhes pa gsum gyis phul la/ badz+ra muḥ gtor 'gron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes dmigs la slar yang rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/

sogs nas spyan drangs shing mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ sku lnga lhun grub bla ma bde gshegs dang*/ khams gsum sems can yi dam lha yi sku// 'gyur med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o// dus gsum bla ma bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ khams gsum 'gro drug 'phags pa'i lha tshogs la// mchod gtor rgyan gyi pū dza 'di phul bas// dgyes par bzhes la mchog mthun dngos grub stsol// las 'khrul bag chag mi dge'i dbang gyur pa'i// dus gsum sdig pa'i las bgyis nyes pa kun// dran shes gnong 'gyod gdung ba'i yid kyis ni// yongs bshags phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca'o// srid zhi dus gsum 'dus dang 'dus ma bya// rang gzhan phan dgai rgya chen gang bsgrubs dang*// bgyid 'gyur dag dang ji snyed yod pa la// kun nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// thar bar 'dren mchog yang dag lam ston pa'i// bla ma rig 'dzin sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// yi dam zhi dang khro bo'i tshul bstan nas// gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro kun rang rig sangs rgyas ma rtogs shing*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang zhi bar ma gyur bar// gang la gang 'dul der snang skur bstan te// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba 'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge ba ni/ dus gsum bsags pa mchis pa 'dis mtshon te// myur du rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku thob nas// kun kyang yang dag sa la 'god gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod cing don yid la dran par byas te/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur par dmigs shing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ slar yang sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral te bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du/

'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bsnyen bsgrub la 'jug par bgyi'o/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥ&haṃ/ zhes chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa nyid kyi ngang las/ 'byung ba rim rtsegs ri rab bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i rwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang 'od du 'bar zhing mchog tu mdzes pa'i lte bar pad ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ yi ge hrī las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis skur gsal ba rnams 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po shel gyi mchod sdong ltar dngas shing gsal ba/ mchog tu zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar zhing*/ 'og ma gnyis chu shel gyi 'phreng ba dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i cod pan bcings shing rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zla ba'i rgyab yol mnga' ba'i/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams sogs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar spyan drangs zhing*/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod pa sogs yan lag bdun pa phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang dang gnyis su med par bsam/ slar yang snying ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ thugs rje chen po rigs lnga'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ oṃ lo ki shwa ra pañtsa ku lā sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bdud rtsi gtor mas mchod/

oṃ lo ki shwa pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wa rā a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri' ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs su brtan par byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pa sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad can gyis rgyas btab par gyur par dmigs la/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing*/ dri med kun rtogs ye shes las// dmar gsal ra ga'i 'od 'bar zhing*// mtshan dang dpe byad kun rdzogs pa// chos sku 'od dpag med phyag 'tshal// rang gdangs ma 'gags cho 'phrul las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang zhing*// zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar// thugs rje chen po'i nyid bdag rang*// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i lam snang las// ma nges cha lugs kun ldan zhing*// sprul sku'i ye shes 'chang ba po// dri med dge bas 'phrin las mdzod// ces bstod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyi mthar/ yi ge drug gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can ma lus pa thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su byas te 'od zer slar 'dus/ rlung dang bcas pa sna bug nas zhugs sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te/ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ zhes bskyed rim gsal bas mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar bzla bar bya'o// bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma/ oṃ k+ṣiṃ swā hās bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las rin po che'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i bh+ruṃ las gser gyi snod bzang*/ rin po che du mas spras pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā las grub pa'i sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ bza' bya bca' ??btung ba'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ sngags de nyid lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/

snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis tshogs zhing ltar spyan drangs la/ mchod gtor gyi sngags rgyas phul zhing*/ bstod pas bstod la badz+ra musaḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos la/ de ni sngon 'gro bdag bskyed bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ bum pa sgrub cing*/ mdun bskyed mchod pa dang dbang gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ gong du bshad pa ltar bsnyen pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa dang mi 'bral ba'i bla mas ji skad du/ dkyil 'khor tshogs gtor dbang gi las bshams la// zhes pas ji ltar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs dang ldan pas/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa der/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bsham la/ byin gyis brlabs te phul bas/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ci bde bar bgyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin te/ tshogs rten gyi lha tshogs rnams sa yi gzhi nyid du thim pas byin gyis brlab par bsam zhing*/ gzhi der chen po bzhi'i lta stangs dang*/ rkang pas bgrod te/ bdag skyed bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams sgo bzhi rnams su so so'i sa bon brjod bzhin pas me tog gi tshom bu bkram la/ mdun bskyed ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim pa la mchod pa rnams dang bstod pas bstod/ bsnyen pa cung zad kyang bya/ de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ mgon po bde bar gshegs pa dang*// bcom ldan rigs drug thub pa'i tshogs// dam can sgo ba srung mar bcas// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// rang gzhan dge tshogs bsags pa dang*// dad ldan slob ma gzhug pa dang*// mgon po khyed bsgrub dkyil 'khor phyir// 'dod don 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pa gsum gyi gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin te rten dang brten par bcas pa steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ bum pa gnyis bum rdzas dang chur bcas pa kha rgyan mgul chings su ldan pa/

dri'i dung gzungs thag tu bcas bsangs sbyangs/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngang nas/ rnam rgyal bum pa pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang sogs/ mdun bskyed ji lta bar rten dang brten par bcas pa skyed pa dang*/ las kyi bum pa e las drag po'i gzhal yas kyi khang par/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la k+ṣiṃ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad zhi bar byas tshur 'dus/ la las dpal zhing skyong nag po khro bo'i zhal can phyag gnyis pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyi brgyan zhing gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa rab tu gdengs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi gdan la 'gying ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor bdun la snang ba mtha' yas/ 'jam dpal la shwakya thub pa/ phyag rdor la mi skyod pa dang*/ zhing skyong rnams la thugs rje chen po sprul sku'i cha byad can gyi dbu brgyan pa la/ mdun bskyed ltar mchod bstod bsnyen pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ gzungs thag spos la/ oṃ k+ṣiṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ spyi khyab tu oṃ hri baṃ shud+dhe dharmā sarba pā pa ni tsa pi bi sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpanā ya hūṃ zhes/ nyer gcig bzla/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par dung chos kyi chu blug cing*/ lha rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bas/ bum chu gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes dmigs shing*/ zhing skyong nag po khyed kyis bdag cag dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma grub kyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod la/ me tog dor bum pa gnyis gnas dben par stan dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol lo// de nas thog mar las kyi thig sa dkar gyis bgos pas che chung ji ltar 'tshams pa'i thig gdab par bya ste/

thig drug spyi mthun/ rta babs snam bu bcu gcig gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam/ phyi rol pad ra rdo ra la/ cha chen gyi sum gnyis dang gcig ste me ri cha chen gcig rtsa thig nang du/ lha rnams la cha chen gcig dang*/ gru bzhir bcad pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar dang bcas pa'i thig gdab cing*/ ye thig rdul tshon so so'i thog tu bkram ste/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon rnams pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥso so'i kha dog can las 'od zer 'phros so// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rigs drug gi 'phags par rang rang gi sku mdog dwangs shing gsal ba zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur bdud rtsis sku gang chu lhag ma yar lud pas zhais pa nas rgyas btab pa la mchod bstod/ thugs kar zla ba la hrī so so'i kha dog can gyi mthar yi ge drug gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros te/ dus gsum gyi bla ma bde bar gshegs pa du ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi 'od zer du spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor sa bon la thim par gyur pa dmigs la/ snying po yi ge bcu pa 'di brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsnyen zhing brten par bya'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ 'aḥ aḥ shaḥ saḥ maḥ haḥ zhes bzla/ mchod pas mchod/ thub pa drug gi bstod pas bstod/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ thig tshon so so'i kha dog can du dmigs te/ gong bzhin chen po bzhi dang ldan pas/ phyogs kun tu ma nges par thig gdab cing*/ gtsang sar bzhag tshon gyi bri ba ni/ lte bar 'byung lnga mtshon pa'i tshon srab mor bris pa'i steng du ljang gu la zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ 'dab brgyad dkar po pad shun mdzes mtshon gyi steng*/ shar dang byang shar lho gsum dang*/ nub dang lho nub nub byang rnams su hrīḥthub pa so so'i kha dog can/ lho dang byang gi 'dab mar/ dhī dmar ser dang hūm̐ mthing nag gru chad mdzes mtshon/ lha snam shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba/

pad+ma'i ldum rdzing 'khyil bar bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ sgo bzhir rim pa bzhin/ lcags kyu/ be con/ ral gri/ dgra s+t+wa rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bri/ rtsigs pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang ba la/ 'dod snam pha khu dra phyed/ shar bu mda' yab/ rta babs glang rgyab rdo ra/ phyi khyams su rgyal srid sna bdun sogs/ pad ra rdo ra'i ra ba/ me ri rnams spyi ltar du bris zin pa dang*/ thig tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod bstod/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ thig tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang gi snying ga'i sa bon la thim par lta'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor rnams legs par grub pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa snod 'bras bu bkang ba'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ shar phyogs su bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs pa dbus dang g.yas g.yon du bsham/ de dag gi nye logs su las kyi bum pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi mthar yon chab dang mar me bdug spos zhal zas sogs lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor ba la/ gnam rgyan dang 'phan gdugs zhal yol sogs kyis legs par brgyan pa'i shar phyogs su/ stegs bu'i khar 'di nyid kyi dbang rdzas rnams tshogs par bkram la/ slob dpon nyid bde ba'i stan la ci bder 'dug pa'i mdun du'ang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bdud rtsi/ rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru sogs mkho ba'i yo byad dang ldan par byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ nang mchod dang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa bdud rtsi ltar la/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros sogs gtor mgron spyan drangs par bsam la/ skabs 'dir mchod cing 'phrin las bcol ba dang*/

tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa la/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing rang nyid la bstim sogs bdag bskyed bsnyen pa dang*/ bum pa sgrub mchod 'od zhu las bcol ba'i bar byas/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gzhan chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i ngang las/ 'gro ba drug tu gnas pa'i sems can thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes rang la gnas te/ lha thugs rje chen po gnang ba dag ma rtogs shing 'khrul ba rnams snying re rje/ de'i phyir du bdag gis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya'o// skad cig gis rang gi rig pa yi ge hrīḥdakar po 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ de las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ rnams/ sngo ljang dkar dmar ser ba'i kha dog can dang*/ sruṃ bh+ruṃ sna tshogs pa'i kha dog can 'phros te 'og nas rim pa bzhin du gnas pa las/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mthing nag gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu zla gam/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du sa yi dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du ri rab gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma srung 'khor rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan zhing*/ ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhi la gnas pa'i thog dbus phur bu'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo yi g.yas g.yon du ka ba bzhi bzhis nye bar bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/

'dod pa'i snam bu dmar po dang nang gi lha snam la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo du mas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa/ rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bad kyis tshul du bskor zhing*/ dra phyed dang shar bus nye bar brgyan pa'i mda' yab pad 'dab phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mdzes par byas pa/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa nas pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa dang*/ 'dab ma rnams 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ oṃ hūm̐ rnams rang rang gi kha dog can dang*/ sgo bzhi k+ṣiṃ sngo ser dmar ljang las so so'i phyag mtshan rnams yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ zhi ba khro bo'i tshul ji snyed pas 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i rgyab yol mnga' ba/ dbu'i gtsug ral pa'i khrod du āḥlas āḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyan du mas spras pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gis tshe bum 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i cha byad can du gsal bar gyur zhes gtso bo dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab ma gsum la/ lha dang lha ma yin dang mi yi 'phags pa dkar sngo ser ba'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa gsum na pad dkar dang g.yon pa gsum na bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi 'dab mar 'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar ser dang*/ phyag na rdo rje mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na po ti dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyab kyi 'dab ma gsum la/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song gi 'phags pa/ gnag dmar ljang gu'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gsum na/

pad dkar dang g.yon gsum na bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor zhing skyong mthing nag lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho sgor zhing skyong ser po be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub sgor zhing skyong dmar po ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang sgor zhing skyong ljang gu dgra sta dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rab tu khro zhing rngams pa'i nyams can/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs te/ bar chad 'dul ba'i las la brtson pa'o// gtso 'khor thams cad ky-i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ mthing kha/ thugs ka'i dbus rnams su rang rang gi sa bon so so'i kha dog can gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams dang zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs shing yan lag bdun sngon du 'gro bas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes pa nas dbang bskur bas 'phags pa drug la sogs/ bum bskyed ltar zhing skyong bzhi'i bar dbu rgyan par gyur zhes bsgom/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ rang rang gis ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam kyis mi khyab par gyur par dmigs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ s+pha ra na khaṃ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ ā hūm̐/

de bzhin du sbyar te shap+da'i bar du byin gyis brlabs so// hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i chu rgyun ar+ghaṃ dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod yon ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi rang byung ar+ghaṃ'i tshogs// bla ma yi dam mgon po'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes phyag rgya spyi 'gro dang sbyar te mchod yon dbul bar bya'o// hrīḥ rkang pa dang po ar+ghaṃ gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ dang*/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ lhun grub lus kyi brlan gsher chu rgyun tshogs// rkang pa bzhi pa kun la 'gre'o// pā d+yaṃ zhes dang zhabs bsil dang*/ hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i bcud rgyas puṣ+pe dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul me tog ji snyed bcas// lhun grub dbang po'i mdangs gsal bkra ba ni// bla ma yi dam= puṣ+pe zhes me tog dang*/ hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dri bsung dhū pe dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul bdug spos ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi dri ngad mchis pa kun// bla ma yi dam= dhū pe/ zhes bdug spos dang*/ hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i bkrag gsal ā lo ke /dngos 'byor yid sprul snang gsal ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi gsal byed mdangs 'phro'i tshogs// bla ma yi dam= ā lo ke= zhes mar me dang*/ hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dri ldan gan+dhe dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul dri chab ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi dri chu'i byug mchod rnams// bla ma yi dam=/ gan+dhe/ zhes dri chab dang hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i bcud ldan zhal zas dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul ro mchog ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi bza' btung mang po'i tshogs// bla ma yi dam= nai wi d+ya/ zhes zhal zas dang*/ hrīḥ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i rang sgra'i sgra brnyan dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul rol mo ji snyed bcas// lhun grub lus kyi sgra ldan rnam pa gang*// bla ma yi dam=

shap+da zhes= phyi nang gsang ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad nye bar mkho ba du mar gsal bas mchod par dmigs la/ hrīḥ bde ba'i spyod ldan gtsug lag khang dang gnas// khyams dang skyid mos tshal dang khrus kyi rdzing*// dpag bsam ljon pa'i yo byad ldan pa dag /bla ma yi dam= hrīḥ sa bla sa steng sa 'og kun spyod pa'i// rig 'dzin zhi khro rgyal ba'i dgongs sgrub gang*// dpag med mkha' dbyings yongs su bkang ba yang*// bla ma yi dam= hrīḥ 'khor lo nor bu rta glang blon po dang*// bran dang pho nya btul phod dmag gi dpung*// rin chen bdun dang nye ba'i rin chen bcas// bla ma yi dam= hrīḥ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos kyi dbyings// byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms bcas// ting 'dzin dgongs klong don gyi mchod pa yang*// bla ma yi dam= /zhes ma nges pa'i mchod tshul dang*/ bdud rts-i dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa la/ tshigs su bcad pa dang sngags kyi dbul lo// bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ dus gsum 'dren mchog rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang*// zhi khro'i skur snang yi dam lha yi tshogs// dpag med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la// rang rtsal 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod/ hrīḥ chags bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su// ye shes yongs rdzogs sku lnga gsal ba'i lha// thub chen rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug la// rang rtsal 'du 'bral= hrīḥ gdod ma'i dbyings la mchog gi skur snang ba// bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub mchog stsol ba// rang rtsal 'du 'bral med= hrīḥ nga rgyal las kyi mnar ba'i sems can la// lhag pa'i thugs rje skyobs pa'i skur snang ba// lha yi rigs 'dul bcom ldan 'phags pa la// rang rtsal 'du 'bral= hrīḥ phrag dog las kyi mnar ba'i sems can la/

lhag pa'i thugs rje= lha min rigs 'dul bcom ldan= rang rtsal 'du= hrīḥ zhen pa'i las kyi mnar ba'i= /lhag pa'i thugs rjes= mi yi= rang rtsal= hrīḥ zhe sdang las kyi mnar ba'i= lhag pa'i= dmyal ba'i= rang rtsal 'du= hrīḥ chags pa'i las= lhag pa'i thugs= yi dwags= rang rtsal= hrīḥ gti mug las= lhag pa'i= byol song= rang rtsal= ma rig rmongs 'joms byang chub lam ston phyir// blo gros snang ba'i shes bya kun ston pa// bcom ldan 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs mchog la// rang rtsal 'du 'bral= /chos dbyings zhing las ye shes skur snang ba// dregs pa kun 'dul khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku// bcom ldan 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la// rang rtsal 'du 'bral= /log lta kun sgrol sgo bzhi bsrung ba'i tshul// chen po bzhi yi ye shes skur snang bas// sprul pa'i khro rgyal 'jigs byed zhing skyong bzhir// rang rtsal 'du= dkyil 'khor phyi nang gnas pa'i lha mo ni// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mchod la brtson// dus bzhi dus med skye 'jig 'bral ba'i sku// rang rtsal= /de ltar lha tshogs rnams la bstod pa'i mthus// srid pa gsum na 'ga' yang mi gnas shing*// rang rig bde chen mchog gi klong grol nas// chams cig sangs rgyas myur du 'grub gyur cig /zhes pas bstod/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyi mthar/ sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can ma lus pa thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su byas te/ 'od zer slar 'dus shangs sbug las brgyud pa thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la phog pas g.yas skor du 'khor bar gyur/ zhes yang yang dmigs shing*/ sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ ā hūm̐ḥhrīḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥk+ṣiṃḥ zhes bzla bar bya'o// mthar mchod cing bstod de mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar bsgrub par bya'o// de ltar bsnyen pa dang bsgrubs pa'i rtags ni/

nyi ma shar ba dang*/ ri rtser phyin pa dang*/ shel gyi mchod rten la bskor ba byed pa dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mthong ba/ chos gos gsar pa gyon pa/ khang pa dang gzhal med khang gsar par phyin pa dang*/ chu la rkyal zhing/ zam la 'dzugs pa dang*/ bgrod pa/ lam 'phrang 'chos pa/ dar 'phyar zhing dung 'bud pa/ rol mo dkrol ba/ ded dpon bya ba/ rje bor bskos pa/ chos bshad pa/ khri la 'dug pa/ zas nor 'du ba/ khrom 'du ba/ dgra dang rtsod pa las rgyal ba/ shel 'phreng dang me tog rnyed pa/ phyag mtshan dang bum pa rnyed pa/ lce la me tog skyes pa/ lus las srin bu 'thor ba/ skyugs shing 'byang ba/ sna khrag lud pa/ sku dang mi dkar po rnams kyis lung ston pa rnams kyis mtshon no// nyams su yang de lta bu dang dngos su yang ci rigs su 'byung ste/ rig pa dwangs pa/ nyams bzang ba/ sems can la snying rje rang shugs su skye ba/ rgyud dul ba/ mi rnams mdun pa sogs ci rigs su 'byung bar rig pas dpyad do// gzhan yang bum chu khol zhing*/ kha rgyan la lo ma dang me tog skye ba/ bdud rtsi dang gtor ma dbyar mi rul dgun mi 'khyags pa/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa mdangs gsal zhing rdul gyis mi gos pa dang*/ zhag mang yang mi nyams pa rnams mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i rtags so// de las log pa rnams ni mi dge ba'i ltas su shes par bya'o// mtshan ltas ngan pa na/ slad nas sgos kyi sgrub pa rnams la spyad par bya zhing/ slob ma gzung bar 'os pa ma yin par shes par bya'o// mtshan ltas bzang po dag mthong ba na slob ma rjes su gzung ba ni/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang rnams mnos te/ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol zhes/ dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la yol ba'i phyir 'khod pa la/ rgyud las/ mos gus gsol btab thog mar dbang bskur ni// dal 'byor thob dka' mi rtag nyes dmigs dang*// las 'bras mi bslu brda dbang rnam bzhi po// gsum skyar sngon 'gro'i dbang ste dang po'o// zhes pas/

slob ma rnams la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi lam la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rigs lan chags la gtor ma sbyin te/ bden pa brjod la bgegs bsal ba ni/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis/ deng 'dir slob ma rnams la dbang zab mo sbyin pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi ba ling 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di sbyin pas khyer la/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mchog tu byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'gyur ba med pa'i bden pa'i bka' byung gis/ myur ba nyid du dengs shig byer shig song zhig ma chags shig ma 'phreng zhig phyis glags lta bar ma byed cig ces brjod cing*/ yi ge bcu gcig pa bzlas pa'i me tog de nyid brjod bzhin pas slob ma la gtor ro// des bsrung bar 'gyur ro// de nas yol ba'i nang du khrid mig dar me tog bcas pas bla ma dang 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug tha mi dad pa la sngon 'gro'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang mjug yon phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hrīḥ dus gsum bde gshegs sku yi dngos// bla ma 'phags pa'i sku mchog gis// bdag cag lus kyi sgrib sbyang phyir// sku yi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol// hrīḥ dus gsum= sogs 'gre/ sku zhes par gsung dang thugs zhes dang*/ bdag cag lus zhes par ngag gi dang yid kyi zhes bsgyur te lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ bla mas/ hrīḥ rang rig ye nas 'phags pa la// gnyis 'dzin 'ching bas dam dkris te// 'khor ba'i skyes bu nga la nyon// rtog 'ching dkris pa ma zhig na// 'phags pa'i rang zhal mthong dka' ste// las sad skyes bu ma gtogs pas// 'di nyid 'jug dang mthong bar dka'// de bas rigs kyi skyes bu kun// rang rig dkyil 'khor skur bsgrub phyir// lam 'di la ni 'jug spro'am// zhes lan gsum brjod/

lan gsol pa ni/ hrīḥ bla mas ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag gis ni rjes su 'jug /thugs rje chen pos nyer bzung ste// mchog lam gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol gsum du gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bsal/ de nas/ slob dpon nyid skad cig gis/ drang srong chen po dri med dge ba zhes bya ba/ drang srong rgan po'i cha byad can/ rab tu dkar zhing ring ba'i sma ra smin ma thur du 'phyang zhing*/ ral pa dkar po spyi bor bcings pa la ras dkar gyi la thod gyon pa/ rna ba dag la shel dung gi wang mig gis spras pa/ sku la sha 'gag dang thang gos/ bla gos 'og tu gsol zhing*/ ral gu dkar po dang ras dkar gyi sham thabs/ char len steng du gyon pa/ phyag gnyis chu shing gi 'khar ba dang*/ bal phreng 'dren pa'i tshul/ ngo bo 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la rnam pa de ltar gsal bar gyur pas/ 'gro drug thugs rje chen pos nye bar bskyang pa'i phyir du/ rab tu rgan pa'i tshul du snang yang*/ brtson pas bskyed de dbang gi bya ba mdzad pa bsgom la/ bla mas 'di bskad brjod par bya'o/ hrīḥ nga ni thog med bskal pa'i yang sngon nas// tshogs ma bsags shing sgrib gnyis ma spangs kyang*// rang bzhin nyid kyis btsan sar mngon phyin nas// rang shes snying rje chen po khong nas shar// 'gro rnams 'dren phyir srid 'dir snang gyur pa// bgrang gi mi lang 'on kyang cha tsam 'dir// mtshon pa'i dri med dge ba nga yin te// nga la chos sku longs sku sprul sku dang*// 'phrin las sgrub pa'i lha ni kun tshang bas// dad pas phyag byos yid kyis the tshom sol// gus pas zhabs btud kho bos thabs kyi drangs// zhes lan gsum brjod pa la/ slob mas langs nas phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ zhabs la btud de slar yang gral du 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis me long gi mthil du rtsi mar gyis brgyan pa'i steng du nas sbreng zhing 'di skad do/ hrīḥ

'phags pa'i thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag cag skyong*// skal ldan mos gus bdag gis tshig don soms// dal 'byor mi lus lon pa shin tu dkon// 'gro lnga'i skye ba 'bru yis mtshon pa ste// mi lus rin chen rtsi mar steng chags ltar// rnyed par dka' bas snying po gces par gzung*// zhes pa gsum bskyar brda don 'phrod par bya/ de nas/ yung chu sbreng zhing*/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag cag skyongs// skal ldan mos bu bdag gi tshig don soms// sngon bsags 'bras bu'i dal 'byor lus 'di yang*// yud tsam yin no rtag pa'i gdeng ma 'cha'// tshe yi rgyun ni chu 'dis mtshon pa de// lo yi grangs ma yungs kar 'bras kyis mtshon// skad cig mi sdod myur bar 'gro 'gyur bas// ngang ring blo sna bstungs ??stun la bsgrub pa gces// zhes dang*/ gro ga mer bsreg cing 'di skad do/ hriḥ'aphags pa'i thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag cag skyongs// skal ldan mos bu bdag gi tshig don soms// mkhrang 'gyur lus kyi dbang po mdangs gsal ba// gro ga me 'bar lta bur snang gyur kyang

// yun mi ring bar 'chi bdag bdud kyis nyen// glo bur me 'bar zhi ba 'di dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs brda don 'phrod par bskyar// gsum pa ni/ lha'i gzugs mer bsregs la/ hriḥ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag cag skyongs// skal ldan mos bu bdag gi tshig don soms// rnyed dka' 'jig sla mi lus 'di thob kyang*// chos sgor mi zhugs lha lus mer bsregs 'dra// mtshar sdug 'dod chags kun gyis bstod smon kyang*// phyi ma'i bde med ngan song me dong 'gro// de'i phyir 'dis mtshon mi lus chud ma zan// zhes pa gsum bskyar/ yid la nges par bshad/ bzhi pa ni/ zan gyi bya gzugs nyi ma'am mar me'i 'od la 'phyar te/ 'di skad do// hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag cag skyong*// skal ldan mos bu bdag gi tshig don soms// tshe 'dir spyad pa'i dge sdig rnam smin rnams// 'jig rten phyi ma 'phrad snyam mi srid de// dper na bya ni nam mkhar 'phur ba dang*// grib ma sa la 'char ba lhan cig tu// tshogs pa srid min snyam kyang sar babs tshe// lus kyi grib ma de ru 'dzoms pa ltar// rgyu 'bras dkar nag 'bras bu myong bzhin du// de phyir 'dis mtshon las 'bras bden par soms// zhes lan gsum go don 'phrod par bskyar zhing nges pa rnyed par bya ste dbang gi sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi ni/ ji skad du/ mtshon pa brda yi dkyil 'khor bsten// dngos gzhi spyod dbang ma nges brda yi tshul// lus lha ngag sngags yid kyi gnas sbyong ste// bsgom pa'i dbang gsum brda don 'phrod par bskyar// spros med kun snyoms bde chen lta ba'i dbang*// yon tan 'phrin las 'bras bu yongs rdzogs rnams// brda yi mtshon pa'i tshig rnams gsal gdab bskur// zhes pas/ slar yang slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus pa// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i bdag

/gang gis khyed gsung dri med ni// bdag ni snying la yang dag tshim// dal 'byor rnyed dka' de mi rtag /mi lus chud gsan nyes dmigs dang*// las 'bras grib bzhin rjes 'brang ba'i// sngon 'gro'i dbang bzhi legs par thob// de las bsgrol ba skyabs kyi mchog /spyod sgom lta bu'i brda dbang gis// bdag cag yang dag rjes gzung gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la/ bla mas las bum gyis bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis/ drang srong chen po dri med dge ba zhes bya ba/ drang srong rgyan po'i cha byad can zhes pa nas/ rab tu rgan po'i tshul du snang yang*/ thugs rjes thabs kyis drang ba'i phyir/ chen po bzhi'i ting 'dzin dang ldan par gsal ba la/ bla mas sha 'gag thogs ste/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs rje= /skal ldan mos bu= /lhan skyes lus kyi tshad ldan bgo ba la// mos brten bla ma'i gong bar rab ldan zhing*/ 'grus brtson dran pa'i phrag zor kun nas btab// gzhi la lam rdzogs rgyan dang ldan pa 'di// skal ldan bu yi bcang ba'i gos su bskur// zhes gsum bskyar zhing sbyin no// de nas thang gos thogs la 'di skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= khrel yod ngo tshar bcas pa'i bgo ba 'di// thub pa'i na bza' drang srong mchog gi gos// rang gzhan kun la khrel ldan bag yod phyir// skal ldan bu yi bcang ba'i gos su bskur// zhes gsum bskyar la sbyin no// de nas bla gos thogs la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs= /skal ldan mos bu= /ma nyams rnam par bzhis mtshon gru bzhi la// thig pa yongs rdzogs glegs bu grangs shing grub// rgyal ba'i gsung gi srad bus brgyan pa 'di// skal ldan bu yi bcang ba'i gos su bskur// zhes pa gsum bskyar zhing sbyin par bya'o// de nas ral gu bstan zhing 'di skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan mos bu= /sdug bsngal tsha grang nad las skyob byed cing*// bcos ma'i mtshon gyi ma bsgyur dri med pa// 'phags pa'i na bza' kun mkho 'di dag kyang*// skal ldan bu yi gsang ba'i gos su bskur// zhes gsum bskyar la gtad do// de nas ras sham thogs la/

hrīḥ skal ldan= /rab dkar dge ba'i lam la zhugs gyur cing*// drang srong 'phags pa'i lam 'dir 'jug pa dag /bag yod khrel ldan khyad par rtags kyi gos// bcang bar bya yi bu yis gzung bar byos// zhes gsum bskyar zhing sbyin no// de nas char len thogs la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= skal ldan= /rnam dag rang don spangs pa'i byang chub sems// kun nas dkar ba'i char bu 'di dag ni// bzod pa'i go cha brten pa'i bgo ba ste// skal ldan bu yi bcang ba'i gos su bskur// zhes pa gsum bskyar la sbyin/ de nas rma ra dang ral pa'i thor tshugs gtad la/ hrīḥ 'phags= /skal ldan= /bcos ma'i tshul khrims tshul khrims 'chal pa ste// ma bcos ma bzung ba de tshul khrims mchog /skra dang rma ra rang skyes ji bzhin du// g.yo bar mi bya rtags kyi phyag rgya bzung*// zhes pa gsum brjod gnas su gtug de nas la thod bstan la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /'di phyi kun skyob 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// 'dul byed dam chos gsang ba mchog gi lam/ mi 'bral la thod spyi bor 'ching ba bzhin// don dam mi 'pho rtags kyi rgya 'di bzung*// zhes pa gsum brjod spyi bor bcing*/ de nas shel dang dung gi wong long bstan la 'di skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /rig pa dri bral shel gyi wang mig dang*// ris med kun snyoms dung gi wang long rtags// skal ldan mos bu'i thabs shes rig pa'i brda// mi 'gyur snying po rtags kyi phyag rgya bzung*// zhes pa gsum go don 'phrod par bskyar la rna ba la brgyan pa'i tshul bya/ de nas chu shing gi 'khar ba bstan te/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /rnam dag drang po'i lam du bgrod pa la// g.yon can gom tshugs 'khyor ba'i bdud sel ba'i// chu shing ngal stegs 'khar ba 'di longs shig /bu yi mi g.yo rtags kyi rgya 'di bzung*// zhes pa gsum brjod lag pa g.yas su sbyin/

de nas bal phreng sbyin zhing 'di skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= skal ldan= zhi des dul?? gsang smra mnyen 'jam bal 'phreng 'di// 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud 'phrin las mchog gi brda// brgya dang brgyad grangs 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku// 'gyur med don gcig mdo yi rang rig mtshon// yon tan 'phrin las mchog gi rtags zung zhig /ces pa gsum brjod lag pa g.yon du btad/ de ltar cha lugs bcu gcig po ni nges med spyod pa'i dbang ngo*// gnyis pa sgom pa'i dbang ni/ chu snod nang du 'o ma blug la 'di skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan mos bu bdag gi= /rang lus ye nas 'phags pa yin mod kyang*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bzang dang ngan par bzung*// de nyid 'phags pa'i skur sgom brda dbang bshad// rang lus rang bzhin chu yi mtshon pa ltar// sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'o mas mdangs skyed ltar// rang bzhin tha dad med pa'i skur sgoms shig /zhes pa gsum bskyar mig mthong go don sprad/ de nas rlung ris kyis mtshon sngags dbang bskur// hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs= /skal ldan= /ngag gi brjod tshig gsang sngags yin pa la// ma rig 'khrul pas tha mal ngag tu gzung*// gnyis 'dzin zhen pas nges gsang mi rtogs pas// rlung sogs 'byung ba'i rang sgras nyer mtshon te// sgra grags sngags ltar chu bo'i rgyun ltar longs// de ltar gsum bskyar ngag la sngags dbang ngo*// de nas gnas sbyong don dbang sems la bskur// spra me bstan la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /rigs drug dug lnga'i sa bon spra bal rnams// 'phags pa drug gi thugs rje'i me byung ste// bsreg sbyang mngon gyur dmigs bcas mtshan ma'i dbang*// skal ldan bu yi yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /zhes gsum bskyar zhing ngo sprad sgom pa'i dbang*// de nas kun snyoms lta ba'i dbang chen ni/ me long gyen bstan dang man shel grib mar bstan la 'di skad do/

hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /'khor dang myang 'das sna tshogs chos rnams kun// rang bzhin dbyer med kun snyoms gdal ba che// phyogs dang ris med kun gsal gzhi 'dzin pa// rkyen ma 'phrad pa'i dpe 'dis shes par byos// zhes pa gsum bskyar slar yang rdzas de nyi ma'am zhu mar gyi 'od la 'phyar/ 'od la ltar gzhug pa dang yang rigs drug gi gzugs brnyan shar ba la bltar gzhag la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /de ltar kun gzhi ma bcos 'gyur med la// rtsal snang 'od du shar la zhen bral bas// 'phags pa dbang phyug 'jig rten tshoms bur snang*// rtsal snang rigs drug chags sdang sgor shar bas// 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba'i khams gsum srid par snang*// rtsa ba kun gzhi rig pa'i gnad shes nas// rtsal gang shar kyang zhen 'dzin rang sar grol// me long man shel brda 'dis rtogs par par bgyis// zhes gsum bskyar lam gyi dbang gsum mo// mthar thug yon tan 'bras bu'i brda dbang ni// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan zhing tshig don 'di lan gsum bskyar ro/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs= /skal ldan= /sngon 'gro'i dbang gis nges shes skyes pa la// dngos gzhi'i dbang gis lam gyis go ba rnyed// yang dag gdams pas rgyud smin lam goms na// lhun grub 'bras bu'i brda dbang nyams su myong*// dper na nyi dkyil rang mdangs kun gsal kyang*// der 'dzin khengs pa'i 'ching ba yongs med cing*// 'od zer sa gzhir kun nas khyab pa la'ang*// rtsol sems 'du 'phro'i g.yeng ba ma mchis ltar// lam mchog 'dir zhugs rang don nyi bzhin gsal// rtsol med shugs 'byung gzhan don 'od zer rgyas// de phyir brdas mtshon nyi mas dbang bskur ro// 'phrin las yongs rdzogs sa yi dbang bskur ni/ tshig 'di gsum bskyar sa yi dkyil 'khor bstan/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= skal ldan= dper na sa ni kun gyi brten pa'i gzhi// phun tshogs dge legs 'bad med kun 'byung ltar// 'phrin las lhun grub sa yi dkyil 'khor dang*// 'bad dang bsgrub pa'i ngal ba ma mchis par// kun la snyoms pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad// de phyir 'phrin las mtshon pa'i sa dkyil dbang*// skal ldan bu la gdams so sa ma ya// zhes pa rgyud las bshad pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// 'dir zhal gsal mi 'dug kyang*/

drang srong rang gi phyag bzhes la/ rjes gnang phran bu'i dbang 'di rnams byung ba ste/ dang po rnam rgyal dang las bum thogs te skad do/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i thugs= /skal ldan= /rnal 'byor dam skongs dngos grub mchog stsol zhing*// 'gyur med rigs brtan sdig sgrib kun dkru ba'i// rnam dag khrus kyi bum pa'i dbang 'di bskur// zhes dang*/ thig tshon lag tu gtad cing*/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /ma bcos gzhi mtshon dkar thig rang bri dang*// lam snang lnga mtshon tshon skud ye shes lnga// mtshon byed thig tshon rdzas kyi dbang bskur ro// zhes dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan mtshon pa'i bla bres yol ba/ 'phan gdugs sogs kyi ri mo gtad la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /byams chen nyon mongs tshad skyabs thugs rje'i gdugs// snying rje chen po kun snyoms bla bres dang*// dga' chen dkyil 'khor mdzes byed yol ba'i dbyibs// kun nas dbyer med btang snyoms chen po'i 'phan// 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyan gyi dbang bskur ro// zhes dang nyer spyod dang bdud rtsi gtad cing*/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= skal ldan= /dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes byed nyer spyod dang*// mchog gi dam rjas bdud rtsi ye shes bcud// skal ldan bu la gtad do mchod par gyis// zhes dang gtor ma rnams rim pa bzhin dbang bskur zhing lag tu gtad la/ hrīḥ 'phags pa'i= /skal ldan= /gtor ma'i rang bzhin ma chags stong pa che// lha ru gsal na mchog mthun dngos grub 'byung*// rdzas su mos na rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskongs// mtshon mer gsal na dgra bgegs zhi bar byed// las rnams kun byed gtor ma'i dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod pa ni/ rjes su gnang ba 'dogs pa dang bcas pa'o// de nas bla mas/ de ltar sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mam/ mtha' rten dang bzhi'i sgo nas sgrib pa 'dag cha la sbyar na lus ngag yid kyi dri ma sbyong ba/
