sbyong byed dbang la sbyor na bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo/ thob bya 'bras bu la sbyar na/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'grub par byed pa'i gsang ba mchog lam gyi smin byed dbang gi sgor zhugs nas rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig bsrung dgos te/ spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig gsang sngags spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ bye brag khyad par gyi dam tshig ni/ sngon 'gro'i dbang bzhi'i dam tshig tu/ lam sbyang ba mchog la ma goms kyi bar dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'jig sla mi lus thob kyang chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i nyes dmigs/ las 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pa rnams kyis/ dus rgyun du yid bskul ba dam tshig dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang po spyod dbang gi dam tshig tu/ gzhan dag rtags dang cha lugs nges pa dang ma nges pa gang ltar byung ba thams cad la'ang mi gshe zhing*/ rang nyid kyang gang byung gi go bas 'tsho ba dang*/ des mtshon sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i bza' bca' ji ltar 'byor ba la spang blang med par bag yod du spyod pa dam tshig gnyis pa sgom dbang gi dam tshig tu/ lus ngag yid gdeng mngon du ma gyur gyi bar/ lus lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ gzhan kyang rang nyid ltar lhar nges pa la khro 'khrugs sogs mi dge ba'i dbang du ma gyur pa/ ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo nges pas/ rten pa dang g.yo ba'i sgra skad ji snyed pa la chags sdang spang ba/ yid 'gro drug gi sems can la gnas sbyong gi gdams pa zab mos nyams su blang ba dam tshig gsum pa lta ba'i dbang gi dam tshig tu/ kun snyoms pa'i rang gzhan la phyogs ris dang mtho dman dbye bsal gyi blo spang zhing*/ yang dag gi don la mi 'da' ba dam tshig yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi dbang gi dam tshig ni/ 'bras bu bzang ngan la re dogs kyi rtsis gdab mi bya zhing*/ gsang ba mchog lam la log pa'i the tshom dang som nyi spangs te rang gzhan lam la gzud par bya ba dam tshig ni/

bzhi pa mtha' rten rjes gnang gi mtshon pa brdas mtshon pa'i dam tshig ni/ bum pa la brten nas gnas skabs kyi dngos grub blang ba dang dam tshig chag nyams bkru ba'i phyir nyams su blang ba dam tshig gi thig tshon la/ tha mal gyi rdzas su mi 'dzin pa dam tshig dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bzhi ni byams pa chen po dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ dga' ba chen po dang*/ btang snyoms chen po ste bzhi la gnas pa dam tshig phyi nang gi mchod pa ni dam tshig/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid la brnyas pa spangs te kun mchod pa dam tshig gtor ma rnams ni gnas skabs dang sbyar te dngos grub blang shes par bya ba dam tshig ste/ de ltar na khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer lnga po 'di dag bsrung ba la nan du byos shig ces brjod cing bsrung bar khas blang ba ni/ hrīḥ bla ma 'phags pas ji ltar stsal ba bzhin/ spyi dang bye brag khyad par dam tshig rnams// ma lus bdag gi bsrung bar yi dam bca'// 'gro kun bcom ldan dbang po'i sa thob shog /zhes lan gsum brjod khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bka' drin gyi yon gang 'byor ba dbul/ slob dpon gyi dgyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod cing bstod/ gnong pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ lo keshwa ra sa ma ya/ zhes sogs kyi yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes rdul tshon dang*/ bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur zhes dmigs/ dkyil 'khor gshegs shing rdul tshon 'bab chu'i 'gor bor bas/ rdul tshon gyis khyab pa'i chu 'thungs pa'i 'gro ba dag byang chub la reg par 'gyur ba'i phan yon no// las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ shis pa brjod/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// dus gzhan du/ mdun bskyed ras bris dang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa dang*/

bdag 'jug blang ba ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ltar bya ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i tshe na/ lha sta gon ltar tshom bu bkram zhing*/ mdun ltar bsgrub pa dang dbang blang bar bya'o// de dag la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar 'dod na/ mchod 'phreng gi rjes sam/ sngon 'gro'i dus sam dbang gi btang rag gi dus sam/ khrid kyi skabs su thabs shes kyi rdzas ci tshogs pa bsags la/ bdud rtsi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung zhes pa nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dmigs/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas spyan drang ba ni/ hrīḥ mi 'gyur chos dbyings rang bzhin gzhal yas las// ma hā gu ru rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs// mos gus gdung ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren gshegs// 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'bul// ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i khri mchog tu// bcom ldan thub chen 'phags pa lha yi tshogs// mos gus= /'dod yon= /bskal me dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba nas/ thugs sprul mgon po nag po 'khor gyi tshogs// mos gus gdung ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren gshegs// 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'bul// ga na tsa kra'i 'khor lo'i longs spyod kyi// thugs kyi dam bskong dam tshig nyams chag bshags// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol zhing*// 'gal rkyen dbyings su bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// zhes brjod la spyan drangs par dmigs shing*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ tshogs rdzas yi ge bcu gcig pa'i mthar ga na tsakra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes dbul zhing phud bteg la/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa gsum pa dor la/ 'og ma'i rjes su/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes sho lo ka gsum gyi rjes su 'dod don gsol ba'i sho lo ka sbyar bar bya'o// bar gyi tshogs spyi ltar longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus la bran te/

oṃ hrīḥswa hā zhes dang*/ a kā ro brjod cing byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do/ hrīḥ rgyal ba'i bka' gnyan lhag sdud chos skyong dang*// zhing skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i mgron rigs kun// phud lhag lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// lan chags bskongs shing nyams bshags 'phrin las mdzod// zhes dang*/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ga na ba ling ta khā hi zhes gsum gyis dbul lo// bshal chu yang sbyin no// dus gzhan du gtor ma bsngo bar 'dod na/ byin rlabs dang*/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams tshogs dang 'dra ba la/ tshig bar gsum gyi rjes su/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul*// zhes sbyar zhing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshig rkang pa dang po/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma yis// zhes pa'i mjug tu rkang pa gsum sbyor/ mthar tshogs gtor gyi 'gron ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur zhes dmigs/ shis pa brjod cing bsngo ba dang smon lam ni spyi dang mthun par bya'o// / gsang ngo*// gsang ba mchog lam gyi cho ga dang dbang gi rim pa rdzogs so/// / lan gcig zhus so// maṅga laṃ//

94)༈ gsang ba mchog lam gyi gtor ma'i dpe'u ris yod/ ༄༅// thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi bskyed rim 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs lnga bzhugs so/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam las/ 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa bshad par bya'o// de yang rgyud las/ chos ?mos skul ston par tshe yi dngos grub zhu// zhes pas gnas yid dang mthun par bris sku dang mchod rdzas/ sngon 'gro gnas bdag gi gtor ma dang*/ tshe'i gtor ma dpe'i chung ltar bzhengs shing*/ rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan dri zhim po'i shing*/ mgul chings dkar dmar gang rung gis brgyan pa/ thum rdzas bdud rtsi'i ril bu dang bcas pa'i chus bkang ba rnams bshams la/ stan bde bar 'dug ste skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ tshogs zhing bar las gzhung ltar bskyang zhing*/ dngos gzhi ni/ tshad med bzhi sgoms nas/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i ngang las/ ye shes 'od zer lnga'i gur khang rba klong 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ rgyu rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i bum pa zlum po mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa/ bskal pa'i me rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa'i nang tshe'i bdud rtsis bltams pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa la gnas pa'i/ yi ge āḥdakar dmar 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong mgon po'i rigs thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ snod bcud ma lus pa la tshe bsring ba'i nus mthu j-i snyed yod pa thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug āḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad brgyad cus bar nye bar spras pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng du pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga dang 'dab mas spud pa'i steng du rin po che'i lhung bzed ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing*/ sku la dar dmar ser gyi thang gos dang chos gos gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil lo krung gi bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla dkyil dkar dmar gyi dbus su āḥl sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ sa bon dang sngags 'phreng la thim zhing 'khor ba las bdud rtsi bab/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun gyi lus kyi nang thams cad gang ste/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī badz+re swāhā/ zhes ci mang bzla zhing thun mthar las byang ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams las/ mgon po snang ba mtha' yas spyan drangs la/ oṃ ā mi de ba āḥhrīḥ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bdud rtsi dbul bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par mos/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam nga rgyal dang ldan par bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas rang nyid ces pa dor la gong bzhin bskyed/ bum pa'i nang thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa bya/ bdag mdun sbrel na gtor mgron bum bskyed la dmigs la dbul/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par dmigs so// rjes shis pa brjod/ bum chu dang tshe zan longs spyad/ shis pa dang bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo// 'dis tshe'i dngos grub myur du thob pa'i ltas 'byung ngo*/ sā mā yāḥ

gnyis pa n-i rgyud las/ longs sku'i ston par mchog thun dngos grub zhu// zhes pas thugs rje chen po rigs lnga bsgrub pa ni/ longs sku thugs rje chen po zhi ba dkar por bsgrub pa dkyil chog ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad 'du bya ba dang*/ sngon 'gro tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yan 'dra ba la/ dngos gzhi ni/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'od kyi gzhal med khang zla gam du 'bar ba'i dbus su/ pad mar 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan la/ hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ de dag thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bkug nas 'dus yi ge la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ pad+ma ra ga'i mdog ltar dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mu tig dmar po'i 'phreng ba 'dren pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pad+ma'i sdong bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med rang chas kyis dbu brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba la hrīḥdamar po'i mthar yi ge brgyad kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bkug nas 'dus/ sngags sa bon dang bcas pa thim zhing 'khor bar gyur zhes yang dang yang du dmigs shing*/ oṃḥ'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥdzāḥzhes rtags ma byung gi bar 'bul/ gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs pa la bdud rtsi bran zhing*/ byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i gtor mgron spyan drangs pa la/ rtsa sngags zhabs su ba liṃ ta khā hi btags la gsum gyi rjes su/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bdud rtsis mchod/ hrīḥ rab dmar pad nyi'i gdan steng du// zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags pa'i nyams// bgrang phreng pad sdong dkur rten pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/

'dod don gsol gdab dang*/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam bkra shis smon lam spyi ltar bya'o// sa ma ya/ gsum pa thugs kyi thugs rje chen po bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ gnas khang dang mchod pa 'du bya ba sogs gong bzhin la/ gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs pa yang bsham/ khyad par yungs dkar rgyal po khro zhal la sngags nas grib can gyi lag ma brgyud pa snod gtsang mar blug pa/ dar mthing gas kha bcad pa yang nye bar bshams te/ sngon 'gro tshogs zhing dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa las gzhung ltar la/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang las 'od zer mthing kha rab tu rgyas pa'i gur khang gi dbus su pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥnag po 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rnams la phog thugs rje dang byin brlabs 'od zer nag po'i rnam par 'dus/ slar 'phros 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum dug lngas kun nas slang ba'i bgegs ris kyis nye bar 'tshe ba rnams dang nad gdon ma lus pa zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug nag po rdo rtag zil ltar gnag pa'i sku can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyi 'phreng ba dang*/ g.yon dug gi bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas nye bar brgyan pa mchog tu zhi ba'i nyams can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med rang chas su dbu la brgyan pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la/ hūm̐ nag po'i mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros skye 'gro ma lus pa la phog pas 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs su byas/ de rnams kyi dug gsum nyon mongs dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa bkug phyag g.yon gyi bum par thim par mos/ yang thun rnams 'phags pa'i skur gsal bar dmigs shing gong ltar 'od zer spro bsdu bya zhing*/

bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃḥ'aḥ.āḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥbhi tri phaṭaḥ zhes bzla bar bya'o// mthar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs yungs kar 'phags par gsal ba dbul/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/ gnag mtshar pad+ma nyi stengs su// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog gnag /bgrang phreng dug 'joms bum pa 'dzin// 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ 'daud don gsol zhing spyod lam du nga rgyal la gnas pa dang*/ shis brjod bsngo bas mjug bsdu bar bya'o/ bzhi pa yon tan gyi 'phags pa bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ gnas dben par yo byad 'du bya ba sogs sngar bzhin la gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs/ sngon 'gro tshad med bzhi yan las gzhung ltar grub nas/ rang bzhin rnam pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma ser po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje dang*/ skye 'gro ma lus pa'i shes rab kyi tshogs bsdus te sa bon la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rab tu rgyas pa'i nyams can/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyis ut+pa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin zhing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad khar kha bye ba rgyas pa'i steng du ral gri dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyal ba shākya thub pas dbu rgyan can du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ dmar ser gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas shes rab kyi tshogs bsdus te sa bon sngags 'khor la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ las nyon shes bya'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par byang zhing dag shes rab dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa mngon du thob par gyur/

oṃḥ'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥsra si hoḥ zhes bzla/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gtor mgron ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la/ sngags kyi mthar ba liṃ ta khā hi btags la dbul/ mchod pas mchod/ las gzhung ltar bstod/ 'dod don gsol zhing spyod lam du nga rgyal la gnas pas/ shis brjod dang bsngo ba bya'o// sa ma ya/ lnga pa 'phrin las kyi 'phags pa bsgrub pa ni/ gnas khang yo byad 'du bya ba sngar bzhin la/ gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs/ sngon 'gro tshad med pa bzhi yan las byang ltar byas la/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems zhi khro du ma'i byin gyis brlabs/ mthu rtsal gyi dngos grub ma lus pa bkug sa bon la thim/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing kha rab tu 'tsher ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ cung zad zhi zhing khro ba'i nyams can/ g.yas lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub kyi sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ mi bskyod pa rang chas kyi dbu la rgyan pa'i thugs kar/ nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ ma lus pa bkug sngags 'phreng la thim pas/ 'od zer mthing nag me'i tsha tsha can 'phros te/ lus kyi nad gdon ma lus pa tshar bcad/ khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus pa'i gdug rtsub zhi bar byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sa bdag klu'i gnod pa yang zhi bar byas te tshur 'dus/ rdzas la thim par dmigs la/ gu gul rgod po lhad med pa/ nam mkha' ma mthong bar sngags pas bdag gzhan gyi don byed cing*/ khyad par 'byung po sde brgyad la dri 'dul ba'i gnyen po mchog go/

hūm̐ḥ'aḥ.āḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥduḥbhiḥshaḥphaṭaḥ ces bzla bar bya'o/ thun mtshams gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gtor mgron spyan drangs/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug la ba liṃ ta khā hi btags la 'bul/ mchod cing bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ spyod lam nga rgyal la gnas pa dang*/ shis brjod bsngo bas bsdu bar bya'o// sa ma ya/ de ltar thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam las/ bskyed rim gyi chos 'phags pa sku lngar bsgrub pa'i gdams pa'o/// / sa ma yā/ maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/ ༈ mgon po 'phrin las myur mgyogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (311)'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi thugs sprul/ dpal mgon po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par 'bru nag gi tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa chos 'byung nang du bkod pa'i steng*/ gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs pa'i nang du/ las gzhi'i 'khor lo dang*/ 'og tu ling ga bting*/ sha dmar gyi rgyan dang ldan par bya'o// rang nyid thugs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma la phog yongs su gyur pa las/ dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ mgon po nag po khro bo'i cha byad can zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas/ tshogs kyi bdag po gnan pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du zhing skyong mthing nag lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lhor zhing skyong ser po be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu zhing skyong dmar po ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du zhing skyong ljang gu dgra sta dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang rab tu 'khros shing rngam pa'i nyams can/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rnams mnyam par bzhengs te/

sgrub pa po'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃ nag po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje phyed pa dbu la brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur pa las/ oṃ k+ṣiṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar dang*/ a mṛ ta bdud rtsi yang 'bul/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs brgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i k+ṣiṃ drangs te hrīḥl thim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad par gyur/ mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs ka'i nyi dkyil gyi steng du gnas pa drag tu 'khor ba/ 'phrin las gang bcol thogs med du bsgrub par bsam zhing*/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum dril ba'i snying po 'di'o// oṃ k+ṣiṃ ma hā ma dza rbad sod/ 'khor lugs zhal shes/ ling ga dgug gzhug lha dbye byas pas/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyis bsgral bar bsam zhing*/ bstod pa yang bya/ gtor ma dang bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs las gzhung ltar bya'o// bstod bskul 'dis bskyang zhing thun gtor dbul/ e ya k+ṣiṃḥ dur khrod chen po'i klaung dkyil nas/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus// thod pa'i pho brang gzhal yas na// gnas pa'i nag po mthu bo che// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bskul// drag po drag chen gnag la 'tsher// mi ro'i chas kyi sku la brgyan// dur khrod g.yang gzhi gos su gyon// thod 'phreng ka pā la 'chang zhing*// bi na ya ka zhabs kyis gnon// 'bod bskul dam bca'i 'phrin las mdzod// phyogs bzhi'i drag po zhing skyong ni// rab gtum rang rtags phyag mtshan spras// drag po'i las kyis dgra srog 'phral// 'joms byed bzhi yi dus la bab// 'bod bskul dam bca'i 'phrin las mdzod// mgon po gtso 'khor bcas pa yis// sngon gyi dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// mchod gtor ba ling 'di bzhes la// thugs dam bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod// zhes bskul lo// gtor ma 'phang*/
ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// rtags ni spyi dang mthun no// mgon po 'phrin las myur mgyogs zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/

༈ gsang ba mchog lam rdzogs rim thugs rje chen po rgyud bshad dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ 317) 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gsang ba mchog lam gyi zab mo rdzogs rim khrid kyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bya ba bstan te/ de yang rgyud las/ de nas khrid gdab spyod pa'i sgor zhugs te/ zhes pas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sngar bshad pa dag gis/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa la dbang gis smin par byas nas khrid kyi rim pa gdab par bya ste/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dang rang zhi bde don gnyer gyi bsam pa ring du dor zhing*/ dman pa'i zas dang phyag dar khrod kyi bgo bas 'tsho ba'i blo can de lta bu rnams/ sgo gsum mnyam pa'i dam tshig khri la 'dug /ces pas lus ngag yid gsum bzang ngan mtho dman spang blang re dogs mtshan 'dzin gyi blo gang gi yang dbang du mi 'phro zhing*/ 'gegs pa'i blo dang phral te/ zhag bdun dben par gnas so// des ni rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed pa'i dgos pa yod do// de nas bla mas sngon 'gror/ bcom ldan 'phags pa drug la brten te/ gnas sbyong gi dmigs pa dbog pa ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras la nges shes bskyed/ khyad par mi lus rin po che thob dus 'dir gdams pa zab mo nyams su len cing*/ btang snyoms dang le lo'i dbang du ma gyur par btson pa drag po bskyed de/ ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don bya snyams pa'i sems bskyed rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi sgo nas phyogs dang ris su ma chad par rgya bskyed/ de nas dngos gzhi rdzogs rim dngos la gnyis te/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do// dang po ni 'di lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di gang las brgyud pa dang*/ ji ltar bstsal ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyud las mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas/ mgon po ni srid pa gsum na mgon du 'os pa nyid las lhag pa gzhan ma mchis pas so// 'od mi 'gyur ba ni/

de nyid kyi rang gdangs sna tshogs su snang ba rang gi ngo bor grol te gzhan du mi g.yo ba ni mi g.yo 'am/ mi 'pho'am/ mi 'gyur ba'o// de la phyag 'tshal ba'i dgos pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du 'dud pa'o/ khams gsum dus gsum phyogs gang 'gyur ba med// ces gsungs pa ni srid pa gsum mam/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum phyogs gang du'ang mgon po de lta bu'i rang bzhin du sems can thams cad la gnas pa de 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang du gnas pa'o// ma bcos gsal dag bde chen lhun gyis grub// ces pa ni de lta bu'i rang bzhin de bcos ma ma yin zhing*/ ngo bo gsal dag rnam pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub pa'o// gzhi med rtsa bral 'khor 'das kun snang ba// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid yangs pa'i 'khor lo'o// zhes pa de ni thog mar 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsa dang bral zhing*/ kho rang gi ngo bo de las mi g.yo mi 'pho bar 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa kun snang ba de ni 'khor 'das mnyam pa'i de bzhin nyid yangs pa'i 'khor lo ste/ de bzhin nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid can no// de'i ngang las mi g.yo'i rang gdangs su// dag pa'i rang snang ma 'dres rig pa'i dngos// zhes pa ni/ de lta bu'i mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i rang gdangs las/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'khrul pa'i 'dzin pa glo bur skye 'gag tu snang ste/ dag pa'i rang ngor rig pa de dang der snang ba ni/ kun gsal rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i mtsho dbus su// zhes pa nas/ chos gos gsum ldan skyil krung mdzes par bzhugs pa'i bar te/ de lta bu'i 'dul byed ston pa'i sku dang*/ rigs mthun byang sems du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'bral med ting 'dzin ngang du bzhugs pa la// zhes bstan te/ kun gsal gyi rgya mtsho ni kun gzhi de bzhin nyid ky-i klong ngo*// de'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i sdong po chags pa med pa mtshon pa'o// bcom ldan ni nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad rang bzhin gyis bcom pa dang ldan pas so// mgon po ni gong bzhin no// snang ba mtha' yas ni rig rtsal dri ma dang bral ba ni sgo kun tu ma 'gags pa'i rang gi sku'o// mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya ni phyogs dang mtha' gang du ma lhung pa'o// de'i steng du pad sdong la gnas pa'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa ni/

chags pa mi mnga' bzhin du 'gro ba la chags pa'i tshul gyis rjes su yid 'dzin pa'i brda'o// lhung bzed ni rmongs pa'i sems can 'gro ba drug tu 'khor te sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba bzed par byed pas na de nyid bsnams pa'o// chos gos gsum dang ldan pa ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi don mtshon pa'i rtags so// skyil krung mdzes par bzhugs pa ni/ de lta bu'i skur snang ba nyid la rtog pa mi mnga' zhing*/ rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i babs tshul du bzhugs pa'i brda'o// rigs mthun du byang sems du ma'i 'khor ni/ ston pa de nyid las gnyis su snang yang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rang rtsal gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba snang ba'o// 'bral med ting 'dzin ngang du bzhugs pa ni/ phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu mi g.yo zhing*/ 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba'i ngang du bzhugs pa'o// de la 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis gsol pa ni/ kye ma zhes pa nas/ srid dang zhi bar mi gnas mnyam nyid dang*/ yan gyis gshis las gdangs shar ba rang ngo shes te/ ye thob ji bzhin par grol ba bstan/ gong du bstan pa'i rig gdangs kyi byang sems de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa'i tshul du snang ste/ kye ma zhes pa snyan par 'bod pa'o// 'gro ba'i mgon po ni gong du bstan pa ltar la/ rig pa'i rgyal po ni ma rig pa'i 'ching bas kun nas gos par ma gyur pas so// rang bzhin ma bcos khyab gdal chen po'i zhing khams ni/ kun gzhi ma bcos 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma 'gags pa de'o// lhun grub rang snang dran shes mi g.yo ba ni de yang 'du shes dang bral ba'i 'byung ba bem po mi g.yo ba chu ma 'khyoms pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rang snang gi rtsal 'char gzhi dang bcas pa'i ye shes kun rdzogs su bzhugs pa'o// ngang nyid rtsol bral yan pa babs la gnas pa ni/ de nyid kyi ngang las bya rtsol gyis 'dzin sems rtog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba yin kyang*/

sgo gar yang ma 'gags par kun nas thol byung du yan pas na/ srid zhi kun tu gsal bar snang nus pa'i de bzhin nyid de ni/ ston pa snang ba mtha' yas/ rgyud gsung ba po yang yin zhing*/ de nyan pa'i 'khor yang yin la/ gsungs pa'i chos kyang de yin zhing*/ lam du 'jug pa'i gdul bya yang de nyid kyi ngang ngo*// srid dang zhi bar mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid// ces pa ni de kho na nyid de rang bzhin chos sku bcos ma dang bral ba ste/ lta ba'i mthar thug tu bshad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de la kun rtog zhes pa nas/ 'ching 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i bka' stsol cig /ces pa'i bar gyi/ ma dag par 'khrul tshul bstan pa dang*/ de'i gnyen por ston par gsol ba btab pa'i tshul te/ ngo bo ni ston pa nyid kyi gsung dang dbyer med do// de yang*/ dang po ni/ de nyid las kun tu rtog pa'i rang 'od rnam pa mar shar ba la/ rang ngo ma shes par 'gyu byed kyi rtog pa ma rig pa'i 'khrul 'dzin de nyid du langs te/ stong pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nga dang*/ 'od la snang ba khyod du 'dzin pa'i chags sdang gi las su gyur zhing*/ 'dzin pa de nyid la kun nas zhen par a 'thas pa la brten/ chags pa dang sdang bar byas pa'i dbang gi 'khor ba dang*/ ma 'khrul ma bcos pa'i de bzhin nyid mngon du gyur pa de la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes par 'dzin pa yul rkyen gnyis su shar bar sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa can du gyur te/ srid pa'i 'khor lo 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba zhes bya ba ste/ de dag rnams kyis/ chags sdang du 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa zhig pa ste/ rang rig gi ye shes mthong ba'i thabs bka' stsol cig ces pa'o// de ltar rgyud kyi le'u dang po ni/ gshis de bzhin nyid las rang gdangs shar ba la/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i snang tshul gyi gleng gzhi'i le'ur gyur pa'i rim pa ste dang po'o// de nas rang rig pa'i ston pas dbyings kyi ngang las bka' stsal ba'i tshul ni/

nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor nyid kyi ji ltar gsol ba las brtsams te/ slar yang 'khrul ba dang ma 'khrul ba'i gnas lugs gsal bar bka' stsal ba ni/ nyon cig ces pa nas/ le'u yan gyis bstan te/ de yang nyon cig bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las g.yos te ma dag pa'i snang tshul du 'khrul ma myong ba'i dag pa'i rang snang gi 'khor gyi tshogs bdag la gus par nyon cig/ ji ltar gsol ba bzhin/ ma bcos pa'i gzhi gdod nas dag pa'i 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyer mi phyed pa'i zhing khams su/ kun nas snang zhing 'char bar byed pa po'i rang gi sems bde ba nas bar gshegs pa de ni/ bya ba dang byed pa'i chos kyi spang blang thams cad dang bral ba'i chos mi gsung ba'i gsung ba chen por 'chad cing*/ nyon mongs rtog pa'ang rnyog ma thams cad dang bral ba'i rig 'khrul 'dus pa'i rang snang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba 'di ni/ rang byung gi sangs rgyas te/ dus kun tu ma bcos shing 'byed pa med par grub mod kyang*/ de bzhin nyid la 'khrul 'dzin ma rig pa'i rtog pas glo bur skye 'gag gi tshul du dbyen bcas te/ nga khyod dge sdig gi las dang de'i 'bras bu bde sdug gi myong bar kun nas gzung bas/ khams gsum na gnas pa'i skye 'gro rigs drug srid pa'i 'khor lo shar ba'o// zhes rang byung gi sangs rgyas kun la gnas pa dang*/ dbyings de nyid la 'dzin pa zhugs te/ 'khrul pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa bshad pa'o// slar yang rang rig snang ba'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams nyon// zhes bskul te/ de ltar zhes pa nas/ le'u 'o zhes pa yan gyis bstan pa'i don ni/ de ltar srid par gnas pa'i sems can ma lus pa gdul bya'i zhing du ji ltar gzigs pa dang*/ de dag la tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos rang shar du 'khrungs pa las 'dren pa'i 'phrul pa thugs rje chen po dang*/ de'i thugs sprul drang srong dri med dge ba ji ltar byon pa'i tshul lo// de yang gong du smos pa de lta bur 'khor bar gnas pa'i 'gro drug sems can rnams la/

dbyings kyi kun gzhi sangs rgyas de nam mkha' lta bur kun nas khyab par gnas pa/ gzhi dang gdangs la rig par ma rtogs par rmongs pas/ nga dang khyod zhes rang gi phyogs dang gzhan gyi ris su phye/ de ltar snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyang snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa 'ja' tshon lta bu la/ 'di dang 'di zhes kha dog so sor gzung*/ phan pa dang gnod pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bya yi grib ma lta bu la 'di dang 'di'i ji ltar du byas zhes byed pa pos byas par bltas nas/ bzang ba la chags shing ngan pa la sdang ba du mar snang bar gyur to// de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rang byung gi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas des/ chos sku'i ston pa zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pas na bdag ni ngor snang bas/ kun nas tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po ngang gi ldan pas/ 'di ltar kun tu 'khrul pa'i sems can rang ngo ma shes pa 'di dag thabs kyi lam mang po la kha brid nas khrid kyang*/ des kyang 'chi ba las gzhan du ma mthong bas/ 'khrul ba rang gi ngo bo gzhi thog tu grol bar byed pa'i thabs 'khrul pa nyid rang gi rig pa'i snang ba'i rang rtsal du ngo sprod par byed pa'i thabs zhig bstan te/ 'di dag gi 'dzin pa'i 'ching zhen ma lus pa gzhi yi dbyings nyid du dbral bar bya'o snyams pa thugs la 'khrungs nas/ nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du de kho nyid kyi don la mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs pa las/ thugs rje'i 'od las 'dren pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ces bya ba ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gangs ri'i ngos ltar rab tu dkar ba'i sku mdog can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bcas te/ bar snang la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba lta bur mkha' la rab tu gsal bar gyur to// slar yang de nyid kyi thugs kyi sprul pa 'gro ba'i 'dren pa lam 'di sbyin pa'i ded dpon de ni/

drang srong chen po dri med dge ba bya ba/ rab tu dkar ba'i rma ra dang smin ma ral pa'i cod pan ring zhing*/ dar dkar gyi thod bcings can/ ma nges pa'i cha lugs kyi bzang po'i gos gyon pa/ chu shing gi 'khar ba dang*/ bal lu'i bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa ste lta bu'i thugs rje chen po mnga' ba'i bdag nyid can de mdun du 'khod par gyur nas/ rgyud don smin grol gdams par bcas pa bstsal ba ste/ chos sku'i ston pa snang ba mtha' yas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang*/ sprul sku drang srong dri med dge bar sprul pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// de nas drang srong dri med dge ba zhes bya ba des/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'di skad ces gsol ba ni/ ston zla'i zhes sogs kyis bstod cing*/ gsang ba mchog lam gyi gdams pa 'di yi/ smin grol gyis gdams pa ma lus pa stsol ba'i don du gsal ba btab pa ni/ thal sbyar 'dud/ ces pa yan gyis bstan te/ de yang 'phags pa'i sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'phrogs pa lta bu rab tu dkar bar mnga' ba'i chos thams cad kyi dus kun tu btsun zhing*/ sems can rnams la thugs rje chen po'i 'jug pa mnga' ba'i bdag nyid dpag tu med pa'i bskal pa du ma'i sngon rol nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba mtshon pa'i pad+ma dang*/ ma rig mun pa'i dmag rum sel ba'i brda mtshon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pa/ stobs sogs yon tan ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyan rnams kyis kun nas brgyan pa dang ldan pa/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang 'phrin las kyi phyag bzhi dang ldan pas 'gro ba ma lus pa 'dren par byed pa/ de lta bu'i 'phags pa la gus pas bstod pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bstod/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ rang cag smon lam mchog gi bden pa'i mthus/ 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig pu'i ma ltar yongs su brtse ba dang ldan yang*/

sems can rnams 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gyi nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pa/ de lta bu'i 'gro ba 'di dag rnams ni bkri ba'i thabs kyi drang ba ma gtogs pa/ dngos kyis cho 'phrul bstan kyang dngos kyis 'dul ba'i bsags pa ma mchis pas/ gang 'di rnams kyi blo log lam du khrid de/ smin par byed pa'i dbang dang*/ grol bar byed rtsol med snying po don gyi ngang la 'byor thub pa'i thabs shig 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po nyid kyis bdag la bka' stsol cig ces rab tu gus shing dang bas pus mo sar btsugs shing thal mo sbyar ste 'dud pa la/ mchog lam gsang ba gsung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa ni/ de lta bu'i drang srong gi tshul can de la 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug gis lan du bka' stsal pa/ bdag nyid kyi sprul pa drang srong chen po dri med dge ba legs so legs so// ci'i phyir na sems can thams cad la legs pa'i blo mnga' ba/ gang de rang bzhin drang por gnas te/ gzhan yon po'i blo can srong ba'i bdag nyid chen po/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma med cing*/ dus kun tu dge ba'i brtse ldan/ khyod ni legs so legs so// legs pa'i blo mnga' ba/ gong ltar drang srong chen po dri med dge ba chen po/ sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol ba'i gdams pa bskul ba legs so// dge ba'i don ngas bshad kyis ma yengs par gus pa'i yid kyis rtse gcig par nyon cig nga ni chos sku'i ston pa snang ba mtha' yas don dang mthun pa yin zhing*/ khyed kyi sprul sku'i drang srong dri med dge ba la/ nam yang 'khrul pa yongs med kyang*/ yang dag log par blta bas bcings pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can gyi blo can gang dang*/ mchog dman du 'dzin pa'i dris ma sbags par/ khyed nyid kyis ji ltar bstan pa yid la gzung la nyams su longs shig ces gdams te/ mchog lam gsang ba gsung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// de nas ston pas bka' stsal ba ni/

drang srong chen po dri med dge ba nyon// zhes pa nas smin grol bskyed rdzogs gdams pa'i le'u'o// zhes pa yan gyis smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ grol byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa bstan te/ dang po la'ang*/ rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad ji ltar 'du bya ba/ slob mas gsol ba gdab pa la/ sngon 'gro'i dbang dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dbang*/ rjes gnang phran bu logs bcas kyi dbang ji ltar bskur tshul lo// gnyis pa la chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la brten nas tshe bsgrub pa/ sku'i thugs rje chen po zhi ba dkar po la brten nas 'gro ba 'dul ba/ gsung gi thugs rje chen po dmar po la brten nas dbang du bsdu ba/ thugs rje chen po nag po la brten nas nad gdon zhi ba/ yon tan gyi thugs rje chen po ser po 'jam dpal gyi shes rab bskyed pa/ 'phrin las kyi thugs rje chen po phyag rdor la brten nas klu gdon 'dul ba ste/ bskyed rim gyi chos lnga dang*/ de las gzhung 'khrugs sdebs te/ rgyud las/ de nas khrid gdab spyod pa'i sgor zhugs te// zhes pas/ dbang dang bskyed rim gyi gdams pa rnams gong ltar nyams su blangs nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i yid ches kyi lo rgyus dang*/ dbang gi don nges shes bskyed pa'i rjes su/ sngon 'gro bcom ldan 'phags pa drug la brten nas gnas sbyong gi dmigs pa 'bogs pa ni/ rang nyid lha'i 'phags pa sku mdog dkar po pad dkar dang shel phreng bsnams pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar bsgom/ de'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ zhabs mthil rnams su yi ge drug dkar por gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lha'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems can dang*/ 'gro ba sngar yang lhar skyes pa'i las bsags pa thams cad kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu byang bar byas/ lha'i 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par rang la thim zhing*/

ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang las/ yig drug brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// lha'i 'phags pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de dang po'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid lha min thub pa sngon po pad dkar dang shel 'phreng 'dzin pa/ gzhan brgyan cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed la/ de dag gi gnas drug tu yi ge drug sngon por bsgoms pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ lha ma yin gyi rigs su gnas pa'i 'gro ba dang*/ rigs sngar yang lha ma yin du skyes pa'i las bsags pa'i rgyu 'bras thams cad byang bar byas/ lha ma yin 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par rang la thim zhing*/ ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang la yi ge drug brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// lha min 'phags pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de gnyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rang nyid mi'i thub pa ser po pad dkar dang shel 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar gsal ba/ de'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug ser por bsgoms pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ mi'i ris su gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang*/ rigs sngar yang mir skyes pa'i las bsags pa'i rgyu 'bras thams cad byang bar byas/ mi'i 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams 'od zer ser po'i rnam pas rang la thim zhing*/ ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang la yi ge drug brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// mi yi 'phags pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de gsum pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid dmyal ba'i thub pa sku mdog nag po pad dkar dang shel 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed pa'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug kha dog nag por gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ dmyal bar gnas pa'i sems can dang*/ rigs sngar yang dmyal bar skyes pa'i las bsags pa'i rgyu 'bras bu thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ dmyal ba'i 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas rang la thim zhing*/ ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang las yi ge drug pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// dmyal ba'i 'phags pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de bzhi pa'o// lnga pa ni/

rang nyid yi dwags kyi 'phags pa sku mdog dmar po pad dkar bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed pa'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ yi dwags kyi rigs su gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba sngar yang yi dwags su skyes pa'i las bsags pa'i rgyu 'bras bu thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ yi dwags kyi 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas rang la thim zhing*/ ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang las yi ge drug pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// yi dwags thub pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de lnga ba'o// drug pa ni/ rang nyid byol song gi 'phags pa sku mdog ljang gu pad dkar dang shel 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed pa'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug kha dog ljang gur gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ dud 'gro'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba sngar yang dud 'gror skyes pa'i las bsags pa'i rgyu 'bras bu ma lus pa byang zhing dag par byas/ byol song gi 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba rnams/ 'od zer ljang gu'i rnam pas rang la thim zhing*/ ma bcos mi dmigs rang babs kyi ngang las yi ge drug pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// dud 'gro'i thub pa'i gnas sbyong gi khrid de drug pa'o// de nas dngos gzhi rdzogs rim la gnyis te/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do// dang po byams pa snying rje byang chub sems gsum gsal gdab cing*/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i ngang las/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bdag bskyed gsal zhing*/ bzlas pa ji ltar rig pa bya zhing*/ 'phags pa'i sku las yid gzhan du ma yengs par bsgom mo// mthar 'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can ma lus pa thugs rje chen po'i skur gsal bar byas pa rnams kyang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/

rang nyid 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba la thim/ de yang me long la has btab pa yal ba ji ltar mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ rang bzhin gyi dbyings su bzhag go// gnyis pa ni/ lus kyi spyod lam kun drang srong gi cha lugs ltar nges med du spyod pa ni/ sprul sku'i drang srong spyod lam rgyun du spyod ces pa'i don te/ lus drang por srang zhing*/ dbang gi dam tshig las mi g.yo ba'i ngang nas/ bcos bral 'pho med bde ba chen po ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sku brjod med rang gdangs ma 'gags par rang grags ni/ thugs rje chen po ni gsung*/ 'gyu byed dran rig rtog tshogs ma lus pa ni thugs rje chen po ni thugs/ de lta bu'i rang gdangs dus kun tu gnas pa ni/ thugs rje chen po ni yon tan de dag thams cad ma lus par gsal zhing*/ 'dzin pa las 'das pa ni thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las te/ de lta bu'i rang 'babs kyi lta ba'i gdeng mngon du ma gyur gyi bar/ man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pas spyad par bya zhing*/ 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid dbyer med pa'i don 'pho 'gyur mtho dman dang bral bar 'char te/ de lta bu dang ma ldan gyi bar du/ rab tu 'bad pa'i gnyen po bzang po dang ldan pa'i dran pas bsrangs su gzhug par bya'o// de ltar zhal gyi gdams pa myong khrid ltar nyams su blangs nas/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi bgegs kyi gnod 'tshe dang bral zhing*/ rab tshe 'dir bde ba chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byas te phung po lhag med kyi 'ja' lus mngon du thob cing*/ 'bring dang tha mas bar do'am/ skye ba phyi mar byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par nges so zhes drang srong chen po de ltar yid la gzung zhig ces gdams so// skal ldan slob ma rnams smin cing grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa'i lnga pa'o// de nas drang srong dri med dge ba byang chub sems dpa' de'i 'khor du bcas pa/

rab tu dga' zhing mgu la yid rang ste/ mngon par dad par gyur to// de ltar gsang ba'i rgyud bu chung le'u lnga pa smin grol dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bde gshegs 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi thugs rje'i zer las gnang ba ste/ lha mi 'byung po bye ba du ma kun gyi phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa 'di ni/ sprul pa'i sku drang srong dri med dge ba nyid la legs par gtad do ces gsungs te gsang ba'i rgyas btab/ gsang ba'i rgyud 'dir bstan pa'i smin grol gdams par bcas pa rnams/ bdag dus mtha'i ldom bu ba/ sna tshogs rang grol bdag la ni/ dag snang du yang dag par bstsal zhing*/ snod ldan la spel ba dang*/ snod min la gsang bar gsang bar drang srong chen po nyid kyis gdams so// thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi rgyud 'grel rdzogs rim zhal gdams su bstan pa'i man ngag go// / lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/

(338)༈ rgyud kyi lung bstan bzhugs so/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis drang srong nyid la bka' stsal 'di skad do// rang gdangs sprul pa dri med dge ba che// gsang ba mchog lam rgyud kyi nye lam 'di// ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi tshe// tshe yi snyigs ma bdun cu ring mthar byed// zas kyi snyigs ma rnam smin dkor la spyod// chos kyi snyigs ma lta log grub mthas khyab// dus kyi snyigs ma mtha' mis yul dbus 'dzin// las kyi snyigs ma sdig la thub sha byed// de dus byang sems skye ba 'bri yi phyogs// sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin rnal 'byor chos kyi ming*/ seng gdong ma dngos bsod nams sgrol ma'i bu// sa khams sbrul gyi lo pa byis pa'i tshul// rme ba'i rgyan can rkang mthil 'khor lo bkra// ma nges spyod pas gdul bya'i rgyud bskul nus// phan pa'i blo can dman pa'i brtul zhugs ldan// sna tshogs rang grol de la gdams so rgya// de yi dus su mthun pa 'gal ba'i rkyen// smon lam las can 'di rnams 'byung ngo rgya// 'di nyid bstan pa'i gtso bo bya khyi'i lo// rang gi rtags 'dzin 'gro ba 'dren pa 'byung*// de dang nyid 'brel skyong ba'i srid skyong ba'i// skal ldan las can dgu la gnad 'di gdams// bi shwa de ni smon lam bden pa ste// bzang ngan ma nges 'brel pa rgya cher 'byung*// gang dang gang bcas thar par 'dren no rgya// de dang dus mtshungs byang sems skye ba dgu// rgya gar rgya nag kha che li yi yul// spu rangs zhang zhung dbus gtsang khams su 'byung*// log pa'i stobs can 'gong po dam sri ni// pho mo'i lus can bco brgyad 'byung ba ste// bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams la bar du gcod/ nga ga ra tsha ra dha dhe rna sta// pho dgu mo ni ming skad 'di la gras// sa ra sa la cha sa ga sa ma// dbus gtsang khams 'brog myang long dwags kong du// las ldan skyes bu rnams kyi yid la nges// chos 'di la ni the tshom som nyi can// kha smras nag po kha 'jam ya ga sgrog

/bstan pa'i chom po gsang ba'i ming lnga yis// sun 'byin lam 'dir mos pa de la sgrims// ces gsungs so// sa ma ya/ 'di la zhib tu phye ba yod srid na'ang*/ 'phags pa'i bka' rgyas gsang bar gdams pas smra bar mi spobs so// sa ma ya rgya/// / lan gcig zhus su/ maṅga laṃ/ (342)༈ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro'i dbang gi 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde'o/ 08388863(chad)00000000 rgya mtsho la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal te// rang gzhan smin byed dbang rim pad+ma yi// bka' yig rtsa tho ji bzhin 'dir bkod bya// de yang 'di skad ces/ gsang sngags smin grol bstan pa'i dus gnad dang*/ lo zla tshes 'phrod spang blang mtshan nyid bcas: gnas yul slob ma bzang ngan dbye ba gces: zhes 'byung bas/ de yang rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la phyi rol gyi byed sbyor gnas kyi bye brag gis kyang zil gyis mi gnon zhing byin gyis brlob pa'i thugs rje la bri gang mi mnga' yang*/ gang zag dang po'i las can yid gnyis kyi 'dzin pa can rnams kyi rtog pa bsal ba'i phyir 08388863(chad)00000000 kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa dang*/ khyad par gsang ba sngags kyi snod du rung ma rung gi slob ma brtag par bya dgos te/ khrus lung dbang gi 'phreng ba las/ dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dus: 08388863(chad)00000000 sos ka'i dus dang ston ser dus: phyi yi 'byung ba snyoms pa'i dus: lus la nad med dngas pa'i dus: sems la bde sdug med pa'i dus: mu ge 'khrug rtsod med pa'i dus: slob dpon yid snang spro ba'i dus: dbang khrid bskor ba'i dus yin no: zhes gsungs pas/ dus rnams 'dzoms pa'am/ dgun ni bsil zhing grang ba'i dus: dbyar ni brlan zhing rmugs pa'i dus: phyi yi 'byung ba mi snyoms dus: nang gi 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i dus: mu ge 'khrug rtsod dar ba'i dus:

sems la 'gro 'ong byed pa ste: dus min de dag spang bar bya: zhes pas phyi nang gi 'tshe ba dang bcas shing*/ lo dang zla ba zhag dus nag po dang*/ bsreg tshes dang bdud nyi/ 'chi sbyor dang ni mi mthun sbyor ba sogs/ gza' skar gyi 'phrod sbyor ngan pa dkar nag gi rtsis lugs bka' gter du/ grags pa rnams la bshad lugs skyon dang bral zhing*/ 'phrod dang dus sbyor bzang po la brtsam par bya'o// gang du bya ba'i gnas kyang*/ ji skad du/ gangs khrod dang ni nags khrod mtsho gling dang*// nyi ma dgun ring dkar mdangs phyed pa'i sa// g.yeng ba mi khyi sgra skad dben pa'i gnas/ ri rtse dwangs mtho mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// sprin dang ser bu khu rlangs med pa'i gnas// gtsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang sa// dad ldan gus pas dge bshes bzhugs pa'i sar// gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang khrid bskor bar bya// yon tan phun tshogs dbang gi byin rlobs 'jug /zhes gsungs pas gnas phun sum tshogs pa de rnams su brtsam par bya yis/ gzhan du na phu shor gnam ral shwa brud chus khyer sa// brad pa'i sder rjes ngus pa'i 'chi 'dra dang*// mdze yug mnol btsog grong yul g.yeng ba rnams// gnas ngan yin pas de dag spang bar bya// ces pas 'di dag tu gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba mi rung ngo*// gang phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas rnams su sngags 'chad cing nyan pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyang*/ spang blang gnyis su ste/ ji skad du/ bcud dang mi ldan slob dpon ni// rang gis mi shes gzhan la slob// rang rgyud ma smin gzhan smin 'dod// rgyud lung man ngag don ma rig /blun po ngan tshis khengs tshig ldan// gsang sngags bon gyer zab chos tshong*// rgyab rten chos byas las sdig gsog /thos chung dris la lan mi thebs// slob dpon ma brtags slob ma'i bdud// /thabs kyis mi bsten spang bar bya// zhes so// bsten par bya ba yang*/

slob dpon bcud dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rig pas gzhan go thugs rjes gzhan 'dren nus// gsang sngags zab mo'i phyi nang lag len mkhas// lta bas rang grol bsgoms pas gzhan phan thogs// spyod pas gnad grol gzhi rten 'gyur ba med// bskyed rdzogs bzlas gsum rtags dang grub pa thob// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'gro la bu ltar brtse// nyams rtogs ldan pa'i bla ma bsten par bya// zhes gsungs so// slob ma spang byar 'os pa'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ ji skad du/ snod dang mi ldan mtshan nyid ni// shes chung kha mkhas gdongs bltas che// bla ma'i bka' bcog g.yo khram byed// zas ngo las ngo drin lan 'debs// log lta skur 'debs 'dod blo can// mthar thug chos la nyams len 'chal// tshogs 'khor spyang ki dkor la 'joms// mi rigs ngan la ngang rgyud thung*// brku zhing brdzun smra rang la bstod// chos byed sgrub pa 'chal bar gtong*// slob ma ma brtag slob dpon dgra// ja shing rul pa lta bu ste// de 'dra'i slob ma bsten mi bya// zhes so// bsten du rung ba yang*/ dad dang ldan pa'i slob ma ni// dag snang dad pa shin tu che// 'dzin chags med cing chos la mos// brtson 'grus che zhing sgrub la brtson// lta ba mtho zhing spyod pa zhib// phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod// dam tshig bsrung zhing gsang sgo dam// bla ma'i bka' byung srog 'dor nus// rang don rtogs shing gzhan phan sgrubs// dpe rten mchod la srid pa che// de 'dra'i slob ma bsten par bya// zhes gsungs so// de ltar dpon slob legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gsang sngags kyi lam rim par dbang gis bgrod dgos pa la/ rtsa tho las/ sa gzhi brtag bslang sbyang zhing bsrung mtshams bcad: sa yi lha mchod khyad par snang ba gsol: lha dang bum pa slob ma sta gon bya: thig dang tshon rlobs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor ni:

/zhes dang*/ zhi ba rigs bsdus spyi sgrub la// dben zhing nyams dga'i sa phyogs su// mi dang mi min gzhi bdag la// rngan byin gnas kyi gnang ba zhu// gegs dang bral ba'i rtags mthong nas// dag pa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs// rang lhar gsal bas sa bzung zhing : bsrung ba'i 'khor los mtshams kyang bcad: dal bul sa yi lha mo la: mchod gtor phul la gsol ba btab: der ni tshom bu lhar gsal bar: mchod gtor bsnyen zhing snyan gsan dbab: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa lnga: khrus bum dang ni las bum rnams: bkrus sogs rdzas ldan chur bcas pa/ kha brgyan mgul chings mtshan gdan bcas// bsang zhing sbyangs te rigs lnga dang : rdor sems bdud rtsi 'khyil par bskyed// mchod bstod bsnyen cing chu byin rlabs: gzhan don byed na slob ma yi: sta gon bya ba gzhan nas bkang : thig mtshon byin rlabs dal la ni: dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri: rgyan dgram mchod pas mdzes par bya: zhes 'byung bas/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa de gzhi bdag gang yin pa la gsol ba'i rngan bdag ste sa blang zhing*/ der gnas pa'i mi ma yin la bdag nyid kun bzang gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtsang gtor byin gyis brlabs te bsngos la/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po'i tshogs// sa 'di bdag gis blang bgyid na// dkyil 'khor don phyir gnang bar mdzod// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// gnang ba sbyin par mos te gtor ma gshegs bsdu/ de'i tshe gzugs can dang gzugs med kyis gnang mi gnang dang dge mi dge yi mtshan ma lto phye brtag pa sogs dgos na bya zhing*/ brtags te/ btsal ba dang dge bar rigs na de nyid du brtsam zhing*/ ltas ma rungs pa mthong na gzhan du bya'o// de nas gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus slob dpon 'dug la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/

hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ mai de nī badz+ri bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi brtan par bsam/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes sa gzhi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du bsam/ de'i sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas/ bdag nyid zhi ba rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor las byang gzhung bsrangs bsnyen pa bya ba ni sa bzung ba'o// de las khro bo rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur la/ mtshams kyang bcad do// de nas dbus der tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mtha' mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor gcig bshams te bsang zhing sbyangs/ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ tshom bu de'i mdun du sa yi lha mo lus phyed thon zhing rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas khas len gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ bdag gi las ci bgyis zhes bka' nod par gyur zhes dmigs/ oṃ pri thi wi de wa sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thar+kham ut+ga te sa pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ ghṛ h+na daṃ bha ling te swā hā/ zhes pa gsum dang*/ pri thi wi de wi'i mjug tu chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bdud rtsis mchod la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ ston pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod tshul sa lam bgrod pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang gyur zhing*// dge ba'i grogs su mdzad pa ltar// bdag cag rig pa 'dzin 'khor bcas// sems can smin grol lam bstan phyir// dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par 'tshal// khyed kyis snang bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyed ci dga' bar byos shig zhes gnang ba byin te gzhi de nyid du thim par gyur/ zhes mos la mchod gtor bsdu zhing*/ gzhi de nyid lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mtha' mchod pas bskor ste/

bsang sbyangs/ mdun bskyed ji lta ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor brten dang rten par bcas par bskyed la mchod bstod bsnyen cing*/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer mos la/ rgyal ba zhi khro gtso 'khor bcas// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni che ge rdo rje 'dzin// sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan don du/ bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro yi// dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs 'tshal bas// de bas gnang ba mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol bas/ gnang ba byin te steng gi nam mkhar 'khod par dmigs tshom bu dang bcas mchod pa bsdu'o// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa lnga/ khrus bum dang las bum lnga dang bcas pa dag par bkru zhing gu gul sogs kyis bdug kha rgyan dang mgul chings kyis spras shing*/ bum rdzas dang ldan pas chus sum gnyis dgang*/ de dag gi steng rnams su thod pa mtshan ldan a mṛ ta dang bur chang sbyar ba blug cing kha kheb dang ldan par bya'o// gzhan yang me long dang man shel tsakli sogs phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar/ gtso 'khor gyi tshul du gnas ma 'chol bar bsham/ las bum khrus bum kyang shar phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon du stegs dang ldan par bgod/ dbus su rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa dkris shing*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du drangs/ mtha' mchod pas bskor te/ rgyas pa na bgegs dbral ba dang*/ kha rgyan mgul chings/ bum chu lnga tshan lnga'i sngags bzlas shing bkod par bgyis pa la 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram snyam/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis/ bum pa dang thod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bum mtshan dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhi khro'i lha khrus bum nang du pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ las bum pad nyi rgya gram gyi gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bstim sogs bya/ mchod cing bstod de/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/

bum thod kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas rgyud bskul te/ bdud rtsi bab pas bum thod khengs par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya/ mthar lha rnams bde stong du zhu nas bum chu dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs/ khrus bum gyi rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu bas dag byed kyi bdud rtsis bum pa khengs par mos shing*/ las bum la dpal khro bo'i rgyal pos 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod cing me tog dor mchod pa dang rdzas bshams pa rnams bsdu zhing*/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo// de nas slob ma sta gon bya ba ni/ snod du rung ba'i slob ma grangs ldan zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas 'khod pa la/ bgegs gtor byin skrad cing mtshams bcad/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba btab pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gsan 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor ba las sgrol phyir/ khyed kyi rjes su 'jug par bgyi// sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// gsang sngags dngos grub don gnyer na// 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa dor// pha rol la ni 'dun pa bskyed// 'di 'bras gnyer na phyi ma 'jig /phyi ma gnyer na 'di 'bras 'grub// de bas rang gzhan don bya'i phyir// bsam pa bzang po mchog la sbyor// zhes de dag gi don kyang rgyas par dkrol la bshad do// slob ma rnams kyi snying gar rang rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag me 'bar ba re rer gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin rtog bag chags thams cad bsregs te/ rig pa hūm̐ gi ngo bo gnas pa/ bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud byin gyis brlabs te gsang ba nas thon/ mdun du 'khod pa rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bsgoms zhing sdom pa bzung ba ni/

ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams// sdom pa la ni gnas pa bzhin// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa bsrung*// zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ gnas gsum dri'i thig le bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs bstim zhing*/ rol mo bsgrag brtan par bya ba'i phyir me tog kyang dor la/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ so shing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byin la mdun du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa'i dbus su kha shar du phyogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes so drud pa'i tshul gyis 'cha' zhing dor te/ rigs lnga dang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa lung bstan/ phyi rol du lhung na skyar zhing dor ro// bsrung skud lnga bsgril tshad ldan mdud pa lnga'am bcu gsum ???bsangs zhing bsngags te/ oṃ sarba bhud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa sarbaṃ swā hā/ zhes skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcing zhing las bum gyi chus mnan/ rdo rje'i rgyas gdab/ bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bsrung bar bya'o/ khrus bum gyi chu btung du gzhug cing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dhar+m+ma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ye bi shud+dha ya sarba bi skal lban a pa na ye hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum sbyin zhing 'thungs te dor bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma byang zhing dor bar bsam/ ku sha bsangs zhing*/ oṃ badz+re trik+na dhiḥ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod che chung stan dang sngas su sbyin la/ seng ge'i stabs kyis nyal bar bsgo zhing 'di skad ces/ bla ma lha la yid gtad cing*// do nub dngos grub bar chad kyi// mtshan ma gang yin gsal bar ston// sang ni ma gsang nga la smros// zhes zab rgyas kyi chos bshad cing spro ba'ang bskyed do// de nas thig mtshon byin gyis brlabs cing bri ba ni/ sngon du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i gzhi der ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug cing brkyang nul legs par byas te/

las kyi thig rdzogs par gtab pa ni/ rgyas par sgo nyis sbrag la sgo brgyan rta babs su bcas/ bsdus par na gzhal yas khang thig drug spyi mthun gcig gi dbus su/ cha chen gcig gi pad 'khor gyi lte ba dang mu khyud nang du cha bran gcig bskor/ de'i phyi cha chen gnyis kyis pad 'khor gyi rtsibs dang 'dab ma/ mu khyud cha phran gcig ni 'od zer lnga'i re kha'i khyon/ gru chad bzhi la khyams cha chen gcig sgo bzhi rta babs dang sgo khang glang rgyab mig gsum lam ghu ṇa ha ri rdo ra dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du pad+ma cha phran gnyis/ dur khrod cha chen gc-ig rdo ra cha chen phyed/ me ri cha chen gcig rnams te/ cha chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid do// de rnams legs par dbye zin nas/ rdul mtshon kha dog lnga/ dpa' bo 'bru lngas mtshan pa'i steng du/ mtshon skud so sor bkram la/ bsang zhing sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las thig skud kar po rnam snang yab yum/ sngon po mi skyod yab yum/ dmar po snang mtha' yab yum/ ljang khu don grub yab yum rnams sku rgyan gdan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ tshon rnams dkar po bud+dha he ru ka yab yum/ mthing ga badz+ra he ru ka yab yum/ ser po rat+na he ru yab yum/ dmar po pad+ma he ru ka yab yum/ ljang khu las kyi he ru ka yab yum rnams su gsal ba'i gnas rnams 'bru lngas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs thim pas dbyer med du gyur pa la mchod cing bstod la/ 'bru lnga'i bsnyen pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bya zhing*/ 'od du zhu ba las thig tshon so sor gyur par dmigs/ thabs shes mtshon pa'i rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ yongs 'joms spangs pas ye thig rim par gdab bo// de nas tshon pra brtag par 'dod na gzhan nas byung ba ltar bya/ bri ba ni/ lte ba mthing kha/ mu khyud ser/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs ljang khu'i g.yu kha/ pad 'dab dmar/ gong ras ser/

mu khyud kha dog lnga'i re kha/ sgo nyis sbrag byed na gru chad ljang*/ khyams khrag zhag gi mtsho/ rtsig pa thod skam rlon nem gsum gyi dbyibs sam/ re kha dmar ljang dkar gsum/ 'dod snam dmar po/ pha gu zhag gis byug pa'i ljang khu/ dra phyed kyi gzhi nag po la/ sgyu ma dang sbrul gyi dra phyed kyi dbyibs/ zhing chung keng rus kyi shar bu/ zhing chen thod skam gyi kha bad dang*/ gnam lcags kyi mda' yab/ sgo dang sgo khyud mun pas 'khyud cing zhing gi ka ba/ lpags pa'i ka rgyan/ rta babs sgo khang dur khrod kyi brgyan pa'i phyi rol du/ khyams nang ma gser gyi rang bzhin ser po la/ phyi ma phyogs mdog sgo sogs spyi mthun/ rta babs sgo tshad gc-ig tshad gcig la bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum stan dang bum pa char khebs la sgo tshad gcig de'i steng du bre ke bre dang*/ chos 'khor char kheb dang bcas pa la cha chen gcig pa ste/ 'og gzhi ljang*/ drwa phyogs mdog dur khrod kyi gzhi ljang khu'i nag po la/ phyogs mtshams phye bas le tshe brgyad mtshan nyid dang ldan par bri/ rdo rje rwa ba'i gzhi sngon po rdo rje ser po'am/ de nyid bsgyur ba'i me ri kha dog sna tshogs g.yas bskor du 'bar ba bri/ lha mtshan dbus su bud+dha he ru ka'i sku 'am/ 'khor lo zhi ba'i sa bon nam thig le dkar po/ shar du badz+ra he ru ka'i sku'am rdo rje thig le sngon po/ lhor rat+na he ru ka'i sku'am rin po che dang zhi ba'i sa bon nam thig le ser po/ nub tu pad+ma he ru ka'i sku'am pad+ma dang zhi ba'i sa bon/ thig le dmar po/ byang du karma he ru ka'i sku'am rgya gram dang zhi ba'i sa bon thig le ljang khu/ khyams rnams su 'od lnga'i thig le ci rigs su bri'o// dkyil 'khor gcig tu byed na/ gru chad khrag mtsho khyams phyogs mdog rtsig pa sgo brgyan phyi ma ltar la/ rta babs dang rgyan phan rnams zhi khro 'chol bar brgyan par bri/

gzhan rnams ni sngar ltar ro// rjogs par bris zin nas thig tshon dang bcas pa la lan gsum bskor/ yi ge brgya pas nyam chags bshags la nyes skyon brtag cing chad na gso/ lhag na bri/ skyon dang bral bar rig nas badz+ra muḥ thig tshon gyi ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs par mos sam/ bdag nyid la bsdu'o// de nas rgyan dgram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir mañdzi'am khri'u sogs kyi steng du sngar sgrub pa'i bum pa rnams bsham/ de rnams kyi steng du thod pa dang me long bzhi/ dar sna dang tshon skud kyi dra ba/ rtsibs brgyad ris dang bcas pa mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bya/ nang du dkyil 'khor gyi mthar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas sman raka gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ de rnams kyi phyi dar yol la sogs kyis bcad cing dar 'phan dang gdugs rgyal mtshan lda ldi la sogs dgram zhing mdzes par bya/ de dag gi bar du slob dpon slob ma'i rmi lam dri zhing bar chad kyi mtshan ma zhi ba'am/ bsnyen pa'i kha bskongs sbyin bsreg sta gon gyis kyang grub na bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyi drang du khrus bum chu rnams dang nyer spyod nang mchod rdor dril ḍā ma ru la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs shing dkyil 'khor la phyogs te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ mdun du rten dang brten par bskyed cing*/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sa chog dang lha sta gon dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbye bas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang ro gcig tu gyur par dmigs shing*/ rten 'brel gyi sngags brjod brtan bzhugs bya/ me tog dor/ de la mchod cing bstod la bsnyen cing*/ bum sgrub ltar bum pa'i bskyed chog bsnyen pa'i bar dang*/ bzhu brtul 'phrin las bcol/ dngos gzhi dbang gi bya ba la/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes tshig dbang rtsal dbang dang lnga las dang po la'ang*/ spyi dang bre brag gnyis so// de yang rtsa tho las/

de la phyi spros bcas kyi dbang la: phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas zhi khro thun mong gi dkyil 'khor la zhugs pa: bye brag tu bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas zhi ba'i bum dbang cha bcas su lus la bskur ba: thod pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas khro bo bum dbang cha bcas su lus la bskur ba'o: zhes 'byung bas/ thog mar slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang : slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ste/ nang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ phyir cha gsum gyi sgo nas gtor ma btang la nye reg byas te nang du 'ongs nas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing phyogs bzhir sngags brjod/ sgo dbye ba me tog dbul zhing phyag bya/ dbang gi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mar me gcig la gnyis 'chad du 'byung bas mdzad par mos shing*/ slob dpon khrus byas nas dbang rnams gang bskur ba bzhin bya'o// slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ de dag rnams khrus nas phyung*/ mig dar dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya sbrel/ hūm̐ sgra dang bcas pas shar sgo'i phyi rol du 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas pas/ sgo'i ging la gsol ba btab pa ni/ kye sgo ba ging chen dgongs su gsol/ khyed ni khro bo chen po'i tshul// mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i sku// bdag ni 'khor ba las sgrol phyir/ khyed kyis gnang zhing gtang du gsol// sgo bas lan btab pa/ bdag ni las kyi sgo ba ste// bka' nyan gsung sdom las mkhan yin// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug pa na// las dang skal par ldan rnams ci// zhes pa'i lan du/ kye sgo ba ging chen dgongs su gsol// bdag cag las can skal ba can// dam tshig dang ni sdom par ldan// dkyil 'khor gzhug cing dbang nod 'tshal// zhes lan btab ste/ phyi rol du phyir 'brang gi bgegs la gtor ma btang zhing zhi bas bskrad cing bka' bsgos la/

sgo phyi nas nang du 'ong ba khro bo'i 'bag gis thun 'phang zhing rol mo drag po dang bcas 'di skad ces bskul lo/ hūm̐ chos dbyings stong nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// snying rje'i rang rtsal thogs med khro bo'i sku// bka' nyan sgo srung pho nya ging gi tshogs// ral pa'i thor tshugs dar gyi chun 'phyang dang*// thod pa'i dbu rgyan dung gi rna wang can/ khro gnyer spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang sgrog /og tshom dmar ser me yi tsha tsha 'phro// shangs kyi hūm̐ sgras khams gsum zil gyis mnon// phaṭa kyi nga ros srid gsum gdug pa 'dul// drag po'i mtshon chas bar gcod dgra bgegs 'joms// mi mgo'i do shal thal ba'i mtshan mas brgyan// glang chen ko rlon zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// sbrul gyi ska rag stag gi sham thabs can// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs gdug pa 'dul// bdud zhi zil gnon skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod// deng 'dir bar chad log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// rdul du rlog cig badz+ra sa ma ya// zhes bskul zhing drag po'i tsha rngam drag tu bya/ de nas 'jug pa'i yon dbul phyag bya me tog dor te/ yol ba'i phyi rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon bla ma'am rig 'dzin gyi chas dang ldan pas shar gyi khrir gnas shing*/ rgyal thab yod na byang shar du 'khod de/ slob dpon gyis/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rigs mchog rnams/ tshe gcig lus gcig gi bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed dbang zab mo nyan pa'i gdams pa rnam par dag par skyed mdzod cig de yang gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang bla na med pa'i dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhes grags pa 'di la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po ni nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na// gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la// yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

yid ches khungs btsun brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i klong mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams na/ gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i rig stong 'phro 'gyur med pa yongs su gsal ba'i ngang gi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang gi skur bstan pa ste/ rang gi thugs rje las mi gzhan pa'i mdangs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor cha lugs du mar snang zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi mnga' bdag gsal mtsher lhun sdug gnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ lta bas chog mi shes te nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon nam me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa rnams la theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ man ngag thams cad kyi bcud gtig pa yang zab rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug cu'i bcud bsdus pa 'di byin gyis brlabs pa rtsam du gsung*/ longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa ni chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i klong na bzhugs kyang*/ ye shes kyi mkhyen pas 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te/ o rgyan gyi yul dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling gi me tog pad+ma'i sgang bu'i sbubs su rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas su sku sprul pa las/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'i tshul du skur bstan nas/ kun bzang dgongs pa'i bdud rtsi/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gdar sha gcod pa'i gdams pa/ rang rig mngon sum gcer mthong du ngo sprod cing*/ gtan la dbab pa'i gnad dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi gdams pa 'di brda tsam du bstan nas/ don gyi lung thob nas smin grol gyi nus mthu la thogs pa med pa'i rtsal dang ldan kyang rjes 'jug yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ dur khrod so sa gling du bzhugs pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro sde lngas lung bstan pa'i tshul la brten nas/

dur khrod chen po me ri 'bar bar byon te/ sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje dang mjal nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sde kun gyi snying po bcud dril ba rnams gsan/ de dag gi tshig dang don la byang zhing chub par mdzad de rdo rje gdan du byon nas bstan pa gsos/ slar za hor yul du byon nas/ lha lcam man+dha ra ba la sgrub rgyar mdzad cing*/ yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po 'di bstan pas phung po lhag med grol/ de'i dus su bod kyi yul na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par dgongs te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ bod kyi mi dang mi ma yin dregs byed thams cad dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan nas dam la btags/ bsam yas kyi sa brtul/ gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ chos 'khor mnga' gsol/ za hor dang rgya gar nas mkhas pa'i paṇa chen mang po spyan drangs pa rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus der/ rgyal pos o rgyan rin po che la 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin grub par gsol ba la/ sdig blon rnams kyis bar du bcad pa dang*/ bod 'bangs bsod nams dman cing*/ khyad par rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig gnyan pa'i che ba 'byin phyir gnas skabs su rten 'brel bshol bas/ rgyal po'i sku tshe phyir bsring tsam las 'chi med ma 'grub pas mya ngan 'das tshul bstan pa'i rjes su/ lha sras 'jings yon sad na legs mu tig btsad po rgyal srid la mnga' mdzad pa'i dus su/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag chen po'i bar khang g.yu zhal du/ o rgyan rin po che'i drung du/ rje 'bangs rnams kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i dus su ma hā ghu rus drang don gyi chos mang du gsungs shing*/

khyad par mtshan gung gi thun la/ rjes 'bangs nang blon rnams kyis tshogs 'khor bskor zhing phyag rten phul te/ gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas/ rje ma hā gu ru rin po ches dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi smin grol gyi gdams pa lung bstan/ bka' gtad dang bcas pa yongs su bstsal te/ da lta lha sras nyid rgyal po'i bya brel gyis g.yengs nas nyams su lon par ma gyur kyang*/ ma 'ongs skye ba'i chos skal du yi ger bris pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar/ o rgyan rin po che nyid dang*/ jo mo lha sras yab yum rnams kyis dung shog dkar po/ g.yu shog ljang skya/ gser shog ser po/ zangs shog dmar po/ lcags shog sngon po/ mchong shog smug po ste/ lnga ldan gyi shog bu zhes grags kyang*/ shog bu rigs drug gi ngos su/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun par rdzas kyi yi ger bris te/ mi phyed pa'i rtsis sbyar nas bam po gcig tu dril ba la dbye ba dang gsal ba'i byang sems dkar dmar dang sbyar ba'i ril bu gnyis dang bcas la/ la bse dmar po'i tshas dang ldan par gzho stod gter sgrom brag dkar gyi tshogs khang chen mo'i yang rtser/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba mchog grub kyi phug pa zhes kyang bya/ ke ru yang rdzong nam mkha'i phug zhes bya ba'i dbus kyi brag 'bur mar gter du sbas pa las/ dus la bab par spyan drangs nas lo mang zhal ma phye ba la/ gter srung rnams kyis bskul byang byung ba la brten nas rim par phab cing*/ dag pa'i snang bar yang 'di'i dbang khrid kyi rim pa rnams/ ghu ru rin po che la nod pa'i tshul nas rim par brgyud de sbyin par bya ba ni/ brgyud pa gsum dang ji ltar ldan tshul lo// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la gnyis te/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi rim pa dang*/ smin pa de grol bar byed pa khrid kyi gdams pa ngo sprod dang bcas shing sgrub pa mthar dbyung ba las rim pa'o// de la thog mar dbang bskur ba la/

gang gis bskur ba slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang la bskur ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms na gsol ba gtab cing gnang ba sbyin pa/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma'i bya ba sogs mang du yod pa la/ gang du dgos pa thams cad tshang*/ zhes sogs ci rigs su 'brel bar bshad de/ me tog bkram zhing bsdus la/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab pa ni/ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro dang*// yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong sogs// thugs rjes bdag brtser dgongs te// dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum zhu zhing slob dpon gyis/ kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug spro ba/ khyod kyi las 'khrul bag chags zad// 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob 'gyur te// zhi khro rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du// gzhug cing byin dbab dbang mchog sbyin// dngos grub sna tshogs khyod la 'byung*// zhi khro rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor dang*// bla med gsang ba'i man ngag rnams// snod min bshad na na raka ltung*// hoḥ kun bzang zhi khro ye shes lha// ye nas rang byung khyed la rdzogs// dam tshig nyams na de la sgrib// de bas dam tshig gces par bsrungs// zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag bdud rtsi sbyin la 'di skad do// 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// bu khyod la ni sbyin par bya// dam srung dngos grub sna tshogs thob// ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub// bla med theg pa'i chos rnams shes// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob// ma bsrung dmyal ba'i rgyu yin phyir// las kyi gshin rje ma rungs pa// lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgur sprul/ khyed kyi snying la gzer cing bsreg /de bas dam bsrungs chu 'di 'thung*// dam tshig srog bzhin gces par bzungs// a mṛ ta sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig

sa ma ya i dan te na rak+kan/ zhes sngags 'og ma'i rjes bzlos bya zhing 'thung ngo*// slar rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ hoḥ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// sgrub bya'i dkyil 'khor nga yin te// nga la brnyas na tshe 'phos nas/ na raka ltung ba gdon mi za// zhes dam la bzhag go /de nas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed dang sdom pa bzung ba ni/ 'di skad do// na mo/ lta ba bla med chos sku phyogs lhung bral// sgom pa bla med longs sku dmigs gtad bral// spyod pa bla med sprul sku spang blang bral// 'bras bu bla med 'khor 'das re dogs bral// bdag sogs 'gro kun sems can skyabs su mchi// zhes lan ci rigs skyabs 'gro dang*/ kyai bla ma zhi khro rigs bsdus dgongs// 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis// ma rgal bsgral ba ma grol sgrol/ dbugs dbyungs mya ngan 'das bkod pa// smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do// zhes dang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*// sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar// 'di zung byang chub ma thob bar// phar phyin drug gi lam zhugs te// log pa'i bsam pa rnams spangs pa// 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bzung*// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dam tshig tu// skyon spangs yon tan sgrub la 'bad// yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin zhing bklag /sdom bsrung log pa'i lta ba spang*// sku gsum dag pa'i dam tshig tu// stong pa zang thal dmigs med bzhag /sku dang thig le lug rgyud brten// dgag sgrub bral ba'i ngang la gnas// lta sgom spyod gsum dam tshig tu// gtad med sems kyi rang bzhin blta// yengs med dran pa'i rgyal sa bzung*// dus su bab pa'i spyod pa spyad// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dam tshig tu// 'khrul pa'i bag chags dri ma bsal// dge bcu lam gyi chos spyod 'bad// chos dang rang rgyud 'dres par bsre// rigs lnga yi ni dam tshig mchog

/rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag sbyin zhing*// theg gsum bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bzung*// gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don bya// mdor na sgo gsum dge ba bsgrub// mi dge la ni gnas mi bya// zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung ngo*// de nyid brtan zhing gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ gnas gsum du thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rdo rje gsum du mos pa bskyed do// de nas byin dbab pa ni/ slob ma rnams lus rnam snang gi chos bdun byed du bcug la/ dar cig mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ gzhi lus kun tu bzang po zhi khro dbyer med ma bskyed gsal rdzogs su bzhugs pa'i thugs kar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs bcud gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa bar med du 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa rgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams/ chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad sprin gtibs pa ltar thibs byon te rang la thim par dmigs shing*/ 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas rang lus kyang 'od du mer mer gyur pa la sems gtad de gzhan du ma yengs par gal che'o// de'i tshe bla ma dang rgyal thob kyi dbyings dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ka dag chen po'i pho brang nas// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gis byin phob cig /'og min longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas// bcom ldan rgyal ba zhing khros byin phob cig /dpal ri pad 'od sprul sku'i pho brang nas// o rgyan pad+ma yab yum byin phob cig /gar bzhugs dag pa rab 'byams zhing khams nas// bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud pas byin phob cig /08388863(chad)00000000 dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ḍā kis byin phob cig /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos byin phob cig

/dben gnas gter sgrom drag po'i gzhal yas nas// gter bdag gnyer bsrung rnams kyis byin phob cig /byin rlabs thugs rje'i na bun thibs se thib// thun mong dngos grub sbrang char si li li// mchog gi nyams rtags mtshan ma 'u ru ru// snang shes rtog pa'i yul tshogs ban ma bun// rig pa'i ye shes rjen bsal sha ra ra// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gdeng chen me re re// 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la byin phob cig /ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ sbyar ba'i spos bdug lus kyi gar sna tshogs su bsgyur/ des lus ngag yid gsum la ye shes phebs pa'i rtags mngon sum du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// ye shes de mi nyams shing brtan par bya ba ni/ ngos sprad la dran shes kyi rgyun dang ma bral bas bskyang ba la slob cing*/ dbang thams cad 'di thog tu bskur ste/ 'di ni gnad shin tu che'o// de la rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor btug cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes rdo rje gtad cing de la 'jus te lu gu rgyud kyi lag pa sbrel zhing sna drangs te/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum du byas te/ nam mkhar bltas la/ ltas brtag cing lung bstan no// me tog gi cod pan thal mo'i bar bzung la 'di skad ces/ kye ma bla ma zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// sngon nas bdag dang gnyis med kyang*// bar du ma rig rtog pas bsgribs// da lta lha dang zhal mjal phyir// 'brel pa gang yod lha dang sprod// ces man ngag dang ldan pas dor ro// pra tits+tsha ho zhes brjod/ me tog gang du phog pa'i rigs dang mthun par ming gdags te/ shar du bab na rdo rje las 'brel rtsal/ lhor rat+na/ nub pad+ma/ byang karma/ dbus su bud+dha rnams dang*/ mtshams su 'phrin las rtsal zhes gdags so// gzhan yang shar du rdo rje rig dbang rtsal zhes pa dang*/ phyogs dang dbus la gong gis 'gre'o// de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje gser thur dang bcas pas mig dar dbye ba ni/
