hoḥ ston pa zhi khro rigs lnga yis/ khyod kyi ma rig ling thog tshogs// rig pa ye shes ngang du gsal// zhi khro rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor ltos// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mig dar bsal zhing*/ gser thur gyis drud pa'i tshul bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ hoḥ ltos shig ltos shig legs par bltos/ mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni las dang skal bar ldan// dkyil 'khor 'di mthong dngos grub thob// kyai rigs kyi bu zhes bos te/ brten dang rten pa thams cad mngon rtogs ltar bstan zhing*/ de yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni mtshon byed kyi dpe las mi 'dug gi don zhi khro bde gshegs ma lus pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bzhugs shing*/ der yang ma zad rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs pa 'di nyid zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ lus ni sku/ ngag ni gsung*/ yid ni thugs kyi rang bzhin no// de las kyang mthar thug rig pa ye shes zangs thal 'di nyid ye nas zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ dbyings stong pa nyid ni zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor/ rig pa sna tshogs kyi sku khro bo khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i lha tshogs/ 'di ni gdod ma nyid nas dus kun tu dkyil zhing 'khor ba las snang srid gang yang mi 'da' ba ni/ ye rdzogs chen po'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du rig par gyis shig ces dang*/ rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bstan cing ngo sprod pa ni/ kyai rigs kyi bu rnams gzhan yang dad pa dang ldan pas rab tu nyon cig chos sku spros pa dang bral ba'i rtags su bum pa rnams zlum por snang ba'o// longs sku ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rtags su bum pa rnams kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'o// thugs rje sprul sku zhi khro 'od zer gyi tshul du yod pa'i rtags su bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa'o// rang rig 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa'o// nyon mongs lnga'i snang yul dag pa'i rtags su mgul chings kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'o// gtsang dme'i rtog pa dang bral ba bde chen ye shes su sbyor bas/

ka pā la bcud dang ldan pa'o// rang rig dri ma med ye shes mtshon pas shel dkar me long dang bcas pa'o// stong gsal mi 'gyur ba'i gdengs ldan pa'i rtags su zhi ba'i gsang snod dang bum pa bcud kyis gang ba'o/ sgrol ma bzhi ye shes kyi mig tu snang ba'i rtags su rma bya'i mdongs phod btsugs pa'o// rig pa lu gu rgyud du gnas pa'i rtags su/ tshon skud sna lnga dra ba ris su bris pa'o// mda' dar rnams ni shes rab rnam pa lnga mtshon pa'i brda'o// me long ni ye shes lngas 'gro don byed pa'i brda'o// dar sna rnams ni las rlung du sbyor ba'i brda'o/ phur pa rnams ni phyogs bcur sprul pas 'gro don rgyun chad med par byed pa'i brda'o// gri rnams ni nyon mongs rnam rtog gi gzung 'dzin gcod pa'i brda'o// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi nub par mtshon pa'i phyir du rgyal mtshan dang dar 'phan 'phyar ba'o// 'khor ba'i tshad gdung las skyabs pa'i rtags su gdugs phub pa'o// mchod tshogs dang gtor mas kun nas bkod pa 'di yang*/ 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol ba'i rtags so// nyon mongs pa'i dri ma ltar snang yang ngo bo stong pa'i rtags su 08388863(chad)00000000rol mo sna tshogs?? dang bcas pa'o// bdud bzhi zil gyis non pa'i rtags su gdan khri bkod pa dang ldan par rtsegs pa'o// dbang bskur ba po rgyal po'i gdung tshob pa'i rtags su rdo rje slob dpon rgyan dang ldan pa'o// zhes so sor ngos sprad do// de yan chad kyi zhi khro thun mong gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i las rdzogs nas/ bye brag tu bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas zhi ba'i bum dbang cha bcas su bskur ba'i tshul ni/ slob dpon la phyag yon maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ kyai ma bla ma kun tu bzang*// bde gshegs rigs lnga kun gyi dngos// gzung 'dzin sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa la/

gsal stong chig rdzogs su dbang bskur ba ni/ dbus kyi bum pa blangs la/ hūm̐ bum pa spros bral chos dbyings lte ba zlum// nang ni ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang*// mgul chings kha dog lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs*// gzungs thag thugs rje ma 'gag sprul pa'i sku// kun bzang rigs kyi bdag po kha rgyan tshul// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// rang rtsal rig pa rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sa man+ta bha tra ma hā su kha dz+nyā na ka la sha a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas snang srid thams cad gdos bcas su 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag ste rang rig pa'i rtsal du ngos shes pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig zhes dbang bskur zhing bum chu blud/ me tog thor ro// 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre shes par bya'o// slar yang bum pa de nyid dang rdor dril bsnol te dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ dbus phyogs dkar gsal me long dkyil 'khor nas// ming gzugs ngo bo bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// sangs rgyas spyan yum thabs shes gnyis med dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// gti mug rnam dag ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ḥhrīḥgasang mtshan 'bod cing a ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la dbus kyi bum pa dang rdo rje dang dril bus dbang bskur bas bdag gzhan ming gzung 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs te nyon mongs pa gti mug rang grol te me long ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig/ shar gyi bum pas dbang bskur cing*/ hūm̐ shar phyogs mthing gsal chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas// rnam shes ngo bo bcom ldan mi skyod pa// mā ma ki yum thabs shes gnyis med yum// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// zhe sdang rnam dag ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ḥhriḥ.a ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

rigs kyi bu khyod la shar gyi bum pas dbang bskur bas/ bdag gzhan gyi rnam shes su 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rang grol nas chos dbyings ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig lha'i bum pa dang dbu rgyan cod pan dang bcas pa dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐ lho phyogs ser gsal mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor nas// tshor ba'i ngo bo bcom ldan rin chen 'byung*// rat+na tā ra thabs shes gnyis med dbang*/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// nga rgyal rnam dag ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ḥhrīḥ.a ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la lho'i bum pa dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas/ bdag gzhan tshor phung du 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs te/ nyon mongs ser sna dang nga rgyal rang grol nas/ mnyam nyid ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig nub kyi bum pa dang rdo rjes dbang bskur zhing*/ hrīḥ nub phyogs dmar gsal sor rtog dkyil 'khor nas// 'du shes ngo bo bcom ldan snang mtha' yas// gos dkar mo yum thabs shes gnyis med dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'dod chags rnam dag ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.a ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la nub kyi bum pa dang rdo rjes dbang bskur bas bdag gzhan 'du shes su 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs te/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi rtog tshogs rang grol nas/ sor rtogs ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig byang gi bum pa dang dril bus dbang bskur zhing*/ āḥ byang phyogs ljang gsal bya grub dkyil 'khor nas// 'du byed ngo bo bcom ldan don yod grub// 'khor ba sgrol mdzad thabs shes gnyis med dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// phrag dog rnam dag ye shes dbang thob shog

/oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrām̐ḥ a ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la byang gi dril bus dbang bskur bas bdag gzhan 'du byed du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs te/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog rang grol nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas zhi ba rtsal rdzogs kyi lha dbang ni/ rnam snang gi sku spyi bor bskur zhing*/ oṃ ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du// mkha' khams rnam dag de bzhin rigs// bya rtsal rdzogs pa'i sa non cing*// bde gshegs sku yi dbang thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.a ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la me long ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang bskur bas/ nam mkha'i khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su nges par byas shing*/ bya rtsal rdzogs pa'i sa non nas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dbang thob par gyur cig/ zhes me tog dor ba sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// mi bskyod pa'i sku snying kar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du// chu khams mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs// 'gyur ba med pa'i sa non cing*// bde gshegs thugs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la chos dbyings ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mi bskyod pas dbang bskur bas/ chu khams rdo rje'i rigs su nges par byas shing*/ 'gyur ba med pa'i sa non nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang thob par gyur cig rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku lte bar bskur zhing*/ traṃ/ ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du// sa khams rin 'byung de bzhin gshegs// sna tshogs 'byung ba'i sa non cing*// bde gshegs yon tan dbang rdzogs shog /oṃ= ghu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang bskur bas/

sa khams rin po che'i rigs su nges par byas shing*/ yon tan sna tshogs 'byung ba'i sa non nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dbang thob par gyur cig snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hrīḥ ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du// me khams snang mtha' de bzhin gshegs// rnam par rtog pa'i sa non cing*// bde gshegs gsung gi dbang thob shog /oṃ= waka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la sor rtog ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang bskur bas/ me khams pad+ma'i rigs su nges par byas shing*/ kun tu snang ba rab tu rtogs pa'i sa non nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang thob par gyur cig don yod grub pa'i sku gsang bar bskur zhing*/ āḥ ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du// rlung khams don grub bde bar gshegs// lhun gyis grub pa'i sa non cing*// bde gshegs 'phrin las dbang thob shog /oṃ= karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la bya grub ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal don yod grub pa'i dbang bskur bas/ rlung khams las kyi rigs su nges par byas shing*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i sa non nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi dbang thob par gyur cig ces brjod/ de ltar zhi ba'i bum dbang cha bcas su rdzogs nas/ gnyis pa khro bo'i bum dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa tho las/ thod pa'i dkyil 'khor la rten nas khro bo'i bum dbang cha bcas su lus la bskur ba'oḥ zhes 'byung bas/ dbus kyi thod pa spyi bor bskur zhing ཿ hūm̐ thod pa dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du// dregs pa'i gdan la khro rgyal yab yum bzhugs// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// kun gzhi'i bag chags sgrib pa kun bral zhing*// ye shes rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog

/oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro ta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la khro bo'i bum pas dbang bskur bas/ kun gzhi bag chags dang bcas pa gnas dag ste/ ye shes ma lus pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog yang de nyid dpral bar gtad cing*/ hūm̐ dbus phyogs smug nag e yi dkyil 'khor nas// gti mug gnas gyur bud+dha he ru kaḥ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i dbang bskur bas// rig pa rang grol chen po'i dbang thob shog /oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro ta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la dbus kyi thod pas dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug gi ngo bo bud+dha he ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te/ rang rig ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur c-ig shar gyi thod pa snying kar gtad de/ hūm̐ shar phyogs mthing nag e yi dkyil 'khor nas// zhe sdang gnas gyur badz+ra he ru kaḥ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i dbang bskur bas// rig pa mtha' grol chen po'i dbang thob shog /oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro ta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la shar gyi thod pas dbang bskur bas/ nyon maungs pa zhe sdang gi ngo bo badz+ra he ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te rig pa 'gyur med du grol ba'i dbang rdzogs par gyur cig lho yi thod pa lte bar gtad/ hūm̐ lho phyogs ser nag e yi dkyil 'khor nas// nga rgyal gnas gyur rat+na he ru kaḥ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i dbang bskur bas// rig pa mnyam pa chen po'i dbang rdzogs shog /oṃ pañtsa= /rigs kyi bu khyod la lho yi thod pas dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi ngo bo rat+na he ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te/ rig pa mtha' dbus bral ba mnyam pa chen por grol ba'i dbang rdzogs par gyur cig nub kyi thod pa mgrin par gtad/ hūm̐ nub phyogs dmar nag e yi dkyil 'khor nas// 'dod chags gnas gyur pad+ma he ru kaḥ

/yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i dky-il 'khor nas// rig pa sna tshogs rol pa'i dbang rdzogs shog /oṃ pañtsa= rigs kyi bu khyod la nub kyi thod pas dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi ngo bo pad+ma he ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang sna tshogs su grol ba'i dbang rdzogs par gyur cig byang gi thod pa gsang bar gtad de/ hūm̐ byang phyogs ljang nag e yi dkyil 'khor nas// phrag dog gnas gyur karma he ru kaḥ /yab yum gnyis med rol ba'i dbang bskur bas// rig pa 'khor 'das yongs grol dbang rdzogs shog /oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro ta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la byang gi thod pa dbang bskur bas/ phrag dog gi ngo bo karma he ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te/ rig pa 'khor 'das rang grol du grol ba'i dbang rdzogs par gyur cig ces brjod cing bdud rtsi blud me tog dor/ de nas khro bo rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang ni/ bud+dha he ru ka spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ rig pa'i sku las mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan dpal chen bud+dha khro bo'i sku// thabs shes zung 'jug skye med sku yi lha// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro ta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la rigs pa'i sku dus gsum skye 'jig dang bral ba bud+dha he ru ka'i dbang bskur bas/ snang stong zung 'jug skye med sku yi dbang rdzogs par gyur cig badz+ra he ru ka snying gar ro// hūm̐ rig pa'i sku la mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra khro bo'i sku// thabs shes zung 'jug brjod med thugs kyi dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la rig pa'i sku dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa badz+ra he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ rig stong zung 'jug bsam brjod dang bral ba thugs kyi dbang rdzogs par gyur cig

rat+na he ru ka lte bar ro// hūm̐ rig pa'i sku las mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga khro bo'i sku// thabs shes zung 'jug lhun grub yon tan lha// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ pañtsa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la rig pa'i sku dus gsum lhun gyis grub pa rat+na he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ mnyam yangs lhun grub kyi dbang rdzogs par gyur cig pad+ma he ru ka mgrin par ro// hūm̐ rig pa'i sku las mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma khro bo'i sku// thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen gsung gi lha// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ pañtsa pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la rig pa'i sku gdod ma nas nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba pad+ma he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang stong pa nyid zung 'jug gsung gi dbang thob par gyur cig karma he ru ka gsang bar ro// hūm̐ rig pa'i sku las mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan dpal chen karma he ru kaḥ /thabs shes zung 'jug yongs rdzogs 'phrin las lha// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ pañtsa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyod la rig pa'i sku 'khor 'das kyi rtsal ma lus rdzogs pa karma he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ sku dang ye shes kyi mnga' thang chen po'i 'phrin las kyi dbang rdzogs par gyur cig ces sku so sor btug cing me tog dor ro// bsdus par na 'di lam gyi don ston par go zhing*/ rtsa tho las cha bcas zhes bshad 'dug pas/ zhi khro ba'i bum dbang gi cha lag tu bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad bskur na rung ngo*// rjes kyi bya ba dag pa brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu skal ba dang ldan pa khyed rnams nyan 'tshal lo// zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rdzas bum dbang bskur ba la 'khor 'das thams cad dbang gi rang bzhin du ma 'dus pa ni gang yang med cing*/

dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu yang gsum du snang ba ste/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mtshon pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ zhi khro sku yi dkyil 'khor ro// de la dpe don rtags gsum ste/ dpe ni rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid do// don ni rang la don tshang gi tshul du bzhugs so// rtags ni nyams su blangs nas mngon sum du gsal lo// de yang da lta'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni phyi dbyibs zlum zhing bsrubs med pa ste/ don chos dbyings dbye gsal dang bral ba'o// rtags ni rnal 'byor lam gyi dus dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma med pa'o// dkyil 'khor 'di'i gzhi mthing nag tu bstan pa ni dpe tsam mo// don dbyings chen rnam dag chos sku ka dag tu gnas pa'o// rtags ni dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs 'di ji bzhin pa ni bcos slad dang bral ba'o// phyi nang gi mu khyud zlum po me ris bskor ba 'di dpe tsam mo// don ni lhun grub spros pa dang bral ba la grwa zur med cing chos nyid du zlum pa'o// rtags ni thig le nyag gcig la lu gu rgyud du mthong ba 'di'o// tshon sna bkra zhing 'od du 'bar ba ni dpe tsam mo// don ni sku dang thig le 'od dang bcas gang du'ang mi gnas par 'char ro// rtags ni bar dor yang ye shes lnga'i rang 'od 'char bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis spros 'di ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur/ sku dang ye shes su lhun gyis grub nas/ rang snang ma 'gags par rang lugs su lhug par 'char ba'o// rdo rje slob dpon dang mched lcam rnams gral 'dir 'khod pa 'di ni dpe tsam mo// don ni sprul pa sku'i zhing khams theg pa dang sa lam thams cad rdzogs nas rtag par rgyun gyi chos 'khor bskor ba ni/ skad cig tu'ang tshang ba'o// rtags ni 'khor ba'i chos la mi zhen cing mi 'dzin/ chos nyid zab mo las blo mi ldog

gang shar gyi ngo bo la gnyen po dang bral ba'i gcog bzhag rang grol 'di kho na'o// zhi khro'i dbang zhes bya ba 'di ming tsam dpe tsam brda' tsam du bstan pa yin te/ bla mas dbang bskur zhing ngo 'phrod pa ni dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa'o// de ltar don dang mi ldan pa ni ma bsangs kyang rang gsang chen po nyid yin te/ dbang bskur kyang smin pa dka'o// de ltar phyi rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum dbang cha bcas su bskur bas/ lus rtsa'i sgrib pa dag lam zhi khro'i bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ sku'i dam tshig ma lus par bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byed do// ces don bshad cing*/ btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa tho las/ spros med kyi dbang la: dkar gsum mngar gsum la brten nas gsang dbang : byang sems thod pa'i bdud rtsi la brten nas khro bo'i gsang dbang ngag la bskur thabs so: zhes 'byung bas/ dus ni nam srod dam gung gi thun la bab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su nya phyis sam dung chos la sogs kyi snod dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar te dgang zhing kha khebs dgab/ de'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan du chang la a mṛ ta dang byang sems ril bu sogs/ thabs shes kyi rdzas rang byung gi bcud mngar gyis bran nas bkang zhing*/ zhal bkab tshogs kyi yo byad dang mchod pa gsar du bsham zhing*/ gsang rdzas gnyis las byang ltar zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed cing bsnyen pa yan grub nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing ???dbang nod/ slob ma zhugs pa ni/ gong du bum dbang gi smin cing bskyed rim la dbang 'byor ba'i bu rnams khrus nas dbyung la/ spros med gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dngos sam yid las byung ba'i rig ma dang mtshan nyid dang ldan par dmigs te dbul zhing*/ kyai hoḥ bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du// spros med gsang ba'i dbang rten phyag rgya ni// bud+dha rin chen pad+ma las// phar phyin drug ldan gsang yum rigs ma dbul// zhes dbul bar dmigs shing*/

me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma khyod ni bde ba che// bde chen zhi khro rigs bsdus lha// bde gshegs rnams kyi bde chen po// bdag cag rnams la rab bshad 'tshal// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la/ bla mas/ kyai hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon// gsang sngags gsang ba'i dbang mchog ni// u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// yang yang 'byung ba dka' bas na// snod dang mi ldan gnyis ka phung*// de bas dam tshig thub par bsrungs// zhes bsgos la/ lce la bdud rtsi reg cing*/ hūm̐ gsang ba dam tshig srog gi chu/ khyod la sbyin gyi dam 'das na// lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pas// skal par lus sems mnar bar byed// sa ma ya i den te// zhes brjod pa la/ slob mas/ sa ma ya i ya shi tham/ zhes khas blang*/ de nas slob bu gdong dar gyis bcings shing*/ lus klod ngag gdams sems gzhan du mi yengs pa bzhag dpon slob thams cad gzhi lus kun tu bzang po mthing kha gcer bu rgyan med zhal gcig phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dpang du/ rig ma kun tu bzang mo dkar mo gcer bu rgyan med/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mgul dang*/ sked du 'khril zhing yab yum bde ba chen po'i nyams dang ldan pa'i dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar pad zla'i gdan la sku rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la gsung rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar pad+ma la a dmar pos mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la thugs rdo rje la sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phan tshun thabs shes sbyor ba'i bde bas bskul te/

rdo rje gsum gyi lha yab yum las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'od dang 'od zer gyi klong du mer mer khyom khyom mgul mgul shig shig byung ste lus la thim pas bde stong gi nyams dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ rol mo dang bcas pas bde ba sbar zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrī āḥ a we sha ya ā āḥzhes dbab cing brtan par byas/ de ltar byin phab pa'i bde ba byang sems kyi bcud gsang snod du rtsal la sbyar ba sbyin zhing*/ 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi byang sems dkar zhing dngas// me long ye shes byin rlabs bcud// sngo zhing dwangs pa chos kyi dbyings// ser zhing brjid pa mnyam pa nyid// dmar zhing gsal ba so sor rtogs// ljang zhing 'tsher ba bya ba grub// sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi 'di// rigs kyi bu la sbyin pa yis// zag med bde bas lus gang zhing*// ye shes chen po 'bar gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dh-i tsit+ta ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes blud cing khar bzung ba la/ bdud rtsi'i ro ci 'dug dris/ lan 'don par mi nus te/ yid la dran kyang khar brjod du med pa myong stong gi ngo bor ngos sprad do// de nas mig dar bshus pa ni/ zhi ba byang sems kyi bdud rtsi la brten nas rang rig stong du ngos sprad pas zhi ba'i gsang dkyil mthong ba'i brda'o// gnyis pa khro bo'i gsang dbang ni/ slob ma la mig dar g.yogs cing*/ slob dpon rnams skad cig gis/ kun bzang yab yum gnas gyur pa la/ bud+dha he ru ka sku mdog smug nag khro bo'i cha byad can gar dgu dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin zhing*/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis bsgrad thabs kyi 'gying zhing brjid pa'i dpang du/ yum bud+dha kro ti shwa ri smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa dang 'khril sbyor gyi tshul/

thod skam gyi do shal dang gzig gi sham thabs can/ 08388863(chad)00000000 rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab yum me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gu lang dang dbang phyug la sogs dregs byed rtsegs pa'i khri'i steng du pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rdo rje brtsegs pa'i khri dang*/ pad nyi'i gdan la badz+ra he ru ka dang badz+ra kro ti shwa ri ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang gri gug mgrin par pad+ma rtsegs pa'i khri dang pad nyi'i gdan la pad+ma he ru ka dang pad+ma kro ti ma dbang mo/ g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang gri gug thugs kar 'khor lo brtsegs pa'i khri dang pad nyi'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo bud+dha he ru ka dang bud+dha kro ti shwa ri ma mthing nag g.yas 'khor lo gri gug phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs gong dang mtshungs pa/ phan tshun yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba rab tu rgyas pa dang*/ de rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu rnams su gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu zhing rab 'byams nas dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rigs lnga dang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang bar byon te/ rang rang gi lus la thim pas bde ba chen po ye shes kyi rol pas snang srid thams cad mer mer khyom khyom shig shig tu gyur nas dmigs shing rol mo drag tu bsgrag bde ba sbar ro// yi ge lnga dang oṃ āḥha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza hūm̐ sarba sid+dhi pha la ho/ a we sha ya ā ā āḥ zhes dbab cing brtan par byas la/ de ltar byin phab pas bde ba byang sems kyi bcud rnal 'byor lhung bzed du rtsal la/ bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba sbyin zhing 'di skad brjod do// hūm̐ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phyag rgya bzhi ldan khro mo yum// thabs chen dpa' bo bdag dang sbyar// yab yum gnyis med las byung ba'i// bde ba byang chub sems kyi dngos// snang stong zhing khams dag pa ru// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes sbyar ba'i// bde ba byang chub sems kyi bcud// gdod nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings// gnyis 'dzin dri ma'i mtha' las 'das// dus gsum mnyam nyid skur ston pa// dngos grub mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di// kro ta thabs chen stong nyid dang*// kro ti gnyis med bde ba'i ro// zung 'jug rdzas su rab sbyar te// ye shes lnga ldan 'od zer 'phro// su 'dod pa la sbyin par bya// thabs shes dngos grub 'di len pa/

sprin mthongs mkha' la nyi shar ltar// gang gis blangs pa bde chen thob// dam tshig rdzas kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥha ri ni saḥr tsa hrī yaḥtsit+ta hring hring dza hūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho// bod+dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes sbyin/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes ro myang zhing khar bzung ba la sngar ltar dri/ don yid la yod kyang brjod du med pa'i ro bro ba mchog tu gyur pa ni/ bdag gzhan gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'gags te/ de tshor stong du shar ba'i nyams bde bar 'bar ba'i ye shes de nyid rang rtsal rgyas pa khro bo'i gsang du ngos sprad do// de nas mig dar bsal ba ni/ khro bo'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsi la brten nas rang rig tshor stong du shar ba rdzas kyi nus pas bde bar 'bar bar rang rtsal du ngos sprad pa ni/ khro bo'i gsang dkyil mthong ba'i brda'o// de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs phung po khams dang skye mched ma lus pa bde gshegs zhi khro gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bzhugs pa/ yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rdzas gsang bas dbang bskur bas/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ rtsa rlung gi dri ma dag lam rtsa rlung gi gdams pa sgom pa dang*/ gsung gi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung zhing sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga brten pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// zhes dbang don bshad/ btang rag tshogs dang maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gsum pa ni/ rtsa tho las/ rab tu spros med kyi dbang la: rig ma'i lus rgya la brten nas bde ba stong par bstan pa zhi ba'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang ཿ me long gi dkyil 'khor la brten pa stong pa'i ngang las thams cad snang yang de'i rang bzhin stong par bstan nas khro bo'i sher dbang sems la bskur thabs so// zhes 'byung bas/ dus nam phyed dam tho rangs gi dus su/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus/

gsang snod kyi steng du/ me long skyon dang bral zhing mdzes pa dar gyi cod pan dang bcas pa bkod pa'i zhal bkab/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang mchod pa gsar du bshams la/ me long dang zung ma las bdag 'jug gi dbang blang zhing*/ spros med kyi dbang gi smin cing rtsa rlung 'byongs pa'i slob ma rnams kyi khrus byas la shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai ma bla ma gsang sngags 'dzin pa la// ltas dang rgod dang lag pa bcang*// sbyor sde'i phyag rgya rnam bzhi bde// dbang bzhi rdzogs phyir bdag gis dbul/ /las dang chos dang dam tshig rgya// phyag rgya chen po bzhi ston phyir// shes rab dbang bskur stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ bcom ldan bde chen chos kyi dbyings// rdo rje rnal 'byor mi phyed bdag /yang dag phyag rgya mchog grub pa// rdo rje rnal 'byor las ni byung*// bdag nyid chen po kun bdag nyid// mnga' bdag chen pos deng bdag stsol// shes rab ye shes thig le'i dbang*// bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab la/ bla mas/ kyai ho skal ldan rig mchog khyed rnams nyon// gsang sngags bla med thabs kyi lam// shes rab chen po'i tshul 'chang ba// mkha' gsang yangs pa'i bha ga'i klong*// rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po rnams// yang dag zhugs pa'i lam chen yin// lhun grub phyag rgya 'khor lo che// chos kyi phyag rgya rdo rje'i bdag /dam tshig phyag rgya rin chen gter// las kyi phyag rgya pad+ma 'khyil// 'phrin las phyag rgya lnga dang ldan// phyag rgya 'di rnams la brten nas// rtsa rlung thig le bsgom nus sam// zhes lan gsum du dri ba las/ kyai dbang mchog rgyal po bdag la dgongs// thig le'i nus pa tshad sbyin phyir// shes rab ye shes gsang ba che// bdag gis sgrub par spro lags pas/ shin tu spros med lam bstan 'tshal// zhes lan gsum du zhu/

de nas dam bsgrag pa ni// kyai ho skal ldan rigs mchog khyed rnams nyon// gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi// dam tshig bsrung bya sems la bzung*// theg chen sems bzung tshangs spyod gnas// phar phyin drug ldan shes rab yum// rigs lnga'i rtags ldan dpa' bo yab// yon tan thams cad 'di 'byung phyir// smod par mi bya yongs su gzung*// 'di dag spangs na rig 'dzin dang*// mkha' 'gro'i chad pas dmyal bar ltung*// phyag rgya bzhi yi mkha' dbyings 'di// bde ba sprul sku 'byung ba'i gnas// bde ba dor na sprul sku spang*// sprul sku mi ldan 'gro don 'chad// 'gro ba'i don du ma bcas na// 'khor ba'i sems can cang thag chad// drod bsher brdzus dang sgo nga la// brten nas byang chub mchog grub pa// sprul sku las ldan nyid las min// lha dang 'dab chags 'bu srin gyis// sku gsum 'bras bu 08388863(chad)00000000 mthong dka'// rang don mthar phyin byang sems kyi// rigs rgyud sprul skus 'gro don sbyangs// rang don mthar 'don gang zag gis// tshangs spyod don gnas ma byin blangs// de ltar gsang ba sngon phyung ba'i// dam tshig la ni gnas nus na// bu mchog khyod la dbang sbyin no// zhes dam bsgrag pa la/ nus na khas blang ba ni/ ho bla mas ji ltar bka' stsal ltar// shi'am srog la bab gyur zhing*// bya dga' chen pos 'drid byed kyang*// dam tshig bka' las yongs mi 'da'// zhes khas blangs/ bdud rtsi byin zhing*/ sa ma ya i dan+te na raka sau phag kha thaṃ/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas bu rnams bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing mdun du gral la bkod/ mig dar bkab la/ slob dpon bdag nyid pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la kun bzang sngon po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'i spang du yum kun tu bzang mo dmar mo gcer bu rgyan med yab la 'khril ba/

de la mar me gcig la gnyis 'chad kyi tshul du/ kun tu bzang mo gnyis pa zhig spros te mdun du gnas pa'i srin lag nas yab kyis bzung la/ slob ma rnams/ pad+ma'i nyi zla'i gdan la kun bzang yab kyang rkyang ??gi tshul du gsal btab la/ gzung ma gtad par mos shing*/ shes rab ma thabs sbyin par bya'o// de nas slob dpon 'di skad ces/ kye 08388863(chad)00000000 rgyal ba thams cad kyi// yang dag gsang ba rmad byung ba// shes rab ye shes dbang zhes bya// de ni mkha' dbyings 'di la brten// yum mkha' rgyal ba thams cad kyis// gsang sngags 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas// yum chen kun tu bzang mo ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i gnas// zhes dang bcu drug lo lon ma/ rdzogs sangs rgyas pa kun gyi yum// zhes dang btsun mo'i bha ga ru// bde gsal mi rtog ye shes kyi// zhes dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// bha ga'i dbyings nas rab byung gsung*// de bas stong pa'i yum spangs pa'i// snang ba sku dang thig le zhing*// rig pa'i ye shes rtsal rnams kun// 'char ba'i gzhi ni yod ma yin// de bas gsang ba'i mdzod chen 'di// bdag gi khyod la sbyin bya yis// bu yi dam tshig ldan par bzung*// zhes sbyin zhing*/ phyag rgyas/ nga yi mkha' gsang bde ba'i mdzod// me long ye shes rang mdangs 'char// mnyam pa nyid ni rang gsal ba'i// so sor rtog pa rang grol che// bya ba grub pa ye shes dbyings// thams cad chos kyi dbyings su sbyor// nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog tshogs kun// ye shes lnga ru sgrol bas e// gang zhig gsang sngags don ldan gang*// yon tan dngos grub 'di la byung*// zhes brjod cing*/ bla mas gtad de/ hūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan bde ba'i sku// kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' sbyin gyis// gsang ba sngags kyi sgrub sder mor/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyer la gus pas rtag tu mchod// dz+nyā pañtsa sarba mu dra su kha ho// de nas yab yum so sor sbyar zhing*/

dmigs dbog pa ni/ yab rnams kun bzang dang yum rnams kun tu bzang mor gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab kyi gsang ba zla dkyil gyi dbus su oṃ dkar po dang*/ yum gyi gsang ba nyi dkyil gyi dbus su muṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ dang muṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas bde ba g.yo ba ni/ gnas rnams kyi yi ge las 'od zer 'phros te/ ting nge 'dzin dag pa'i gnas mchog rnams nas/ bla ma zhi khro'i lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drang lus la thim pas/ lus kyang 'od du mer mer gyur pa la sems gtad cing*/ bde ba cher sbar te/ dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung dang*/ slar lugs bzlog gis dbab bzung ldog bgram la mkhas par bya zhing*/ rol mo cher bsgrag slob dpon gyi zhi khro byin dbab kyi sngags brjod brtan par byas la/ de'i don ngo sprod pa ni 'di skad do// hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon// de ltar thabs shes sbyar ba las// byung ba'i bde ba gang yin pa// dang po yid spro dga' ba ste// de las mchog dga' khyad par dga'// dga' bral lhan cig skyes pa ste// lugs 'byung srid pa'i bde ba'o// de la dum tsam mnyam bzhag pas// srid pa 'khor ba ye shes sbyor// de las bzlog pa'i 'gros rnam bzhi// lugs ldog mya ngan 'das pa ste// dam pa'i don du lhan skyes bde// dbyer med bde ba stong pa'i dbyings// de la bcu drug rnam byed sogs// dpag med 'gyur gyi bye brag kyang*// de ni bde ba'i ye shes su// ngo bo gcig te thams cad du// stong pa nyid las gzung du med// mtshan ma med cing spros dang bral// mchog mtha' dga' bral dang po ni// mun pa nang gi snang ba bzhin// bu yi don 'di shes par gyis// tshig lhug pas kyang bkrol te bshad de/ de nas mig dar bsal ba ni zhi ba rig ma'i lus rgya la brten nas rang rig bde stong du ngos sprad pas/

zhi ba'i shes rab ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda' yin no// gnyis pa khro bo'i gsang dbang ji ltar bya ba ni slob ma mig dar dang bcas/ slob dpon skad cig gis kun bzang yab yum du gnas gyur pa'i/ bud+dha he ru ka sku mdog smug nag khro bo'i cha byad can gar dgu dang ldan pa/ zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa/ zhabs bsgrad thabs kyi 'gying ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug gu lang khyab 'jug la sogs pa dregs byed thams cad brtsegs pa'i khri'i steng du pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ badz+ra he ru ka gtso bor gyur pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan dang bcas pa'i lte bar g.yung drung ri dmar po g.yas su 'khor ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro bzhin par bsgom/ slob dpon bud+dha he ru kar gsal ba'i dpang du yum bud+dha kro ti shwa ri ma smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa dang 'khril sbyor gyi tshul/ thod skam gyi do shal dang gzig gi sham thabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan can du gsal ba'i yum de las mar me gcig la gnyis chad dam/ las yum la bstim zhing so sor sbyar bas bde ba g.yo ba na/ lte ba'i g.yung drung g.yas su drag tu 'khor zhing*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad bud+dha zhi khro'i lha tshogs nam mkha' khengs par spyan drangs lus la thim pas/ yab yum gyi lus kyang 'od du mer mer zhu ba la sems gtad cing bde ba sbar te/ lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dbab bzung bzlog bgram mkhas par bya zhing*/ rol mo cher sgrog slob dpon gyi hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing ting nge 'dzin gyi byin dbab/ brtan par byas la sngon du myong ba'i bde ba gang*/ de'i don dpe mtshon te ngos sprad pa ni/

me long thogs te 'di skad do// kyai ho skal ldan bu rnams rna gtad 'tshal/ sngon du myong ba'i bde ba gang*// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las// rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel gyi// rang rig stong gsal mtha' bral te// bde bar rnam par shar gyur te// dga' bzhi lugs dang lugs bzlog gis// bde ba'i ngo bo stong par bstan// rang don mthar phyin gdams pa ste// de las rtsal chen gzhan rjes 'dzin// 'khor 'das thabs shes ma gyur med// de phyir stong las bde ba 'bar// gnas skabs rgyu yi byang chub sems// dkar po gsal zhing 'bar ba dang*// dmar po 'tsher zhing bkrag pa ni// slar yang drangs pas bde ba che// rab 'bar ye shes rtsal chen ni// 'khor ba 'das shing myang 'das sgrol// don dam zag med bde chen po// de yang dpe ni me long nang*// rang bzhin stong yang rnam pa dwangs// gzugs kyi bye brag 'char ba bzhin// bde ba'i rang bzhin stong pa las// slar la bde chen mi btang ba// bde chen ye shes rgyun chad med// ye shes chen po 'du ???'bral med// zung 'jug chen po'i mtha' las 'das// dus kun 'gyur med bde chen sku// rang dngas sgrib med bde chen gsung*// rtog bral spros bral bde chen thugs// 'di nyid don dang ldan gyur na// 'khor ba bral zhing myang 'das zhi// zhi bral bde chen chos kyi sku// zhes dang*/ tshig lhug pas kyang don bkral te man ngag gi gnad bstan no// de nas mig dar bsal ba ni/ khro bo shes rab me long gi rdzas la brten nas/ stong pa'i ngang las thams cad lhar snang yang*/ de'-i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du ngo sprad pas/ khro bo'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i brda' yin no// de ltar las kyi phyag rgya dang ming ngo la brten nas spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gnyis mthong*/ yid thig le'i sgrib pa dag

lam nor bu 'gengs shing las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa byas so// zhes don bshad cing gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi dga' ston bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ rtsa tho las/ shin tu spros med kyi dbang la: me shel dang sku 'bag gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas 'dzin pa'i sems stong par bstan pa zhi ba'i tshig dbang dang : de'i rang mdangs gsal stong du bstan pa khro bo'i dbang bzhi pa lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med la bskur thabs so: zhes 'byung bas/ tho rangs sam nam langs kyi dus su/ gong gi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ man shel dang sku 'bag bkod pa'i mtha' mchod pa dang tshogs kyi yo byad bkod pas mdzes par bya/ slob ma dbang gsum gyi rgyud sbyangs shing*/ phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la nges pa rnyed pa rnams/ khrus byas la shin tu spros med tshig dbang zhu ba'i don du sman 'bru rin po che la sogs kyi maṇ+ḍal phul te/ mig dar dang bcas nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ khyed zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// dbang bskur rim pa rnam gsum thob// slar la de don ngos sprod pa// tshig dbang gis ni grol bar 'tshal// sman 'bru rin chen maṇ+ḍal dbul// ka dag rang byung ngo sprad cing*// bla med mchog gi dbang bskur ba// nges par don de bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa la/ bla mas dam bsgrag cing mna' chu blud pa ni/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin zhing 'di skad do/ hūm̐ bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig mchog /thams cad chos dbyings ro gcig pa'i// spang blang bral ba'i dam tshig las/ khyed kyi 'das na 'khor bar ltung*// sa ma ya i dan te na raka kan/ zhes bdud rtsi btung ngo*// de nas dpon slob rnams rnam snang chos bdun bca' zhing*/ bla mas dmigs pa sprod pa ni/ rang re thams cad gnas pa'i yul ris dang rgyal khams sa phyogs dang khang khyim thams cad 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhin du 'khyil zhing mer ba'i dbus su/

rang dang thams cad kyang thig le kha dog lnga ldan sran ma tsam re re'i dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo g.yung drung ris dkar po kha dog rab tu 'tsher ba re re g.yon du drag tu 'khor bas snang srid kyi 'od snang thams cad 'ub 'ub 'dus te thig le la thim/ thig le yang je chung je chung la song bas mthar dbyer med pa stong pa nyid gyur pa la sems gtod cig ces brda' sbyar ste/ rol mo drag tu byas pas stong pa'i nyams rtsol med du 'char bar 'gyur te/ ka dag gi byin dbab bo// de nyid la phaṭa ces brjod pas/ rang gsal du rjen bzhag pa ni brtan par bya ba'o// de la don ngo sprad pa ni/ slob ma rnams la ye shes ji lta ba phebs pa de las mi sems par bcos med du zhogs la sgra lhang tsam du rna bar gtod cig ces mtshams sbyar la 'di skad ces/ man shel dang sku 'bag thogs te/ kyai skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams bdag la gson// de ltar dmigs pa'i bye brag kyang*// thog mar ka dag rang dbyings las// lhun grub 'od snang phyir shar bas// snang srid 'od dang thig ler bsgom// rang lus thig ler gsal ba ni// bdag 'dzin bzung 'dzin sgrib byang phyir// rig pa g.yung drung 'khor bas bsdus// ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su yal// dmigs med bzhag pas bde zhing gsal// mi rtog ye shes lhang nger 'char// 'bol le shig se lhan ne gnas// gshis kyi gnas lugs de yin no// kyai ma bu rnams 'di ltar byos// gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bu dang*// 'gyu dran rlung dmar lta bu gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir// rlung mig sems gsum nam mkhar gtod// rang sor lhod la bcos med zhog /de ltar bzhag na gol sa med// chos sku zangs thal grub par gyur// rang bzhin skye med nam mkha'i ngang*// ka dag chos sku yid byed med// 'di ltar sgom med ngang nyid las// 'da' med yengs med ngang nyid du// rtsol bral ye shes lhun grub ngang*// ma yengs sa ler bzhag par bya// ma bcos ngang la stong sang nge*// gang yang 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang*// ma bsgyur ba la bde lhan no// gang yang mi sems mi smin par// sa le hrig ge dwangs sang nge/

gnyug ma'i ngang du rang sar zhog /rang bab ngang la lhod de zhog /de ltar bzhag pa'i dus kyi tshe// mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho 'dra// gsal stong dbyer med nam mkha' 'dra// zung 'jug du ma ro gcig ngang*// ma yengs ngang la lhan ne ba// rig pa ka dag ngang la zhog /yang skal ldan bu rnams nyon cig /gong du phyag rgya las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi don/ bde stong zung 'jug nam mkha' lta bu rang shar ba 'di ni/ rgyar chad pa dang phyogs su lhung ba med par/ rang bzhin gnas kyi ngang de nyid las/ ma yengs par gsal seng nge*/ rig pa rjen par zhog cig gsal le/ sing nge*/ yer re/ stong gsal chen paur zhog stong nge*/ mer re/ 'khyil le rang rang bab kyi ngang la zhog mi spro/ mi bsdu/ mi bsgom/ bden med kyi ngang la zhog snang shes 'di rnams bden med/ bun ne/ sgom med du khros se khrigs se???/ rtsol med du shigs se/ rang bab du lhod de/ rjes med du khrol le/ 'di ni gzhi khregs chod kyi lta ba zhes bya'o// de la gang gis kyang ma slad pa'i rig pa dwangs sal le ba/ wa le ba/ rtog bral gyi ye shes 'di ltos dang*/ gsal yang rtog pa med pa/ nam mkha' dwangs par nyi ma shar bas/ nam mkha'i yul du mthong bya gzhan med kyang*/ dngas sal le 'byung ba bzhin du mthong bya gzhan med kyang*/ rig pa'i go ma 'gag par 'khor 'das kun sa ler gsal ba 'di spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes lhag mthong zhes bya'o// de nas mig dar bsal ba ni rig pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda'o// de ltar mtshon pa tshig gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes ngo sprod pa'i shin tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che bskur bas/ sgo gsum gyi rtog tshogs tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ lam khregs chod kyi phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes bshad cing gtang rag gi tshogs 'khor dang*/

maṇ+ḍal kyang dbul lo// lnga pa ni rtsa tho las/ kun tu spros med kyi dbang la: snang ba dang mun pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas brda' don gsum du ngo sprad pas: rig pa ye shes kyi rang zhal mngon sum du ston pa zhi khro dbyer med rig pa'i ngo bor bskur thabs so: zhes 'byung bas/ dus nyi ma shar ba'i dus/ gnas mun khang snang mun gyi dbye ba phyed par/ slob bu shin tu spros med la nges gsang rnyed pa rnams khrus byas/ rdo rje slob dpon la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ don gyi rtogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai sku gsum ston pa rgyal ba'i mtshan// 'khor 'das dbyer med bde bar gshegs// ma bcos lhun rdzogs bcom ldan 'das// slob dpon mchog la bdag skyabs mchi// bdag cag skal ldan slob ma rnams// gang gis khyod zhabs bka' drin las// bum pa'i dbang gi lus smin cing*// gsang ba'i dbang gi ngag sgrib sbyangs// shes rab ye shes bde chen rnyed// bzhi pa'i don gyi mtha' ru phyin// ka dag rig pa'i gdengs ldan kyang*// 'khor 'das rig grol rang rtsal dbang : bdag cag rnams la bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum du zhu zhing*/ spros med kyi las kyang don gyi gsal 'debs gang yang rung bas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed/ yan lag bcu'am bdun gyi tshogs bsag rgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas/ dam tshig dbog pa ni/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing 'di skad ces/ hūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi 'di// dam tshig rdo rje mchog gi chu/ khyod la sbyin gyis thub par bsrungs// sa ma ya dha thim: zhes btung ngo*// de nas dam tshig brjod pa ni/ kyai ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon// spros pa kun las yongs 'das pa'i// lam gyi dam tshig gang zhe na// lus kyi bya byed thams cad bor// glang seng drang srong bzhugs stangs byos// ngag gi brjod pa thams cad spongs// rlung gnad dal ba nyid la slob// sems kyi rtog tshogs thams cad spongs// dbyings kyi dbus su rig pa zhog

/de ni lus kyi sku gsum 'grub// ngag gi gsung dbyangs pha rol phyin// sems ni bde gshegs mnyam nyid thugs// de las 'das na 'gro drug gi// sdug bsngal gyis ni kun tu mnar// de bas dam las ma 'da' zhig /ces brjod do// de nas dbang dngos bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi 'di skad ces/ kyai ho skal ldan bu rnams bdag la nyon// phyi dang nang zhes gnyis su med pa'i khar// yang dag rdo rje'i rig pa sku gsum bzhugs// gsal zhing 'tsher la 'gyur bong lug gu rgyud// lhun grub ye shes sbubs su dbang bskur ro// zhes dang*/ sgo yi gnad bzlog phob zur gyis khrid pa'i gnad dang bcas te ngo sprad pa ni/ ho skal ldan bu 08388863(chad)00000000 sa nyon/ lus kyi gzigs stangs bcun pa las// mig gi sgom pa'i sgron ma ni// nam mkha'i dbyings su snang gyur te// 'ja' 'am rma bya'i mdongs ltar gsal// thig le thig phran lu gu rgyud// 'gul zhing 'phrig pa yal yul lo// kun tu rgyu zhing lding ba'i tshul// stong zhing gsal la bkrags mdangs ldan// mu tig 'phreng ba lta bu'am// me tog chun 'phyang bcangs pa 'dra// lhang lhang tsher tsher kun tu 'phro// de ni mi gnas ye shes che// rig pa rdo rje'i sku zhes bya// mngon sum snang ba'i ye shes ni// 'di nyid yin no ma yengs cig /'di 'dzin med do lta shes na// skye 'chi med pa'i 'od lus 'grub// 'gag med rang grol chos sku zin// 'khor 'das chos zhes sa lam rdzogs// thams cad mngon sum 'dir snang bas// chos nyid mngon sum zhes bya'o// zhes ngo sprad cing*/ de mthar phyin pa na nyams gong 'phel dang rig pa tshad phebs chos nyid zad pa'i brda dbang bya ba ni/ zhi khro'i 'bag dang dang 'phan dar/ me long la sogs lag len ltar bshams pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long la klan zhing bstan te/ kyai ho rigs kyi bu rnams ltos// nam mkha'i dbyings su bltas pa'i tshe// rang gzugs smin pa zhi khro'i tshogs/

kha dog ma 'dres so sor snang*// rang rang cha 'dzin gar nyams bsgyur// 'ja' dang 'od khyim kun nas 'phro// gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// dbyer med blo 'das dbang thob shog /ces dang*/ kyai ho skal ldan bu rnams nyon// gong gi mngon sum la goms pas// nyams snang gong du 'phel ba ni// rang gi smin prag thig le ni// stong pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba// 'ja'am rma bya'i mdongs 'dra 'char// de ni nam mkhar bral gyur te// sran ma tsam gyi 'od zer 'bar// de dang de las 'od kyi tshogs// dus gsum gyen 'greng rtsibs shar dang*// bdud rtsi za 'og gur khyim tshul// stong sgron 'od dkar mdun rgyab 'char// rig pa lu gu rgyud kyi sku// 'dab chags 'phur ba ji bzhin du// yang chod yad yud gyu ba tsam// nyi zla rin chen drwa mig dang*// mkhar thabs pad+ma nya mig ris// me lce dang ni phub 'dra'i 'od// rig pa ri dwags rgyug pa ltar// lu gu rgyud ni bring tsam rgyu// thig le la bor bse sbug tsam// yang na rig pa lu gu rgyud// bung ba bcud lding ji lta ba// stong gsum gang ba'i 'od la chags// de las dbyings rig mi 'bral bar// zhi dang khro bo ma nges pa'i/ phyed sku sku rkyang yab yum tshul// tshom bu lnga gsum grangs med par// 'gul 'phrig mi byed gang gtad sdod// gar ltas 'od kyi sku ru gsal// 'di mthong bar do med par ni// phung po lhag med sangs rgya bo// gong gi chos nyid mngon sum du// mthong ba'i snang bar 'char bas na// nyams snang gong 'phel zhes bya'o// de nas thig le re re'i nang*// rigs lnga'i sku dang zhing khams kun// bgrang zhing gzhal ba mi lang 'char// rang rig tshad la phebs pa ste// chos sku'i snang ba rang chas shing*// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mtshan dpes rdzogs/ kha dog ma nges sna tshogs pa'i// sprul pa sku yi snang brnyan ston// sku gsum zhing khams rtsal rdzogs shing*// gdos bcas phung pos 'od lus mnyes// rten dang brten pa mngon gyur pa'i// rig pa tshad phebs zhes bya'o// de nas gong gi 'od snang bas// sku dang zhing khams rtags tshad kun// 'phel rgyu med par kun nas zad// nyams snang 'char sgo'i 'khrul pa zad// lus dang dbang po'i sgor mi snang*// las zad 'khrul pa'i yul kyang zad// rtog tshogs gnyis 'dzin dri ma zad// brjod bya rjod byed tshig mtha' zad// thog ma'i gzhi ru rang log pa// chos nyid zad pa zhes bya ste// 'bras bu mthar phyin sangs rgya'o// zhes ngo sprad/
